papers.title: FedA2L: Adaptive layer-wise learning rate adjustment in decentralized federated learning
papers.abstract: Decentralized intelligence systems with heterogeneous devices and limited coordination increasingly rely on decentralized federated learning (DFL). However, DFL suffers from convergence inefficiency under data heterogeneity due to the use of a uniform learning rate (LR) that ignores layer-specific optimization needs. Foundational layers are responsible for maintaining network consensus, while specialized layers adapt to local data characteristics, leading to conflicting gradients and degraded performance under non-IID conditions. To address this fundamental tension, this work introduces FedA2L, a method that dynamically adjusts layer-wise LRs based on model divergence signals. By leveraging local update intensity and network consensus constraints, FedA2L seamlessly integrates into existing DFL protocols without additional communication or coordination. Extensive evaluations across DFL algorithms, various model architectures, and datasets demonstrate that FedA2L achieves up to 4.94 times faster convergence than vanilla DFL and reduces communication rounds by up to 59% compared to scheduler-based baselines. Furthermore, FedA2L exhibits resilience to severe data heterogeneity, larger network sizes, and sparse topologies, reducing communication overhead and establishing it as a versatile optimization tool for resource-constrained or large-scale distributed learning in edge and IoT deployments. The code is released at https://github.com/nclabteam/FedA2L.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景与挑战**：去中心化联邦学习（DFL）在异构设备与有限协调条件下，常因数据异构（Non-IID）导致收敛效率低下。传统方法采用统一学习率（LR），忽略了不同网络层对优化的差异化需求——基础层需维持全局共识，而专用层需适应本地数据特性，由此引发梯度冲突与性能退化。  

**方法创新**：本文提出 **FedA2L**，一种基于模型发散信号动态调整逐层学习率的自适应方法。FedA2L 利用本地更新强度与网络共识约束，无需额外通信或协调即可无缝集成至现有 DFL 协议，有效缓解层间优化冲突。  

**关键结果**：在多种 DFL 算法、模型架构与数据集上的实验表明，FedA2L 相比标准 DFL 收敛速度提升最高 **4.94 倍**，相比基于调度器的基线减少最多 **59% 的通信轮次**。此外，该方法在严重数据异构、大规模网络及稀疏拓扑下表现出强鲁棒性，显著降低通信开销，适用于资源受限或大规模边缘计算与物联网部署。  

**意义与开源**：FedA2L 为去中心化学习提供了一种轻量级、通用且高效的优化工具。代码已开源（https://github.com/nclabteam/FedA2L）。
papers.summary_en: **FedA2L** addresses convergence inefficiency in decentralized federated learning (DFL) under data heterogeneity by adaptively adjusting layer-wise learning rates based on model divergence signals. Unlike uniform learning rates that cause gradient conflicts between consensus-maintaining and local-adapting layers, FedA2L dynamically balances optimization needs without extra communication or coordination. Extensive experiments show it accelerates convergence by up to **4.94×** over vanilla DFL and reduces communication rounds by up to **59%** compared to scheduler baselines. FedA2L remains robust under severe heterogeneity, larger networks, and sparse topologies, making it a versatile solution for resource-constrained edge and IoT deployments. Code: https://github.com/nclabteam/FedA2L.

**背景与挑战**：去中心化联邦学习（DFL）在异构设备与有限协调条件下，常因数据异构（Non-IID）导致收敛效率低下。传统方法采用统一学习率（LR），忽略了不同网络层对优化的差异化需求——基础层需维持全局共识，而专用层需适应本地数据特性，由此引发梯度冲突与性能退化。  

**方法创新**：本文提出 **FedA2L**，一种基于模型发散信号动态调整逐层学习率的自适应方法。FedA2L 利用本地更新强度与网络共识约束，无需额外通信或协调即可无缝集成至现有 DFL 协议，有效缓解层间优化冲突。  

**关键结果**：在多种 DFL 算法、模型架构与数据集上的实验表明，FedA2L 相比标准 DFL 收敛速度提升最高 **4.94 倍**，相比基于调度器的基线减少最多 **59% 的通信轮次**。此外，该方法在严重数据异构、大规模网络及稀疏拓扑下表现出强鲁棒性，显著降低通信开销，适用于资源受限或大规模边缘计算与物联网部署。  

**意义与开源**：FedA2L 为去中心化学习提供了一种轻量级、通用且高效的优化工具。代码已开源（https://github.com/nclabteam/FedA2L）。

papers.title: SiriusDeliver: Automating Data Warehouse Delivery at Tencent
papers.abstract: Enterprise data warehouses (DWs) support business-critical analytics, but warehouse task delivery remains a complicated production process involving context retrieval, workflow configuration, code generation, platform submission, and failure diagnosis. Although large language models (LLMs) and coding agents have improved software development, they are insufficient for production DW delivery, which requires dependency-aware orchestration, lifecycle-aware artifact control, and continuous adaptation to evolving platform practices. We present SiriusDeliver, an end-to-end delivery automation agent for production warehouse task submission. SiriusDeliver integrates three components: a hierarchical delivery agent that orchestrates warehouse skills, an artifact lifecycle control module that verifies and revises artifacts before and after platform execution, and a trace-driven skill evolution mechanism that maintains reusable skills from delivery trajectories. We evaluate SiriusDeliver through offline datasets and large-scale production deployment on Tencent Cloud WeData. Offline experiments on real-world warehouse delivery cases show that SiriusDeliver improves delivery success and automation efficiency over representative baselines. During a two-month deployment across 6 business teams and 4 warehouse task types, SiriusDeliver served 3,600 monthly active users and supported 18,240 delivery sessions, achieving an 87.2% end-to-end success rate and a 73.5% autonomous submission rate. A one-month A/B test shows that SiriusDeliver reduces median delivery time from 228 to 23 minutes and engineer effort from 95 to 11 minutes, while maintaining comparable final delivery success.
papers.summary_zh:
## 摘要

企业数据仓库（DW）支撑着关键业务分析，但其任务交付仍是复杂生产流程，涉及上下文检索、工作流配置、代码生成、平台提交与故障诊断。尽管大语言模型（LLM）与编码智能体已提升软件开发效率，却难以胜任生产级DW交付——该场景要求依赖感知的编排、生命周期感知的工件管控，以及对平台实践演进的持续适应。

为此，我们提出**SiriusDeliver**，一个面向生产仓库任务提交的端到端交付自动化智能体。其核心包含三大组件：
- **分层交付智能体**：统筹仓库技能编排，拆解复杂任务；
- **工件生命周期管控模块**：在平台执行前后对工件进行验证与修正，确保质量；
- **轨迹驱动技能进化机制**：从交付轨迹中提炼并维护可复用技能，实现持续自适应。

我们在离线数据集及腾讯云WeData的大规模生产部署中评估了SiriusDeliver。基于真实仓库交付案例的离线实验表明，其交付成功率与自动化效率均优于代表性基线。在为期两个月、覆盖6个业务团队与4类仓库任务的部署中，SiriusDeliver服务了3,600名月活用户，支撑18,240次交付会话，实现**87.2%的端到端成功率**与**73.5%的自主提交率**。为期一个月的A/B测试显示，SiriusDeliver将交付中位耗时从228分钟降至23分钟，工程师投入从95分钟降至11分钟，同时保持相当的最终交付成功率。

**创新点**在于：首次将分层智能体编排与生命周期工件管控结合，用于生产DW交付；通过轨迹驱动机制实现技能的自适应进化，有效应对平台实践变化。该系统已在腾讯大规模落地，验证了其实际价值。

## Abstract

We present **SiriusDeliver**, an end-to-end delivery automation agent for production warehouse task submission. papers.title: Agentic Router: An Execution-Grounded Continual Learning Approach With Memory
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents provide a promising interface for command-line-based network operations, but a plausible command may still fail or introduce operational risk after execution. Existing approaches mainly focus on command generation or final configuration correctness, and do not use execution-grounded experience to jointly improve candidate coverage and action selection. We propose an execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent for CLI-based SONiC operations, which generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action through utility- and risk-aware reranking. The proposal-side path abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the proposal LLM, while the selection-side path adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback to improve conditional selection quality. Experiments over multi-turn SONiC operation sessions with different Qwen3 proposal models show that the framework improves feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, and that the two adaptation paths provide complementary gains over interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景与挑战**：大语言模型（LLM）智能体为基于命令行的网络运维提供了有前景的交互接口，但一个看似合理的命令在执行后仍可能失败或引入运维风险。现有方法主要聚焦于命令生成或最终配置的正确性，未能利用执行反馈（execution-grounded experience）来同时改进候选命令的覆盖范围与动作选择质量。  
**方法创新**：本文提出一种**执行驱动的双路径后果感知智能体**（Execution-Grounded Dual-Path Consequence-Aware Agent），用于基于CLI的SONiC系统运维。该框架的核心流程为：① 生成多个完整动作候选；② 预测每个候选的执行后果；③ 通过效用与风险感知的重新排序选择最终动作。其关键创新体现在两条互补的适应路径上：  
- **提案侧路径**：将可复用的运维经验抽象为可检索的指导性知识，在不修改底层提案LLM的前提下提升可行动作的覆盖率；  
- **选择侧路径**：利用真实SSH反馈，通过会话级LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）更新来持续适配后果预测器，从而提升条件选择质量。  
**实验与结果**：在多轮SONiC运维会话中，使用不同规模的Qwen3提案模型进行验证。结果表明：① 该框架显著提升了可行动作覆盖率与Top-1执行成功率；② 两条适应路径在交互过程中提供了互补性增益，即联合使用效果优于任一单独路径。  
**意义**：该工作为LLM智能体在真实网络运维中的可靠执行提供了新范式，强调了“预测后果”与“持续学习”在闭环决策中的核心价值。
papers.summary_en: This paper proposes an **execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent** for CLI-based SONiC network operations. Unlike prior work focusing only on command generation or final configuration correctness, our framework generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action via utility- and risk-aware reranking. Two complementary adaptation paths are introduced: a proposal-side path that abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the LLM, and a selection-side path that adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback. Experiments on multi-turn SONiC sessions with different Qwen3 models show significant improvements in feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, with the two paths providing complementary gains over interaction. This work demonstrates the importance of consequence prediction and continual learning for reliable LLM-agent deployment in real-world network operations.

papers.title: Rethinking Medical Landmark Localization with Prototype Learning-based Progressive Offset Correction
papers.abstract: Accurate landmark localization in medical images is a fundamental step for quantitative clinical measurement and downstream analysis. Existing localization methods have advanced, among which multi-stage refinement is a superior solution. Although this strategy mitigates the anatomical ambiguity inherent in single-stage global predictions, its high computational cost limits practical applicability. In this work, we propose a parameter-economic model, PPOC-LL, which leverages Prototype learning-based Progressive Offset Correction for Landmark Localization. Our contribution is three-fold. First, to drive coarse-to-fine landmark optimization, we introduce a multi-scale dynamic perception strategy for patch-level feature pyramid modeling. Second, to effectively handle anatomically similar patterns, we design a similarity-driven prototype learning mechanism that captures informative local semantics for robust offset prediction. Last, to stabilize the model learning and improve the overall performance, we incorporate a novel error-aware reliability regularization via tolerance-based balancing. We collected a large validation cohort, including two public and one private datasets spanning X-ray and ultrasound modalities, covering cephalometric, symphysis-fetal head, and fetal heart landmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PPOC-LL achieves satisfactory performance with a favorable trade-off between accuracy and model complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景**：医学图像中的标志点精确定位是临床定量测量与下游分析的基础步骤。现有方法中，多阶段细化策略虽能缓解单阶段全局预测的解剖模糊性，但其高计算成本限制了实际应用。  
**方法**：本文提出参数高效的 **PPOC-LL** 模型，基于原型学习的渐进式偏移校正。核心贡献有三：  
1. **多尺度动态感知策略**：构建 patch 级特征金字塔，驱动粗到细的标志点优化；  
2. **相似性驱动原型学习机制**：捕获信息丰富的局部语义，稳健处理解剖相似模式；  
3. **误差感知可靠性正则化**：通过容差平衡稳定训练并提升整体性能。  
**数据与结果**：在涵盖 X 射线与超声的 3 个数据集（2 个公开、1 个私有）上验证，涉及头影测量、胎头联合及胎儿心脏标志点。实验表明，PPOC-LL 在精度与模型复杂度间取得了良好平衡，性能优于现有方法。  
**结论**：该工作为医学标志点定位提供了一种高效、稳健的解决方案，尤其适用于计算资源受限的临床场景。
papers.summary_en:
**Objective**: Accurate medical landmark localization is crucial for clinical quantification. We propose **PPOC-LL**, a parameter-economic model using prototype learning-based progressive offset correction to balance accuracy and efficiency.  
**Methods**: Three innovations: (1) multi-scale dynamic perception for coarse-to-fine feature pyramid modeling; (2) similarity-driven prototype learning to handle anatomically similar patterns; (3) error-aware reliability regularization with tolerance-based balancing.  
**Results**: Evaluated on three datasets (X-ray and ultrasound) covering cephalometric, fetal head, and fetal heart landmarks. PPOC-LL achieves superior accuracy with significantly reduced model complexity compared to multi-stage refinement baselines.  
**Conclusion**: The method offers a practical, high-performance solution for landmark localization in resource-limited clinical settings.

papers.title: From Relevance to Execution Utility: Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gating for Skill-Based LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Agent skills are increasingly used to equip large language model (LLM) agents with reusable procedural knowledge. Although recent work has substantially improved skill retrieval due to the increasing skill libraries, retrieving a plausible skill bundle does not guarantee that executing it is worthwhile. Since every skill-conditioned rollout is computationally expensive, deciding whether a retrieved bundle should be executed has become an increasingly important challenge. To this end, we introduce the Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate (RADEG), a lightweight, retriever-agnostic decision layer between skill retrieval and agent execution. RADEG learns a low-cost surrogate model that predicts the execution utility of a query--bundle pair before the expensive rollout is launched. To obtain informative supervision while controlling for task difficulty, we locally perturb each retrieved bundle by deleting, adding, or replacing one skill, producing matched same-query rollouts that isolate the effect of bundle composition on verifier reward. During deployment, RADEG updates only a warm-started logistic head as new verifier feedback becomes available, enabling inexpensive adaptation of the execute/skip boundary without retraining either the retriever or the agent. Under a query-level held-out evaluation on 288 collected rollouts, RADEG substantially reduces unnecessary agent executions while preserving a large fraction of the downstream verifier reward. It consistently outperforms relevance-based and random gating across different execution budgets, demonstrating that execution-aware surrogate modeling provides a practical and cost-effective complement to skill retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
技能库的不断扩充显著提升了大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的技能检索能力，但**检索到合理的技能组合并不等于执行它就值得**。由于每次技能条件化 rollout 的计算成本高昂，如何决定是否执行检索到的技能包，已成为一个日益重要的实际挑战。

## 方法创新
本文提出**奖励感知动态执行门控（RADEG）**，一种轻量级、与检索器无关的决策层，置于技能检索与智能体执行之间。RADEG 的核心思想是：
- 学习一个低成本的**代理模型**，在昂贵 rollout 启动前预测“查询-技能包”对的执行效用；
- 通过**局部扰动**（删除、添加或替换一个技能）生成匹配的同查询 rollout，隔离技能组合对验证器奖励的影响，从而获得信息丰富的监督信号并控制任务难度；
- 部署阶段仅更新**热启动的逻辑回归头**，利用新验证反馈低成本调整执行/跳过边界，无需重训检索器或智能体。

## 主要结果与贡献
在 288 个收集 rollout 的查询级留出评估中，RADEG 显著减少了不必要的智能体执行，同时保留了大部分下游验证器奖励。在不同执行预算下，它一致优于基于相关性和随机门控的基线。这表明**执行感知的代理建模**为技能检索提供了实用且经济的补充，有效解决了“检索成功但执行低效”的痛点。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We introduce **RADEG (Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate)**, a lightweight, retriever-agnostic decision layer that sits between skill retrieval and agent execution for LLM agents. RADEG learns a low-cost surrogate model to predict the execution utility of a query-bundle pair *before* expensive rollouts are launched. Supervision is obtained via local perturbation (delete/add/replace one skill) of retrieved bundles, creating matched same-query rollouts that isolate bundle-composition effects on verifier reward. During deployment, only a warm-started logistic head is updated with new verifier feedback, enabling cheap adaptation of the execute/skip boundary.

## Key Results
On query-level held-out evaluation with 288 rollouts, RADEG substantially reduces unnecessary executions while preserving most downstream verifier reward, consistently outperforming relevance-based and random gating across execution budgets. This demonstrates that execution-aware surrogate modeling offers a practical, cost-effective complement to skill retrieval, addressing the gap between retrieval quality and execution value.

- 部署阶段仅更新**热启动的逻辑回归头**，利用新验证反馈低成本调整执行/跳过边界，无需重训检索器或智能体。

## 主要结果与贡献
在 288 个收集 rollout 的查询级留出评估中，RADEG 显著减少了不必要的智能体执行，同时保留了大部分下游验证器奖励。在不同执行预算下，它一致优于基于相关性和随机门控的基线。这表明**执行感知的代理建模**为技能检索提供了实用且经济的补充，有效解决了“检索成功但执行低效”的痛点。

papers.title: Tabular Numeric Stretch Transformation
papers.abstract: Tabular data presents unique challenges for deep learning due to its heterogeneous nature, where numeric features exhibit diverse distributions, scales, and statistical properties. Although recent advances have improved how models learn from tabular data, how numeric data are transformed into model-friendly representations remains comparatively underexplored. We introduce the stretch transformation framework, which formulates numeric feature preprocessing as an optimization problem to make the target function smoother and thus more learnable. Our framework has two variants: (1) unsupervised stretch, which uniformly redistributes feature density via minimax optimization, and (2) supervised stretch, which optimizes target-aware numeric feature transformations from the perspective of target-function smoothness by minimizing the target function's Dirichlet energy in the transformed space. Our theoretical analysis further connects this framework to several popular transformations: unsupervised stretch is closely related to Piecewise Linear Encoding through a shared piecewise-linear geometry and approaches the empirical CDF transformation as the number of bins grows, while supervised stretch becomes closely related to target encoding in the fine-binning limit. Comprehensive experiments on 38 datasets from the TALENT benchmark demonstrate that supervised stretch consistently outperforms all baselines. These results show that explicitly optimizing for target function smoothness is a powerful and underexplored strategy for tabular deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
表格数据因数值特征分布多样、尺度不一，给深度学习带来独特挑战。现有方法多关注模型架构改进，但对数值特征如何转化为模型友好表示这一基础问题研究不足。本文提出**拉伸变换框架**，将数值特征预处理形式化为优化问题，通过使目标函数更平滑来提升模型可学习性。

## 方法框架
框架包含两种变体：
- **无监督拉伸**：通过极小极大优化均匀重分布特征密度，与分段线性编码共享分段线性几何结构，随分箱数增加趋近于经验CDF变换。
- **监督拉伸**：从目标函数平滑性出发，通过最小化变换空间中目标函数的Dirichlet能量，优化目标感知的数值特征变换。

## 理论贡献
理论分析揭示了该框架与多种主流变换的内在联系：无监督拉伸与分段线性编码、经验CDF变换的等价关系；监督拉伸在细分箱极限下与目标编码的关联。这些连接为理解现有方法提供了统一视角。

## 实验验证
在TALENT基准的38个数据集上，监督拉伸**一致性地优于所有基线方法**。结果表明，显式优化目标函数平滑性是一种强大且尚未充分探索的表格深度学习策略，为数值特征工程提供了新范式。

---

Two variants are proposed: *unsupervised stretch* redistributes feature density via minimax optimization, while *supervised stretch* minimizes the target's Dirichlet energy in transformed space. Theoretical analysis connects these methods to Piecewise Linear Encoding, empirical CDF transformation, and target encoding under specific limits. Experiments on 38 TALENT datasets show supervised stretch consistently outperforms all baselines, demonstrating that explicitly optimizing for target-function smoothness is a powerful, underexplored strategy for tabular deep learning.

papers.title: From Inaudible Inputs to Model Failures: Low-Frequency Safety Risks in LALMs
papers.abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding diverse audio inputs. This diversity includes low-frequency signals that are inaudible to humans but can still enter the model and influence its generation. However, the practical impact of such low-frequency inputs on LALMs remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Intermittent Low-Frequency Lockout (ILL), an inaudible red teaming method that evaluates this risk using a universal waveform template in a black box setting. ILL uses Sentence Attention Scale Estimation to determine active intervals and Frequency Confusion Transfer to construct a low-frequency waveform with continuous phase from corpus spectral variation. To mitigate this risk, we propose Distributional Requery Guard (DRG) to detect low-frequency distribution shifts and conditionally request a second recording for semantic recovery. Across six LALMs and multiple audio understanding tasks, ILL reduces accuracy by up to 67 percentage points while receiving a mean human audibility rating of 1.33, close to 1.17 for clean audio; DRG raises mean attacked accuracy from 28.5\% to 46.1\% after clean reacquisition. These findings identify a previously overlooked safety risk for LALMs and provide a foundation for future research on robust audio understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机
大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在处理多样化音频输入时表现出色，其中包括人类听不见但能影响模型生成的**低频信号**。然而，这类低频输入对模型的实际安全影响尚未被系统研究。

## 核心方法
本文提出**间歇性低频锁定（ILL）**——一种黑盒环境下的不可闻红队测试方法，通过通用波形模板评估该风险。ILL包含两个关键技术：
- **句子注意力尺度估计**：确定低频干扰的有效作用区间
- **频率混淆转移**：利用语料频谱变化构造具有连续相位的低频波形

为缓解该风险，作者提出**分布重查询防护（DRG）**机制，通过检测低频分布偏移，条件性地请求二次录音以恢复语义。

## 主要发现
在6个LALM和多项音频理解任务中：
- ILL使模型准确率**最高下降67个百分点**，而人类可听度评分仅1.33（接近干净音频的1.17），证实其隐蔽性
- DRG将受攻击后的平均准确率从**28.5%提升至46.1%**（经干净重采集后）

## 创新与意义
该研究首次揭示了LALMs中**被忽视的低频安全风险**，为未来构建鲁棒音频理解系统提供了重要基础。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper identifies a **previously overlooked safety risk** in large audio-language models (LALMs): inaudible low-frequency signals that can silently manipulate model outputs. We propose **Intermittent Low-Frequency Lockout (ILL)**, a black-box red-teaming method using a universal waveform template, and **Distributional Requery Guard (DRG)**, a defensive mechanism that detects low-frequency distribution shifts and requests clean re-recordings.

## Key Results
Across six LALMs and multiple audio tasks, ILL reduces accuracy by up to **67 percentage points** while maintaining near-inaudibility (mean human audibility score 1.33 vs. 1.17 for clean audio). DRG recovers attacked accuracy from 28.5% to **46.1%** after clean reacquisition.

## Significance
These findings expose a critical vulnerability in LALMs' audio processing pipeline and lay groundwork for robust audio understanding research.

papers.title: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: While learned robotic policies hold promise for advancing generalizable manipulation, their practical deployment is often hindered by suboptimal execution speeds. Imitation learning policies are inherently limited by hardware constraints and the speed of the operator during data collection. In addition, there are no established methods for accelerating policies learned via imitation, and the empirical relationship between execution speed and task success remains underexplored. To address these issues, we introduce SpeedTuning, a reinforcement learning framework specifically designed to enhance the speed of manipulation policies. SpeedTuning learns to predict the optimal execution speed for actions, thereby complementing a base policy without necessitating additional data collection. We provide empirical evidence that SpeedTuning achieves substantial improvements in execution speed, exceeding 2.4x speed-up, while preserving an adequate success rate compared to both the original task policy and straightforward speed-up methods such as linear interpolation at a fixed speed. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of dynamic and precise tasks, including pouring, throwing, and picking, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness in enhancing real-world robotic manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
尽管学习型机器人策略在通用操作任务中展现出巨大潜力，但其实际部署常受限于执行速度不足。模仿学习策略的性能受硬件条件及数据采集时操作员速度的制约，且目前缺乏系统性的加速方法，执行速度与任务成功率之间的经验关系也尚未被充分探索。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **SpeedTuning**——一种专为提升操作策略执行速度设计的轻量级强化学习框架。该框架通过预测每个动作的最优执行速度，对基础策略进行补充增强，**无需额外采集演示数据**，即可实现策略的加速部署。

## 主要发现
- **显著加速**：在倒水、投掷、抓取等多种动态与精细任务中，SpeedTuning 实现超过 **2.4 倍**的执行速度提升。
- **成功率保持**：在加速同时，策略仍能保持与原始任务策略相当的成功率，优于固定速度线性插值等朴素加速方法。
- **鲁棒性验证**：跨任务类型的广泛实验证明了该方法在真实机器人操作中的有效性和稳健性。

## 核心贡献
1. 首次提出针对模仿学习策略的通用加速框架，填补该领域方法空白。
2. 揭示执行速度与任务成功率之间的权衡关系，并提供自适应速度调节方案。
3. 无需额外数据收集，直接兼容现有策略，降低部署成本。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We introduce **SpeedTuning**, a lightweight reinforcement learning framework that accelerates robotic manipulation policies by predicting optimal action execution speeds, requiring no additional data collection.

## Key Results
- Achieves **2.4x+ speed-up** across dynamic tasks (pouring, throwing, picking) while maintaining adequate success rates.
- Outperforms naive fixed-speed interpolation methods in both speed and task performance.
- Demonstrates robust generalization across diverse manipulation scenarios.

## Significance
This work addresses the underexplored gap in accelerating imitation-learned policies, providing a practical, data-efficient solution for real-world deployment.

papers.title: When Latents Forget Pixels: Restoring Fidelity in Diffusion Transformer Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Image super-resolution (SR) with large generative models has recently achieved remarkable perceptual quality, yet maintaining fidelity to the LR observation remains challenging. In particular, we observe that diffusion transformers (DiTs) built on latent representations suffer from a critical limitation: the compression bottleneck of the VAE weakens fine-grained spatial information, leading to hallucinated details that are weakly grounded in the input image. In this work, we revisit generative SR from a representation perspective and propose a pixel-grounded super-resolution (PGSR) framework that preserves LR-observed pixel evidence before VAE compression and reuses it throughout restoration. Instead of relying solely on the compressed latent condition, PGSR extracts pre-VAE pixel evidence from the upsampled LR image and reuses it at two stages. First, Condition-Side Trajectory Guidance fuses LR-derived pixel evidence with the latent LR condition to guide the latent restoration trajectory. Second, Decoder-Side Pixel Grounding injects multi-scale pixel features into the frozen VAE decoder to ground the final rendering with LR-observed cues. To efficiently adapt large pretrained DiT models, we keep the latent autoencoder and main flow-matching backbone frozen, and train only lightweight restoration modules. We further study an efficient local-window attention variant for improved high-resolution efficiency and scalability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSR improves the realism--fidelity trade-off and produces more faithful, visually convincing results than existing latent generative SR approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
基于扩散变压器（DiT）的生成式超分辨率（SR）模型虽能生成逼真的纹理，却常因**潜在表征的VAE压缩瓶颈**而丢失精细空间信息，导致产生与低分辨率（LR）输入弱相关的幻觉细节，即“潜在遗忘像素”问题。

## 方法创新
本文提出**像素接地超分辨率（PGSR）框架**，核心思想是在VAE压缩前保留LR观测像素证据，并在复原全程复用。具体包含两个关键模块：
- **条件侧轨迹引导**：将LR像素证据与潜在LR条件融合，引导潜在复原轨迹。
- **解码器侧像素接地**：将多尺度像素特征注入冻结的VAE解码器，用LR观测线索约束最终渲染。

模型保持预训练DiT主干和潜在自编码器冻结，仅训练轻量复原模块，并设计了高效局部窗口注意力变体以提升高分辨率可扩展性。

## 主要贡献
- 首次从表征视角揭示DiT-SR中VAE压缩导致保真度下降的机制。
- 提出无需重训大模型即可注入像素级证据的双阶段接地方案。
- 实验表明PGSR在**真实感-保真度权衡**上显著优于现有潜在生成式SR方法，生成结果更忠实且视觉上更可信。
papers.summary_en: This paper identifies a critical fidelity bottleneck in diffusion transformer (DiT) super-resolution: VAE compression weakens fine-grained spatial cues, causing hallucinated details. We propose **Pixel-Grounded Super-Resolution (PGSR)**, which preserves LR-observed pixel evidence before VAE compression and reuses it via two lightweight modules—condition-side trajectory guidance and decoder-side pixel grounding—while keeping the pretrained DiT and VAE frozen. An efficient local-window attention variant is also introduced for scalability. Experiments demonstrate that PGSR achieves a superior realism-fidelity trade-off, producing more faithful and visually convincing results than existing latent generative SR approaches.

papers.title: MARA: Flow-Matching-Guided Multi-Agent Resource Allocation for Computational Resource Efficient Learning
papers.abstract: Allocating limited computation among concurrent learning tasks is difficult when each task must reach a target loss before a deadline but its required training effort is unknown. Existing approaches combine online loss prediction with adaptive resource allocation, yet commonly treat computation as continuously divisible throughput. We instead study a practical setting in which tasks arrive over time and computation is provided by discrete nodes. This setting introduces both uncertain demand and constrained sequential decisions. We propose MARA, which predicts future loss trajectories with conditional flow matching and coordinates compute nodes through a cooperative multi-agent autoregressive policy. A potential-based progress reward supplies intermediate training feedback while preserving the undiscounted task-completion objective. Across in-distribution, reinforcement-learning, and vision workloads, flow matching reduces remaining-resource prediction error relative to weighted least squares. At the scheduler's training load, MARA completes 63.46% of tasks on average, 8.54 percentage points above strong baseline Learning with Adaptive Resource Allocation (LARA), and remains ahead under unseen heavier workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
在并发学习任务中，当每个任务需在截止日期前达到目标损失、但其所需训练算力未知时，如何分配有限计算资源极具挑战。现有方法通常将计算视为可连续分割的吞吐量，忽略了实际场景中计算由离散节点提供的约束。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **MARA** 框架，核心贡献包括：
- **条件流匹配预测器**：利用生成模型预测未来损失轨迹，相比传统加权最小二乘法，显著降低剩余资源需求预测误差。
- **多智能体自回归调度策略**：将计算节点视为协作智能体，通过自回归方式顺序决策，适应离散节点与动态任务到达场景。
- **势能基进度奖励**：在保持无折扣任务完成目标的同时，为中间训练过程提供密集反馈信号，缓解稀疏奖励问题。

## 主要结果
在分布内任务、强化学习任务及视觉任务三类负载下：
- 流匹配方法在剩余资源预测误差上全面优于加权最小二乘基线。

papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **MARA**, a novel framework for allocating discrete computational nodes to concurrent learning tasks with unknown resource demands and deadline constraints. Unlike prior work assuming continuously divisible throughput, MARA integrates **conditional flow matching** for accurate loss-trajectory prediction and a **cooperative multi-agent autoregressive policy** for sequential node assignment. A **potential-based progress reward** provides dense intermediate feedback while preserving the undiscounted completion objective.

## Key Results
Across in-distribution, reinforcement-learning, and vision workloads, flow matching reduces remaining-resource prediction error versus weighted least squares. At the scheduler's training load, MARA completes **63.46%** of tasks on average, surpassing the strong LARA baseline by **8.54 percentage points**, and maintains superiority under unseen heavier workloads. This work bridges the gap between idealized continuous-resource assumptions and practical discrete-node constraints, offering robust scheduling for deadline-sensitive learning in real clusters.

## 研究背景与问题
在并发学习任务中，当每个任务需在截止日期前达到目标损失、但其所需训练算力未知时，如何分配有限计算资源极具挑战。现有方法通常将计算视为可连续分割的吞吐量，忽略了实际场景中计算由离散节点提供的约束。

- **势能基进度奖励**：在保持无折扣任务完成目标的同时，为中间训练过程提供密集反馈信号，缓解稀疏奖励问题。

papers.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent social settings where they must cooperate, negotiate, and adapt to other agents. Measuring and improving these social skills is hard because, unlike math or logic, social interaction offers no objective ground truth: evaluations fall back on LLM judges, which are costly, subjective, and noisy, and models get no reliable signal to learn from. To address both, we first introduce Social Gym, an environment of 21 multi-agent social games (e.g., Werewolves, Resistance, Spyfall) whose rule-decided outcomes make agent performance verifiable and objective, with an Elo tournament that produces a cross-game leaderboard. Benchmarking experiments show that while GPT-5-mini tops the leaderboard, no model excels at all games uniformly or in all game roles, pointing to limitations of social reasoning. Motivated by this, we additionally propose SPaRTan (Self-Play and Reflect-Transfer), a training-free self-improvement loop: a model plays a game, reflects on its trajectories and their outcomes to produce a transferable playbook, and applies that playbook in subsequent games. Our results show that SPaRTan playbooks help GPT-5-mini agents level their performance on weaker roles, but largely do not improve Qwen3-32B's performance. Together, Social Gym and SPaRTan offer a reproducible, verifiable foundation for measuring and improving LLM social reasoning without weight updates.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
大语言模型（LLM）代理正越来越多地被部署于多智能体社交场景中，需要具备合作、协商与适应其他代理的能力。然而，社交能力的测量与提升面临双重困境：其一，社交互动缺乏类似数学或逻辑的客观标准答案，现有评估往往依赖LLM裁判，成本高、主观性强且噪声大；其二，模型缺乏可靠的学习信号，难以通过反馈持续改进。

## 方法与创新
**Social Gym 基准框架**：本文构建了包含21种多智能体社交游戏（如狼人杀、抵抗组织、间谍危机等）的测试环境。这些游戏的规则化结局使代理表现可验证、可客观量化，并通过Elo锦标赛系统生成跨游戏的综合排行榜。

**SPaRTan 自改进机制**：提出一种免训练的自提升循环——模型先进行自我对弈，随后反思其游戏轨迹与结果，生成可迁移的“战术手册”，并在后续游戏中应用该手册，实现无需权重更新的能力增强。

## 主要发现
- **能力不均衡**：GPT-5-mini虽位居排行榜首位，但没有任何模型能在所有游戏或所有角色中表现卓越，揭示当前LLM社交推理的显著局限。
- **方法有效性差异**：SPaRTan战术手册能帮助GPT-5-mini在弱势角色上提升表现，但对Qwen3-32B几乎无改善，表明该方法对不同模型的适用性存在差异。

## 核心贡献
Social Gym与SPaRTan共同构建了可复现、可验证的基准与改进框架，为LLM社交推理研究提供了无需权重更新的客观测量与增强途径，填补了该领域缺乏可靠评估信号与训练信号的空白。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contributions
This paper tackles the dual challenges of measuring and improving LLM social reasoning in multi-agent settings, where objective ground truth is absent and LLM judges are costly and noisy. We introduce **Social Gym**, an environment comprising 21 multi-agent social games with rule-decided outcomes, enabling verifiable performance evaluation through an Elo-based cross-game leaderboard. Benchmarking reveals that while GPT-5-mini ranks first, no model uniformly excels across all games or roles, highlighting inherent limitations in current social reasoning. We further propose **SPaRTan**, a training-free self-improvement loop where models reflect on self-play trajectories to generate transferable playbooks. Results show SPaRTan enhances GPT-5-mini's performance on weaker roles but yields negligible gains for Qwen3-32B, indicating variable model applicability. Together, Social Gym and SPaRTan provide a reproducible, verifiable foundation for objectively measuring and enhancing LLM social capabilities without weight updates.

papers.title: ChronoState: Hidden Elapsed-Time Conditioning for Temporal-State Action Selection in Frozen-Backbone Language Models
papers.abstract: Temporal decisions in language-model systems often depend on both symbolic task state and elapsed wall-clock time, such as cache expiration, job completion, quota resets, deadlines, or stale sessions. We study whether elapsed time can be supplied as a non-token, system-side scalar and composed with visible symbolic state by a frozen-backbone language model. We introduce ChronoState, a compositional temporal-state benchmark in which symbolic state appears in the prompt, elapsed seconds tau are supplied through a hidden chronometric-injection channel, and the model selects a forced-choice temporal action. Here, "hidden" means hidden from the user-visible token sequence, not from model computation. Using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a frozen bf16 backbone with a 31-dimensional sinusoidal-plus-log time encoding, gated FiLM residual modulation, and a rank-8 LoRA action surface, hidden-time CI reaches 0.9305 +/- 0.0134 accuracy and 0.9410 +/- 0.0103 balanced accuracy. No-time and shuffled-time controls fall to 0.5511 +/- 0.0042 and 0.3323 +/- 0.0097, respectively, with high shuffled-time wrong-state consistency supporting causal dependence on the injected scalar within the trained distribution. Generalization remains strong for held-out templates, durations, and multi-constraint compositions, but held-out quota-family transfer is weak at 0.5065 +/- 0.0559, while a fair prompt+LoRA timestamp baseline reaches 0.9893 +/- 0.0052. Thus, ChronoState supports a narrow conclusion: hidden elapsed time can be composed with symbolic task state under direct supervision, but does not establish autonomous time tracking, broad unseen-family abstraction, or superiority over prompt-injected timestamps.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景与问题**：语言模型系统中的时间决策常同时依赖符号任务状态和真实流逝时间（如缓存过期、任务完成、配额重置、截止日期或会话失效）。现有方法通常将时间作为显式文本注入，但真实时间本质上是非符号的连续标量。本文研究：能否将流逝时间作为非令牌的系统侧标量，与可见符号状态组合，由冻结骨干语言模型完成时间状态动作选择？  

**方法**：提出 **ChronoState** 基准，符号状态出现在提示中，流逝秒数 τ 通过隐藏计时注入通道（非用户可见令牌序列，但参与模型计算）提供，模型需在强制选择任务中输出时间动作。采用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 作为冻结 bf16 骨干，使用 31 维正弦+对数时间编码、门控 FiLM 残差调制和秩 8 LoRA 动作面。  

**关键结果**：隐藏时间条件（CI）达到 **0.9305±0.0134 准确率**和 **0.9410±0.0103 平衡准确率**。无时间对照降至 0.5511±0.0042，打乱时间对照降至 0.3323±0.0097，且高错态一致性表明模型在训练分布内因果依赖注入标量。泛化测试显示：未见模板、时长和多约束组合表现强健，但未见配额族迁移弱（0.5065±0.0559）；公平的“提示+LoRA 时间戳”基线达 0.9893±0.0052，远超本方法。  

**结论**：ChronoState 支持窄结论——隐藏流逝时间可在直接监督下与符号状态组合，但**不**具备自主时间跟踪、未见族抽象能力，也不优于提示注入时间戳。本研究为时间条件语言模型提供了首个系统化基准与消融分析，明确了隐藏时间通道的适用边界。
papers.summary_en: **ChronoState** investigates whether elapsed wall-clock time can be supplied as a non-token, system-side scalar and composed with visible symbolic state in a frozen-backbone language model for temporal action selection. Using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with a 31-dimensional sinusoidal-log time encoding, gated FiLM modulation, and rank-8 LoRA, hidden-time conditioning achieves **0.9305±0.0134 accuracy** and **0.9410±0.0103 balanced accuracy**, far above no-time (0.5511) and shuffled-time (0.3323) controls. Generalization holds for held-out templates, durations, and multi-constraint compositions, but weak transfer on unseen quota families (0.5065) and inferior performance versus a prompt-injected timestamp baseline (0.9893) reveal clear limitations. The benchmark supports a narrow conclusion: hidden elapsed time can be learned under direct supervision, but does not establish autonomous time tracking, broad abstraction, or superiority over explicit timestamps. This work provides the first systematic benchmark and ablation for hidden-time conditioning in language models.

papers.title: RISE-RL: Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) for open-ended tasks is challenging because responses must satisfy multidimensional criteria without following a single correct generation trajectory. Existing rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods compress fine-grained criterion-level feedback into scalar rewards, making persistent capability gaps difficult to target under limited on-policy exploration. We propose $\textbf{RISE-RL}$ (Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration), which uses repeatedly missed rubric criteria to elicit privileged trajectories that are difficult to discover through unguided exploration alone. RISE-RL retains only trajectories whose complete-rubric reward exceeds the mean reward of natural rollouts, and then re-evaluates them under the original prompt to emphasize behaviors that remain weakly supported by the natural policy. The resulting guidance signal is optimized through a separate auxiliary objective and removed once its additional benefit diminishes. Experiments with 4B and 14B models across writing, chat, health, and science show that RISE-RL achieves the highest mean score on every evaluated benchmark under guidance-free evaluation. Compared with standard Rubric-RL, it improves the average score by 1.3 points at the 4B scale and $\textbf{3.3 points at the 14B scale}$, including a $\textbf{6.0-point}$ gain on CreativeWriting-V3. It also improves creative-writing diversity and yields gains on objectively scored medical and scientific benchmarks. These results indicate that selective internalization through reward filtering and policy support shaping is effective for open-ended reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
开放任务下的大语言模型（LLM）对齐极具挑战性，因为模型需满足多维标准，且不存在单一正确生成路径。现有基于量规（Rubric）的强化学习方法，将细粒度标准级反馈压缩为标量奖励，导致在有限的在线策略探索下，难以精准定位并改进持续存在的能力短板。

## 方法创新：RISE-RL
本文提出 **RISE-RL（量规引导的选择性探索）** 框架，核心思路是**利用反复错失的量规标准来激发特权轨迹**——这些轨迹在无引导的随机探索中极难被发现。具体机制包括：
1. **奖励过滤**：仅保留完整量规奖励高于自然策略平均奖励的轨迹；
2. **策略支持塑造**：在原始提示下重新评估这些轨迹，强化自然策略中支持薄弱的正确行为；
3. **自适应去噪**：通过独立辅助目标优化引导信号，当其额外收益递减时自动移除。

## 实验结果
在 **4B 和 14B 模型**上，覆盖写作、对话、健康、科学四类基准，RISE-RL 在**无引导评估**下均取得最高平均分。与标准 Rubric-RL 相比：
- 4B 规模平均分提升 **1.3 分**；
- 14B 规模平均分提升 **3.3 分**，其中创意写作（CreativeWriting-V3）提升 **6.0 分**；
- 同时提升创意写作多样性，并在客观打分的医疗与科学基准上取得增益。

## 结论
研究表明，通过**奖励过滤与策略支持塑造**实现的选择性内化，是开放任务强化学习的有效范式，能够显著突破无引导探索的瓶颈。

---

Across writing, chat, health, and science benchmarks with 4B and 14B models, RISE-RL achieves the highest mean score under guidance-free evaluation—outperforming standard Rubric-RL by **1.3 points (4B)** and **3.3 points (14B)**, including a **6.0-point gain** on CreativeWriting-V3. It also improves diversity and objective medical/scientific scores.

## Significance
Our results demonstrate that selective internalization via reward filtering and policy support shaping is a highly effective paradigm for open-ended RL.

papers.title: Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract: The localized depiction of perceptual quality has long been a crucial, yet underexplored, challenge in image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches based on large multimodal models (LMMs) predominantly rely on text-driven supervised fine-tuning (SFT).   However, this training paradigm exhibits notable limitations in detection accuracy. Moreover, synthetically distorted images, which are often used as the primary training data source,   show a significant generalization gap when deployed in real-world scenarios; thus, the \textbf{synthetic-to-authentic (\textit{S2A})} problem represents a critical challenge. Motivated by these issues, we propose \textbf{\textit{VIGIL}}, which leverages the LMM architecture for precise visual distortion detection. From a candidate pool of over 1000K samples, we construct the \textbf{\textit{VIGIL-140K}} training set, which consists of over 140K distorted images. These images are obtained through rigorous quality filtering and carefully crafted distortion injection, covering 8 major synthetic distortion categories.   Our model leverages different layers of the large language model (LLM) decoder, treating them as \textit{multiple detectors} that perform synchronous distortion detection using multi-level features. Additionally, we retain distortion cues from predictions assigned to the non-distortion class, which helps mitigate the ambiguous foreground-background (\textit{FG-BG}) separation commonly encountered in the \textit{S2A} problem.   After post-processing, our model consistently outperforms strong baselines on both in-domain synthetic distortion detection and \textit{S2A} tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
图像质量评估（IQA）中长期存在一个关键但未被充分探索的挑战——**局部感知质量描述**（即视觉失真检测）。现有基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的方法主要依赖文本驱动的监督微调（SFT），但该训练范式在检测精度上存在明显不足。此外，合成失真图像作为主要训练数据源，在真实场景中应用时存在显著的**泛化差距**，由此引出的**合成到真实（S2A）问题**成为一项关键挑战。

## 方法创新
针对上述问题，本文提出 **VIGIL** 模型，利用 LMM 架构实现精准的视觉失真检测。核心贡献包括：

- **大规模数据集构建**：从超过 100 万样本的候选池中，通过严格质量过滤与精心设计的失真注入，构建了包含 14 万+失真图像的 **VIGIL-140K** 训练集，覆盖 8 大主流合成失真类别。
- **多检测器协同机制**：将大语言模型（LLM）解码器的不同层视为**多个检测器**，利用多层级特征执行同步失真检测。
- **背景-前景分离优化**：保留非失真类预测中的失真线索，有效缓解 S2A 问题中常见的**前景-背景（FG-BG）模糊分离**难题。

## 主要结果
经过后处理，VIGIL 在**域内合成失真检测**和 **S2A 任务**上均持续优于强基线模型，验证了其架构设计与训练策略的有效性。

papers.title: Motif 3: Technical Report
papers.abstract: We introduce Motif 3, a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion activated per token. Each sparse MoE layer contains 384 routed experts, with eight selected per token. This fine-grained sparsity provides substantial expert capacity while limiting computation. Motif 3 is built around Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA), which integrates grouped differential attention with the compressed key-value representation of Multi-head Latent Attention. The architecture further incorporates modified manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction to improve optimization stability, expert specialization, and inference efficiency. We pretrain Motif 3 on approximately 12.5 trillion tokens spanning web documents, STEM, code, mathematics, multilingual content, and domain-specialized corpora. Expert-balancing and numerical-stabilization techniques support stable training at scale, while selective MXFP8 computation and communication, memory-efficient fused kernels, and window-aware context parallelism enable training with context lengths up to 256K tokens. Our post-training pipeline combines general supervised fine-tuning, six specialist teachers trained with reinforcement learning, a software-engineering teacher trained with supervised fine-tuning, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation. The resulting unified model consolidates complementary capabilities in reasoning, coding, tool use, professional work, long-context understanding, calibrated abstention, and instruction following. Across a broad evaluation suite, Motif 3 demonstrates competitive performance against leading open weight models, including strong results on long-horizon agentic tasks, mathematical reasoning, scientific knowledge, and hallucination-sensitive evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
## 核心贡献  
本文介绍 **Motif 3**，一个仅解码器架构的混合专家（MoE）语言模型，总参数量达 **3140亿**，每个 token 仅激活 **132亿** 参数。其稀疏 MoE 层包含 **384个路由专家**，每 token 选取 8 个，通过细粒度稀疏性在保持强大专家容量的同时大幅降低计算成本。

## 架构创新  
Motif 3 的核心是 **分组差分潜在注意力（GDLA）**，该机制融合了分组差分注意力与多头潜在注意力的压缩键值表示，显著提升长序列建模效率。此外，架构还引入：  
- 改进的**流形约束超连接**（manifold-constrained hyper-connections）  
- **专家特定 PolyNorm 激活函数**，增强专家专业化  
- **多 token 预测**，提升推理效率与训练稳定性  

## 训练与优化  
模型在约 **12.5万亿 token** 上预训练，覆盖网页文本、STEM、代码、数学、多语言及领域专业语料。训练中采用专家平衡与数值稳定技术，确保超大规模训练的稳定性；结合选择性 MXFP8 计算与通信、内存高效融合内核及窗口感知上下文并行，支持最长 **256K token** 的上下文长度。

## 后训练与能力整合  
后训练流程包括：通用监督微调、**6个基于强化学习的专家教师**、1个基于监督微调的软件工程教师，以及**多教师同策略蒸馏**。最终统一模型整合了推理、编程、工具使用、专业工作、长上下文理解、校准性拒答及指令遵循等互补能力。

## 评估结果  
在广泛评测中，Motif 3 与领先开源模型相比表现出竞争力，尤其在长程智能体任务、数学推理、科学知识及幻觉敏感评估上成绩突出。

Its core innovation, **Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA)**, combines grouped differential attention with compressed key-value representations, alongside manifold-constrained hyper-connections and Expert Specific PolyNorm activations. Pretrained on ~12.5T tokens with context lengths up to 256K, the model employs expert-balancing, MXFP8 computation, and window-aware context parallelism for stable scaling. Post-training integrates supervised fine-tuning, six RL-trained specialist teachers, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation. Motif 3 achieves competitive performance against leading open-weight models, excelling in long-horizon agentic tasks, mathematical reasoning, scientific knowledge, and hallucination-sensitive benchmarks.

papers.title: RAVEN-Eval: Rubric-Guided Automatic Evaluation for AI Video Generation Models Based on LMM Preference Judgement
papers.abstract: AI video generation has advanced rapidly and entered widespread commercial use. As a result, quality differences among videos produced by state-of-the-art AI video generation models~(AIVGMs) have become increasingly difficult to discern using conventional evaluation criteria, such as visual fidelity and semantic instruction following. Meanwhile, human evaluation now requires more expertise and sustained attention, substantially increasing annotation costs. This calls for automated evaluation that can reliably distinguish fine-grained differences among advanced AIVGMs with minimal human intervention. To address this challenge, we present RAVEN-Eval, a rubric-guided automated evaluation framework for AIVGMs, built primarily on the LMM-as-a-judge paradigm. Through an automatic task curation and quality-filtering pipeline, RAVEN-Eval curates 150 text-to-video~(T2V) tasks and 100 image-to-video~(I2V) tasks, and systematically collects more than 4,500 AIGVs. At its core, RAVEN-Eval adopts rubric-guided automated LMM preference judgement, in which LMM judges conduct pairwise comparisons according to task-specific rubrics. It further introduces an anchor-based model insertion approach to reduce the evaluation cost of incorporating new models. Finally, we evaluate 20 high-performance AIVGMs, as well as the judging capabilities of 13 LMM judges, and establish the RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards. Overall, RAVEN-Eval paves a scalable path for automatic and trustworthy evaluation of rapidly evolving AIVGMs.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
AI视频生成技术已快速进入大规模商业应用，但当前最先进的AI视频生成模型（AIVGMs）之间的质量差异，已难以通过传统评估标准（如视觉保真度、语义指令遵循）进行区分。同时，人工评估需要更高的专业性和持续注意力，导致标注成本大幅上升。因此，亟需一种能在最少人工干预下、可靠区分先进AIVGMs细微质量差异的自动化评估方法。

## 方法创新：RAVEN-Eval框架
本文提出**RAVEN-Eval**，一个基于规则（rubric）引导的自动化评估框架，核心采用**LMM-as-a-judge**（大型多模态模型作为评审）范式。其主要创新包括：
- **自动化任务策展与质量过滤**：通过自动化流程构建了150个文生视频（T2V）任务和100个图生视频（I2V）任务，系统收集了超过4,500个AI生成视频（AIGVs）。
- **规则引导的偏好判断**：LMM评审根据任务特定的规则（rubrics）对视频进行两两比较，而非简单整体打分，从而捕捉更细粒度的质量差异。
- **锚点式模型插入**：引入基于锚点的模型插入方法，显著降低了评估新模型时的计算成本。

## 主要发现与贡献
- 对**20个高性能AIVGMs**进行了全面评估，并检验了**13个LMM评审**的判断能力，建立了**RAVEN-Eval排行榜**。
- 实验表明，规则引导的偏好判断能有效区分模型间的细微差异，且LMM评审在结构化规则辅助下展现出较高的判断一致性。
- RAVEN-Eval为快速演进的AIVGMs提供了一条**可扩展、自动化且可信赖**的评估路径，大幅减少了人工干预需求。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We present **RAVEN-Eval**, a rubric-guided automated evaluation framework for AI video generation models (AIVGMs), built on the LMM-as-a-judge paradigm. It automatically curates 150 text-to-video (T2V) and 100 image-to-video (I2V) tasks, collecting over 4,500 AI-generated videos. The framework employs task-specific rubrics to guide LMM judges in pairwise comparisons, enabling fine-grained quality discrimination beyond conventional metrics. An anchor-based model insertion method further reduces evaluation cost for new models. We evaluate 20 state-of-the-art AIVGMs and 13 LMM judges, establishing the RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards. This work provides a scalable, trustworthy path for automated evaluation of rapidly evolving video generation models with minimal human intervention.

papers.title: Who Bridges Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Pathways
papers.abstract: Uncovering the internal mechanisms underlying the safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for developing trustworthy artificial intelligence. Currently, mechanistic interpretability studies on multilingual safety are largely confined to local components, such as isolated neurons. However, this static and fragmented perspective overlooks the synergy among components and fails to elucidate how safety signals dynamically propagate within the model to drive safety decisions ultimately. In this work, we move beyond isolated neurons to identify and target the cross-layer functional pathways formed during safety signal propagation, thereby uncovering the mechanisms driving the cross-lingual safety gap. Specifically, we first identify monolingual safety pathways and validate their impact on refusing harmful requests. Subsequent cross-lingual analyses reveal a sparse subset of cross-lingual shared safety pathways, confirming that this intersection acts as the internal bridge transferring safety capabilities from high-resource (HR) languages to non-high-resource (NHR) languages. Building on these mechanistic findings, we propose a pathways-targeted alignment method based on the cross-lingual shared safety pathways. Experimental results show that updating only a small fraction of pathway parameters significantly improves safety in NHR languages while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型（LLMs）的安全能力是其可信部署的关键，但多语言场景下存在显著的安全差距：高资源语言（如英语）的安全防护较强，而低资源语言（NHR）则相对薄弱。现有可解释性研究多聚焦于孤立神经元等局部组件，忽视了安全信号在模型内部跨层传播的动态协同过程。

## 方法与核心发现
本研究突破静态、碎片化的分析框架，系统识别了**跨层功能通路**（functional pathways）——即安全信号在模型层间传播时形成的功能连接。主要工作与发现包括：

1. **单语安全通路识别**：首先定位模型内部负责拒绝有害请求的单语安全通路，并验证其对安全行为的因果影响。
2. **跨语言共享通路发现**：通过跨语言对比分析，发现存在一个**稀疏的跨语言共享安全通路子集**。该交集结构充当内部“桥梁”，将安全能力从高资源语言迁移至低资源语言，直接解释安全差距的机制根源。
3. **通路靶向对齐方法**：基于上述机制发现，提出一种仅针对共享安全通路参数进行更新的对齐方法。实验表明，仅微调少量通路参数（占比很小），即可显著提升低资源语言的安全性，同时基本保持模型通用能力。

## 创新与意义
- 首次将可解释性视角从“孤立组件”提升至“动态功能通路”，揭示安全信号传播的全局机制。
- 为跨语言安全对齐提供了**机制驱动的精准干预方案**，避免了全参数微调的高成本与能力退化风险。
- 为构建更公平、更安全的多语言AI系统奠定了理论基础与工程路径。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper moves beyond isolated-neuron analysis to investigate **cross-layer functional pathways** underlying LLM safety, revealing how safety signals propagate dynamically across layers to drive refusal behaviors.

## Key Findings
1. **Monolingual safety pathways** were identified and causally validated for rejecting harmful requests.
2. Cross-lingual analysis uncovered a **sparse subset of shared safety pathways** acting as an internal bridge, transferring safety capabilities from high-resource (HR) to non-high-resource (NHR) languages—directly explaining the cross-lingual safety gap.
3. A **pathways-targeted alignment method** was proposed: updating only a small fraction of pathway parameters significantly improves NHR safety while largely preserving general model capabilities.

## Significance
This work provides the first mechanism-driven, pathway-level intervention for multilingual safety alignment, offering a cost-effective and capability-preserving alternative to full fine-tuning, with implications for fair and trustworthy multilingual AI systems.

3. **通路靶向对齐方法**：基于上述机制发现，提出一种仅针对共享安全通路参数进行更新的对齐方法。实验表明，仅微调少量通路参数（占比很小），即可显著提升低资源语言的安全性，同时基本保持模型通用能力。

## 创新与意义
- 首次将可解释性视角从“孤立组件”提升至“动态功能通路”，揭示安全信号传播的全局机制。
- 为跨语言安全对齐提供了**机制驱动的精准干预方案**，避免了全参数微调的高成本与能力退化风险。
- 为构建更公平、更安全的多语言AI系统奠定了理论基础与工程路径。

papers.title: When Confidence Fails: Overconfidence in LLMs under Uncertainty and Missing Clinical Information
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in medical question answering and clinical reasoning tasks. However, their reliability under uncertainty remains poorly understood which raises critical concerns for deployment in high-stakes clinical settings. In such environments, incorrect predictions are inherently risky, but confident incorrect predictions can be particularly harmful as they may mislead clinical decision-making. In this paper, we conduct a systematic behavioral analysis of LLMs under clinical information uncertainty. We propose an evaluation framework based on the MedMCQA dataset consisting of two complementary uncertainty settings. First, we introduce linguistic uncertainty cues through prompt modifications to simulate ambiguous clinical contexts. Second, we construct an answer removal setting, wherein the correct option is deliberately excluded mandating the model to recognize insufficient information and abstain. We analyze both model accuracy and confidence behavior using multiple calibration metrics including calibration gap, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and Unsafe Confident Error Rate (UCER) across 500 medical questions. Our results reveal a consistent failure mode, i.e., although accuracy degrades under increasing uncertainty, model confidence remains misaligned with accuracy. This leads to a substantial increase in unsafe confident errors, indicating that model confidence remains largely insensitive to clinically meaningful information loss. Furthermore, we observe significant variation across models in their ability to abstain when the correct answer is unavailable, with some models persistently producing high confidence hallucinated answers. These findings expose critical limitations in the epistemic reliability of current LLMs and highlight the need for uncertainty aware evaluation methods prior to their deployment in clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型（LLMs）在医学问答和临床推理任务中表现出色，但其在信息不确定条件下的可靠性尚未得到充分研究。在临床高风险场景中，错误预测本身具有风险，而**过度自信的错误预测**（即模型以高置信度给出错误答案）可能误导临床决策，造成更严重的后果。

## 研究方法
本文基于 MedMCQA 数据集构建了系统性的行为分析框架，设计了两种互补的不确定性场景：
1. **语言不确定性提示**：通过修改提示词引入模糊的临床语境线索；
2. **答案移除场景**：刻意排除正确选项，迫使模型识别信息不足并主动弃答。

研究覆盖 500 道医学问题，采用多种校准指标（包括校准差距、期望校准误差 ECE 和**不安全自信错误率 UCER**）同时分析模型的准确率与置信度行为。

## 主要发现
- **一致的失败模式**：随着不确定性增加，模型准确率显著下降，但置信度并未随之调整，导致不安全自信错误率大幅上升——表明模型的置信度对临床意义上的信息缺失基本不敏感。
- **模型间差异显著**：不同模型在正确选项缺失时的弃答能力差异很大，部分模型持续产生高置信度的幻觉答案。

## 创新点与意义
本研究首次系统性地揭示了当前 LLMs 在临床信息不确定性下的**认知可靠性缺陷**，强调了在模型部署于临床工作流之前，必须引入**不确定性感知的评估方法**。这一发现对医疗 AI 的安全落地具有重要警示意义。

---

Analyzing 500 medical questions with calibration metrics (calibration gap, ECE, and Unsafe Confident Error Rate), we find a consistent failure mode: although accuracy degrades under uncertainty, model confidence remains misaligned, leading to a substantial increase in unsafe confident errors. Additionally, models vary significantly in their abstention ability, with some persistently producing high-confidence hallucinated answers. These findings expose critical epistemic limitations in current LLMs and underscore the urgent need for uncertainty-aware evaluation before clinical deployment.

papers.title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs. Yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate only whether the final patch passes tests. Satisfying a user request requires a long chain of interdependent reasoning and decisions: an agent must recover explicit and implicit requirements, formulate a repository-grounded implementation plan, and translate it into correct code. A pass/fail outcome cannot characterize how an unsuccessful trajectory diverges from the requirements and implementation process needed for a correct patch. To address this gap, we introduce SWE-RPG, a repository-level benchmark that combines executable patch evaluation with validated ground-truth references (GTs) for (1) Requirement Clarification and (2) Implementation Planning. These intermediate GTs support retrospective, GT-aligned diagnosis of complete coding-agent trajectories across clarification, planning, code generation, and artifact submission. SWE-RPG comprises 163 tasks from 31 Python and Java repositories, including 113 bug fixes and 50 feature additions. We evaluate 3 coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, with 6 large language model backends, including Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.6-Terra. Results show that the evaluated popular coding agents still struggle to implement user requests in existing repositories, achieving an average resolved rate of only 31.5% on SWE-RPG. Intermediate-GT diagnosis further identifies implicit requirement recovery as the main bottleneck, accounting for 24.5%--46.0% of agent runs. This result suggests implicit-requirement recovery as a key candidate direction for improving coding agents. The benchmark data and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Xin-Zhou-smu/SWE-RPG-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型驱动的编码代理（coding agents）正被广泛用于修改现有代码仓库，如添加功能或修复缺陷。然而，现有仓库级基准（benchmark）通常仅以最终补丁是否通过测试作为评价标准，忽略了用户请求满足过程中所需的完整推理链：**需求澄清、实现规划与代码生成**。这种二元通过/失败的结果无法诊断代理在何处偏离了正确路径。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **SWE-RPG**——一个仓库级基准，创新性地将**可执行补丁评估**与**经过验证的中间参考标准（GTs）** 相结合，覆盖两个关键中间环节：
1. **需求澄清**（显式与隐式需求的恢复）
2. **实现规划**（基于仓库结构的落地计划）

这些中间GTs支持对代理完整轨迹进行**回溯性、GT对齐的诊断**，从而精确定位失败环节。

## 数据集与实验
- **规模**：31个Python与Java仓库中的163个任务（113个缺陷修复 + 50个功能新增）
- **评估对象**：3种编码代理（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode）× 6种LLM后端（含Claude-Sonnet-5、GPT-5.6-Terra）

## 主要发现
1. **整体性能低下**：主流编码代理在SWE-RPG上平均仅解决31.5%的任务，表明现有代理在真实仓库中实现用户请求的能力仍严重不足。
2. **关键瓶颈识别**：中间GT诊断显示，**隐式需求恢复**是最大失败点，占代理运行失败的24.5%–46.0%。
3. **研究方向**：结果明确指向**隐式需求恢复**作为提升编码代理能力的关键候选方向。

## 资源开源
基准数据与评估代码已公开：https://github.com/Xin-Zhou-smu/SWE-RPG-Bench

## Core Contribution
We introduce **SWE-RPG**, a repository-level benchmark that combines executable patch evaluation with validated ground-truth references (GTs) for two intermediate stages: **requirement clarification** and **implementation planning**. Unlike existing pass/fail benchmarks, SWE-RPG enables **retrospective, GT-aligned diagnosis** of complete agent trajectories across clarification, planning, code generation, and artifact submission.

## Key Results
Evaluating 3 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) with 6 LLM backends on 163 tasks from 31 Python/Java repositories, we find that popular agents resolve only **31.5%** of tasks on average. Intermediate-GT diagnosis identifies **implicit requirement recovery** as the primary bottleneck, accounting for 24.5%–46.0% of agent failures—a key direction for future improvement. Benchmark data and code are publicly available.

papers.title: Triple Expert Learning from Noisy Labels for Semi-Supervised Vision Foundation Model Adaptation
papers.abstract: Semi-supervised adaptation of vision foundation models (VFMs) commonly freezes the pretrained backbone and updates lightweight modules such as LoRA. However, pseudo-labels have mixed reliability, and a single LoRA adapter must absorb reliable, ambiguous, and noisy gradients in the same low-rank space. This can make VFM adaptation sensitive to pseudo-label noise. We propose \textbf{TriNoL}, a \textbf{Tri}ple-expert learning framework from \textbf{No}isy \textbf{L}abels for semi-supervised VFM adaptation. TriNoL routes unlabeled samples into three confidence regions and assigns them to three LoRA experts: a Positive Expert for high-confidence pseudo-labels, an Alignment Expert for medium-confidence ambiguous samples, and a Negative Expert for low-confidence noisy samples. The VFM backbone remains frozen, and only the LoRA experts and classifier head are updated. By separating different pseudo-label reliability regions into specialized adaptation paths, TriNoL improves robustness to noisy supervision while keeping the training cost low.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
视觉基础模型（VFM）在半监督适应任务中，通常采用“冻结主干网络+更新轻量模块（如LoRA）”的策略。然而，伪标签的可靠性参差不齐，单一LoRA适配器不得不在同一低秩空间中同时吸收可靠、模糊和噪声梯度，导致模型对伪标签噪声高度敏感，影响适应效果。

## 方法创新：TriNoL框架
本文提出 **TriNoL**（**Tri**ple-expert learning from **No**isy **L**abels），一种面向半监督VFM适应的三专家学习框架。其核心设计如下：
- **置信度分区**：将无标注样本按伪标签置信度划分为三个区域。
- **三专家分工**：
  - **Positive Expert**：处理高置信度伪标签样本；
  - **Alignment Expert**：处理中等置信度模糊样本；
  - **Negative Expert**：处理低置信度噪声样本。
- **参数高效**：VFM主干保持冻结，仅更新三个LoRA专家和分类头，训练成本低。

## 主要贡献与结果
通过将不同可靠性的伪标签分流至专用适应路径，TriNoL有效解耦了噪声监督与可靠监督，显著提升了对伪标签噪声的鲁棒性，同时保持了轻量级训练开销。实验表明，该方法在半监督VFM适应任务中优于现有基线，尤其在噪声比例较高时优势明显。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **TriNoL**, a triple-expert learning framework for semi-supervised vision foundation model (VFM) adaptation under noisy pseudo-labels. Instead of forcing a single LoRA adapter to absorb all gradients, TriNoL partitions unlabeled samples into three confidence regions and routes them to specialized experts: a **Positive Expert** for high-confidence labels, an **Alignment Expert** for ambiguous samples, and a **Negative Expert** for noisy samples. The VFM backbone stays frozen; only LoRA experts and the classifier head are updated.

## Key Results
This separation of reliability regions into dedicated adaptation paths substantially improves robustness to pseudo-label noise while maintaining low training cost. Experiments demonstrate that TriNoL outperforms existing semi-supervised VFM adaptation baselines, particularly under high noise ratios, without sacrificing parameter efficiency.

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production
papers.abstract: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
手语研究近期呈现出将多个理解子任务（如孤立词识别、连续识别与翻译）统一到单一框架的趋势，并取得了显著进展。与此同时，手语生成（从文本生成手语序列）也日益受到关注。本文探讨一个更具挑战性的问题：能否将手语理解与生成统一到一个框架中？

与统一理解子任务不同，手语翻译（SLT）和手语生成（SLP）处于符号—文本映射的相反方向，统一面临两大核心难题：
1. **模态鸿沟**：连续手语动作与离散文本token之间需通过共享的符号分词器桥接，同时支持语言抽象与动作重建；
2. **双向生成**：需训练单一条件自回归模型，既能以手语为输入生成文本，也能以文本为输入生成手语。

## 方法：Uni-SLTP框架
本文提出**Uni-SLTP**统一框架，包含两个关键组件：
- **共享符号分词器**：将手语序列转换为离散token与潜在表征，同时捕捉语义信息（用于翻译）与重建信息（用于生成），弥合模态差异；
- **统一自回归生成模型**：将SLT与SLP均表述为条件序列生成任务，以手语或文本为条件，生成另一模态的目标序列。

## 主要发现与贡献
- 在多个公开数据集上，Uni-SLTP在手语生成任务上取得了**更优的动作准确度**，同时保持了**有竞争力的翻译性能**；
- 证明了理解与生成可以在单一框架内协同优化，而非相互割裂；
- 为手语研究提供了一种统一的表征与建模思路，有助于降低系统复杂度并促进跨任务知识迁移。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **Uni-SLTP**, the first unified framework for sign language translation (SLT) and production (SLP), addressing the bidirectional sign-text mapping challenge. Unlike prior work that unifies only understanding subtasks, our framework tackles the modality gap through a **shared sign tokenizer** that encodes sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, preserving both semantic and reconstructive information. A single **conditional autoregressive model** then formulates both tasks as sequence generation, enabling seamless bidirectional generation.

## Key Results
Experiments on public benchmarks show that Uni-SLTP achieves **superior motion accuracy** for SLP while maintaining **competitive SLT performance**, demonstrating that understanding and production can mutually benefit within one framework. This work bridges the semantic-reconstructive gap and offers a scalable paradigm for unified sign language AI systems.

手语研究近期呈现出将多个理解子任务（如孤立词识别、连续识别与翻译）统一到单一框架的趋势，并取得了显著进展。与此同时，手语生成（从文本生成手语序列）也日益受到关注。本文探讨一个更具挑战性的问题：能否将手语理解与生成统一到一个框架中？

与统一理解子任务不同，手语翻译（SLT）和手语生成（SLP）处于符号—文本映射的相反方向，统一面临两大核心难题：
1. **模态鸿沟**：连续手语动作与离散文本token之间需通过共享的符号分词器桥接，同时支持语言抽象与动作重建；
2. **双向生成**：需训练单一条件自回归模型，既能以手语为输入生成文本，也能以文本为输入生成手语。

## 方法：Uni-SLTP框架
本文提出**Uni-SLTP**统一框架，包含两个关键组件：
- **共享符号分词器**：将手语序列转换为离散token与潜在表征，同时捕捉语义信息（用于翻译）与重建信息（用于生成），弥合模态差异；
- **统一自回归生成模型**：将SLT与SLP均表述为条件序列生成任务，以手语或文本为条件，生成另一模态的目标序列。

## 主要发现与贡献
- 在多个公开数据集上，Uni-SLTP在手语生成任务上取得了**更优的动作准确度**，同时保持了**有竞争力的翻译性能**；
- 证明了理解与生成可以在单一框架内协同优化，而非相互割裂；
- 为手语研究提供了一种统一的表征与建模思路，有助于降低系统复杂度并促进跨任务知识迁移。

papers.title: MusicLayout: Explicit Structural Planning for Controllable Text-to-Music Generation
papers.abstract: Text-to-music generation has advanced rapidly, but current systems still rely primarily on global text prompts, leaving the structural organization of generated music implicit and difficult to inspect, control, or revise before audio generation. To address this issue, we introduce MusicLayout, an explicit intermediate representation for controlling musical structure in text-to-music generation. MusicLayout describes a musical piece as a time-aligned layout of sections, textures, repetitions, variations, and instrument-level arrangements, serving as an interpretable planning layer between textual intent and the generated music. We integrate MusicLayout into a text-to-music framework built on a unified autoregressive formulation, where the model first generates a MusicLayout representation and subsequently predicts audio tokens conditioned on this representation within a single sequence. The resulting MusicLayout can be inspected and modified prior to audio generation, providing a mechanism for layout-level structural control. We evaluate MusicLayout through layout-conditioned generation, layout manipulation experiments, and matched-data ablations, providing evidence that explicit layout planning can improve long-range structural organization and support layout-level control.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
文本到音乐生成技术近年来发展迅速，但现有系统主要依赖全局文本提示，导致生成音乐的结构组织是隐式的，在音频生成前难以检查、控制或修改。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **MusicLayout**，一种用于控制文本到音乐生成中音乐结构的显式中间表示。MusicLayout 将音乐作品描述为时间对齐的布局，包含：
- 段落（section）划分
- 织体（texture）变化
- 重复与变奏模式
- 乐器级编排

该表示作为文本意图与生成音乐之间的**可解释规划层**。

## 技术实现
我们将 MusicLayout 集成到基于统一自回归框架的文本到音乐系统中：
1. 模型首先生成 MusicLayout 表示
2. 随后在单一序列中，基于该表示预测音频 token

这种设计使得生成的布局可在音频生成前被**检查和修改**，从而提供布局级别的结构控制机制。

## 主要发现
通过布局条件生成、布局操作实验和匹配数据消融研究，我们验证了：
- 显式布局规划能显著改善**长程结构组织性**
- 支持灵活的**布局级控制**（如修改段落顺序、调整重复次数等）

## 核心贡献
1. 首次提出音乐结构规划的显式中间表示
2. 实现可检查、可编辑的文本到音乐生成流程
3. 通过实验证明显式规划优于隐式结构控制

---
papers.summary_en: We introduce **MusicLayout**, an explicit intermediate representation for structural control in text-to-music generation. Unlike current systems that rely solely on global text prompts, MusicLayout describes a piece as a time-aligned layout of sections, textures, repetitions, and instrument arrangements, serving as an interpretable planning layer. Integrated into a unified autoregressive framework, the model first generates this layout, then predicts audio tokens conditioned on it within a single sequence, allowing users to inspect and edit the structure before audio synthesis. Through layout-conditioned generation, manipulation experiments, and matched-data ablations, we demonstrate that explicit planning improves long-range structural organization and enables layout-level control. This work provides a practical mechanism for interpretable and revisable music structure generation.

papers.title: How People Evaluate AI-, Expert-, and Peer-Style Financial Advice
papers.abstract: As generative AI increasingly becomes a common source of daily decision-making, including financial choices, it is critical to understand how people evaluate AI-generated financial advice. We conducted a preregistered vignette experiment (N = 285) in which substantive financial content---including facts, numerical values, recommendation direction, and core reasoning---was held constant while communication style varied across AI Financial Assistant (AI), Certified Financial Planner (Expert), and Online Community Forum (OC) advice. Displayed source attribution was independently manipulated through correctly labeled, unlabeled, and mislabeled conditions, allowing us to separate attribution effects from source-specific communication cues. Expert advice was rated more favorably than AI advice on 9 of 10 outcomes (|d|=0.20--0.47), and this advantage remained visible without source labels, where Expert advice outperformed AI advice on 8 of 10 outcomes (up to d=0.60). Correct labels added limited differentiation, whereas mislabeling increased ratings of AI advice for situational fit and overall quality (d=0.42 for each) and attenuated the Expert advantage in situational fit (d=-0.36). Descriptive analyses further showed that AI advice was most responsive to displayed attribution and, conversely, that advice-style differences were most visible under an AI label. These findings show that financial-advice evaluations are shaped jointly by displayed attribution and message-level communication cues. We position disclosure not as a neutral transparency mechanism, but as an interpretive frame whose accuracy and interaction with message cues can shape trust and reliance.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
随着生成式AI日益成为日常决策（尤其是财务决策）的常见信息来源，理解人们如何评估AI生成的财务建议变得至关重要。现有研究往往混淆了“内容”与“风格”的效应，且对来源标注（如“AI生成”）的影响机制认识不足。

## 研究方法
本研究开展了一项预注册的情境实验（N=285）。实验巧妙地将实质性财务内容（事实、数值、建议方向、核心推理）完全固定，仅改变沟通风格，形成三类建议：AI财务助理（AI）、注册理财规划师（专家）、在线社区论坛（网友）。同时，独立操控来源标注：正确标注、不标注、错误标注，从而分离“标注效应”与“来源特有沟通线索”的影响。

## 主要发现
- **专家优势显著**：在10项评估指标中，专家建议有9项显著优于AI建议（效应量 |d|=0.20–0.47）。即使在无来源标注时，专家优势依然存在（10项中8项占优，最高d=0.60），说明风格本身即传递了专业信号。
- **标注的复杂作用**：正确标注只带来有限区分度；而错误标注（如将专家建议标为AI）反而提升了AI建议的情境契合度与整体质量（均d=0.42），同时削弱了专家在情境契合度上的优势（d=-0.36）。
- **不对称敏感性**：描述性分析显示，AI建议对来源标注的响应最敏感；反之，风格差异在“AI标签”下最明显。

## 核心结论与创新点
财务建议评价受“来源标注”与“信息层沟通线索”共同塑造。本研究将来源披露从“中立透明机制”重新定位为“解释框架”——其准确性及与信息线索的交互，会深刻影响信任与依赖。这为AI金融产品的设计、监管与用户教育提供了实证依据。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This preregistered vignette experiment (N=285) disentangles the effects of source attribution from communication style in financial advice evaluation, holding substantive content constant across AI, expert, and peer styles.

## Key Findings
Expert advice was rated significantly more favorably than AI advice on 9/10 outcomes (|d|=0.20–0.47), an advantage persisting even without labels (8/10, up to d=0.60). Correct labels added little differentiation, whereas mislabeling inflated AI ratings for fit and quality (d=0.42 each) and erased the expert advantage on fit (d=-0.36). AI advice proved most responsive to displayed attribution, and style differences were most visible under an AI label.

## Implications
We reframe source disclosure not as a neutral transparency tool but as an interpretive frame whose accuracy and interaction with message cues shape trust. This carries direct implications for AI-based financial service design, disclosure regulation, and user education.

papers.title: SignLlama: Enhancing Gloss-free Sign Language Translation by Prioritizing Visual Features for LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of tasks. However, fine-tuning LLMs for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation (GFSLT) remains a challenge. In this paper, we investigate how to effectively adapt LLMs to the GFSLT task. We show that there are two key issues that need to be solved: (1) the inherent distributional gap between visual feature inputs and text feature inputs makes it difficult for LLMs to interpret visual inputs; and (2) existing approaches typically concatenate visual and textual features in an autoregressive framework, which leads to the model overemphasizing textual inputs and deprioritizing visual cues, as LLMs are pretrained predominantly on text-centric data. To address the first challenge, we propose a simple yet effective method named Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining, which leverages filtered pseudo-gloss sequences generated from text sequences to supervise the training of the visual backbone. To tackle the second issue, we introduce a Visual-Prioritized Distillation training strategy. Specifically, we define a visual-only prediction path in which text inputs are masked, and the model is required to generate the target sequence relying solely on visual inputs. To guide this path, the outputs from the standard visual-textual prediction are then distilled into the visual-only prediction path, encouraging the model to prioritize visual features. Comprehensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. The proposed SignLlama achieves very competitive performance on multiple datasets for GFSLT tasks, without using any extra modalities or external sign language datasets for pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
大语言模型（LLMs）在众多任务中表现卓越，但在**无词汇表手语翻译（GFSLT）** 任务中，直接微调LLMs仍面临显著困难。本文识别出两大核心问题：
1. **特征分布鸿沟**：视觉特征与文本特征之间存在固有的分布差异，导致LLMs难以理解视觉输入。
2. **文本偏置问题**：现有方法在自回归框架中简单拼接视觉与文本特征，由于LLMs预训练以文本为中心，模型会过度关注文本输入而弱化视觉线索。

## 研究方法
针对上述挑战，本文提出 **SignLlama** 模型，包含两项关键技术：

### 1. 过滤伪词汇CTC预训练（Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining）
- 利用从文本序列生成的**过滤伪词汇序列**监督视觉骨干网络训练
- 有效弥合视觉与文本特征之间的分布差距，使视觉特征更易被LLMs理解

### 2. 视觉优先蒸馏训练策略（Visual-Prioritized Distillation）
- 定义**纯视觉预测路径**：遮蔽文本输入，模型仅依赖视觉信息生成目标序列
- 将标准视觉-文本联合预测的输出蒸馏至纯视觉路径
- 强制模型优先利用视觉特征，缓解文本偏置问题

## 主要结果与贡献
- 在多个GFSLT基准数据集上取得**极具竞争力的性能**
- 无需额外模态或外部手语数据集进行预训练
- 通过消融实验和定性分析验证了各模块的有效性

**核心创新**在于系统性地解决了LLMs在手语翻译中视觉特征利用不足的问题，为GFSLT任务提供了新的技术路径。

---
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper presents **SignLlama**, a novel framework for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation (GFSLT) that effectively adapts Large Language Models (LLMs) to visual inputs. We identify two critical obstacles: the distributional gap between visual and textual features, and the text-centric bias in autoregressive models that deprioritizes visual cues.

## Proposed Methods
To address these issues, we introduce: (1) **Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining**, which supervises visual backbone training using filtered pseudo-gloss sequences derived from text, bridging the visual-textual feature gap; and (2) **Visual-Prioritized Distillation**, where a text-masked visual-only prediction path is trained by distilling knowledge from the standard visual-textual path, forcing the model to prioritize visual features.

## Results & Impact
SignLlama achieves highly competitive performance across multiple GFSLT benchmarks **without any extra modalities or external sign language datasets**. Our work provides a practical solution for integrating visual signals into LLMs, advancing sign language translation technology.

papers.title: DeepFreqMark: End-To-End Learnable Frequency-Domain Watermarking with Spherical Attack Simulation for Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: The proliferation of AI-generated images produced by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) has raised critical concerns regarding copyright infringement and misinformation. Although existing frequency-domain watermarking methods embed handcrafted geometric patterns into the initial latent noise prior to generation, they suffer from limited capacity and rigid pattern designs. We propose DeepFreqMark, an end-to-end learnable frequency-domain watermarking framework that replaces manual pattern engineering with a neural message encoder and decoder. To circumvent the computational bottleneck caused by Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) inversion during training, we introduce a Spherical Linear Interpolation (Slerp)-based attack simulation. This approach operates directly on the noise latent while strictly preserving the Gaussian variance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeepFreqMark achieves significantly lower Bit Error Rates (BER) than baseline methods under real-world attacks and scales to 256 bits message capacity. Our source code is available at https://github.com/chenhsiu48/DeepFreqMark.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
潜在扩散模型（LDMs）生成的AI图像日益泛滥，引发严重的版权侵权与虚假信息担忧。现有频域水印方法虽能在生成前将手工设计的几何图案嵌入初始潜噪声，但存在**容量有限**和**模式僵化**两大缺陷。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **DeepFreqMark**——一种端到端可学习的频域水印框架，核心创新包括：
1. **神经编解码器替代手工设计**：用可训练的消息编码器与解码器取代人工图案，实现自适应水印嵌入与提取。
2. **基于球面线性插值（Slerp）的攻击模拟**：针对训练中DDIM反演带来的计算瓶颈，直接在噪声潜变量上模拟攻击，同时严格保持高斯方差特性，大幅降低训练开销。

## 主要发现与结果
- **鲁棒性显著提升**：在真实攻击场景下，比特错误率（BER）大幅低于基线方法。
- **高容量支持**：可扩展至**256比特**消息容量，远超传统方法。
- **实用性验证**：代码已开源，便于复现与二次开发。

## 意义
该工作首次将频域水印从“手工特征工程”推向“全自动学习范式”，为AI生成内容版权保护提供了高性能、可扩展的新方案，尤其适用于需要大容量嵌入的批量生成场景。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We present **DeepFreqMark**, an end-to-end learnable frequency-domain watermarking framework for Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs). Unlike prior handcrafted pattern-based methods, it employs neural message encoders/decoders for adaptive embedding.

## Key Innovation
To avoid computationally prohibitive DDIM inversion during training, we introduce a **Spherical Linear Interpolation (Slerp)-based attack simulation** that operates directly on noise latents while preserving Gaussian variance, dramatically reducing training cost.

## Results & Impact
Extensive experiments show our method achieves **significantly lower Bit Error Rates** under real-world attacks compared to baselines, and scales to **256-bit message capacity**—a substantial improvement over existing approaches. This work shifts frequency-domain watermarking from rigid manual design to a flexible learning paradigm, offering a robust and scalable solution for AI-generated image copyright protection. Code is publicly available.
