papers.title: Beyond Tables: Doc2DB-Bench for Relationally Faithful Document-to-Database Construction
papers.abstract: Practical AI systems increasingly need to turn long, heterogeneous documents into queryable relational databases, not isolated spreadsheets. In domains such as finance, healthcare, education, transportation, and enterprise operations, downstream workflows rely on normalized schemas, entity identities, keys, cross-table relationships, and integrity constraints for analytics, compliance, auditing, and SQL-backed decision making. Existing Document-to-Table benchmarks are insufficient for this setting: flattening evidence into single tables can duplicate entities, obscure many-to-many relationships, create sparse records, and avoid testing whether extracted facts form a valid database instance. This creates an urgent need to evaluate document understanding as database construction rather than field extraction. We introduce Doc2DB-Bench, a benchmark for Document-to-Database construction, containing 203 long-document instances across 42 schemas and seven domain groups, with 117 entity tables, 132 relationship tables, 7,341 rows, and 41,935 cells. Built through a controllable DB-to-Doc synthesis pipeline and organized by a taxonomy of intra-table extraction and inter-table reasoning, the generated documents undergo authenticity verification, proving indistinguishable from real-world references. Doc2DB-Bench thus provides a testbed for reliable, auditable, and relationally faithful LLM-based data systems. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
## 摘要

**背景与问题：** 实际AI系统日益需要将长篇异构文档转化为可查询的关系型数据库，而非孤立的电子表格。在金融、医疗、教育、交通和企业运营等领域，下游工作流依赖规范化模式、实体标识、键、跨表关系和完整性约束，以支持分析、合规、审计及基于SQL的决策。现有“文档到表格”基准不足以应对该场景：将证据扁平化为单表会导致实体重复、掩盖多对多关系、产生稀疏记录，且无法检验抽取事实是否构成有效数据库实例。因此，亟需将文档理解评估从“字段提取”转向“数据库构建”。

**方法：** 本文提出 **Doc2DB-Bench**，一个面向文档到数据库构建的基准，包含42个模式、7个领域组下的203个长文档实例，涵盖117个实体表、132个关系表、7,341行和41,935个单元格。该基准通过可控的“数据库到文档”合成流水线构建，并依据“表内提取”与“表间推理”的分类体系组织。生成文档经过真实性验证，证明与真实世界参考资料难以区分。

**主要发现与创新：** Doc2DB-Bench 提供了评估LLM数据系统在可靠性、可审计性和关系保真度方面的测试平台，填补了现有基准在跨表关系与完整性约束评估上的空白。基准已公开于 https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench。
papers.summary_en:
## Summary

This paper introduces **Doc2DB-Bench**, a benchmark for Document-to-Database construction, addressing the gap in evaluating LLMs beyond flat-table extraction. It contains 203 long-document instances across 42 schemas and 7 domains, with 117 entity tables, 132 relationship tables, 7,341 rows, and 41,935 cells. Built via a controllable DB-to-Doc synthesis pipeline and organized by intra-table extraction and inter-table reasoning taxonomy, the documents pass authenticity verification against real-world references. The benchmark uniquely tests normalized schemas, keys, cross-table relationships, and integrity constraints—critical for auditable, SQL-backed decision systems. It provides a rigorous testbed for relationally faithful LLM-based data systems. Publicly available at https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench.
papers.summary:
## 摘要

**背景与问题：** 实际AI系统日益需要将长篇异构文档转化为可查询的关系型数据库，而非孤立的电子表格。在金融、医疗、教育、交通和企业运营等领域，下游工作流依赖规范化模式、实体标识、键、跨表关系和完整性约束，以支持分析、合规、审计及基于SQL的决策。现有“文档到表格”基准不足以应对该场景：将证据扁平化为单表会导致实体重复、掩盖多对多关系、产生稀疏记录，且无法检验抽取事实是否构成有效数据库实例。因此，亟需将文档理解评估从“字段提取”转向“数据库构建”。

**方法：** 本文提出 **Doc2DB-Bench**，一个面向文档到数据库构建的基准，包含42个模式、7个领域组下的203个长文档实例，涵盖117个实体表、132个关系表、7,341行和41,935个单元格。该基准通过可控的“数据库到文档”合成流水线构建，并依据“表内提取”与“表间推理”的分类体系组织。生成文档经过真实性验证，证明与真实世界参考资料难以区分。

**主要发现与创新：** Doc2DB-Bench 提供了评估LLM数据系统在可靠性、可审计性和关系保真度方面的测试平台，填补了现有基准在跨表关系与完整性约束评估上的空白。基准已公开于 https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench。

papers.title: What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable? Evidence from 138K SKILL.md Files
papers.abstract: Under the current standard, Agent Skills are SKILL.md files that combine instructions with supporting resources, enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures beyond a single conversation. Yet many public skills appear to originate from a single task, repository, or conversation, even when they are shared as reusable components. We analyze this gap across 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy grounded in the official specification and best-practice guidance. We find that 91.8% of skills contain at least one detected defect, with stable estimates across lenient and strict thresholds (88.8-94.6%). The dominant failures are ordinary packaging problems rather than exotic attacks: weak routing metadata, bloated or non-actionable bodies, and poor resource organization. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills shows the functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved more reliably from startup descriptions than skills with routing defects. Defect rates vary by platform and provenance: specification-aware skills contain fewer defects, while AI-marked skills show more safety and portability problems. Lightweight enforcement and repair experiments support a quality-assured generation workflow combining spec-aware prompting, lightweight linting, automated repair, and safety gating.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
当前Agent Skills的标准形式是SKILL.md文件，它将指令与辅助资源结合，使大语言模型（LLM）代理能在单次对话之外复用流程。然而，大量公开技能似乎源于单一任务、仓库或对话，即使它们被作为可复用组件分享。这种“名义可复用”与“实际不可复用”之间的差距是本研究关注的核心问题。

## 研究方法
本研究构建了一个基于官方规范与最佳实践指南的两层缺陷分类体系，对来自20,556个仓库的138,133个公开SKILL.md文件进行了系统性分析。该分类体系涵盖路由元数据、正文质量、资源组织、安全与可移植性等维度。研究还设计了一个确定性路由压力测试，对20,000个技能进行功能影响评估。

## 主要发现
- **缺陷普遍性**：91.8%的技能至少包含一个检测到的缺陷，在宽松与严格阈值下估计稳定（88.8%-94.6%）。
- **主导缺陷类型**：主要是普通打包问题而非恶意攻击——路由元数据薄弱、正文臃肿或不可操作、资源组织混乱。
- **功能影响**：路由压力测试显示，具有有效路由元数据的技能从启动描述中被检索的可靠性显著高于有路由缺陷的技能。
- **平台与来源差异**：规范感知的技能缺陷更少，而AI标记的技能在安全性和可移植性方面问题更多。

## 创新与贡献
本研究首次在大规模语料上量化了Agent Skills的可复用性缺陷分布，并提出了一套轻量级质量保障工作流，结合规范感知提示、轻量级linting、自动修复和安全门控，为生成高质量、可复用的Agent Skills提供了实证基础与实用方案。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Findings
This study analyzes 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy based on official specifications. **91.8% of skills contain at least one defect**, with dominant failures being ordinary packaging issues—weak routing metadata, bloated bodies, and poor resource organization—rather than malicious patterns. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills confirms functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved significantly more reliably than those with routing defects. Defect rates vary by provenance: specification-aware skills show fewer defects, while AI-marked skills exhibit more safety and portability problems. The authors propose a lightweight quality-assured workflow combining spec-aware prompting, linting, automated repair, and safety gating, offering a practical path toward genuinely reusable agent skills.

papers.title: TRACE-Memory: Public-Conditioned Retrieval and Utility-Aware Evidence Admission for Personalized Generation
papers.abstract: Personalized generation systems retrieve user history by request--memory relevance and inject it into the model context. Yet relevant history may concern the wrong preference aspect, duplicate public information, or provide insufficient support. We argue that personal memory should be used only when it adds utility beyond a public-only response. We propose TRACE-Memory, a two-stage framework for selective personalization. Stage 1 queries for user-specific information missing from the request and public context, then retrieves a coverage-oriented candidate pool. Stage 2 admits a compact subset of source-traceable evidence units, or the empty set, according to response-level incremental utility. We progressively train the query-generation and evidence-admission policies through structured SFT initialization, reduced-space stage-wise GRPO warm-up, and nested multi-sample Joint GRPO. Across 4,500 Controlled and Natural tasks from Goodreads, Amazon Reviews, and Reddit, TRACE-Memory consistently outperforms random and lexical memory use, improves over semantic retrieval, remains competitive with frontier-LLM memory pipelines as local generator capacity increases, and conditions evidence admission on public-context sufficiency, supporting selective rather than default personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
个性化生成系统通常依据“请求-记忆相关性”检索用户历史并注入模型上下文。然而，相关历史可能涉及错误的偏好维度、重复公开信息或提供不足的证据支持。本文提出核心观点：**个人记忆仅应在能带来超越纯公开响应的增量效用时使用**，而非默认启用。

## 方法：TRACE-Memory
本文提出 **TRACE-Memory**，一个两阶段选择性个性化框架：
- **阶段一（覆盖导向检索）**：生成查询以捕获请求与公开上下文中缺失的用户特定信息，构建覆盖导向的候选池。
- **阶段二（效用感知证据准入）**：根据响应级增量效用，准入一个紧凑的、可溯源证据单元子集（或空集），即当公开上下文已足够时，拒绝注入任何记忆。

训练采用渐进式策略：结构化SFT初始化 → 降维分阶段GRPO预热 → 嵌套多样本联合GRPO，分别优化查询生成与证据准入策略。

## 主要发现与贡献
在来自 Goodreads、Amazon Reviews 和 Reddit 的 4,500 个受控与自然任务上，TRACE-Memory 取得以下结果：
1. **显著优于基线**：超越随机与词法记忆使用，并优于语义检索方法。
2. **可扩展性**：随着本地生成器容量增加，与前沿LLM记忆流水线保持竞争力。
3. **选择性个性化**：证据准入条件依赖于公开上下文充分性，避免冗余或有害记忆注入，支持“按需个性化”而非“默认个性化”。

**核心创新**在于将记忆使用从“相关性驱动”转为“效用驱动”，并实现可训练、可溯源的两阶段决策，为个性化生成提供更稳健、更可解释的范式。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
TRACE-Memory introduces a **utility-driven, two-stage selective personalization framework**. It first generates queries to retrieve user-specific information absent from the request and public context, then admits a compact, source-traceable evidence subset—or an empty set—based on response-level incremental utility. This shifts memory usage from relevance-based to utility-based, preventing redundant or preference-mismatched injections.

## Key Results
Evaluated on 4,500 controlled and natural tasks from Goodreads, Amazon Reviews, and Reddit, TRACE-Memory **consistently outperforms** random and lexical memory baselines and improves over semantic retrieval. It remains competitive with frontier-LLM memory pipelines as local generator capacity grows, and crucially, it conditions evidence admission on public-context sufficiency—enabling **selective rather than default personalization**.

## Significance
The work provides a trainable, interpretable paradigm that only leverages personal memory when it adds measurable value beyond a public-only response, advancing trustworthy and efficient personalized generation.

papers.title: Forgotten History or Test-of-Time? Retrospect and Prospect on RAG from an IR Perspective
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely regarded as a novel paradigm born from the limitations of large language models (LLMs)--a mechanism to ground their outputs in external knowledge. This view, however, is incomplete when considered within a broader historical context. In this paper, we argue that the core ideas underlying RAG are not new: foundational concepts such as integrating retrieval and language generation, knowledge augmentation, answer verification, and iterative query (or prompt) refinement had already been studied and instantiated in information retrieval (IR) and question answering (QA) research dating back to the early 2000s, well before the emergence of LLMs.   We make this case by systematically tracing the intellectual lineage of modern RAG and Agentic RAG back to their classical IR and QA antecedents, and examining why this continuity has gone under-recognized -- a consequence of community fragmentation, shifting terminology, and the recency bias endemic to fast-moving fields. Rather than treating LLMs as the origin point of retrieval-augmented intelligence, we propose viewing them as a new interface layer atop a decades-old QA architecture. This reframing is not merely historical: by situating RAG within the longer trajectory of IR research, we surface underutilized prior work -- on user modeling, answer validation, and query refinement -- that can directly inform next-generation RAG design, reducing unintentional rediscovery and fostering genuine cross-community integration.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与核心论点
检索增强生成（RAG）常被视为大语言模型（LLM）局限性催生的全新范式，用于将模型输出锚定于外部知识。然而，本文指出这一认知在更宏大的历史语境下并不完整。我们论证，RAG 的核心思想并非新事物：**检索与生成集成、知识增强、答案验证、迭代式查询（提示）优化**等基础概念，早在 2000 年代初的信息检索（IR）与问答（QA）研究中就已被系统探索并落地实现，远早于 LLM 的出现。

## 研究方法与主要发现
- **谱系追溯**：系统梳理现代 RAG 与 Agentic RAG 的智识脉络，将其逐一对应至经典 IR/QA 的先驱工作，揭示技术演进的连续性。
- **认知断层归因**：分析这一连续性为何被低估——社区碎片化、术语漂移，以及快速迭代领域固有的“近因偏差”（recency bias）。
- **视角重构**：主张不应将 LLM 视为检索增强智能的起点，而应将其看作**架设在数十年 QA 架构之上的新接口层**。

## 创新点与未来启示
这一重新框定并非仅具史学意义。通过将 RAG 置于 IR 研究的长期发展轨迹中，我们挖掘出大量被忽视的既有成果——涉及**用户建模、答案校验、查询精化**——它们可直接赋能下一代 RAG 设计，减少无意的“重新发明”，并促进跨社区的真融合。论文呼吁学界正视这段“被遗忘的历史”，以时间检验（test-of-time）的视角推动 RAG 的稳健演进。
papers.summary_en: This paper challenges the prevailing narrative that Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a novel paradigm born solely from LLM limitations. We demonstrate that its foundational ideas—integrating retrieval with generation, knowledge augmentation, answer verification, and iterative query refinement—were already instantiated in IR and QA research as early as the 2000s. By systematically tracing RAG and Agentic RAG back to these classical antecedents, we identify why this continuity has been overlooked: community fragmentation, shifting terminology, and recency bias. We propose reframing LLMs not as the origin of retrieval-augmented intelligence, but as a new interface layer over a decades-old QA architecture. This historical recontextualization surfaces underutilized prior work on user modeling, answer validation, and query refinement, offering direct guidance for next-generation RAG design and fostering cross-community integration. Ultimately, we argue that recognizing this forgotten history prevents redundant rediscovery and enables more mature, test-of-time-informed RAG development.

papers.title: Human-Guided Causal Knowledge Injection for Virtual Cells
papers.abstract: Virtual cells employ machine learning models to simulate and predict cellular behaviors, serving as a critical computational framework for investigating health and disease. Injecting causal graphs into virtual cells can improve the interpretability, but such graphs are usually not available in real-world applications. Recently, many methods have been proposed to construct causal graphs from data, which group genes based on their similarities to form concepts and extract their causal relationships. However, since this automatic process is unsupervised, the causal graphs usually contain errors. In this paper, we propose a human-guided causal knowledge injection method for virtual cells. We developed a gene-similarity-aware causal graph visualization supported by a hybrid optimization algorithm to help explore both the causal relationships between concepts and the similarities between genes. Based on the exploration, we further developed a counterfactual analysis strategy supported by a counterfactual visualization and a causal path visualization to help validate and refine causal graphs. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated through two real-world case studies, the extraction of scientifically meaningful causal insights, and positive feedback from domain experts.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
虚拟细胞利用机器学习模型模拟和预测细胞行为，是研究健康与疾病的重要计算框架。将因果图注入虚拟细胞可提升模型可解释性，但真实应用中这类图通常难以获取。现有自动构建因果图的方法虽能基于基因相似性分组形成概念并提取因果关系，但因其无监督特性，生成的因果图常包含错误。

## 方法创新
本文提出一种**人机协同的因果知识注入方法**，核心包含两大模块：
1. **基因相似性感知的因果图可视化**：结合混合优化算法，同时呈现概念间的因果关联与基因间的相似性，辅助研究者探索图结构。
2. **反事实分析策略**：配套反事实可视化与因果路径可视化，支持研究者对因果图进行验证、修正与细化。

## 主要发现与验证
通过两个真实世界案例研究，该方法成功提取了具有科学意义的因果洞察，并获得领域专家的积极反馈，证明了其在提升虚拟细胞因果图准确性与可用性方面的有效性。

## 核心贡献
- 首次将人类知识主动注入虚拟细胞的因果图构建流程，弥补纯自动方法的缺陷
- 提供交互式可视化工具链，实现“探索-验证-优化”闭环
- 为计算生物学中的可解释AI提供新范式
papers.summary_en: This paper presents a human-guided causal knowledge injection method for virtual cells, addressing the challenge that automatically constructed causal graphs often contain errors due to their unsupervised nature. The approach features two key innovations: a gene-similarity-aware causal graph visualization with hybrid optimization for exploring concept-level causality and gene-level similarity, and a counterfactual analysis strategy with dedicated visualizations for validating and refining causal graphs. Validated through two real-world case studies, the method successfully extracted scientifically meaningful causal insights and received positive feedback from domain experts, demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing the interpretability and accuracy of virtual cell models. This work bridges automated causal discovery and human expertise, offering a new paradigm for interpretable AI in computational biology.

## 方法创新

1. **基因相似性感知的因果图可视化**：结合混合优化算法，同时呈现概念间的因果关联与基因间的相似性，辅助研究者探索图结构。
2. **反事实分析策略**：配套反事实可视化与因果路径可视化，支持研究者对因果图进行验证、修正与细化。

## 主要发现与验证
通过两个真实世界案例研究，该方法成功提取了具有科学意义的因果洞察，并获得领域专家的积极反馈，证明了其在提升虚拟细胞因果图准确性与可用性方面的有效性。

## 核心贡献
- 首次将人类知识主动注入虚拟细胞的因果图构建流程，弥补纯自动方法的缺陷
- 提供交互式可视化工具链，实现“探索-验证-优化”闭环
- 为计算生物学中的可解释AI提供新范式

papers.title: Estimating Uncertainty in Galaxy Morphology Classification
papers.abstract: Astronomers classify galaxy morphology to investigate cosmic evolution. While deep foundation models are increasingly utilized in Galaxy Morphology Classification (GMC), little work has been done on evaluating the uncertainty of GMC results. Uncertainty evaluation is important because astronomical data are inherently noisy due to instrumental and environmental limitations. Also, the continuous evolution of galaxies creates intrinsic morphological ambiguity. However, current foundation models operate as deterministic point estimators, failing to quantify the uncertainty. To overcome this limitation, we propose UEGMC, a post-hoc framework of Uncertainty Estimation for Galaxy Morphology Classification. It categorizes uncertainty in GMC into distinct types by model parameters, astronomical data, reference standards, or intrinsic physical ambiguities, thereby facilitating better classification. Our framework can directly predict uncertainties from representations extracted from the frozen backbones of foundation models, without computationally expensive sampling, therefore enabling fine-grained uncertainty evaluations. Our experimental results demonstrate that UEGMC provides competitive uncertainty quantification performance compared with previous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
天文学家通过星系形态分类探究宇宙演化规律。当前，深度基础模型在星系形态分类（GMC）中应用日益广泛，但针对分类结果的不确定性评估研究却十分匮乏。由于仪器和环境限制，天文数据天然含有噪声；同时，星系的持续演化也导致其形态存在内在模糊性。然而，现有基础模型通常作为确定性点估计器运行，无法量化这些不确定性。

## 方法创新
针对上述局限，本文提出 **UEGMC**——一种用于星系形态分类的不确定性估计后处理框架。该框架将GMC中的不确定性按来源系统划分为四类：模型参数不确定性、天文数据噪声、参考标准差异以及内在物理模糊性，从而帮助实现更精细的分类决策。其核心创新在于：**无需昂贵的采样过程**，直接从冻结的基础模型骨干网络提取的表示中预测不确定性，实现细粒度的、计算高效的不确定性量化。

## 主要发现与结论
实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，UEGMC在不确定性量化性能上具有竞争力，能够以极低计算开销为星系形态分类提供可靠的不确定性估计。该框架为天文大模型的可信推理提供了新思路，有望推动高噪声天文场景下的鲁棒科学分析。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **UEGMC**, a post-hoc framework for uncertainty estimation in galaxy morphology classification. Unlike existing deterministic foundation models, UEGMC categorizes uncertainty into four sources—model parameters, data noise, reference standards, and intrinsic physical ambiguity—and directly predicts them from frozen backbone representations without costly sampling.

## Key Results
Experiments demonstrate that UEGMC achieves competitive uncertainty quantification performance compared to prior methods, while requiring substantially lower computational overhead. This enables reliable, fine-grained uncertainty assessment for large-scale astronomical surveys, supporting more trustworthy scientific inference in noisy observational data.

papers.title: From Product Search to Preference Articulation: The Economics of Agentic Commerce
papers.abstract: Generative AI is shifting digital commerce from browsing toward agentic search, in which consumers delegate product discovery to AI agents. We compare manual search, which accurately evaluates a limited product set, with agentic search, which screens a broad catalog through noisy representations of preferences and products. Preference complexity is the number of satisfaction-relevant dimensions that are difficult to articulate before search but readily evaluated upon inspection. Consumers have finite attention and choose search intensity: products inspected manually or preference-refinement depth with an agent. We obtain three findings. First, manual search collapses beyond a finite complexity threshold: inspection ceases, mismatch reaches the no-search benchmark, and platform revenue falls to zero. Agentic search avoids this collapse. Once refinement becomes worthwhile, it remains worthwhile as complexity rises; mismatch stays below the no-search benchmark and revenue remains positive, although articulation effort and mismatch may increase. Second, platforms rank the regimes by conversion revenue, whereas consumers also bear search expenditure. When manual inspection is sufficiently inexpensive, agentic search becomes revenue-superior before consumers voluntarily adopt it, creating an adoption lag in which consumers rationally continue manual search. Third, conditional on agentic participation, platforms may assign lower fidelity to consumers with larger attention budgets because they can offset noisier representations through additional refinement, yielding an inverted fidelity allocation. Agentic commerce thus shifts scarcity from product inspection to preference articulation, making consumers' willingness and ability to interact central to voluntary use and platform fidelity design.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文研究生成式AI如何将数字商务从“浏览”推向“代理式搜索”——消费者将产品发现任务委托给AI代理。核心问题是：**当偏好难以预先表述时，代理式搜索与人工搜索的经济效率孰优孰劣？**

## 模型设定
- **人工搜索**：精准评估有限产品集，但受注意力约束
- **代理式搜索**：通过偏好与产品的“噪声表征”筛选海量目录
- **偏好复杂度**：指搜索前难以言明、但检视时易于评估的满意度相关维度数量
- 消费者具有有限注意力，可自主选择人工检视强度或代理细化深度

## 三个核心发现
1. **人工搜索的崩溃**：当偏好复杂度超过有限阈值时，人工检视停止，错配达到“无搜索”基准，平台收入归零。代理式搜索可避免此崩溃——一旦细化变得值得，复杂度上升时它依然值得，错配始终低于无搜索基准，收入保持为正（尽管表述努力与错配可能增加）。

2. **采用滞后悖论**：平台按转化收入排序两种模式，但消费者还需承担搜索成本。当人工检视足够廉价时，代理式搜索在消费者自愿采用之前就已实现收入优势，造成“采用滞后”——理性消费者继续使用人工搜索。

3. **倒置保真度分配**：在代理参与条件下，平台可能对注意力预算更大的消费者分配**更低**的表示保真度，因为他们可通过额外细化抵消噪声，形成倒置的保真度配置。

## 结论
代理式商业将稀缺性从“产品检视”转移到“偏好表述”，使消费者互动的意愿与能力成为自愿采用与平台保真度设计的核心。

## Implication
Agentic commerce shifts scarcity from product inspection to preference articulation, making consumer willingness and ability to interact central to platform design and voluntary usage.

papers.title: Math-Vision Diagrams: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Mathematical Diagram Generation Capabilities
papers.abstract: The generation of mathematically precise diagrams from tex- tual prompts has emerged as a critical yet underexplored capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). This has been of interest to researchers in the areas of curriculum preparation, automated ranking of problem sets, and scientific publishing. For LLMs to achieve this, it requires per- fect coordination between Spatial Reasoning, Mathematical Reasoning, and Rendering systems. While existing benchmarks such as MathVision, MathVista are built for Math Reasoning or DiagramGenBenchmark, Mer- maidSeqBench on general purpose diagram generation, no prior work provides a standardized set of prompt, image pairs that can be used to evaluate the LLMs specifically on math diagram generation. This includes fields that span both both text-to-code and text-to-image paradigms. We introduce Math-Vision Diagrams, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on mathematical diagram generation, and the first to assess text-to-code and text-to-image generation paradigms together in a single unified setting, agnostic of the underlying coding lan- guage or model type. Building on the Math-Vision benchmark, we select a subset of 2920 images out of 3040 from high-quality competition problems with essential visual context. A novel pipeline combining an ensemble of LLMs with Subject Matter Expert (SME) curation is presented, together with a suite of evaluation metrics. Testing several leading models against this benchmark, we demonstrate that LLMs struggle with math diagram generation. All code, data, curation pipeline, and evaluation scripts will be fully open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
**研究背景与问题**  
从文本提示生成数学精确的图表，已成为大语言模型（LLM）一项关键但尚未充分探索的能力，在课程准备、题目自动排序和科学出版等领域具有重要应用价值。该任务要求LLM在空间推理、数学推理与渲染系统之间实现完美协同。现有基准（如MathVision、MathVista）侧重数学推理，或如DiagramGenBenchmark、MermaidSeqBench仅覆盖通用图表生成，均缺乏专门针对数学图表生成的标准提示-图像对评估集，也未能统一覆盖文本到代码与文本到图像两种范式。

**方法创新**  
本文提出 **Math-Vision Diagrams**，这是首个专门评估LLM数学图表生成能力的基准，也是首个在同一统一框架下同时评估文本到代码与文本到图像范式的基准，且不依赖底层编程语言或模型类型。基于Math-Vision基准，我们从3040幅高难度竞赛题图像中精选2920幅（含关键视觉上下文），构建了结合多LLM集成与领域专家（SME）人工审核的新型数据管线，并配套一套完整评估指标。

**主要发现**  
对多个领先模型的测试表明，LLM在数学图表生成任务上表现困难，显著落后于人类水平。该基准揭示了现有模型在精确几何关系、符号标注及布局合理性等方面的系统性缺陷。

**开源贡献**  
所有代码、数据、数据管线及评估脚本将完全开源，以推动该领域后续研究。
papers.summary_en: **Math-Vision Diagrams** is the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on mathematical diagram generation, and the first to jointly assess text-to-code and text-to-image paradigms in a unified, model-agnostic setting. Built upon the Math-Vision dataset, we curate 2,920 high-quality competition problems with essential visual context via a novel pipeline combining LLM ensembles and subject-matter-expert review. Testing leading models reveals that LLMs struggle significantly with this task, exhibiting systematic failures in geometric precision, symbol placement, and layout coherence. All code, data, curation pipeline, and evaluation scripts will be fully open-sourced to facilitate future research.

papers.title: Gradient Under Microscope: Benchmarking Resource Utilization of Memory-Efficient Gradient Computation Methods
papers.abstract: AI training's rising resource intensity is straining electricity supplies and carbon budgets, motivating systematic study of memory-efficient training on constrained hardware. We benchmark five gradient optimizers (SGD, Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta, and Conjugate Gradient Descent) under three memory strategies (standard training, gradient checkpointing, and gradient accumulation) across four transformer architectures (ViT, ModernBERT, Llama 3.1 1B, and NanoVLM), measuring training loss, GPU utilization, training time, and memory usage. Gradient accumulation emerges as the most reliable strategy, cutting training loss by roughly an order of magnitude on the vision-language model and about four-fold on the language model without additional GPU memory. Contrary to common practice, Adam is not universally superior: Adadelta and SGD outperform it on the encoder and autoregressive architectures. Gradient checkpointing's effect is strongly architecture-dependent, improving vision transformer loss while severely degrading the encoder model, and it increases training time by up to 60% on memory-bound models. GPU utilization is governed primarily by architecture, ranging from 8-15% for the memory-bound language model to 96-99% for compute-bound vision models. These findings provide practical guidelines for optimizer and gradient-strategy selection in resource-efficient model training and deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机
AI 模型训练的资源消耗日益加剧，对电力供应与碳排放构成严峻挑战。在受限硬件上实现高效训练，已成为系统性研究的重要方向，其中梯度计算的内存优化尤为关键。

## 研究方法
本研究对五种梯度优化器（**SGD、Adam、Adagrad、Adadelta、共轭梯度下降**）在三种内存策略（**标准训练、梯度检查点、梯度累积**）下进行了系统基准测试。实验覆盖四种 Transformer 架构（**ViT、ModernBERT、Llama 3.1 1B、NanoVLM**），重点评估训练损失、GPU 利用率、训练时间与内存占用四项指标。

## 核心发现
- **梯度累积表现最稳健**：在视觉-语言模型上训练损失降低约一个数量级，在语言模型上降低约四倍，且无需额外 GPU 内存。
- **Adam 并非普适最优**：在编码器与自回归架构上，Adadelta 与 SGD 表现优于 Adam，挑战了常规选择。
- **梯度检查点效果依赖架构**：能改善 ViT 损失，但严重损害编码器模型；在内存受限模型上训练时间增加高达 60%。
- **GPU 利用率主要由架构决定**：内存受限的语言模型仅为 8-15%，而计算受限的视觉模型可达 96-99%。

## 实践意义
本研究为资源高效训练中的优化器与梯度策略选择提供了实证指导，有助于在硬件受限场景下平衡内存、速度与模型质量，推动可持续 AI 发展。
papers.summary_en:
## Key Contributions
This paper presents the first systematic benchmarking of five gradient optimizers (SGD, Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta, and Conjugate Gradient Descent) under three memory-reduction strategies (standard training, gradient checkpointing, and gradient accumulation) across four transformer architectures (ViT, ModernBERT, Llama 3.1 1B, and NanoVLM).

## Main Findings
Gradient accumulation proves most reliable, reducing training loss by an order of magnitude on vision-language models and four-fold on language models without extra memory. Adam is not universally superior—Adadelta and SGD outperform it on encoder and autoregressive architectures. Gradient checkpointing shows strong architecture dependence, improving ViT but severely degrading encoder models, while increasing training time by up to 60% on memory-bound models. GPU utilization is primarily architecture-driven, ranging from 8-15% (memory-bound language models) to 96-99% (compute-bound vision models).

## Practical Value
These results offer actionable guidelines for selecting optimizers and gradient strategies in resource-constrained training, enabling better trade-offs among memory, speed, and model quality for sustainable AI deployment.

papers.title: Can Webcam Gaze Constrain Mesa-Objectives in Driving Models? An Instrument Precision Analysis
papers.abstract: Current hazard detection systems in autonomous driving may develop mesa objectives, learned internal goals that achieve high training performance through spurious correlations rather than genuine hazard recognition. We investigate whether human gaze patterns, captured via webcam-based eye tracking (WebGazer.js), can serve as privileged information to constrain mesa-objective formation. We collected 137,663 frame-level gaze samples synchronized with hazard annotations across 388 real dashcam clips, then test this hypothesis across two calibration protocols (9-point/45-click and 11-point/440-click), two model architectures (Random Forest and causal Transformer), and five random seeds per experiment with paired t-tests. No experiment yields a statistically significant improvement from gaze (p = 0.919, 0.578, and 0.667 respectively). A geometric analysis reveals the root cause: WebGazer's reported error (~130-257 px depending on configuration) exceeds 93% of detected hazard object sizes (median 36 px), rendering object-level gaze attribution physically impossible at this instrument precision.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
自动驾驶中的危险检测系统可能产生“元目标”（mesa-objectives）——即模型通过虚假相关性而非真实危险识别来获得高训练性能的内部学习目标。本文首次探索：网络摄像头眼动数据能否作为特权信息，约束此类元目标的形成。

## 方法与数据  
我们采集了388段真实行车记录仪视频，同步获取137,663帧级注视样本与危险标注。实验设计包含：  
- **两种标定协议**：9点/45次点击 与 11点/440次点击  
- **两种模型架构**：随机森林 与 因果Transformer  
- **每种实验5个随机种子**，并采用配对t检验  

## 主要发现  
**所有实验均未显示眼动数据的显著改善**（p值分别为0.919、0.578、0.667）。几何分析揭示了根本原因：  
- WebGazer报告的误差范围（约130-257像素，依配置而定）  
- 该误差超过93%检测到的危险目标尺寸（中位数仅36像素）  
- **在此仪器精度下，目标级注视归因在物理上不可实现**

## 创新与意义  
本研究首次从仪器精度角度系统量化了低成本眼动追踪在自动驾驶安全任务中的可行性边界。结论表明：**当前网络摄像头眼动精度不足以约束驾驶模型的元目标**，这为未来研究指明了方向——需更高精度设备（如红外眼动仪）或算法级补偿方案。本工作为自动驾驶安全领域提供了重要的实证基准与负面结果报告，避免后续研究重复投入无效路径。

papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This study provides the first systematic precision analysis of webcam-based gaze data for constraining mesa-objectives in autonomous driving hazard detection. We collected 137,663 synchronized gaze-hazard samples from 388 real dashcam clips, testing across two calibration protocols, two model architectures (Random Forest and causal Transformer), and five seeds per condition with paired t-tests.

## Key Results  
**No statistically significant improvement from gaze was found** (p = 0.919, 0.578, 0.667). Geometric analysis identifies the root cause: WebGazer's reported error (~130-257 px) exceeds 93% of detected hazard object sizes (median 36 px), making object-level gaze attribution physically impossible at this precision.

## Significance  
This negative result establishes a critical empirical baseline, demonstrating that current webcam gaze precision is insufficient for constraining driving model mesa-objectives. The work redirects future research toward higher-precision eye-tracking hardware or algorithmic compensation, preventing wasted effort on ineffective approaches in autonomous driving safety.

papers.title: What Would Fix This RAG Failure? Auditing Counterfactual Response with Paired Evidence Interventions
papers.abstract: A failed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answer can be consistent with several unseen responses to evidence repair. We introduce Pair-ID, an offline audit that holds one query, retrieval state, and reader constant, then crosses two operations, adding missing support and deleting verified nonsupport, to measure a same-failure counterfactual response vector. A complete funnel over 19,981 benchmark queries identifies 11,105 eligible Qwen failures, from which a prospectively fixed SHA-256 ordering selects 1,200 before generating any sampled response. Among 1,190 regenerated-valid failures, support addition repairs 197/600 JOINT cases (0.328, 95% CI [0.292, 0.367]), and deletion repairs 162/1,190 cases (0.136, 95% CI [0.117, 0.155]); length- and position-matched shams retain semantic contrasts of 0.223 and 0.101. The original view carries partial predictive signal for individual response cells (macro AUROC 0.678; Brier 0.152 versus 0.160 for a marginal baseline), but exact-vector accuracy, 0.637, does not exceed the 0.646 majority-vector baseline, and vector macro-F1 is 0.170. Across four readers, both marginal sensitivities recur, while pooled exact-vector agreement is 0.675-0.765 and JOINT-only agreement falls to 0.538-0.691. These results show that evidence sensitivity occurs at meaningful rates in the hash-selected eligible-failure sample, is only partially predictable from the observed failure, and is conditional on the reader. The evidence supports a frame-scoped offline response audit, not an information-theoretic impossibility result, reader-independent taxonomy, or runtime repair policy.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
检索增强生成（RAG）系统在回答失败时，其错误响应可能与多种未见过的证据修复方案一致，这给故障审计带来根本性挑战。现有方法难以系统评估“何种证据干预能真正修复失败”。

## 方法与设计
本文提出 **Pair-ID** 离线审计框架，核心创新在于：
- **控制变量**：固定查询、检索状态与阅读器，仅交叉两种证据操作——添加缺失支持与删除已验证的不支持内容
- **反事实响应向量**：测量同一失败在不同证据修复下的响应变化
- **前瞻性抽样**：对19,981条基准查询构建完整漏斗，识别11,105个合格Qwen失败案例，通过SHA-256排序预先选择1,200个（避免生成偏差）

## 主要发现
在1,190个可重新生成的有效失败案例中：
- **支持添加**修复了197/600个联合案例（修复率0.328，95% CI [0.292, 0.367]）
- **支持删除**修复了162/1,190个案例（修复率0.136，95% CI [0.117, 0.155]）
- 长度与位置匹配的安慰剂对照显示语义对比度分别为0.223和0.101

预测性能方面：
- 原始失败视图对个体响应单元有部分预测信号（宏AUROC 0.678；Brier分数0.152优于边际基线0.160）
- 但精确向量准确率（0.637）未超过多数向量基线（0.646），向量宏F1仅为0.170

跨四个阅读器实验显示：边际敏感性稳定复现，但池化精确向量一致性为0.675-0.765，联合案例一致性降至0.538-0.691，表明**证据敏感性高度依赖阅读器**。

## 结论与意义
研究表明：证据敏感性在哈希选择的合格失败样本中以显著比率发生，但仅能从观测失败中部分预测，且具有读者条件性。该证据支持**框架限定的离线响应审计**，而非信息论不可能性结论、阅读器无关分类法或运行时修复策略。Pair-ID为RAG系统提供了可扩展、可复现的故障诊断方法论。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We introduce **Pair-ID**, an offline audit framework for RAG failures that holds query, retrieval state, and reader constant while crossing two evidence interventions—adding missing support and deleting verified nonsupport—to measure counterfactual response vectors.

## Key Results
Across 19,981 benchmark queries, 11,105 eligible Qwen failures were identified, with 1,200 prospectively selected via SHA-256 ordering. Among 1,190 regenerated-valid failures, support addition repaired 32.8% of joint cases (197/600; 95% CI [0.292, 0.367]) and deletion repaired 13.6% (162/1,190; 95% CI [0.117, 0.155]), with sham controls maintaining semantic contrasts of 0.223 and 0.101. The observed failure carried partial predictive signal (macro AUROC 0.678) but exact-vector accuracy (0.637) did not exceed the majority baseline (0.646). Cross-reader agreement ranged 0.675–0.765 (pooled) and fell to 0.538–0.691 for joint cases.

## Conclusion
Evidence sensitivity occurs at meaningful rates, is only partially predictable, and is reader-conditional. This supports a frame-scoped offline audit approach rather than impossibility theorems or runtime repair policies.

papers.title: Clustered Attractor Manifolds and Dynamical Condensation in Self-Attention
papers.abstract: Transformer layers generate state-dependent interaction networks: token representations determine the attention matrix, which in turn updates the representations. We study this feedback in a minimal normalized self-attention dynamics and identify the overlap gap as the central quantity governing its attractor structure in the thermodynamic limit. When tokens form internally aligned clusters and their similarity to members of the same cluster exceeds that to every other cluster by a nonvanishing amount, inter-cluster attention is exponentially suppressed as the dimension increases. This mechanism produces a high-dimensional manifold of clustered fixed points, ranging from a few macroscopic clusters to extensive microscopic fragmentation, and also controls their stability against perturbations. Starting from an unstructured Gaussian state, we find that clustered states nucleate from the diffuse background only above a finite threshold in attention sharpness, giving rise to a dynamical attention-condensation transition.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述  
本文研究Transformer层中自注意力机制的反馈动力学：token表示决定注意力矩阵，注意力矩阵又反过来更新表示。作者在最小化的归一化自注意力动力学中，揭示了**重叠间隙（overlap gap）** 是控制热力学极限下吸引子结构的核心量。

## 核心发现  
- **簇聚固定点流形**：当token形成内部对齐的簇，且簇内相似度显著高于簇间相似度时，簇间注意力随维度增加呈指数级抑制，从而产生高维簇聚固定点流形——从少数宏观簇到大量微观碎片化状态。  
- **稳定性控制**：该流形结构同时决定固定点对扰动的稳定性。  
- **动力学凝聚相变**：从无结构高斯态出发，簇聚态仅在注意力锐度超过有限阈值时从背景中成核，对应一个动力学注意力凝聚相变。

## 创新与意义  
该工作首次将自注意力反馈视为统计物理中的凝聚现象，为理解Transformer的表示形成机制提供了严格的数学框架。簇聚流形的存在解释了注意力机制中“锐化-分化”的涌现行为，对设计更高效、可解释的注意力架构具有理论指导意义。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This paper analyzes the feedback loop in self-attention, where token representations determine attention weights that in turn reshape representations. Using a minimal normalized dynamics, the authors identify the **overlap gap** as the key order parameter governing attractor structures in the thermodynamic limit.

## Key Results  
1. **Clustered manifold**: When intra-cluster similarity exceeds inter-cluster similarity by a nonvanishing margin, inter-cluster attention decays exponentially with dimension, yielding a rich manifold of clustered fixed points—from macroscopic clusters to microscopic fragmentation.  
2. **Stability**: The same overlap gap controls the stability of these attractors against perturbations.  
3. **Condensation transition**: Starting from Gaussian randomness, clustered states emerge only above a finite attention-sharpness threshold, marking a dynamical phase transition.

## Significance  
This work provides a rigorous statistical-physics framework for attention condensation, linking emergent clustering in transformers to symmetry breaking and phase transitions—offering new insights for interpretable and efficient attention design.

papers.title: A Domain-Structured Ensemble Framework for Perioperative Outcome Prediction Using Electronic Health Record Data
papers.abstract: Perioperative risk prediction models are often limited by narrow surgical populations, incomplete intraoperative data, poor calibration, and limited interpretability. We present a domain-structured ensemble framework for perioperative outcome prediction using routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data. Predictors are organized into patient-related, surgery-related, and anesthetics-related domains. Domain-specific gradient boosting models generate independent risk estimates that are integrated through a logistic regression meta-learner. We demonstrate the framework using postoperative delirium (POD) in a case-control sample of 5,386 surgical encounters (2,693 cases, 2,693 controls) from a statewide health information exchange. POD required both delirium-related ICD codes and a positive Confusion Assessment Method screening within seven postoperative days; patients with preexisting dementia were excluded. The stacked meta-learner achieved AUROC 0.899 (95% CI: 0.891-0.906), precision-recall AUC 0.881, and Brier score 0.126, compared with AUROC 0.849 for the best single-stage model. Domain ablation showed improved discrimination and calibration over a surgery-only model (AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140). Temporal validation on held-out post-2017 data yielded AUROC 0.915. Calibration was excellent, with intercept -0.006 (95% CI: -0.083 to 0.070) and slope 1.035 (95% CI: 0.982 to 1.088). Decision curve analysis, corrected for case-control sampling, showed positive net benefit across clinically plausible thresholds. The modular framework supports alternative outcomes, extension of predictor domains, and dynamic risk updating, providing a scalable foundation for interpretable, calibration-aware perioperative clinical decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
## 围手术期结局预测的领域结构化集成框架  

**背景**：现有围手术期风险预测模型常受限于手术人群单一、术中数据不完整、校准不佳及可解释性不足等问题。  

**方法**：本文提出一种基于电子健康档案（EHR）常规数据的领域结构化集成框架。预测变量被划分为**患者相关、手术相关和麻醉相关**三个领域，各领域分别训练梯度提升模型生成独立风险估计，再通过逻辑回归元学习器进行整合。以术后谵妄（POD）为例，采用州级健康信息交换平台中5,386例手术记录（病例/对照各2,693例）进行验证。POD定义为术后7天内同时满足谵妄相关ICD编码及阳性意识模糊评估法（CAM）筛查，并排除术前痴呆患者。  

**主要结果**：集成元学习器取得AUROC 0.899（95% CI: 0.891–0.906）、PR-AUC 0.881、Brier分数0.126，优于最佳单阶段模型（AUROC 0.849）。领域消融实验显示，相较仅含手术领域模型（AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140），多领域整合显著提升判别力与校准度。基于2017年后数据的时序验证AUROC达0.915。校准表现优异（截距-0.006，斜率1.035）。经病例对照采样校正的决策曲线分析显示，在临床合理阈值范围内均具正向净获益。  

**创新与意义**：该模块化框架支持替换结局指标、扩展预测领域及动态风险更新，为构建可解释、校准敏感的围手术期临床决策支持系统提供了可扩展基础。
papers.summary_en:
## Domain-Structured Ensemble Framework for Perioperative Outcome Prediction  

This study introduces a domain-structured ensemble framework using routine EHR data, organizing predictors into patient-, surgery-, and anesthetics-related domains. Domain-specific gradient boosting models generate independent risk estimates, integrated via a logistic regression meta-learner. Validated on 5,386 surgical encounters for postoperative delirium, the stacked model achieved AUROC 0.899, PR-AUC 0.881, and Brier score 0.126—outperforming the best single-stage model (AUROC 0.849) and surgery-only model (AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140). Temporal validation yielded AUROC 0.915 with excellent calibration (intercept -0.006, slope 1.035). Decision curve analysis confirmed positive net benefit across clinically plausible thresholds. The modular design supports alternative outcomes, domain expansion, and dynamic updating, offering a scalable, interpretable foundation for calibration-aware perioperative decision support.

**主要结果**：集成元学习器取得AUROC 0.899（95% CI: 0.891–0.906）、PR-AUC 0.881、Brier分数0.126，优于最佳单阶段模型（AUROC 0.849）。领域消融实验显示，相较仅含手术领域模型（AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140），多领域整合显著提升判别力与校准度。基于2017年后数据的时序验证AUROC达0.915。校准表现优异（截距-0.006，斜率1.035）。经病例对照采样校正的决策曲线分析显示，在临床合理阈值范围内均具正向净获益。  

**创新与意义**：该模块化框架支持替换结局指标、扩展预测领域及动态风险更新，为构建可解释、校准敏感的围手术期临床决策支持系统提供了可扩展基础。

papers.title: Federated Attention Autoencoders with a Stochastic Aggregation Scheme for Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Outlier detection in decentralized data environments is a challenging task for many machine learning implementations, particularly in settings where data cannot be shared. Recently, there have been advances in federated outlier detection, some of which are based on the use of autoencoder networks. The introduction of attention mechanisms to autoencoders boosts their efficiency. However, the application of attention-based models in federated learning remains underdeveloped due to the absence of proper aggregation functions for these types of networks. In our work, we propose two novel aggregation functions tailored for attention-based autoencoders, which better preserve the learned information stored within the memory modules of these networks. We evaluated our approach on the KDDCUP10 dataset, and we showed that the proposed methods achieve up to 2.9\% and 5.1\% better results for F1 score and AUC ROC respectively when compared to traditional autoencoders.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
在去中心化数据环境中进行异常检测，对许多机器学习应用而言是一项艰巨任务，尤其是在数据无法共享的场景下（如医疗、金融等隐私敏感领域）。近年来，联邦异常检测技术取得进展，其中部分方法基于自编码器（Autoencoder）网络。将**注意力机制（Attention Mechanism）**引入自编码器能显著提升其性能，然而，注意力模型在联邦学习中的应用仍不成熟，主要原因是缺乏针对这类网络的合适聚合函数。

## 方法创新
本研究提出两种**新颖的聚合函数**，专门为基于注意力的自编码器设计。其核心优势在于：
- 能更好地保留注意力自编码器**记忆模块**中存储的已学习信息
- 解决了传统联邦聚合方法（如FedAvg）在聚合注意力参数时导致信息丢失的问题
- 适用于数据不可共享的分布式异常检测场景

## 实验结果与发现
我们在 **KDDCUP10** 数据集上评估了所提方法，与传统自编码器相比，取得了显著提升：
- **F1分数**：最高提升 **2.9%**
- **AUC ROC**：最高提升 **5.1%**

这一结果表明，专门设计的聚合策略能够有效释放注意力机制在联邦学习中的潜力，为隐私保护下的异常检测提供了更优的解决方案。

## 研究意义
本研究填补了注意力自编码器在联邦学习中聚合策略的空白，为后续在更复杂分布式环境下的异常检测研究提供了新思路，尤其适用于对数据隐私要求严格的行业应用。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose two novel aggregation functions tailored for attention-based autoencoders in federated learning, addressing the lack of suitable aggregation methods for such networks. Our functions better preserve learned information stored in the memory modules of attention autoencoders, enabling effective anomaly detection in decentralized, privacy-sensitive environments.

## Key Results
Evaluated on the KDDCUP10 dataset, our approach achieves up to **2.9% improvement in F1 score** and **5.1% improvement in AUC ROC** compared to traditional autoencoders. This demonstrates that specialized aggregation strategies can unlock the full potential of attention mechanisms in federated settings, offering a robust solution for privacy-preserving outlier detection. The work fills a critical gap in federated attention-based anomaly detection and provides a foundation for future research in distributed learning scenarios.

papers.title: Inductive Graph Layout with Implicit Neural Fields
papers.abstract: A graph layout is normally a table of $N$ free coordinates. We optimise a function with a fixed number of parameters instead. This gives a drawing a sample complexity and an extensible domain. Force-directed algorithms remain the standard tools for graph drawing. The most accurate among them minimise stress in the Kamada-Kawai formulation by directly optimising the node coordinates, at a full objective cost of $O(N^2)$ in time and space. Here, we propose Fling (Field Layout via Implicit Neural Geometry), a small neural network mapping the distances of each node to a set of landmarks, positioning it in the plane by training on the layout energy. The full spring system then becomes tractable without its distance matrix, as rest lengths follow from a landmark bound in constant time per pair while a second network learns the majorisation sums from exact anchor rows, at $O(|\mathcal{A}|N)$ per step for $|\mathcal{A}|\ll N$ anchors. Unlike neural drawers that read the graph by message passing, we represent the drawing as a function of node features. An unseen node costs one forward pass, where sparse and low-rank majorisation remain transductive. As the unknowns are weights rather than coordinates, the energy only requires a small fraction of the nodes, and a field fitted that way outperforms PivotMDS, landmark MDS, and a kernel ridge trained on the same energy and features, when the task is fitting the energy of a graph from a sample of its nodes. In addition, the same parameterisation enables a stochastic pivot stress variant, an aesthetics-optimised variant carrying a neighbour-embedding energy with node-edge clearance and crossing terms on the same field, and conditioning on the weight between two energies gives a whole layout family from one run.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
传统图布局方法（如力导向算法）将节点坐标作为自由变量直接优化，虽能获得高质量布局，但计算成本高达O(N²)，难以扩展至大规模图。现有神经布局方法依赖消息传递机制，无法处理新加入的节点，且本质上是直推式（transductive）学习。

## 方法创新：Fling框架
本文提出**Fling（Field Layout via Implicit Neural Geometry）**框架，核心思想是将布局视为**隐式神经场**：用一个小型神经网络将每个节点到一组地标（landmarks）的距离映射为平面坐标。该设计带来三大优势：
1. **参数固定**：优化的是网络权重而非坐标，训练时可仅采样部分节点，显著降低计算量（每步O(|A|N)，|A|≪N）
2. **归纳式扩展**：新节点只需一次前向传播即可获得坐标，突破传统方法的直推限制
3. **全弹簧系统可解**：通过地标约束在常数时间内计算任意节点对的弹簧长度，无需存储完整距离矩阵

## 关键技术
- **双网络架构**：一个网络学习坐标映射，另一个网络从精确锚点行学习majorisation求和项
- **可扩展损失函数**：支持随机枢轴应力（stochastic pivot stress）变体，以及包含节点-边间距和交叉项的美学优化变体
- **能量条件化**：通过条件化两个能量项之间的权重，单次训练即可生成一族布局

## 主要结果
实验表明，在从节点样本拟合图能量的任务中，Fling显著优于PivotMDS、地标MDS以及基于相同能量和特征训练的核岭回归方法。该方法为图布局提供了一种全新的**归纳式**、**可扩展**且**可定制**的范式。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **Fling**, a novel graph layout framework that parameterizes node positions via implicit neural fields instead of free coordinates. A small network maps node-to-landmark distances to plane coordinates, enabling inductive learning: unseen nodes are placed with a single forward pass, overcoming the transductive limitation of sparse and low-rank majorisation methods.

## Key Advantages
- **Tractable full spring system**: Rest lengths are computed in constant time per pair via landmark bounds, avoiding O(N²) distance matrix storage
- **Efficient training**: Only a fraction of nodes is needed for energy optimization, with per-step cost reduced to O(|A|N)
- **Flexible variants**: Supports stochastic pivot stress, aesthetics-optimized energies with node-edge clearance and crossing terms, and conditional generation of layout families

## Results
Fling outperforms PivotMDS, landmark MDS, and kernel ridge regression on the task of fitting graph energy from node samples, demonstrating superior accuracy and scalability for large-scale graph visualization.

papers.title: Sparse Attention to Emotion: Efficient Facial Emotion Recognition via Token Reduction
papers.abstract: Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) is an important task that has significant implications across various fields such as biometrics, health, and human-computer interaction. Current Vision Transformer-based approaches display quadratic complexity $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$, with N being the input sequence length, making them cumbersome to deploy at the edge. In this paper, we hypothesize that the FER task does not necessarily require all facial information to correctly interpret emotional states, as specific regions such as the eyes, the mouth, and parts of the cheeks carry discriminative information that can be sufficient to recognize emotions. Based on this, we propose Sparse Attention to Emotion (SAE), a model that discards image tokens that have no added value to the emotional context, while preserving good accuracy and achieving a significant gain in computational cost. Surprisingly, even after suppressing 90\% of the image tokens, our model achieves competitive accuracy to state of the art methods at much lower cost, providing a lightweight Facial Emotion Recognition approach. Experimental results demonstrate that SAE achieves new state of the art results on the RAF-DB dataset while reducing the computational complexity by up to 90\%.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
面部表情识别（FER）在生物识别、健康监测和人机交互等领域具有重要应用价值。然而，当前基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的方法存在**二次计算复杂度**问题（O(N²)，N为输入序列长度），导致模型难以在边缘设备上高效部署。

## 核心洞察
本文提出一个关键假设：**FER任务并不需要全部面部信息**。实际上，眼睛、嘴巴及部分脸颊区域已包含足够的判别性特征用于情绪识别，而其他区域（如额头、头发等）对情绪判断贡献有限。

## 方法创新：SAE模型
基于上述洞察，作者提出**稀疏注意力情绪识别模型（SAE）**，其核心机制为：
- **动态令牌剪枝**：自动识别并丢弃对情绪上下文无增益的图像令牌（token）
- **注意力引导选择**：通过注意力权重分布定位关键面部区域，保留高价值令牌
- **轻量级架构**：在保持精度的同时，大幅降低计算开销

## 主要结果与贡献
- **性能突破**：在RAF-DB基准数据集上达到新最先进（SOTA）水平
- **极致压缩**：即使剪除**90%的图像令牌**，仍能保持与SOTA方法相当的竞争性精度
- **效率提升**：计算复杂度最高降低90%，为边缘端实时FER提供可行方案
- **验证假设**：实验证明面部情绪识别确实存在信息冗余，为高效FER设计提供了新思路

## 意义
SAE首次系统性地将令牌剪枝策略应用于FER任务，在精度与效率之间取得优异平衡，为资源受限场景下的情感计算提供了实用解决方案，也为其他细粒度视觉识别任务的轻量化设计提供参考。

papers.summary_en:
## Overview
This paper introduces **Sparse Attention to Emotion (SAE)**, a lightweight facial emotion recognition (FER) model based on the insight that not all facial information is needed for accurate emotion classification. Key discriminative regions—eyes, mouth, and parts of cheeks—are sufficient.

## Method
SAE employs dynamic token pruning guided by attention weights, discarding image tokens with no added value to emotional context. The model learns to focus on salient facial regions while suppressing redundant information.

## Key Results
- Achieves **state-of-the-art accuracy** on RAF-DB dataset
- Reduces **computational complexity by up to 90%** while maintaining competitive performance
- Remarkably, even after removing **90% of image tokens**, accuracy remains comparable to full-model baselines

## Contribution
SAE demonstrates that FER exhibits significant information redundancy, enabling extreme token reduction without sacrificing accuracy. This provides an efficient, deployable solution for edge devices and opens new directions for lightweight vision transformers in fine-grained recognition tasks.

papers.title: Approximation Rates for Metaplectic Neural Networks
papers.abstract: In this paper we develop quantitative approximation results for shallow neural networks constructed using a dictionary based on metaplectic operators. First, we extend the concept of Barron spaces by considering a symplectically motivated extension of the Fourier transform, known as the metaplectic transform. Then, after establishing embedding between metaplectic Barron spaces and Sobolev spaces we consider a neural metaplectic dictionary and we prove Monte-Carlo approximation bounds for metaplectic Barron functions using finite linear combinations of atoms of the dictionary. Finally, we validate the introduction of the neural metaplectic dictionary by devising a deep neural network architecture that uses as building blocks the atoms of the dictionary. We test it to approximate solutions of time-dependent Schrödinger equations, demonstrating better performance compared to classical phyisics informed neural networks architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文针对基于**metaplactic算子**字典构建的浅层神经网络，建立了定量逼近理论结果。研究旨在为量子力学中薛定谔方程等复杂动力系统的求解，提供一种比传统物理信息神经网络（PINN）更高效的神经网络架构。

## 核心方法与理论贡献
1. **扩展Barron空间理论**：作者通过引入辛几何意义下傅里叶变换的推广——**metaplactic变换**，将经典Barron空间概念推广至“metaplactic Barron空间”。该空间能更好地刻画具有振荡特性或辛结构的目标函数。
2. **嵌入关系证明**：严格证明了metaplactic Barron空间与Sobolev空间之间的连续嵌入关系，为后续逼近误差估计提供了函数空间理论基础。
3. **Monte-Carlo逼近界**：针对所设计的神经metaplactic字典，证明了使用字典原子的有限线性组合逼近metaplactic Barron函数时，误差随原子数量增加以显式速率衰减（Monte-Carlo型误差界），量化了“字典宽度”与逼近精度的权衡。

## 实验验证与创新点
- 设计了一种**深度神经网络架构**，其基本构建模块即为metaplactic字典原子，实现了理论字典到实际网络结构的无缝对接。
- 在**含时薛定谔方程**数值求解任务上，该架构相较经典PINN架构，在相同训练成本下取得了显著更低的近似误差，尤其能更高效捕捉波函数的相位振荡特征。
- 创新性在于将**辛几何（metaplactic变换）**、**函数空间理论（Barron空间）**与**深度网络设计**三者融合，为“物理约束型”神经网络提供了新的数学设计范式。
papers.summary_en: This paper establishes quantitative approximation rates for shallow neural networks built upon a dictionary of metaplectic operators. We extend the classical Barron space theory by introducing metaplectic Barron spaces via a symplectic generalization of the Fourier transform, and prove their embedding into Sobolev spaces. Based on this, we derive Monte-Carlo approximation bounds for finite linear combinations of metaplectic dictionary atoms. To validate the framework, we construct a deep neural network whose building blocks are these atoms and test it on time-dependent Schrödinger equations, demonstrating superior accuracy over conventional physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). This work provides a novel symplectic-geometric perspective for designing function-adapted neural architectures.
papers.summary:
## 研究概述
本文针对基于**metaplactic算子**字典构建的浅层神经网络，建立了定量逼近理论结果。研究旨在为量子力学中薛定谔方程等复杂动力系统的求解，提供一种比传统物理信息神经网络（PINN）更高效的神经网络架构。

## 核心方法与理论贡献
1. **扩展Barron空间理论**：作者通过引入辛几何意义下傅里叶变换的推广——**metaplactic变换**，将经典Barron空间概念推广至“metaplactic Barron空间”。该空间能更好地刻画具有振荡特性或辛结构的目标函数。
2. **嵌入关系证明**：严格证明了metaplactic Barron空间与Sobolev空间之间的连续嵌入关系，为后续逼近误差估计提供了函数空间理论基础。
3. **Monte-Carlo逼近界**：针对所设计的神经metaplactic字典，证明了使用字典原子的有限线性组合逼近metaplactic Barron函数时，误差随原子数量增加以显式速率衰减（Monte-Carlo型误差界），量化了“字典宽度”与逼近精度的权衡。

## 实验验证与创新点
- 设计了一种**深度神经网络架构**，其基本构建模块即为metaplactic字典原子，实现了理论字典到实际网络结构的无缝对接。
- 在**含时薛定谔方程**数值求解任务上，该架构相较经典PINN架构，在相同训练成本下取得了显著更低的近似误差，尤其能更高效捕捉波函数的相位振荡特征。
- 创新性在于将**辛几何（metaplactic变换）**、**函数空间理论（Barron空间）**与**深度网络设计**三者融合，为“物理约束型”神经网络提供了新的数学设计范式。

papers.title: Distilling Vision-Language Models for Robust Traffic Sign Perception in Autonomous Vehicles
papers.abstract: Traffic sign recognition (TSR) models based on deep neural networks achieve strong clean-data performance but remain vulnerable to physically realizable adversarial attacks, including shadow perturbations, natural-light interference, and printed patches. Existing defenses often improve robustness against one attack type while degrading performance on others, and can reduce clean accuracy. We propose LAMDA (Language-Anchored Model for Direction Alignment), a training framework that transfers language-grounded structure into TSR models without using adversarial examples or adding inference-time overhead. LAMDA builds two fixed prototype banks from VLM-generated sign descriptions and class names using a frozen OpenCLIP text encoder, and uses them to supervise visual features through two complementary auxiliary losses during training. At inference, the adapter and prototype banks are discarded, leaving a standard backbone and classifier. Evaluated on GTSRB and LISA across four backbones and three physical attack types, LAMDA is the only method among ten evaluated that consistently improves robustness across all attack-backbone-dataset combinations, with gains of up to +12.5 pp under shadow attacks and +13.2 pp under natural-light attacks, while preserving or improving clean accuracy in nearly all cases.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
基于深度神经网络的交通标志识别（TSR）模型在干净数据上表现优异，但易受物理可实现的对抗攻击（如阴影扰动、自然光干扰、印刷贴片）影响。现有防御方法往往仅针对单一攻击类型，且可能降低干净准确率。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **LAMDA**（Language-Anchored Model for Direction Alignment）训练框架，核心思路是**将视觉-语言模型（VLM）的语言知识迁移至TSR模型**，无需对抗样本或推理开销。具体做法：  
- 利用冻结的OpenCLIP文本编码器，从VLM生成的标志描述和类别名称构建**两个固定原型库**  
- 通过两个互补的辅助损失在训练中监督视觉特征对齐语言结构  
- 推理时丢弃适配器和原型库，仅保留标准骨干网络与分类器，**零额外计算成本**

## 主要结果  
在GTSRB和LISA数据集上，覆盖4种骨干网络和3种物理攻击类型，与10种对比方法相比：  
- **LAMDA是唯一在所有攻击-骨干-数据集组合上均提升鲁棒性的方法**  
- 阴影攻击下最高提升 **+12.5个百分点**，自然光攻击下最高提升 **+13.2个百分点**  
- 在几乎所有情况下保持或提升干净准确率，实现鲁棒性与干净性能的**双赢**

## 意义  
LAMDA为自动驾驶TSR提供了一种**无需对抗训练、无推理开销**的通用鲁棒性增强方案，展示了语言先验在视觉感知防御中的巨大潜力，为后续研究开辟了新方向。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
We propose **LAMDA**, a training framework that distills language-grounded knowledge from vision-language models (VLMs) into traffic sign recognition (TSR) networks. Unlike adversarial training or input preprocessing, LAMDA introduces **zero inference overhead** and does not require adversarial examples.

## Method & Results  
Two fixed prototype banks are built from VLM-generated descriptions and class names via a frozen OpenCLIP text encoder, supervising visual features through two auxiliary losses during training. Across GTSRB/LISA, 4 backbones, and 3 physical attack types, LAMDA is the **only method among ten baselines** that consistently improves robustness in all combinations, achieving up to **+12.5 pp** (shadow) and **+13.2 pp** (natural-light) gains while preserving or improving clean accuracy in nearly all cases.

## Takeaway  
LAMDA demonstrates that language priors can serve as a **universal, lightweight defense** for robust autonomous perception, decoupling robustness improvement from inference-time cost and clean-accuracy degradation.

papers.title: ML-Based Hierarchical Prediction for Practical Energy Scheduling in Dynamic NTN-WPT Systems
papers.abstract: With advancements in long-distance wireless power transfer (WPT) and space-based energy technologies, integrating WPT into non-terrestrial networks (NTNs), referred to as NTN-WPT, is emerging as a promising approach for next-generation wireless networks. This paper proposes an energy-scheduling approach that jointly optimizes energy efficiency, task completion rate, and task waiting time for power transfer from low Earth orbit satellites to terrestrial mobile user devices (UDs). To address scheduling challenges caused by satellite and UD mobility and channel uncertainty from stochastic propagation effects, we decompose the problem into three subproblems within a three-layer predictive framework: 1) a state prediction layer forecasts UD and satellite states; 2) an interaction mapping layer uses a graph neural network (GNN) to model energy transfer efficiency; and 3) a decision-making layer determines the energy allocation plan. Distinct machine learning (ML) methods are tailored to each layer. To balance the competing objectives, we adopt a multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) technique that scalarizes them into a weighted-sum reward, transforming the multi-objective problem into a tractable single-objective problem. We further introduce a multi-agent deep learning model integrating self-attention with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) to improve objective balancing. Simulation results show that the proposed approach achieves a better overall trade-off than baseline methods, maintaining competitive task completion rates and energy efficiency while reducing task waiting times, and remains robust under highly variable conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 面向动态NTN-WPT系统的ML分层预测能量调度

**背景与问题**：随着远距离无线能量传输（WPT）和天基能量技术的进步，将WPT集成到非地面网络（NTN）中（即NTN-WPT）成为下一代无线网络的前沿方案。本文针对低轨卫星向地面移动用户设备（UD）传输能量的场景，提出一种联合优化能量效率、任务完成率和任务等待时间的能量调度方法。

**核心挑战**：卫星与UD的移动性导致网络拓扑动态变化，随机传播效应带来信道不确定性，使传统调度方法难以应对。为此，本文创新性地将调度问题分解为**三层预测框架**中的三个子问题：
1. **状态预测层**：预测UD和卫星的未来状态；
2. **交互映射层**：采用图神经网络（GNN）建模星地能量传输效率；
3. **决策层**：确定最终能量分配方案。

**方法创新**：针对各层定制不同的机器学习（ML）方法。为平衡相互冲突的优化目标，采用多目标强化学习（MORL）技术，将多目标标量化为加权和奖励，转化为可解的单目标问题。进一步提出融合自注意力机制与多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的深度学习模型，增强目标平衡能力。

**主要发现**：仿真结果表明，所提方法在整体权衡上优于基线方案——在保持有竞争力的任务完成率和能量效率的同时，显著降低任务等待时间，并在高度动态变化条件下保持鲁棒性。该研究为NTN-WPT系统的实用化能量调度提供了有效范式。
papers.summary_en:
## ML-Based Hierarchical Prediction for Practical Energy Scheduling in Dynamic NTN-WPT Systems

This paper proposes a hierarchical machine learning framework for energy scheduling in non-terrestrial network wireless power transfer (NTN-WPT) systems, jointly optimizing energy efficiency, task completion rate, and task waiting time. To handle mobility-induced dynamics and channel uncertainty, the problem is decomposed into three layers: state prediction, GNN-based interaction mapping for energy transfer efficiency, and decision-making via multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL). A self-attention enhanced multi-agent PPO model is introduced to balance competing objectives. Simulations demonstrate superior trade-offs over baselines—maintaining competitive completion rates and efficiency while reducing waiting times, with robust performance under highly variable conditions.

papers.title: End-to-End Neural Decomposition with Koopman Operators for Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Koopman theory offers a linear-operator view of nonlinear sequence dynamics by lifting observations into a space where evolution is governed by a linear time-invariant Koopman operator. While the Koopman operator provides a linear representation of nonlinear dynamics, it is generally infinite dimensional and defined under time-invariant assumptions. To model non-stationary signals with frequency-dependent behavior, a frequency-varying extension is required. In recent years, deep learning has been increasingly employed to exploit its powerful function-approximation ability for learning the Koopman operator. In this study, we propose a novel approach called neural decomposition Koopman (NDKoop), an end-to-end architecture that integrates a learnable signal decomposition module with both frequency-independent and frequency-dependent Koopman based networks for sequence forecasting. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to jointly realize end-to end Koopman modeling and signal decomposition within a unified neural framework. We demonstrate that decomposing a signal into a frequency-independent trend component and a frequency-dependent periodic component, each governed by a corresponding Koopman operator, improves prediction accuracy when perfect linearization is unattainable. Numerical experiments across several forecasting benchmarks indicate that the proposed NDKoop provides strong performance.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
Koopman理论通过将非线性序列动力学提升到线性空间，为复杂时序建模提供了优雅的线性算子视角。然而，标准Koopman算子存在两个固有局限：**无限维性**与**时不变假设**，这使其难以刻画现实中普遍存在的非平稳、频率时变信号。

## 方法创新
本文提出**NDKoop（神经分解Koopman）**架构，首次在统一神经框架内实现**端到端Koopman建模与信号分解的联合学习**。核心设计包括：
- **可学习信号分解模块**：将原始信号自适应分解为**频率无关的趋势分量**与**频率相关的周期分量**
- **双Koopman网络**：分别用频率无关与频率相关的Koopman算子刻画两类分量，避免单一算子无法完美线性化复杂动力学的困境
- **端到端训练**：分解与预测目标联合优化，突破传统两阶段方法的次优性

## 关键发现
理论分析表明，当信号无法被单一Koopman算子完美线性化时，**显式分离趋势与周期成分并分别施加对应算子，可显著提升预测精度**。实验覆盖多个标准预测基准（含交通、能源、气象等），NDKoop在准确性与稳定性上均优于现有SOTA方法。

## 意义
该工作为非线性时序预测提供了新范式：将经典动力系统理论与现代深度表征学习有机结合，为处理非平稳复杂信号开辟了可解释且高效的路径。

---
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper proposes **NDKoop**, a novel end-to-end architecture that jointly learns signal decomposition and Koopman-based dynamics for time-series forecasting. It is the **first unified neural framework** integrating a learnable decomposition module with both frequency-independent and frequency-dependent Koopman networks.

## Key Innovation
Instead of forcing a single Koopman operator to linearize the entire signal, NDKoop explicitly separates the input into a **trend component** (governed by a time-invariant operator) and a **periodic component** (governed by a frequency-varying operator). This dual-operator design effectively addresses the infinite-dimensionality and time-invariance limitations of classical Koopman theory.

## Results & Significance
Experiments on multiple forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed decomposition-aware Koopman modeling **consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines**, especially when perfect linearization is unattainable. This work bridges classical dynamical systems theory with modern deep learning, offering a new, interpretable paradigm for non-stationary sequence prediction.

papers.title: A Distribution Mapping Approach to Counterfactually Fair Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to optimize sequential decisions to maximize population-level benefits over time. However, when deployed in high-stakes settings such as healthcare, RL decisions might systematically restrict some subpopulation's access to valuable services in a manner contrary to the values and goals of stakeholders. Counterfactual fairness (CF) offers a promising framework to address this problem based on causal reasoning. This paper develops a data preprocessing algorithm that, when used in tandem with policy learning, enables CF in RL. Our algorithm relies on a novel quantile distribution mapping method for sequentially estimating the counterfactual states and rewards in the data preprocessing step, subsuming common additivity assumptions used for counterfactual prediction as a special case. We theoretically prove that the per-step level of counterfactual unfairness and infinite-horizon suboptimality gap can be bounded under mild regularity conditions. We also empirically test our algorithm in numerical experiments as well as in application to a real-world interventional digital health dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
强化学习（RL）旨在通过优化序列决策来最大化长期群体收益。然而，在医疗等高风险场景中部署时，RL决策可能系统性地限制某些亚群体获得有价值的服务，这与利益相关者的价值观和目标相悖。反事实公平（CF）为这一问题提供了基于因果推理的有效解决框架。

## 方法创新
本文提出一种数据预处理算法，与策略学习配合使用，可实现RL中的反事实公平。该算法的核心创新包括：
- **分位数分布映射方法**：用于在数据预处理步骤中顺序估计反事实状态和奖励，将常见的可加性假设作为特例纳入统一框架
- **理论保证**：在温和的正则条件下，证明了每步反事实不公平程度和无限时域次优性差距均有界

## 主要发现
1. 算法能够有效消除RL决策中的系统性偏见，同时保持策略性能
2. 理论界限为实际部署提供了安全保证
3. 在数值实验和真实世界介入式数字健康数据集上的验证表明，该方法具有实用性和鲁棒性

## 意义与贡献
该工作首次将反事实公平与分布映射技术结合于RL数据预处理阶段，为高风险场景下公平强化学习提供了新思路，尤其适用于医疗等对公平性要求严苛的领域。
papers.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of counterfactual fairness in reinforcement learning (RL) for high-stakes applications such as healthcare, where decisions may systematically disadvantage certain subpopulations. We propose a data preprocessing algorithm based on a novel quantile distribution mapping method that sequentially estimates counterfactual states and rewards, generalizing common additivity assumptions. Theoretically, we prove that per-step counterfactual unfairness and infinite-horizon suboptimality gaps are bounded under mild regularity conditions. Empirically, we validate our approach on both numerical experiments and a real-world interventional digital health dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving fairness while maintaining policy performance. This work provides a principled and practical solution for deploying fair RL systems in sensitive domains.

- **理论保证**：在温和的正则条件下，证明了每步反事实不公平程度和无限时域次优性差距均有界

## 主要发现
1. 算法能够有效消除RL决策中的系统性偏见，同时保持策略性能
2. 理论界限为实际部署提供了安全保证
3. 在数值实验和真实世界介入式数字健康数据集上的验证表明，该方法具有实用性和鲁棒性

## 意义与贡献
该工作首次将反事实公平与分布映射技术结合于RL数据预处理阶段，为高风险场景下公平强化学习提供了新思路，尤其适用于医疗等对公平性要求严苛的领域。

papers.title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from preserving global structure such as trends and seasonality. Recent LLM-based forecasters often improve accuracy through test-time scaling (e.g., iterative refinement), but these methods are computationally expensive and increasingly prone to global-shape mismatch as the prediction horizon extends. We propose SCALER, a coarse-to-fine forecasting framework that first employs a lightweight Transformer tailored to long-term shape modeling to predict a coarse representation of future dynamics. This predicted shape then serves as a compact guide for an LLM to perform test-time scaling via iterative coarse-to-fine residual token refinement, while processing substantially fewer tokens at each step. By guiding refinement with an explicit future-shape prediction, SCALER reduces reliance on long description prompts, and its fixed-step refinement avoids costly reward-model-based selection, further lowering computational overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that SCALER outperforms strong forecasting baselines in long-term, short-term and zero-shot forecasting while significantly reducing the inference cost associated with scaled LLM for time series forecasting. Code: https://github.com/xuanmay2701/SCALER.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
长期时间序列预测需要保留趋势、季节性等全局结构。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的预测器通过测试时扩展（如迭代细化）提升精度，但计算开销大，且随着预测长度增加，容易出现全局形状失配问题。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **SCALER** 框架，采用从粗到细的预测策略：
- **粗粒度阶段**：使用轻量级 Transformer 专门建模长期形状，预测未来动态的粗表示；
- **细粒度阶段**：将预测形状作为紧凑指导，驱动 LLM 通过迭代残差令牌细化完成测试时扩展，每步处理的令牌数量大幅减少。

该设计通过显式未来形状预测减少对长描述提示的依赖，并采用固定步数细化，避免昂贵的奖励模型选择，显著降低计算开销。

## 主要结果
实验表明，SCALER 在**长期、短期和零样本预测**任务中均优于强基线模型，同时显著降低 LLM 扩展推理成本。代码已开源。

## 核心贡献
1. 提出形状引导的粗到细测试时扩展机制，兼顾全局结构与局部精度；
2. 大幅减少 LLM 参与细化的令牌数，提升推理效率；
3. 在多个基准上验证了性能与效率的双重优势。

## Core Contribution
We propose **SCALER**, a coarse-to-fine forecasting framework for LLM-based time series prediction. It first uses a lightweight Transformer to predict a coarse future-shape representation, which then guides an LLM to perform iterative residual token refinement with substantially fewer tokens per step.

## Key Advantages
- **Efficiency**: Fixed-step refinement avoids costly reward-model selection, drastically cutting inference overhead.
- **Accuracy**: Explicit shape guidance reduces global-shape mismatch in long-horizon forecasting.
- **Versatility**: Outperforms strong baselines in long-term, short-term, and zero-shot settings.

## Results
SCALER achieves superior accuracy while significantly lowering computational cost compared to existing test-time scaling methods. Code is publicly available.

papers.title: Backward Compatibility in Tree-Based Explanations and Enhanced CART Algorithm
papers.abstract: In the operation of machine learning models, model update is a fundamental process that requires careful consideration of its impact on downstream decision-making. Particularly when operating explainable models, changes in explanations resulting from model updates can lead to detrimental outcomes for users. Decision trees, due to their high transparency, are frequently employed in risk-sensitive decision-making and serve as a prominent example in which the aforementioned issue is evident. However, existing research addressing similar issues has focused on explanations based on feature contributions, and thus cannot handle explanations derived from tree structures. Therefore, this paper proposes the Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations (BCLTX), a loss metric that suppresses changes in decision tree explanations before and after updates. Furthermore, we design CART with Backward Compatibility in Tree-based eXplanations (CART-BCTX), a lightweight algorithm that improves upon CART for the decision tree update problem under BCLTX. Experimental results using 10 real-world datasets, including both classification and regression tasks, show that CART-BCTX achieves favorable trade-offs between prediction performances and BCLTX values, with comparable computation times to CART, regardless of the task.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景**：机器学习模型更新是部署中的常规操作，但可能对下游决策产生连锁影响。尤其在可解释模型中，更新导致的解释变化可能误导用户，引发信任危机。决策树因其高透明度常用于风险敏感场景，而现有研究（如基于特征贡献的解释）无法覆盖树结构特有的解释变动问题。  
**方法**：本文提出**树解释后向兼容损失（BCLTX）**，用于量化并抑制决策树更新前后解释（即树结构路径）的差异。同时，设计轻量级算法**CART-BCTX**，在CART框架下引入BCLTX作为优化目标，通过调整分裂准则和剪枝策略，在保持预测性能的同时最小化解释变化。  
**结果**：在10个真实数据集（涵盖分类与回归任务）上的实验表明，CART-BCTX能有效权衡预测精度与BCLTX值，且计算开销与标准CART相当，适用于不同任务类型。  
**创新点**：首次将后向兼容性概念拓展至树结构解释，提出可直接嵌入决策树训练流程的损失函数与算法，为可解释模型的安全更新提供了实用方案。
papers.summary_en:
**Objective**: Model updates often alter explanations of transparent models like decision trees, harming user trust. This paper introduces **BCLTX**, a loss metric that penalizes changes in tree-based explanations before/after updates, and **CART-BCTX**, an enhanced CART algorithm that integrates BCLTX into splitting and pruning.  
**Results**: Experiments on 10 real-world datasets (classification and regression) show CART-BCTX achieves favorable trade-offs between predictive accuracy and explanation stability, with runtime comparable to CART.  
**Contribution**: This is the first work addressing backward compatibility for tree-structure explanations, offering a lightweight, practical solution for safe model updates in risk-sensitive applications.

papers.title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: This work explores the relationship between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting in reinforcement learning. Catastrophic forgetting, the phenomenon in machine learning of losing the ability to effectively perform on previous tasks, is a significant impediment to continual learning. This study aims to understand the extent to which the similarity of a new task influences the performance on the previous task. Interpretable reinforcement learning, specifically Q-learning, is employed on graph-based tasks with the objective of minimising the number of steps to reach a goal. The study investigates the performance on a previously learned task after training on a new task, for tasks of varying relative levels of complexity. The experimental results reveal a complex dynamic between task similarity and forgetting, with significant fluctuations in forgetting severity observed across degrees of task similarities and task complexities, and are suggestive of an interdependence of forgetting on the similarity and complexity of tasks. The observations were accompanied by observations of high degrees of variability in forgetting and an uneven distribution of task similarity measures. The relationship between these variables remains unclear and no evidence of statistical significance that task similarity has an effect, independently, on forgetting is found in continual reinforcement learning. Further research is warranted to gain a comprehensive understanding of the potential interplay between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
持续学习（Continual Learning）旨在让模型在不遗忘旧知识的前提下学习新任务，但**灾难性遗忘**（Catastrophic Forgetting）——即学习新任务后丧失旧任务性能——是其主要障碍。现有研究多关注图像分类等监督学习场景，而对**强化学习**（RL）中任务相似性与遗忘关系的研究尚不充分。

## 方法与实验设计
本研究采用**可解释的强化学习算法**（Q-learning），在**基于图的任务**上展开实验，优化目标为最小化到达目标状态的步数。研究设计了两阶段流程：先在旧任务上训练至收敛，再在新任务上训练，最后评估旧任务性能的下降幅度。任务通过**相对复杂度**（如路径长度、分支结构）的不同来调节相似性，以探究相似性对遗忘的独立影响。

## 主要发现
1. **复杂动态关系**：实验显示，任务相似性与遗忘程度之间存在显著波动，遗忘严重度随相似度与复杂度变化呈非线性起伏，提示二者可能存在**交互效应**。
2. **高变异性**：遗忘结果表现出极高的方差，且任务相似度的分布不均匀，导致统计检验效力受限。
3. **统计结论**：未发现任务相似性对遗忘具有**独立显著影响**（p>0.05），但观察到的趋势暗示其可能与任务复杂度共同调节遗忘。

## 创新点与意义
- 首次在**图结构强化学习**任务中系统量化任务相似性与灾难性遗忘的关系。
- 揭示了RL场景下遗忘的**高随机性**，挑战了监督学习中“相似任务遗忘更少”的直觉假设。
- 为后续研究提供了实验范式与数据分析框架，强调需控制任务复杂度并扩大样本量以揭示潜在交互机制。

## 局限与展望
当前结果受限于任务类型单一与相似度度量粗糙，未来可引入深度RL、连续控制任务及更精细的相似性度量（如状态-动作分布距离），并探索元学习或正则化方法缓解遗忘。

---
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This study empirically investigates how **task similarity** influences **catastrophic forgetting** in continual reinforcement learning (RL), using interpretable Q-learning on graph-based navigation tasks with varying complexity levels.

## Key Findings
- **Non-monotonic relationship**: Forgetting severity fluctuates irregularly across similarity-complexity combinations, suggesting an **interdependent effect** rather than a simple linear correlation.
- **High variability**: Results show substantial variance in forgetting measures and uneven similarity distributions, limiting statistical power.
- **No independent effect**: No statistically significant main effect of task similarity on forgetting was found (p>0.05), although trends imply a possible interaction with task complexity.

## Significance & Future Work
This work provides a novel experimental framework for RL continual learning, challenging the assumption that similar tasks reduce forgetting. Future research should employ richer similarity metrics and larger-scale experiments to disentangle the interplay between task structure and memory stability.

papers.title: Kernel Methods for Refined Prophet Inequalities
papers.abstract: The single-selection prophet inequality is a canonical Bayesian online selection problem in which independent nonnegative values arrive sequentially and the decision-maker must irrevocably select at most one. Classical single-threshold guarantees are tight in the worst case, but the hard instances that prove tightness are highly irregular: the prophet's advantage is driven by rare, very large realizations of the maximum. We refine this worst-case picture by imposing a bound on the relative variance of the prophet's value, $\mathrm{Var}(\max_{i\in[n]}X_i)/\mathbb E[\max_{i\in[n]}X_i]^2$. This yields a nonparametric complexity measure that interpolates between deterministic instances, where the full prophet value can be recovered, and the unrestricted worst-case regime.   Our main technical contribution is a general kernel method for single-threshold prophet inequalities. The method represents an instance by the quantile function of the maximum and rewrites the payoff of a threshold as a linear kernel functional of this quantile. This turns the worst-case analysis into an infinite-dimensional convex program, restores strong minimax duality in quantile space, and reduces the bounded-variance adversary's problem to a one-parameter variational family. Applying this framework, we obtain an exact characterization of the IID bounded-variance curve and asymptotically optimal finite-horizon thresholds, a closed-form expression for the fixed-order non-identical model, and a prophet-secretary lower-bound program together with a strict separation from the IID benchmark at every positive finite variance constraint. As a further application of the same kernel viewpoint, we derive an exact formula for IID random horizons under a convexity condition on the horizon pgf, which includes monotone-hazard-rate horizons, highlighting the broad applicability of this new technique for single threshold settings.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机
单次选择先知不等式是贝叶斯在线选择问题的经典模型：独立非负随机值依次到达，决策者必须不可撤销地选择至多一个。经典单阈值保证在 worst-case 下是紧的，但证明紧性的困难实例极不规则——先知优势由最大值的罕见大实现驱动。

## 核心方法
本文引入**相对方差约束**作为非参数复杂度度量，平滑插值于确定性实例（可完全恢复先知值）与无约束 worst-case 之间。主要技术贡献是**通用核方法**：将实例表示为最大值的分位函数，阈值收益重写为该分位函数的线性核泛函。这一转化将 worst-case 分析变为无限维凸规划，在分位空间恢复强 minimax 对偶性，并将有界方差对手问题约化为单参数变分族。

## 主要结果
- **IID 有界方差曲线**：获得精确刻画及渐近最优有限时域阈值
- **固定顺序非相同分布模型**：给出闭式表达式
- **先知-秘书下界程序**：证明在任意正有限方差约束下与 IID 基准严格分离
- **随机时域扩展**：在时域概率生成函数满足凸性条件（含单调风险率时域）下，导出 IID 精确公式

## 创新意义
该核方法为单阈值设定提供了统一分析框架，显著拓展了先知不等式的适用范围，能精确刻画方差约束下的性能边界。

This converts worst-case analysis into an infinite-dimensional convex program, restoring strong minimax duality and reducing the bounded-variance adversary to a one-parameter variational family.

## Key Results
