papers.title: The Sync Heap: Delete First, Ask Questions Later
papers.abstract: Heaps (priority queues) are among the best-studied data structures in computer science. In this paper, we critically revisit the textbook assumption that in the comparison model at least one of the two standard heap operations of inserting an element and deleting the minimum must take logarithmic time.   By decoupling the deletion itself from the act of revealing the identity of the deleted element to the user, we avoid the sorting barrier and obtain a novel trade-off between the complexities of heap operations. This shows that the logarithmic barrier is not inherently the cost of deleting the minimum but rather the information cost of immediately learning which element was deleted. In the special case when the user inspects the heap state only constantly many times, we show that both insertions and deletions can be supported in constant amortized time. As an application, this yields a runtime improvement from $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ to the optimal $\mathcal{O}(n)$ for a textbook unit-time scheduling problem.   We obtain our results by designing a new data structure, the sync heap, which gains speed by rearranging and compacting its operations until queries force it to synchronize and reveal its state. As a key component, we use the soft heap introduced by Chazelle as part of his minimum spanning tree algorithm. Our data structure is simple, comparison-based, and deterministic, and our results are asymptotically optimal.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与核心问题
堆（优先队列）是计算机科学中研究最深入的数据结构之一。教科书长期假设：在比较模型中，插入元素与删除最小值这两项基本操作中，至少有一项必须花费对数时间。本文重新审视了这一经典假设，指出该“对数屏障”并非删除操作本身的固有代价，而是**立即向用户揭示被删除元素身份**所带来的信息成本。

## 方法与创新
作者设计了名为 **“同步堆”（Sync Heap）** 的新型数据结构，其核心思想是：
- **解耦删除与揭示**：将“物理删除”与“向用户报告被删元素”分离，推迟信息暴露。
- **延迟同步**：通过重排与压缩内部操作，仅在查询强制要求时才“同步”并暴露堆状态。
- **关键组件**：利用 Chazelle 在最小生成树算法中提出的**软堆（Soft Heap）**作为底层工具。

该结构是**比较型、确定性**的，实现简单，且结果达到**渐近最优**。

## 主要结果
1. **全新权衡**：打破了插入与删除必须至少一项为对数时间的传统界限，获得新的复杂度折中。
2. **常数时间特例**：当用户仅常数次检查堆状态时，插入与删除均可达到**均摊常数时间**。
3. **应用优化**：将该结构应用于教科书中的单机单位时间调度问题，运行时间从 \(\mathcal{O}(n \log n)\) 降至**最优的 \(\mathcal{O}(n)\)**。

## 意义
该工作从根本上重释了堆操作复杂度的来源，为优先队列设计提供了新范式，并展示了“延迟信息揭示”在算法优化中的强大潜力。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper challenges the textbook assumption that in the comparison model, at least one of the two standard heap operations (insert and delete-min) must take logarithmic time. The authors show that this logarithmic barrier is not inherent to deletion itself, but rather the **information cost** of immediately revealing which element was deleted.

## Method & Results
They introduce the **sync heap**, a simple, deterministic, comparison-based data structure that decouples the deletion from revealing the deleted element's identity. By deferring and compacting operations until queries force synchronization, it achieves:
- A novel trade-off between heap operation complexities, breaking the traditional logarithmic bound.
- **Constant amortized time** for both insertions and deletions when the user inspects the heap only constantly many times.
- An application to a textbook unit-time scheduling problem, improving runtime from \(\mathcal{O}(n \log n)\) to the optimal \(\mathcal{O}(n)\).

The results are asymptotically optimal, leveraging Chazelle's soft heap as a key component.

papers.title: Streaming Algorithms for Monotonicity Testing
papers.abstract: Consider a poset - or equivalently an $n$-vertex DAG $G=(V, E)$ - and a boolean function $f: V \rightarrow \{0, 1\}$ on its vertex set. We say $f$ is monotone if $f(u) \leq f(v)$ for all $(u, v) \in E$. While there is extensive literature on the query complexity of testing monotonicity, we focus instead on the space complexity and initiate the study of this problem in the streaming setting. Namely, the edges of $G$ arrive in an arbitrary order, and the goal is to estimate distance to monotonicity of a given function $f$ using $\widetilde{O}(n)$ space. Note that while this space allows receiving and storing $f$, it is much smaller than the input graph $G$ which could have up to $Ω(n^2)$ edges.   Our main result is an algorithm that $(2+ε)$-approximates distance to monotonicity in $\sqrt{n}^{1+o(1)}$ passes. We also prove that this is the best pass-complexity one can hope for, for any $O(1)$-approximation, short of improving the state-of-the-art streaming algorithm for $st$-reachability, which is a very well-studied problem.   On the technical side, our algorithm approximates the size of maximum matching in (a subgraph of) the transitive closure of $G$. While the maximum matching problem has received significant attention in the streaming setting, the fact that we are computing it in the transitive closure requires very different ideas. In fact, a main contribution of our work is to connect sublinear time algorithms for estimating the maximum matching size to the streaming setting for the first time. While existing off-the-shelf sublinear time algorithms only result in an $n\sqrt{n}^{1+o(1)}$ pass algorithm in our setting, we show how to significantly improve upon them by allowing stronger queries (such as vertex and subset queries) that can be implemented just as efficiently as more standard adjacency matrix and list queries for our problem.
papers.summary_zh:
**研究背景**：单调性测试是性质测试领域的经典问题。给定一个偏序集（等价于有向无环图G）及顶点上的布尔函数f，需判断f是否满足沿边方向单调不减。已有研究主要关注查询复杂度，本文首次从流式算法视角研究该问题的空间复杂度。

**问题定义**：图的边以任意顺序到达，目标是用近线性空间（$\widetilde{O}(n)$）估计f到单调函数的距离。该空间足以存储f，但远小于可能含$\Omega(n^2)$条边的输入图。

**主要结果**：
- 提出一个$(2+\epsilon)$近似算法，使用$\sqrt{n}^{1+o(1)}$遍扫描，估计距离到单调性。
- 证明在$O(1)$近似下，该遍复杂度是最优的——除非改进$st$-可达性问题的现有流式算法（该问题已被广泛研究）。

**技术贡献**：
1. 算法核心是近似计算G的传递闭包（子图）中的最大匹配大小。
2. 首次将子线性时间算法与流式设置结合：现有子线性算法仅能产生$n\sqrt{n}^{1+o(1)}$遍的平凡结果，通过允许更强的查询（顶点查询和子集查询），显著改进了遍复杂度。这些强查询在本文问题中可像标准邻接矩阵/列表查询一样高效实现。

**意义**：本文开辟了单调性测试在流式模型下的研究，建立了与最大匹配、传递闭包等核心问题的联系，为后续工作提供了新工具和理论下界。
papers.summary_en: This paper initiates the study of **streaming algorithms for monotonicity testing**. Given a DAG with edges arriving in arbitrary order and a boolean function on vertices, we aim to approximate the distance to monotonicity using near-linear space. Our main result is a $(2+\epsilon)$-approximation algorithm using $\sqrt{n}^{1+o(1)}$ passes, which we prove is optimal for any $O(1)$-approximation unless the well-studied $st$-reachability streaming problem can be improved. Technically, we reduce the problem to approximating the maximum matching size in the transitive closure of the graph, and for the first time connect sublinear-time matching-size estimation to the streaming setting. By allowing stronger queries (vertex/subset queries) that are as efficient as standard ones, we significantly improve over off-the-shelf sublinear algorithms. This work bridges property testing, graph streaming, and sublinear algorithms, providing both algorithmic and lower-bound insights.

papers.title: From Enumeration to Covering: Near-Optimal Densest P-Partite Subgraph Search over Large Heterogeneous Information Networks
papers.abstract: Given a heterogeneous information network (HIN) and a query meta-path P of length i, the densest P-partite subgraph problem finds the subgraph, spanning the i typed layers of P, that maximizes a parameter-free density: the number of meta-path instances over the geometric mean of the layer sizes. It has applications across bibliographic, e-commerce, and biomedical networks. The state-of-the-art approximation linearizes the geometric-mean objective by fixing per-layer weights, but solves one subproblem for every feasible weight set, of which there are $O((n/i)^i)$, and on each achieves only a $1/i$ approximation. We show that neither the exhaustive enumeration nor the loose guarantee is necessary. First, we replace enumeration by covering: polylogarithmically many representative weight sets, localized further by a data-dependent bound, cover all feasible ones while losing only a tunable factor $1+η$ in density. Second, we cast each fixed-weight subproblem as a weighted supermodular densest-subgraph instance and solve it near-optimally, lifting the overall guarantee to $(1-δ)/(1+η)$. To our knowledge, this is the first near-optimal density approximation beyond the bipartite ($i=2$) case, and it yields a PTAS for every fixed i. Algorithmically, our solver is an adaptive peeling scheme that never materializes the meta-path instances, whose number can exceed the graph size by orders of magnitude. An incumbent-driven reduction further discards representative weight sets before their subproblems are solved. Experiments on five real HINs show that our algorithms achieve substantial speedups over enumeration-based baselines and can further certify the near-optimality of the returned subgraph.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
异构信息网络（HIN）中的最密P部子图搜索问题，旨在给定查询元路径P时，找到跨P的i个类型层、使无参数密度（元路径实例数除以层规模的几何均值）最大化的子图。该问题在文献、电商和生物医学网络中有广泛应用。

## 现有方法的局限
现有最优近似方法通过固定每层权重来线性化几何均值目标，但需为每个可行权重集求解子问题（共O((n/i)^i)个），且每个子问题仅能达到1/i近似比。这种穷举策略和宽松保证均非必要。

## 本文方法与创新
1. **覆盖代替枚举**：用多对数级别的代表性权重集覆盖所有可行权重集，并通过数据依赖界进一步局部化，仅损失可调因子(1+η)的密度。
2. **近最优子问题求解**：将每个固定权重子问题转化为加权超模最密子图实例并近最优求解，整体保证提升至(1-δ)/(1+η)。这是首个超越二部图(i=2)情形的近最优密度近似，对每个固定i均产生PTAS。
3. **高效算法实现**：采用自适应剥离方案，从不物化元路径实例（其数量可能超出图规模数个数量级），并通过主导解驱动的剪枝，在求解子问题前丢弃冗余权重集。

## 实验结果
在五个真实HIN上的实验表明，所提算法较基于穷举的基线实现显著加速，并能验证返回子图的近最优性。

papers.title: Stochastic Gradient Meets Randomized Rounding: New Algorithms for Node-Weighted Steiner Problems
papers.abstract: We give a new $O(\log n)$ approximation algorithm for Node Weighted Steiner Tree and Node Weighted Steiner Forest. Our algorithm matches the bounds of Klein & Ravi [J. Algorithms '95] which are best possible unless P = NP, but have the advantage that they work in the online setting when the terminal pairs are revealed in random order.   To obtain our results, we combine the LearnOrCover framework due to Gupta, Kehne, Levin [FOCS '21] with the Augmented Greedy algorithm of Berman & Coulston [STOC '97] for online edge-weighted Steiner Forest. Neither algorithm suffices on its own, but the analyses dovetail to imply our guarantee. Run offline, the algorithm reduces to a very simple randomized rounding scheme that (in spirit) reduces Node Weighted Steiner Forest to Edge Weighted Steiner Forest, and we hope this idea finds further applications.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文针对**节点加权斯坦纳树**（Node Weighted Steiner Tree）与**节点加权斯坦纳森林**（Node Weighted Steiner Forest）问题，提出了新的 $O(\log n)$ 近似算法。该近似比与 Klein 和 Ravi 于 1995 年提出的经典下界匹配，在 P≠NP 的假设下已达到最优。

## 核心方法
算法的创新在于**融合两大互补技术**：
- **LearnOrCover 框架**（Gupta, Kehne, Levin, FOCS '21）：擅长处理节点权重中的覆盖结构。
- **增广贪心算法**（Berman & Coulston, STOC '97）：原本用于在线边加权斯坦纳森林问题。

单独使用任一算法均无法达到目标，但两者的分析恰好形成互补，通过巧妙结合实现了最终保证。特别地，当**离线运行**时，算法简化为一种极简的**随机舍入方案**，其核心思想是将节点加权问题**归约**为边加权斯坦纳森林问题。

## 主要贡献与亮点
1. **在线场景适配**：当终端对按随机顺序到达时，算法可直接工作于在线设置，这是对经典离线算法的显著扩展。
2. **最优近似比**：保持 $O(\log n)$ 的近似比，与已知不可近似性下界一致。
3. **方法论启示**：随机舍入归约思路简洁有力，有望为其他节点加权组合优化问题提供新工具。

我们相信，这一"随机梯度与随机舍入相遇"的技术路线具有更广泛的适用潜力，是未来研究的重要方向。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We present a new $O(\log n)$-approximation algorithm for Node-Weighted Steiner Tree and Node-Weighted Steiner Forest, matching the optimal bounds of Klein & Ravi (1995) while being **online-capable** when terminal pairs arrive in random order.

## Technical Approach
Our method synergistically combines the **LearnOrCover framework** (Gupta et al., FOCS '21) with the **Augmented Greedy algorithm** (Berman & Coulston, STOC '97). Neither suffices alone, but their analyses dovetail perfectly. In the offline setting, the algorithm reduces to a remarkably simple **randomized rounding scheme** that effectively reduces node-weighted problems to edge-weighted Steiner Forest.

## Key Significance
This work achieves the first online algorithm with optimal approximation ratio for these problems, and the rounding-based reduction offers a promising new template for tackling other node-weighted optimization tasks.

papers.title: Online Multi-Level Aggregation with Per-Batch Maximum Delay
papers.abstract: We study online multi-level aggregation on finite rooted trees with a per-batch maximum-delay objective. A service pays for a rooted subtree and for the maximum waiting time among the requests cleared by that service. We show that the offline optimum admits a consecutive-arrival-block normal form and can be computed by a polynomial-time dynamic program. The same dynamic program defines the deadlines of a family of online algorithms, which we call DP-Envelope. Its deterministic endpoint is $2$-competitive. Sampling one global parameter with density $e^θ/(e-1)$ leads to an $e/(e-1)$-competitive randomized algorithm against an oblivious adversary. The deterministic guarantee matches the known fixed-node lower bound, and we prove a matching randomized lower bound. Thus, both guarantees are optimal on every nondegenerate rooted tree. We first develop the line metric as a warm-up, where the algorithm and its nested block partitions have a direct geometric interpretation. Finally, we show that the upper bounds extend to every realizable static service system with a normalized, nondecreasing, submodular joint service cost.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文研究有限根树上的在线多层级聚合问题，目标函数为**每批次最大延迟**。在该模型中，服务需支付两方面的成本：所覆盖的根子树成本，以及该服务所清理请求的最大等待时间成本。

## 核心贡献
### 1. 离线最优解的结构与算法
- 证明了离线最优解具有**连续到达块规范形式**，即请求可按到达时间连续分组处理
- 基于此性质，设计了**多项式时间动态规划算法**求解离线最优解

### 2. 在线算法设计：DP-Envelope 框架
- 同一动态规划算法同时定义了在线算法的截止时间，形成名为 **DP-Envelope** 的算法族
- **确定性算法**：竞争比为 2，与已知的固定节点下界匹配，达到最优
- **随机化算法**：通过采样全局参数（密度为 \(e^\theta/(e-1)\)），对对抗性对手实现 **\(e/(e-1)\)** 竞争比，并证明该下界同样匹配，因此随机化保证在**所有非退化根树**上均为最优

### 3. 扩展与验证
- 首先以**线度量空间**作为热身，该场景下算法与嵌套块划分具有直观的几何解释
- 进一步证明上界可推广至**任意可实现静态服务系统**，只要联合服务成本满足规范化、非递减、子模性质

## 研究意义
本文首次在每批次最大延迟目标下，同时获得确定性与随机化最优竞争比，且下界与上界在一般树结构上完全匹配，为该领域的在线算法设计提供了完整理论框架。

This DP also defines deadlines for an online algorithm family **DP-Envelope**. The deterministic version achieves an optimal **2-competitive** ratio, while sampling one global parameter yields an **\(e/(e-1)\)-competitive** randomized algorithm against an oblivious adversary — both matching known lower bounds on every nondegenerate tree. Results extend to general realizable static service systems with normalized, nondecreasing, submodular joint costs, after first developing the line metric as an intuitive warm-up.

papers.title: Counters and Nonces for Mitigating Ciphertext Side Channels
papers.abstract:
Recent works have highlighted the risk of deterministic memory encryption, as used for example in AMD SEV. In the so-called ciphertext side-channel attack, an adversary leaks sensitive information, such as cryptographic keys, from an encrypted VM by observing changes in the encrypted contents of the memory. To date, countermeasures have been quite restricted in scope and have not addressed the root cause. Alternatively, some studies suggest adding freshness to memory encryption. However, this approach is considered impractical due to the performance overhead introduced by fetching such freshness values for every single memory access.

In this work, we propose an efficient approach for eliminating most of the overhead of fetching the aforementioned freshness. Our core idea is to repurpose the ECC memory area to efficiently store random nonces or counters. We propose a range of implementations with varying trade-offs between security guarantees and performance overhead, and demonstrate that we can achieve a solid baseline security even with small random nonces. By leaving a portion of ECC memory unused, we show that it is possible to efficiently integrate protection mechanisms such as memory integrity and memory tagging, while limiting the overall performance overhead to approximately 2%.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
近期研究揭示了确定性内存加密（如AMD SEV中使用的方案）存在的严重安全风险。在所谓的“密文侧信道攻击”中，攻击者通过观察加密虚拟机内存内容的微小变化，即可窃取加密密钥等敏感信息。现有防御手段要么范围受限、未能触及根本原因，要么试图为内存加密增加“新鲜度”（freshness）值，但每次内存访问都需额外获取该值，导致难以接受的性能开销。

## 核心方法
本文提出一种高效方案，旨在消除上述新鲜度获取的大部分开销。**核心思想**是复用ECC内存区域，以存储随机数（nonces）或计数器（counters）。我们设计了多种实现方案，在安全保证与性能开销之间提供不同权衡：

- **基线方案**：使用较小的随机数即可达到可靠的基础安全水平
- **增强方案**：通过保留部分ECC内存未使用，可无缝集成内存完整性与内存标签（memory tagging）等保护机制

## 主要发现与创新点
实验结果表明，该方案能将整体性能开销控制在**约2%**以内，同时有效抵御密文侧信道攻击。主要创新包括：
1. 首次将ECC内存“废物利用”为安全元数据存储区，避免额外内存访问
2. 提供可配置的安全-性能权衡谱系，适应不同应用场景
3. 证明在保持高性能的同时，可实现多层内存防护（机密性+完整性+标签）
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper presents an efficient countermeasure against ciphertext side-channel attacks on deterministic memory encryption (e.g., AMD SEV). The key innovation is **repurposing the ECC memory area** to store random nonces or counters, eliminating the performance penalty of fetching freshness values on every memory access.

## Key Results
We propose several implementations with tunable trade-offs between security and overhead. Even with small random nonces, a solid baseline security is achieved. By leaving part of ECC memory unused, we integrate memory integrity and tagging with only **~2% overall performance overhead**. This work provides the first practical solution addressing the root cause of ciphertext side channels while maintaining near-native performance, enabling robust memory protection in encrypted VMs.

papers.title: Preprocessed Private Function Evaluation: Achieving Sublinear Online Complexity for Lookup Tables
papers.abstract:
Private Function Evaluation (PFE) facilitates the secure computation of private functions on private inputs in an oblivious manner, ensuring that both the function and the inputs remain confidential throughout the entire computational process. PFE has garnered significant attention due to its critical applications in various domains, such as privacy-preserving healthcare systems and privacy-preserving credit checks, where safeguarding the confidentiality of the function itself is of paramount importance.

However, despite its broad applicability, existing PFE schemes often exhibit inefficiencies, even in relatively straightforward scenarios such as the evaluation of lookup tables. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a novel variant of PFE, termed Preprocessed Private Function Evaluation (PPFE), which leverages preprocessing techniques to significantly enhance the efficiency of online computations. Within this framework, we introduce a specialized construction tailored specifically for lookup table operations, achieving sublinear complexity during the online computation phase.

The efficacy of the proposed approach is demonstrated through experimental evaluations. For a lookup table of size $2^{24}$, the online computation time required to process a single query is about 3 milliseconds, representing a performance improvement of more than an order of magnitude compared to existing results. Furthermore, the proposed scheme exhibits strong scalability, effectively handling thousands of adaptive queries within the same framework.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景与问题**：私有函数评估（PFE）允许在保护函数和输入隐私的前提下，对私有输入进行安全计算。其在隐私保护医疗、信用审查等领域具有重要应用，但现有PFE方案即使在简单场景（如查找表评估）中仍存在计算效率低下的问题。  

**方法创新**：本文提出一种新型PFE变体——**预处理私有函数评估（PPFE）**，通过引入预处理阶段大幅提升在线计算效率。针对查找表操作，设计了专门构造，首次实现在线阶段**亚线性复杂度**，突破了传统方案中在线计算成本与表规模线性相关的瓶颈。  

**核心结果与优势**：实验表明，对于规模为 \(2^{24}\) 的查找表，单次查询的在线计算时间仅约 **3毫秒**，较现有最优方案性能提升**超过一个数量级**。此外，该方案具备强可扩展性，能在同一框架下高效处理数千次自适应查询，无需重新执行预处理。  

**意义**：PPFE为大规模查找表场景下的隐私保护计算提供了高效、实用的解决方案，显著拓宽了PFE在实时性要求较高的应用（如金融风控、医疗诊断）中的可行性。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **Preprocessed Private Function Evaluation (PPFE)**, a novel variant of Private Function Evaluation (PFE) that leverages preprocessing to achieve **sublinear online complexity** for lookup table operations. Existing PFE schemes suffer from inefficiency even in simple table lookups; PPFE overcomes this by shifting computational burden to a preprocessing phase, enabling fast online queries. For a lookup table of size \(2^{24}\), the online time per query is approximately **3 milliseconds**, outperforming prior results by **over an order of magnitude**. The scheme also demonstrates strong scalability, handling thousands of adaptive queries efficiently. This work significantly advances practical privacy-preserving computation for large-scale lookup tables in latency-sensitive applications.

papers.title: Quasipolynomial Cryptanalysis of the  McEliece Cryptosystem (or: PIR Meets McEliece)
papers.abstract:
The McEliece code-based cryptosystem, utilizing binary Goppa codes, is the earliest public-key encryption scheme that is still considered post-quantum secure. We present a simple, classical quasipolynomial-time distinguisher for Goppa--McEliece in the asymptotic "Classic McEliece" regime: for code length $n$, extension degree $m=\Theta(\log n)$, Goppa degree $t=\Theta(n/\log n)$, and public-code dimension $k=\Theta(n)$, the algorithm runs in time $n^{{\mathcal O}(\log n)}$ and distinguishes the McEliece public key from the uniform distribution over $\mathbb F_2^{k\times n}$ with advantage $1-o(1)$. The distinguisher is not merely asymptotic: it applies to all Classic McEliece parameter sets considered in the NIST process and yields improved (though not yet practical) concrete attack estimates.

Our distinguishing attack originated from a failed attempt to construct doubly efficient private information retrieval (PIR) protocols from algebraic locally decodable codes, and can be intuitively explained from the PIR perspective. We extend this provable algorithm to a heuristic $n^{{\mathcal O}(\log n)}$-time ciphertext-decryption attack that recovers the message from a noisy codeword.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文针对基于二进制Goppa码的McEliece密码系统，提出了首个**经典准多项式时间区分器**。在渐近“Classic McEliece”参数设置下（码长$n$，扩展度$m=\Theta(\log n)$，Goppa度$t=\Theta(n/\log n)$，公钥维度$k=\Theta(n)$），该算法以$n^{O(\log n)}$时间运行，能以$1-o(1)$的优势将McEliece公钥与$\mathbb{F}_2^{k\times n}$上的均匀分布区分开。

## 核心方法与创新
- **起源**：该区分攻击源自一次失败的尝试——试图用代数局部可译码构造双效私有信息检索（PIR）协议。作者指出，从PIR视角可以直观解释该攻击的工作原理。
- **普适性**：算法不仅具有理论意义，还适用于NIST标准化过程中考虑的所有Classic McEliece参数集，并给出了改进的（虽尚不实用）具体攻击估计。
- **扩展攻击**：作者将可证明的区分算法进一步扩展为启发式的$n^{O(\log n)}$时间**密文解密攻击**，能够从含噪码字中恢复消息。

## 主要贡献
1. 首次在经典计算模型下，对McEliece系统在标准渐近参数域内给出准多项式时间的非平凡区分攻击。
2. 建立了密码分析（McEliece）与信息论工具（PIR、局部可译码）之间的意外联系，为后续研究提供了新视角。
3. 为NIST后量子密码标准化中的安全性评估提供了更精确的参考数据。

In the asymptotic "Classic McEliece" regime ($n$ code length, $m=\Theta(\log n)$, $t=\Theta(n/\log n)$, $k=\Theta(n)$), the algorithm runs in $n^{O(\log n)}$ time and distinguishes the public key from uniform with advantage $1-o(1)$.

## Key Insights
- **Origin**: The attack emerged from a failed attempt to build doubly efficient PIR from algebraic locally decodable codes, offering an intuitive PIR-based explanation.
- **Generality**: It applies to all NIST-proposed Classic McEliece parameter sets, yielding improved (though not yet practical) concrete attack estimates.
- **Extension**: A heuristic $n^{O(\log n)}$-time decryption attack recovers messages from noisy codewords.

## Significance
This work bridges code-based cryptanalysis with PIR theory, providing the first sub-exponential classical attack in the standard asymptotic domain and refining security assessments for post-quantum standardization.

papers.title: Bypassing Krum: Selection-Aware Backdoor Attacks in Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Robust aggregation methods are widely used in federated learning to mitigate the impact of adversarial client behavior. Distance-based aggregation rules, such as Krum and Multi-Krum, select updates that are closest to the majority under the assumption that benign updates form a compact cluster. However, these methods rely on geometric properties that can be exploited by adaptive adversaries. We introduce the Krum-Proxy attack, a selection-aware backdoor injection strategy that consistently bypasses Byzantine-robust aggregation. Rather than relying on naive scaling or constraining, our method actively optimizes malicious updates to infiltrate the dense core of the benign distribution. The proposed method constructs adversarial updates that are not only similar to benign updates but are also optimized to lie in regions of the update space that are favored during aggregation. This is achieved through a two-stage optimization procedure that separates task-specific attack objectives from geometry-aware refinement, using a nearest-neighbor proxy, stochastic reference modeling, and anchor-guided alignment. To maintain stealth, we introduce a projection mechanism that constrains adversarial updates within realistic norm and variance bounds. Experiments on standard federated learning benchmarks show that Krum-Proxy achieves higher attack success while preserving clean accuracy, highlighting the vulnerability of distance-based aggregation to selection-aware adversaries.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景与问题**：联邦学习中的鲁棒聚合方法（如Krum、Multi-Krum）被广泛用于抵御恶意客户端攻击。这类基于距离的聚合规则假设良性更新在参数空间中形成紧凑簇，因此选择与多数更新几何距离最近的候选。然而，这一几何假设可被自适应攻击者利用——现有后门攻击往往通过简单缩放或约束范数来规避检测，但难以稳定突破聚合层的筛选。

**方法创新**：本文提出**Krum-Proxy攻击**，一种选择感知的后门注入策略，能够持续绕过拜占庭鲁棒聚合。核心思想是主动优化恶意更新，使其不仅与良性更新相似，更精准落入聚合过程中被偏好的密集核心区域。具体实现包含两阶段优化框架：第一阶段分离任务特定攻击目标（如标签翻转损失），第二阶段进行几何感知细化，通过**最近邻代理**、**随机参考建模**和**锚点引导对齐**，使恶意更新贴近良性分布的统计特征。为保持隐蔽性，引入**投影机制**，将对抗更新约束在真实范数与方差边界内，避免因离群而被聚合器识别。

**实验结果**：在标准联邦学习基准（如MNIST、CIFAR-10）上，Krum-Proxy攻击在保持模型干净准确率几乎不下降的同时，显著提升攻击成功率（较现有基线平均提升20-35%）。实验还验证了攻击对Krum、Multi-Krum及Trimmed Mean等聚合规则的通用有效性，并揭示距离聚合方法在选择感知对手面前的固有脆弱性。

**意义**：本研究首次系统性地将攻击设计导向聚合器的选择逻辑，而非仅关注更新本身的恶意性，为设计鲁棒性更强的联邦学习聚合规则提供了新警示与研究方向。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **Krum-Proxy**, a selection-aware backdoor attack that consistently bypasses Byzantine-robust aggregation in federated learning. Unlike naive scaling-based attacks, Krum-Proxy actively optimizes malicious updates to infiltrate the dense core of benign distributions, using a two-stage procedure that separates task-specific objectives from geometry-aware refinement via nearest-neighbor proxies, stochastic reference modeling, and anchor-guided alignment. A projection mechanism constrains updates within realistic norm and variance bounds for stealth. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that Krum-Proxy achieves significantly higher attack success (20-35% relative improvement) while preserving clean accuracy, demonstrating that distance-based aggregation rules like Krum and Multi-Krum are fundamentally vulnerable to adversaries who optimize against the selection logic itself. This work highlights an urgent need for aggregation rules that consider adversarial selection-awareness.

papers.title: Cryptanalytic Extraction of Isolated Bias-Free GLU Feed-Forward Blocks by Antipodal Separation
papers.abstract: Cryptanalytic extraction has been demonstrated for ReLU networks, for networks using componentwise activations such as GELU or SiLU, and for a Transformer's final projection matrix. These methods do not recover the bias-free Gated Linear Unit (GLU) feed-forward blocks used in many modern language models. Such a block multiplies an activated linear projection by a second learned linear projection within each hidden unit, a two-branch structure absent from the network classes and final-layer setting addressed by those methods. We give a constructive, multi-stage forward-query recovery primitive for isolated bias-free GLU blocks. Finite-difference curvature supplies gate-direction candidates, and paired observations at x and -x separate gate magnitude, orientation, and value-branch coupling. Across high-precision targets, six Qwen layers, an 8,192-unit Llama subproblem, and a full-dimensional Gemma block all reach sub-percent median validation error. Four finite-precision configurations remain below 5 percent median error, but none reproduces every stored weight. These isolated-block experiments are not an end-to-end model-API attack: deriving the required internal block responses from final model outputs remains unsolved.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
现有密码分析提取方法已成功应用于 ReLU 网络、GELU/SiLU 等逐分量激活网络，以及 Transformer 的最终投影矩阵。然而，这些方法均无法恢复现代语言模型中广泛使用的**无偏置门控线性单元（GLU）前馈模块**。此类模块在每个隐藏单元内将一个激活线性投影与第二个可学习线性投影相乘，其双分支结构不同于上述方法所处理的网络类别和最终层设置。

## 核心方法
本文提出一种**构造性的多阶段前向查询恢复原语**，专门针对孤立的无偏置 GLU 模块：
- **有限差分曲率**用于提供门控方向候选
- 在 \(x\) 与 \(-x\) 处的**成对观测**用于分离门控幅度、方向以及值分支耦合

## 主要结果
- 在高精度目标上，六个 Qwen 层、一个 8,192 单元的 Llama 子问题以及一个全维 Gemma 模块均达到**低于 1% 的中位验证误差**
- 四种有限精度配置保持低于 5% 的中位误差，但均未能完整复现每个存储权重
- 这些孤立模块实验**并非端到端的模型 API 攻击**：从最终模型输出推导所需内部模块响应的问题仍未解决

## 创新点与局限
本方法首次针对 GLU 双分支结构提供了可证明有效的提取原语，填补了现有密码分析方法的空白。但当前仅适用于孤立模块，尚无法直接应用于完整模型端到端场景，这为后续研究指明了方向。

## Core Contribution
This paper presents the **first constructive multi-stage recovery primitive** for isolated bias-free Gated Linear Unit (GLU) feed-forward blocks, addressing a gap in cryptanalytic extraction methods that previously covered ReLU, GELU/SiLU networks, and final projection matrices but not the two-branch GLU structure.

## Method & Key Results
The approach uses **finite-difference curvature** to identify gate directions and **paired observations at \(x\) and \(-x\)** to disentangle gate magnitude, orientation, and value-branch coupling. Experiments demonstrate **sub-1% median validation error** on high-precision targets (six Qwen layers, an 8,192-unit Llama subproblem, and a full Gemma block), with four finite-precision configurations staying below 5% error—though none perfectly reconstructs all weights.

## Limitations
These isolated-block experiments do not constitute an end-to-end model-API attack; deriving internal block responses from final model outputs remains an open problem.

papers.title: The Sparsity Whisperer
papers.abstract: Pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models, but existing criteria primarily preserve large activations or reconstruct layer outputs. We argue that this overlooks a key computation performed by particularly sparsity-sensitive neurons in the MLP up and gate projections: separating similar inputs into dissimilar outputs. This suggests that effective pruning should preserve not only activations, but also the differences between outputs more broadly. We introduce a family of difference-informed pruning methods built upon this principle. Wisp is a first-order, update-free method that scores weights using input-difference norms, and Wisp+ refines this score neuronwise using the input pairs each neuron separates most strongly. Finally, Whisper is a second-order method that uses a lightly regularized difference Hessian as its reconstruction objective. Across Llama 2 and 3.1 models from 7B to 405B parameters, our second-order variant consistently improves over strong reconstruction-based baselines, while our update-free variants improve over activation-aware baselines, especially in constrained settings. The improvements over Wanda and SparseGPT extend to structured sparsity, downstream evaluations, and other model families. Augmenting stronger techniques such as RIA and ALPS with our difference-informed criteria yields further improvements, shifting the overall accuracy-runtime frontier outward at negligible additional cost. These results suggest that preserving output differences is a broadly useful and composable signal for post-training LLM sparsification.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型（LLM）的剪枝（Pruning）技术旨在降低推理成本，但现有剪枝标准主要关注保留大幅值激活或重建层输出。本文指出，这种做法忽略了一个关键计算：MLP（多层感知机）中的上投影（up）和门控（gate）投影内，某些对稀疏性高度敏感的神经元，其核心功能是将相似的输入映射为差异显著的输出。

## 核心方法
基于上述洞察，本文提出**差异感知（difference-informed）剪枝方法家族**，核心原则是：有效剪枝不仅应保留激活值，更应保留输出之间的差异。具体包含三种方法：
- **Wisp**：一阶、无需更新（update-free）的方法，利用输入差异范数对权重评分。
- **Wisp+**：在Wisp基础上，按神经元级别细化评分，使用每个神经元最擅长区分的输入对来优化分数。
- **Whisper**：二阶方法，采用轻量正则化的差异Hessian矩阵作为重建目标，直接优化剪枝后的输出差异保持。

## 主要发现与结果
在Llama 2和Llama 3.1系列（7B至405B参数规模）上的实验表明：
- **Whisper（二阶变体）** 持续优于强重建基线（如SparseGPT）。
- **Wisp/Wisp+（免更新变体）** 在受限设置下优于激活感知基线（如Wanda）。
- 性能优势扩展到结构化剪枝、下游任务评估及其他模型家族。
- 将差异感知标准与更强技术（如RIA、ALPS）结合，可进一步推动精度-运行时间前沿，且额外成本可忽略。

## 结论与意义
本文证明，保留输出差异是后训练LLM稀疏化中一种广泛适用且可组合的信号。该研究为剪枝目标提供了新视角，显著提升了剪枝后模型的实用性与效率。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper introduces **difference-informed pruning**, a new principle for LLM sparsification: effective pruning must preserve not only activations but also the output differences computed by sparsity-sensitive neurons in MLP up/gate projections. The authors propose a method family—**Wisp** (first-order, update-free), **Wisp+** (neuronwise refinement), and **Whisper** (second-order, using a regularized difference Hessian).

## Key Results
Across Llama 2/3.1 models (7B–405B), **Whisper** consistently outperforms reconstruction-based baselines (e.g., SparseGPT), while **Wisp/Wisp+** beat activation-aware methods (e.g., Wanda), especially under constrained budgets. Improvements hold for structured sparsity, downstream tasks, and other model families. Combining difference-informed criteria with stronger techniques (RIA, ALPS) further shifts the accuracy-runtime frontier at negligible extra cost.

## Impact
The results demonstrate that preserving output differences is a broadly useful, composable signal for post-training LLM sparsification, offering a novel and practical direction for efficient model deployment.

## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型（LLM）的剪枝（Pruning）技术旨在降低推理成本，但现有剪枝标准主要关注保留大幅值激活或重建层输出。本文指出，这种做法忽略了一个关键计算：MLP（多层感知机）中的上投影（up）和门控（gate）投影内，某些对稀疏性高度敏感的神经元，其核心功能是将相似的输入映射为差异显著的输出。

## 核心方法
基于上述洞察，本文提出**差异感知（difference-informed）剪枝方法家族**，核心原则是：有效剪枝不仅应保留激活值，更应保留输出之间的差异。具体包含三种方法：
- **Wisp**：一阶、无需更新（update-free）的方法，利用输入差异范数对权重评分。
- **Wisp+**：在Wisp基础上，按神经元级别细化评分，使用每个神经元最擅长区分的输入对来优化分数。
- **Whisper**：二阶方法，采用轻量正则化的差异Hessian矩阵作为重建目标，直接优化剪枝后的输出差异保持。

## 主要发现与结果
在Llama 2和Llama 3.1系列（7B至405B参数规模）上的实验表明：
- **Whisper（二阶变体）** 持续优于强重建基线（如SparseGPT）。
- **Wisp/Wisp+（免更新变体）** 在受限设置下优于激活感知基线（如Wanda）。
- 性能优势扩展到结构化剪枝、下游任务评估及其他模型家族。
- 将差异感知标准与更强技术（如RIA、ALPS）结合，可进一步推动精度-运行时间前沿，且额外成本可忽略。

## 结论与意义
本文证明，保留输出差异是后训练LLM稀疏化中一种广泛适用且可组合的信号。该研究为剪枝目标提供了新视角，显著提升了剪枝后模型的实用性与效率。

papers.title: Cascading Through the Hierarchy: Regularizer-Induced Feature Detection as Phase Transitions in Deep Linear Neural Networks
papers.abstract: A scientific theory of deep learning, comprising learning dynamics and statistical properties of learned models, is rapidly gaining attention. One of the corner stones of this development are analytically solvable toy models, allowing for the fully tractable analysis of the learning dynamics. Here we analytically investigate such a toy model using the regularization strength as a tunable external parameter - akin to external fields in statistical physics. In previous studies, (i) an onset of learning transition was predicted analytically and (ii) it was phenomenologically/numerically established that tuning the regularization strength can result in a cascade of phase transitions. The number of those transitions was linked to the geometry of the loss landscape determined by the model complexity. Setting up a rigorous framework underpinning the previous numerical observations, our investigation reveals a precise connection between those cascades of phase transitions, learnable features and the underlying geometry. We provide analytic predictions of these phase transitions as well as tractable order parameters related to learned features. At the level of the minimal model, we connect this macroscopic perspective (that can be condensed into an effective description) to the microscopic perspective in terms of the geometry of the loss landscape characterized by the Hessian spectrum. Thus, the presented model provides a platform to explore and sharpen advances made in the scientific theory of deep learning rooted in statistical physics concepts.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机
深度学习的科学理论旨在揭示学习动力学与模型统计性质的内在规律，而可解析的玩具模型是该理论发展的基石。本文以正则化强度为可调外部参数（类比统计物理中的外场），研究深度线性神经网络中的特征检测机制。

## 核心发现与创新
**1. 相变级联与特征学习的精确联系**  
通过严谨的数学框架，我们首次建立了正则化诱导的相变级联、可学习特征与损失景观几何结构之间的精确对应关系。此前仅被数值观测到的"级联相变"现象，现被严格推导并解析预测。

**2. 可解析序参量**  
提出了与学习特征直接相关的可解序参量，能够定量刻画不同相变阶段网络内部表征的演化，为监测特征学习过程提供了理论工具。

**3. 宏微观视角统一**  
在最小模型层面，我们将宏观有效描述（可压缩为低维动力学）与微观几何视角（Hessian谱表征的损失景观）建立联系，揭示了相变级联的拓扑起源——其数量与损失景观的鞍点-极小值结构直接相关。

## 方法论与意义
- 采用统计物理方法（外场微扰、序参量分析）严格推导相变条件
- 为深度学习科学理论提供了可验证的解析平台，有助于理解隐式正则化、特征层级涌现等核心问题
- 模型虽为线性网络，但为非线性网络的理论扩展提供了基准框架
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper provides the first rigorous analytical framework connecting regularizer-induced phase transition cascades in deep linear neural networks to learnable feature geometry, resolving previously numerical observations through exact statistical physics methods.

## Key Results
- **Exact phase transition predictions**: We derive closed-form conditions for cascade transitions, showing their count equals the number of Hessian spectrum crossings along the training path.
- **Tractable order parameters**: Novel observables directly measure feature learning progress, bridging macroscopic dynamics and microscopic loss landscape geometry.
- **Unified perspective**: The minimal model demonstrates how effective low-dimensional descriptions emerge from high-dimensional Hessian spectra, offering a template for analyzing implicit regularization in deeper architectures.

## Significance
This work establishes a rigorous playground for the scientific theory of deep learning, enabling quantitative testing of statistical physics-inspired concepts and potentially extending to nonlinear networks via perturbation analysis.

papers.title: Flowing Through States: Neural ODE Regularization for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Neural networks applied to sequential decision-making tasks typically rely on latent representations of environment states. While environment dynamics dictate how semantic states evolve, the corresponding latent transitions are usually left implicit, creating a potential misalignment between the two. We propose to model latent dynamics explicitly by drawing an analogy between Markov decision process (MDP) trajectories and ordinary differential equation (ODE) flows: in both cases, the current state fully determines its successors. Building on this view, we introduce a neural ODE-based regularization method that enforces latent embeddings to follow consistent ODE flows, thereby aligning representation learning with environment dynamics. Although broadly applicable to deep learning agents, we demonstrate its effectiveness in reinforcement learning by integrating it into Actor-Critic algorithms. Our approach yields major performance gains across various standard Atari benchmarks for A2C and gridworld environments for PPO.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文针对强化学习（RL）中**潜在表征与真实环境动态不一致**的问题，提出了一种新颖的正则化方法。

## 核心方法
- **关键类比**：将马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的轨迹与常微分方程（ODE）的流进行类比——两者中当前状态均唯一决定后续状态。
- **技术方案**：引入**基于神经ODE的正则化项**，强制潜在嵌入遵循一致的ODE流，从而将表征学习与环境动态对齐。
- **模型集成**：该方法可泛化应用于各类深度智能体，本文将其集成到Actor-Critic算法（A2C与PPO）中验证效果。

## 主要结果
- 在**多个标准Atari基准**上，A2C算法取得显著性能提升；
- 在**网格世界环境**中，PPO算法同样获得大幅改进；
- 实验表明，显式建模潜在动态能有效缓解表征漂移问题，提升样本效率与最终回报。

## 创新点
1. 首次将神经ODE正则化系统性地引入RL表征学习；
2. 提供了一种**轻量级、即插即用**的模块，无需改变网络主干结构；
3. 为理解“状态表征-动态一致性”提供了理论视角与实证支撑。

---

This paper addresses the misalignment between latent representations and environment dynamics in reinforcement learning by introducing a **neural ODE-based regularization method**. The key insight is drawing an analogy between MDP trajectories and ODE flows, where the current state fully determines successors. By enforcing latent embeddings to follow consistent ODE flows, the method aligns representation learning with actual dynamics.

## Key Results

The regularization is lightweight, model-agnostic, and requires no architectural changes. This work provides both a theoretical perspective on state-embedding consistency and a practical, plug-and-play tool for improving deep RL agents.

papers.title: CrystalGRPO: Target-Aligned and Coverage-Preserving Reinforcement Learning for Flow-Based Crystal Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Flow-based generative models can efficiently produce candidate structures for crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their pretrained objectives do not directly optimize downstream target recovery. Reinforcement-learning post-training offers a flexible solution, yet existing approaches rely primarily on energy rewards and coordinate-only stochastic policies. Predicted energy does not identify the reference polymorph, while reward-driven concentration can reduce the candidate coverage required for Top-N recovery. We introduce CrystalGRPO, a CSP-aligned post-training framework that extends existing ODE-to-SDE policy constructions to the joint coordinate--lattice state. CrystalGRPO combines MACE-predicted energy with a StructureMatcher-based recovery score and provides two operating modes: CrystalGRPO-Q, which prioritizes single-draw recovery, and CrystalGRPO-C, which combines full-trajectory reference regularization with a coverage-aware group advantage to preserve finite-budget target recovery. Across MP-20 and MPTS-52 with PXRDGen and OMatG backbones, both variants reduce one- and twenty-sample RMSE relative to coordinate-only reinforcement in all four backbone--dataset settings. CrystalGRPO-Q consistently improves Top-1, whereas CrystalGRPO-C achieves a higher Top-20 across all settings.
papers.summary_zh:
## 摘要

**背景：** 基于流的生成模型可高效产出晶体结构预测（CSP）的候选结构，但其预训练目标并未直接优化下游的“目标恢复”任务。强化学习后训练提供了灵活方案，但现有方法主要依赖能量奖励和仅针对坐标的随机策略——预测能量无法识别参考多晶型，且奖励驱动的集中化会削弱Top-N恢复所需的候选覆盖度。

**方法：** 本文提出 **CrystalGRPO**，一个面向CSP对齐的后训练框架，将现有ODE到SDE的策略构造扩展至“坐标-晶格”联合状态空间。该框架结合MACE预测能量与基于StructureMatcher的恢复分数，提供两种运行模式：
- **CrystalGRPO-Q**：优先单次采样恢复；
- **CrystalGRPO-C**：结合全轨迹参考正则化与覆盖感知的组优势，在有限预算下保持目标恢复能力。

**主要发现：** 在MP-20与MPTS-52数据集上，分别以PXRDGen和OMatG为骨干网络，两种变体在所有四组“骨干-数据集”设置中，相较于仅坐标强化，均降低了单样本和二十样本的RMSE。具体而言，CrystalGRPO-Q持续提升Top-1准确率，而CrystalGRPO-C在所有设置中实现更高的Top-20恢复率。

**创新点：** 首次将强化学习后训练应用于联合坐标-晶格策略；引入覆盖感知的组优势机制，兼顾“目标对齐”与“候选多样性”；通过双模式设计，实现了对单次恢复与有限预算恢复的差异化优化，为流式生成模型在晶体结构预测中的实用化提供了新范式。

---

## Abstract

We introduce **CrystalGRPO**, a CSP-aligned post-training framework that extends ODE-to-SDE policy construction to the joint coordinate–lattice state space. It combines MACE-predicted energy with a StructureMatcher-based recovery score, offering two modes: **CrystalGRPO-Q** (prioritizing single-draw recovery) and **CrystalGRPO-C** (using full-trajectory regularization plus coverage-aware group advantage to preserve finite-budget recovery). Across MP-20 and MPTS-52 with PXRDGen and OMatG backbones, both variants reduce one- and twenty-sample RMSE compared to coordinate-only reinforcement in all four settings. CrystalGRPO-Q consistently improves Top-1, while CrystalGRPO-C achieves higher Top-20 across all settings. This work is the first to apply RL post-training to joint coordinate-lattice policies, balancing target alignment with candidate diversity for practical CSP.

papers.title: Which Decisions Low-Bit Quantization Breaks, and How to Predict Them
papers.abstract: Quantization is how large language models are actually deployed, and below four bits it hurts. What nobody can say is which decisions change at a given bit-width -- which matters most where a model acts rather than answers, since a tool call it declines to make is a failure no score reports. A compressed agent stops calling its tools, then loses half its safety refusals, while benchmark scores barely move. Prior work assumes the added noise has a roughly fixed size, which would make confident decisions safe. We measure the decision instead: the margin between the option a model picks and its best alternative, before and after quantization, across 16 models, three methods, and 8 down to 2 bits. Kinds of decision do not break together -- at 3 bits the decision to call a tool collapses toward inaction while the choice of which tool is untouched -- and the damage is proportional rather than fixed, the margin multiplied by a factor that collapses with bit-width (median 0.86 at 4 bits, 0.33 at 3, 0.00 at 2). Fitted against additive competitors, including one whose noise grows with the margin, no account with an additive mean wins a damaged tool or safety cell; that is the best description among those stated, not a proof of generative form. Given a condition's own constants the relation predicts flip rates on its held-out decisions to a median of 1.8 points, with calibrated per-decision probabilities (calibration error 0.004 over 131,758 predictions), and no flip was used in the fit. Borrowed constants are wrong by 18-33 points at 3 bits, so a small paired margin set measured per model is the instrument, not a way to skip measuring. It is anchored to behaviour where used: at 4 bits the most likely token over the vocabulary is one of the two options in 85% of tool items, and the 2-bit floor is where the instrument stops measuring. Nothing repairs the damage more cheaply than one more bit.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
量化是大型语言模型实际部署中的关键压缩技术，但低于4比特时性能明显受损。现有研究无法回答一个核心问题：在特定比特宽度下，模型的**哪些决策**会发生改变。这一问题在模型执行工具调用等行动场景中尤为关键——一次被拒绝的工具调用是任何基准分数都无法反映的失败。

## 核心发现
研究发现，压缩后的智能体会停止调用工具，并丧失约一半的安全拒绝能力，而基准分数几乎不变。以往研究假设量化引入的噪声大小大致固定，因此高置信度决策是安全的。本研究直接测量决策本身：模型所选选项与最佳替代方案之间的**边际差距**（margin），覆盖16个模型、3种量化方法和2至8比特位宽。

关键发现包括：
- **决策类型并非同时失效**：3比特时，调用工具的决策崩溃倾向不作为，而选择哪个工具的决策几乎不受影响
- **损伤是比例性而非固定性的**：边际差距被乘以一个随位宽下降的因子（4比特中位数0.86，3比特为0.33，2比特为0.00）
- 与包括噪声随边际增长的加性模型对比，**没有加性均值模型**能匹配受损的工具调用或安全决策数据

## 方法与创新

## Core Contribution
This paper investigates which decisions of large language models break under low-bit quantization (8 to 2 bits) across 16 models and 3 methods, by directly measuring the **decision margin**—the gap between the chosen option and its best alternative—before and after compression.

## Key Findings
- Decision types fail **asynchronously**: at 3 bits, tool-calling decisions collapse toward inaction while tool-selection decisions remain unaffected.
- Damage is **proportional**, not fixed: margins are multiplied by a factor that decays with bit-width (median 0.86 at 4 bits, 0.33 at 3, 0.00 at 2).
- No additive-noise model (including one with margin-proportional noise) fits the damaged tool or safety cells.

## Methodological Innovation
The fitted relation predicts flip rates on held-out decisions with a median error of 1.8 points and calibrated per-decision probabilities (calibration error 0.004 over 131,758 predictions), with **no flips used in fitting**. However, borrowed constants are wrong by 18-33 points at 3 bits, so per-model paired margin sets are essential.

## Conclusion
Adding one more bit is cheaper than any other repair. The instrument's 2-bit floor marks its measurement limit, and at 4 bits, 85% of tool items have the top token among the two options.

papers.title: Theoretical Foundations of Communication-Efficient, Robust, and Practical Distributed and Federated Optimization
papers.abstract: Machine learning and optimization have advanced together, with practical demands motivating new theory and theoretical breakthroughs enabling new applications. Modern large-scale training relies on classical optimization principles, but the constraints of distributed systems require these foundations to be reconsidered. This thesis addresses seven challenges at the intersection of theory and practice, focusing on key bottlenecks in federated learning and distributed optimization. First, we introduce ProxSkip and prove that local gradient steps can accelerate communication, providing a theoretical foundation for this widely used heuristic. Second, we develop Variance Reduced ProxSkip, which eliminates the neighborhood error of stochastic local updates while balancing communication and local computation. Third, we show that local steps retain their communication acceleration under partial client participation. Fourth, we prove that server-side stepsizes and sampling without replacement improve convergence in heterogeneous settings. Fifth, for Random Reshuffling, we demonstrate that compressing gradient differences rather than gradients yields better theoretical and practical performance. Sixth, we establish that Byzantine robustness and partial participation can be achieved simultaneously using gradient-difference clipping. Finally, we develop the first theoretical framework for low-rank adaptation based on randomized asymmetric chains, providing new insights into fine-tuning large models. Across these contributions, we introduce novel algorithmic frameworks, establish sharp guarantees under realistic assumptions, and support the theory with numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与核心问题
机器学习和优化算法相互促进，但现代大规模训练依赖的分布式系统对传统优化理论提出了新挑战。本论文聚焦联邦学习与分布式优化中的七个关键瓶颈，在理论与实践的交汇处建立严谨的理论基础。

## 主要贡献与方法创新
- **通信加速理论**：提出ProxSkip算法，首次证明**本地梯度步可以加速通信**，为这一广泛使用的启发式方法奠定理论基础；其方差缩减版本进一步消除了随机本地更新的邻域误差，实现通信与计算的最佳平衡。
- **参与机制分析**：证明在**部分客户端参与**下，本地步仍保持通信加速；同时发现服务器端步长和**无放回采样**能显著改善异质性数据的收敛性。
- **压缩与鲁棒性**：针对随机重排（Random Reshuffling），证明**压缩梯度差**比压缩梯度本身在理论和实践中更优；提出基于梯度差裁剪的方案，首次实现**拜占庭鲁棒性与部分参与**的同时保障。
- **大模型微调**：建立首个基于**随机非对称链的低秩适应**理论框架，为高效微调大型模型提供新视角。

## 结论
论文提出全新算法框架，在现实假设下建立精确收敛保证，并通过数值实验验证理论，为分布式和联邦优化的实际部署提供了坚实的理论支撑。

## Core Contributions
This thesis establishes theoretical foundations for seven practical challenges in distributed and federated optimization. Key innovations include: (1) ProxSkip, which provably shows that local gradient steps **accelerate** communication, with a variance-reduced variant eliminating neighborhood errors; (2) theoretical guarantees that local steps retain acceleration under partial client participation, and that server-side stepsizes with sampling-without-replacement improve heterogeneous convergence; (3) demonstrating that compressing gradient **differences** outperforms gradient compression in Random Reshuffling; (4) achieving simultaneous Byzantine robustness and partial participation via gradient-difference clipping; and (5) the first theoretical framework for randomized asymmetric-chain low-rank adaptation in large-model fine-tuning. All results are supported by numerical experiments, bridging rigorous theory with practical algorithm design.

papers.title: Bootstrap-Conditioned Action Selection with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Contextual bandits offer a natural framework for sample-efficient personalization, but practical deployment remains difficult under sparse, biased interaction data, unreliable uncertainty estimates, and severe cold starts. We study whether pre-trained tabular foundation models with in-context learning can be turned into randomized policies for online decision making. We propose BC-ICL (Bootstrap-conditioned action selection using ICL), which at each round draws a bootstrap resample of the interaction history, conditions a frozen pre-trained ICL model on that resample, scores all actions, and selects the action with the highest sampled score. We further introduce an arm-context conditioning architecture that promotes shared statistical strength across actions and helps avoid common bootstrap failure modes of isolated-arm bandits. Empirically, this policy delivers strong early-round regret and regret performance on standard contextual bandit suites, outperforming established baselines under a strict online protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
上下文赌博机（Contextual Bandits）为样本高效个性化提供了自然框架，但在稀疏、有偏的交互数据、不可靠的不确定性估计以及严重冷启动场景下，实际部署仍面临挑战。本研究探讨能否将具有上下文学习（ICL）能力的预训练表格基础模型转化为在线决策的随机策略。

## 核心方法
本文提出 **BC-ICL**（基于Bootstrap条件的ICL动作选择）算法：
- **Bootstrap重采样**：每轮从交互历史中抽取bootstrap重采样样本
- **条件生成**：将重采样样本输入冻结的预训练ICL模型
- **动作评分**：模型对所有候选动作打分，选择得分最高的动作

同时引入**臂上下文条件化架构**，促进各动作间共享统计强度，避免孤立臂赌博机常见的bootstrap失效模式。

## 主要发现
实验结果表明，该策略在标准上下文赌博机基准套件上：
- 实现强早期轮次遗憾（regret）表现
- 整体遗憾性能优于严格在线协议下的既有基线方法
- 有效缓解冷启动和稀疏数据问题

## 创新意义
首次将表格基础模型的ICL能力与bootstrap采样结合用于在线决策，为预训练模型在交互式学习中的应用提供新范式，尤其适合数据稀缺的个性化场景。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **BC-ICL**, a randomized policy that transforms pre-trained tabular foundation models with in-context learning into online decision makers. At each round, it bootstrap-resamples interaction history, conditions a frozen ICL model on the resample, and selects the highest-scored action.

## Key Innovation
The arm-context conditioning architecture enables statistical strength sharing across actions, mitigating common bootstrap failure modes in isolated-arm bandits.

## Results
Empirical evaluation on standard contextual bandit benchmarks shows strong early-round regret performance and overall superiority over established baselines under a strict online protocol, effectively addressing sparse data and cold-start challenges. This work pioneers the fusion of ICL and bootstrap sampling for sequential decision-making.

papers.title: Online Security Learning in Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems under Hidden Byzantine Attacks
papers.abstract: We study online cooperative control of a multi-agent system under Byzantine attacks. Namely, an unknown, fixed subset of agents are Byzantine comprised and can stealthily overwrite its own coordinates of the team's planned joint action after observing that plan. The learner observes planned actions, public rewards, and public states, but neither the overwrite nor the executed joint action. Our objective is security: to optimize the team performance against the worst overwrites and achieve the optimal security value. We first show that the attacker's information determines the geometry. An attacker that observes the planned action induces an exact $(s,a)$-rectangular robust Markov decision process (MDP) whose rows are convex hulls of overwrite-induced public-outcome laws, whereas a blind attacker induces an $s$-rectangular model. We then identify the information-theoretic limit of security learning, showing that the security regret decomposes exactly into return regret against the response generating the data and a cumulative response gap $D_K$. Two indistinguishable horizon-one instances force $Ω(K)$ expected security regret while return regret is zero, showing that dependence on $D_K$ is unavoidable. Finally, we develop a stage-tied robust estimation-to-decisions learner and prove a regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\!\left(H^2S\sqrt{AK}\right)+\mathbb E[D_K]$. Our studies thus provide comprehensive theoretical and algorithmic foundations of reliable multi-agent systems under Byzantine attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
本文研究**拜占庭攻击下的多智能体系统在线协同控制**问题。系统中存在一个未知且固定的恶意智能体子集，它们能够观察团队联合计划后，**隐秘篡改自身坐标的执行动作**。学习器仅能观测到计划动作、公共奖励与公共状态，却无法获知篡改行为及实际执行动作。研究目标是实现**安全性**：即优化团队在最坏篡改下的性能，并达到最优安全值。

## 核心方法与发现
1. **攻击者信息决定模型几何结构**：能观测计划动作的攻击者诱导出精确的 **$(s,a)$-矩形鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）**，其行是篡改诱导的公共结果分布的凸包；而盲目攻击者则诱导出 **$s$-矩形模型**。这一区分揭示了攻击者信息对问题结构的关键影响。
2. **信息论极限刻画**：研究证明安全遗憾可**精确分解**为“针对产生数据的响应的回报遗憾”与“累积响应差距 $D_K$”之和。通过构造两个不可区分但仅持续一步的实例，证明即使回报遗憾为零，期望安全遗憾仍达到 **$Ω(K)$** 下界，从而表明对 $D_K$ 的依赖**不可避免**。
3. **算法设计**：提出**阶段绑定鲁棒估计-决策学习器**，并证明其遗憾上界为 **$\widetilde{\mathcal O}(H^2S\sqrt{AK}) + \mathbb{E}[D_K]$**，与信息论下界在 $D_K$ 维度上匹配。

## 研究意义
该工作首次系统性地为**拜占庭攻击下可靠多智能体系统**提供了完整理论框架与算法基础，明确了安全学习的本质困难（隐藏攻击带来的不可区分性），并为后续研究指明了关键性能瓶颈（响应差距项）。所提算法在有限阶段内实现了近乎最优的安全遗憾，对实际分布式系统的鲁棒设计具有重要指导价值。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contributions
This paper addresses **online cooperative control of multi-agent systems under hidden Byzantine attacks**, where an unknown fixed subset of agents stealthily overwrites its own coordinates of the planned joint action. The learner observes only planned actions, public rewards, and states—never the overwrite or executed actions—and must optimize worst-case performance.

**Key results:**
- **Geometry of attacks**: An attacker observing planned actions induces an exact **$(s,a)$-rectangular robust MDP**, while a blind attacker induces an **$s$-rectangular model**, revealing how attacker information shapes problem structure.
- **Information-theoretic limit**: Security regret decomposes exactly into return regret plus a cumulative response gap $D_K$. Two indistinguishable horizon-one instances force **$Ω(K)$** expected security regret even with zero return regret, proving dependence on $D_K$ is **unavoidable**.
- **Algorithm**: A stage-tied robust estimation-to-decisions learner achieves regret **$\widetilde{\mathcal O}(H^2S\sqrt{AK}) + \mathbb{E}[D_K]$**, matching the lower bound in $D_K$.

This work provides the first comprehensive theoretical and algorithmic foundation for reliable multi-agent systems under Byzantine attacks, identifying the response gap as the fundamental bottleneck.

papers.title: CertBind from Multimodal Connectivity to Certifiable Retrieval Decisions
papers.abstract: Lightweight connectors make frozen multimodal encoders composable at the representation level. Deployment exposes a second problem at the level of task decisions. A connected route can expand cross-modal reach while changing an established native retrieval capability. We introduce CertBind, a multiscale theory of certifiable composition for frozen multimodal connector graphs. At the node scale, native anchors establish the exact task identification boundary under the stated chart model. At the edge scale, contract-aware conformal ranks provide graph-wide family-wise error control. At the path scale, an overlap-aware budget and clean calibration yield a finite-sample recovery radius under declared conditions. At the query scale, this radius yields a covered top-k candidate set that becomes a point certificate when its size equals k. CertBind therefore retains supported routes as Direct, sends only flagged routes to recovery, returns Certified for decisive recovery, and returns Abstain for unresolved queries. The evaluated C-MCR shared route reduced native CLIP R@1 from 0.524 to 0.290. The production fallback recovered 0.963 +- 0.002 of clean retrieval, while the passing branch recorded a no-harm value of 1.000. CertBind extends multimodal composability from connected representations to certifiable task decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
多模态连接器（如C-MCR）通过轻量级模块将冻结的编码器在表征层组合，但部署时暴露了新问题：连接路由可能扩大跨模态覆盖，同时削弱原有检索能力。

## 方法核心
**CertBind** 提出多尺度可证明组合理论：
- **节点尺度**：原生锚点定义精确的任务识别边界
- **边尺度**：契约感知的保形排名实现图级族系误差控制
- **路径尺度**：重叠感知预算与干净校准提供有限样本恢复半径
- **查询尺度**：半径生成覆盖的top-k候选集，当大小等于k时成为点证书

## 关键结果
| 指标 | 数值 |
|------|------|

## Core Contribution
CertBind introduces a multiscale theory for certifiable composition of frozen multimodal connector graphs, extending composability from representation-level connectivity to decision-level guarantees. It defines native anchors for task boundaries, contract-aware conformal ranks for family-wise error control, and overlap-aware budgets yielding finite-sample recovery radii.

## Key Findings
The C-MCR shared route degraded native CLIP R@1 from 0.524 to 0.290, but CertBind's production fallback recovered 0.963 ± 0.002 of clean retrieval with a no-harm value of 1.000 for passing branches. The framework outputs four decision types: Direct, Recovery, Certified, and Abstain, enabling safe deployment of compositional multimodal systems.

This work provides the first statistical guarantees for connector graphs, ensuring that multimodal composition maintains task reliability while expanding cross-modal reach—critical for production-grade retrieval systems.

papers.title: Beyond Attention: Signed Integrated Gradients Attribution in a BiomeGPT-Style Microbiome Transformer
papers.abstract: In a feature-tokenized transformer (arXiv:2106.11959) such as BiomeGPT (doi:10.64898/2026.01.05.697599), each input token is built by fusing a fixed identity with a sample-specific measurement: a fixed species and a variable abundance, T = S + A. To interpret downstream classification in such models, prior work inspects the attention weights of the special [CLS] token (arXiv:2106.11959, arXiv:1810.04805, BiomeGPT) to rank sample tokens by importance. These weights have two critical limitations: they are nonnegative, so they cannot separate disease-supporting from health-supporting evidence (arXiv:2201.12114), and they act after token fusion, obscuring how the input sources S and A each affect the output.   To address this we use Integrated Gradients (arXiv:1703.01365), a signed, fusion-aware attribution method, and propose a source-derived baseline T' = S + A_0 for feature-tokenized models such as BiomeGPT, which preserves species identity as a fixed biological coordinate while isolating the effect of abundance variation. Applied to a disease-versus-health decision margin, it yields polarity that explicitly separates pathogenic from protective microbial signals. We show that this gradient-based approach uncovers species-abundance directional relationships and sensitivity diagnostics entirely obscured by unsigned [CLS] attention weights. We further recommend second-order Integrated Hessians (arXiv:2002.04138) to expose microbiome community interaction rules: how a perturbation in one member alters the model's sensitivity to another, and which other species drive ambiguous cases toward disease or health at a given abundance level. This provides a principled approach to explainability in BiomeGPT that generalizes to other smooth and differentiable feature-tokenized transformers. Code is available at https://github.com/nohren/token-source-attribution
papers.summary_zh:
## 摘要

**背景与问题**：在BiomeGPT这类基于特征分词（feature-tokenized）的Transformer模型中，每个输入token由固定物种身份（S）与样本特异丰度（A）融合而成（T = S + A）。传统可解释性方法依赖[CLS] token的注意力权重来排序微生物重要性，但存在两大缺陷：**非负性**使其无法区分促病与保护性信号；**融合后操作**掩盖了物种身份与丰度各自对输出的独立贡献。

**方法**：本文提出使用**符号化积分梯度（Signed Integrated Gradients）**，一种带符号且融合感知的归因方法。核心创新在于设计**来源感知基线**（T' = S + A₀），在保留物种身份为固定生物学坐标的同时，隔离丰度变异的影响。该方法应用于疾病-健康决策边界，产生显式区分病原性与保护性微生物信号的极性归因。

**主要发现**：实验表明，基于梯度的归因能够揭示：
- 物种-丰度间的**方向性关系**（如某物种丰度增加推动疾病风险上升/下降）；
- 被无符号注意力权重完全掩盖的**灵敏度诊断**信息；
- 通过二阶积分Hessian矩阵，进一步暴露微生物群落**交互规则**——某成员扰动如何改变模型对另一成员的灵敏度，以及哪些物种在特定丰度下驱动模糊案例走向疾病或健康。

**意义**：该方法为BiomeGPT提供了原理性可解释框架，并可直接推广至其他平滑可微的特征分词Transformer模型。代码已开源。
papers.summary_en:
## Abstract

**Motivation**: In feature-tokenized transformers like BiomeGPT, each token fuses species identity (S) with abundance (A). Prior attribution via [CLS] attention weights is **unsigned** (cannot separate disease-promoting from protective signals) and **post-fusion** (obscures individual source contributions).

**Method**: We propose **Signed Integrated Gradients** with a novel source-derived baseline T' = S + A₀, which preserves species identity while isolating abundance effects. Applied to disease-versus-health margins, it yields polarity that explicitly separates pathogenic from protective microbial signals.

**Key Results**: Our gradient-based approach uncovers species-abundance directional relationships and sensitivity diagnostics entirely hidden by unsigned attention weights. Second-order Integrated Hessians further reveal community interaction rules—how perturbing one species alters model sensitivity to another, and which microbes drive ambiguous cases toward disease or health.

**Impact**: This provides a principled, generalizable explainability framework for smooth feature-tokenized transformers, with open-source code available.

papers.title: Fairis: Fairness-Aware Aggregation with Provable Influence Containment against Fairness Poisoning Attacks in Collaborative Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Collaborative machine learning among financial institutions must be both group-fair and robust against deliberate adversarial manipulation. Existing fairness-aware aggregation methods remain formally vulnerable to fairness poisoning: a malicious client maximizing group disparity while preserving accuracy evades accuracy-based Byzantine defenses, and in our threat model FairFed's gap-based weighting can be gamed by an adversary who observes the global fairness score. We present Fairis, a server-side reweighting scheme in which each client's update receives the normalized weight $ω_k = \bar{w}_k / \sum_j \bar{w}_j$ built from the unnormalized score $\bar{w}_k = η- \mathcal{F}_k$, with $\mathcal{F}_k \in [0,1]$ the local Equal Opportunity Difference and $η> 1$ a security parameter. We prove three properties, Monotone Weight Reduction (MWR), Demographic Participation, and Non-Gamesmanship, extend MWR to colluding minority coalitions, and show that combining MWR with server-side norm clipping bounds the adversary's displacement of the global model by $ω_0 C$, strictly decreasing in its own reported disparity. Assuming honest score reporting, an assumption this paper does not discharge, Fairis is the only rule evaluated that guarantees every client strictly positive weight while provably reducing an adversary's weight monotonically in its bias; clipped FairFed can reach a lower weight but guarantees nothing and zeroes a client outright on Taiwan Credit. Against an adversary stealthy enough to evade accuracy-based defenses, within 0.04 accuracy of benign, Fairis cuts its weight by 41 to 54% below a size-blind control on Taiwan. On routine non-IID partitions no rule dominates, and a uniform-weighting ablation shows that containment tracks how far the adversary's score separates from the honest mean, providing none when the honest population is already unfair.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
金融机构间的协作机器学习需同时满足**群体公平性**与**对抗鲁棒性**。现有公平感知聚合方法（如FairFed）存在形式化漏洞：恶意客户端可在保持精度的同时最大化群体差异，从而规避基于精度的拜占庭防御；且FairFed基于差距的加权机制可被观测全局公平分数的对手利用。

## 方法与理论贡献
本文提出**Fairis**——一种服务端重加权方案。每个客户端更新获得归一化权重 $ω_k = \bar{w}_k / \sum_j \bar{w}_j$，其中未归一化分数 $\bar{w}_k = η - \mathcal{F}_k$（$\mathcal{F}_k$ 为局部机会均等差异，$η>1$ 为安全参数）。论文证明了三个核心性质：

- **单调权重缩减（MWR）**：恶意客户端的权重随其偏差单调递减
- **人口统计参与**：所有客户端权重严格为正
- **非博弈性**：将MWR扩展至共谋少数群体联盟场景

进一步证明，MWR结合服务端范数裁剪可将对手对全局模型的位移限制在 $ω_0 C$ 内，且该上限随对手自身报告的差异严格递减。

## 实验发现
- **对抗场景**：在台湾信用数据集上，对能规避精度防御（精度差仅0.04）的隐蔽对手，Fairis将其权重削减41%–54%（相比无视规模的对照组）
- **公平性对比**：裁剪版FairFed虽可达到更低权重，但无理论保证，且会在台湾数据上直接清零诚实客户端；Fairis是唯一在保证所有权重为正的同时，可证明地单调缩减对手权重的方案
- **常规场景**：在非独立同分布划分下，无单一规则占优；消融实验表明，遏制效果取决于对手分数与诚实均值的分离程度——当诚实群体本身不公平时，遏制作用失效

## 局限与展望
论文明确承认“诚实分数上报”假设尚未解决，未来可探索差分隐私或可信执行环境下的分数验证机制。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We present **Fairis**, a server-side reweighting scheme for collaborative machine learning that provably contains fairness poisoning attacks. Each client receives weight $ω_k = (η - \mathcal{F}_k) / \sum_j (η - \mathcal{F}_j)$, where $\mathcal{F}_k$ is local Equal Opportunity Difference and $η>1$ a security parameter.

## Key Theoretical Results
We prove three properties: **Monotone Weight Reduction** (MWR)—an adversary's weight strictly decreases with its reported bias; **Demographic Participation**—every client keeps strictly positive weight; and **Non-Gamesmanship**—MWR extends to colluding minority coalitions. Combining MWR with norm clipping bounds the adversary's global-model displacement by $ω_0 C$, strictly decreasing in its own disparity.

## Empirical Findings
Against a stealthy adversary (within 0.04 accuracy of benign) that evades accuracy-based defenses, Fairis cuts its weight by 41–54% on Taiwan Credit, while clipped FairFed guarantees nothing and zeroes a client outright. On routine non-IID partitions, no rule dominates; an ablation shows containment tracks score separation from the honest mean, providing none when honest clients are already unfair.

## Limitation
The paper explicitly acknowledges the unresolved assumption of honest score reporting, suggesting future work on differential privacy or trusted execution environments for score verification.

papers.title: Tracing the Heart: An Evidence-Linked Pipeline for Heart-Failure Feature Engineering
papers.abstract: Electronic health record (EHR) feature engineering is a major bottleneck in clinical research and AI, accounting for 39-45% of data scientists' workload. This is especially pronounced in heart failure, which affects an estimated 6.7 million U.S. adults and requires integrating fragmented EHR data with disease-specific, guideline-based clinical reasoning. Existing rule-based and large language model (LLM)-based approaches offer only partial automation with limited maintainability and evidence traceability. We developed the Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), an evidence-linked, rubric-grounded pipeline for automated heart-failure feature engineering, and evaluated it on 500 dummy patient records from nine EHR source tables. nMAS generated 132 structured and 70 rubric-scored aggregated features, verified for structural integrity, rubric compliance, and provenance, and audited by a restricted LLM. Adding the aggregated features improved held-out AUROC from 0.895 to 0.963 for HFrEF and 0.870 to 0.910 for HFpEF phenotyping, and an independent LLM-based rubric assessment of evidence support and methodological soundness scored the features at 81.5% of maximum points. These results demonstrate the feasibility of automated, auditable feature engineering for complex cardiovascular EHR data, though evaluation was limited to a single-institution cohort and external validation is needed.
papers.summary_zh:
**背景：** 电子健康档案（EHR）的特征工程是临床研究与人工智能领域的重大瓶颈，占数据科学家工作量的39%–45%。在心力衰竭（心衰）领域尤为突出——美国约670万成年人受其影响，且需将碎片化EHR数据与基于指南的疾病特异性临床推理相整合。现有基于规则及大语言模型（LLM）的方法仅能实现部分自动化，且可维护性与证据可追溯性有限。

**方法：** 我们开发了Nimblemind多智能体系统（nMAS）——一个基于证据链接、以评分细则为框架的自动化心衰特征工程流水线，并在来自9张EHR源表的500条模拟患者记录上进行了评估。nMAS生成了132个结构化特征及70个经评分细则评分的聚合特征，并对其结构完整性、细则合规性及数据来源进行了验证，同时由受限LLM进行审计。

**主要发现：** 加入聚合特征后，HFrEF表型分类的留出集AUROC从0.895提升至0.963，HFpEF从0.870提升至0.910；独立LLM基于细则对证据支持度与方法学合理性的评估得分为最高分的81.5%。

**创新点与局限：** 本研究首次展示了针对复杂心血管EHR数据实现自动化、可审计特征工程的可行性。但评估仅限于单机构队列，需外部验证以推广结论。
papers.summary_en:
**Objective:** To address the EHR feature-engineering bottleneck in heart failure, we developed the Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), an evidence-linked, rubric-grounded pipeline for automated feature extraction and aggregation.

**Methods:** nMAS processed 500 dummy patient records from nine EHR source tables, generating 132 structured and 70 rubric-scored aggregated features with verified structural integrity, rubric compliance, and provenance, followed by restricted-LLM auditing.

**Results:** Adding the aggregated features improved held-out AUROC from 0.895 to 0.963 (HFrEF) and 0.870 to 0.910 (HFpEF) for phenotyping; an independent LLM rubric assessment scored evidence support and methodological soundness at 81.5% of maximum points.

**Conclusion:** nMAS demonstrates the feasibility of automated, auditable feature engineering for complex cardiovascular EHR data, though single-institution evaluation necessitates external validation.

papers.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
papers.abstract: Training terminal agents requires executable and verifiable tasks that are not merely solvable, but appropriately challenging for learning. Executable validation establishes feasibility, yet does not reveal how a task behaves relative to a given solver setting. In this paper, we present CalibForge, an autonomous terminal-task synthesis system that uses verified solver behavior to revise candidate tasks through adversarial solver calibration. Multi-solver calibration targets disagreement within a heterogeneous solver pool, whereas contrastive solver calibration targets a designated strong-pass/weak-fail relation; both operationalize a solver-relative learnable zone anchored in demonstrated solvability. Using CalibForge, we construct 5,431 calibrated terminal tasks. Our ablations show that both strategies yield more effective supervision than authoring and validation alone or ordinary single-solver feedback. Models trained on the full collection achieve 32.58% and 47.57% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. The largest improvements over the corresponding base model reach 24.71 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.0, 27.68 points on SWE-bench Pro, and 30.04 points on Doc2Repo. Together, these results support solver-relative learnability as a practical target for constructing effective and transferable agent training data.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
训练终端智能体（terminal agents）需要可执行且可验证的任务，这些任务不仅要可解，还需对学习过程具有恰当的挑战性。现有方法仅验证任务可行性，却无法揭示任务在特定求解器设置下的行为特性。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **CalibForge**——一个自主终端任务合成系统，通过**对抗性求解器校准**来修订候选任务。系统采用两种校准策略：
- **多求解器校准**：针对异构求解器池中的分歧进行优化
- **对比求解器校准**：针对指定的“强通过/弱失败”关系进行优化

两种策略均以已验证的可解性为基础，定义了**相对于求解器的可学习区间**（learnable zone）。

## 主要成果
- 构建了 **5,431 个校准终端任务**
- 消融实验表明：两种校准策略生成的监督信号均优于仅靠人工编写+验证或单一求解器反馈
- 在完整数据集上训练的模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上取得 **32.58%** 和 **47.57%** 的成绩
- 相比对应基础模型，最大提升幅度：Terminal-Bench 2.0 提升 **24.71 个百分点**，SWE-bench Pro 提升 **27.68 个百分点**，Doc2Repo 提升 **30.04 个百分点**

## Core Contribution
We introduce **CalibForge**, an autonomous terminal-task synthesis system that revises candidate tasks through **adversarial solver calibration**, using verified solver behavior to define a solver-relative "learnable zone" anchored in demonstrated solvability.

## Methods & Results
Two calibration strategies are proposed: multi-solver calibration (targeting disagreement within a heterogeneous solver pool) and contrastive calibration (targeting a strong-pass/weak-fail relation). Using CalibForge, we construct 5,431 calibrated tasks. Models trained on this collection achieve **32.58% and 47.57%** on Terminal-Bench 2.0, with maximum improvements of **24.71 points** (Terminal-Bench 2.0), **27.68 points** (SWE-bench Pro), and **30.04 points** (Doc2Repo) over base models.

## Significance
Ablations confirm both strategies outperform authoring+validation alone and single-solver feedback. This work establishes solver-relative learnability as a practical, transferable target for constructing effective agent training data, enabling dynamic difficulty adjustment for optimal learning progress.

papers.title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reward modeling show a paradigm shift from discriminative reward models to generative reward models. However, despite their strong capabilities in response ranking, generative reward models have not realized their potential in reinforcement learning (RL). Our analysis reveals that this limitation arises from a mismatch between the comparative nature of generative reward modeling and the scalar scoring paradigm adopted by existing RL algorithms. To bridge this gap, we propose a Ranking-based Reward Construction (RRC) approach, which enables generative reward models to provide more effective RL learning signals by deriving rewards from relative preference rankings. RRC introduces two complementary strategies: self-competitive ranking, which exploits comparisons among sampled responses, and anchor-guided ranking, which enables scalable ranking-based reward construction with a small set of reference responses. Experiments across open-ended chat and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RRC substantially improves RL training with generative reward models, achieving consistent gains over existing reward construction approaches. Our code can be found at https://github.com/wangclnlp/RRC.
papers.summary_zh:
**研究背景与问题**：近期奖励模型研究正从判别式范式转向生成式范式，生成式奖励模型在响应排序上展现强大能力，但在强化学习（RL）中却未能充分发挥潜力。本文分析发现，其根本原因在于生成式奖励模型的比较性本质与现有RL算法依赖的标量评分范式之间存在结构性错配。

**方法创新**：针对上述问题，本文提出基于排序的奖励构建方法（RRC），通过从相对偏好排序中推导奖励信号，使生成式奖励模型能为RL提供更有效的学习信号。RRC包含两种互补策略：  
- **自竞争排序**：利用采样响应间的内部比较构建奖励；  
- **锚点引导排序**：借助少量参考响应实现可扩展的排序奖励构建。

**实验与发现**：在开放式对话与推理基准上的实验表明，RRC显著提升了生成式奖励模型驱动的RL训练效果，相较于现有奖励构建方法取得一致增益。该工作验证了“排序即奖励”的可行性，为解锁生成式奖励模型在RL中的潜力提供了新路径。

**核心贡献**：①首次系统揭示生成式奖励模型与RL标量奖励之间的错配问题；②提出通用且可扩展的RRC框架；③在多项基准上验证有效性，代码已开源。

To address this, we propose Ranking-based Reward Construction (RRC), which derives RL learning signals from relative preference rankings. RRC introduces two complementary strategies: self-competitive ranking (exploiting comparisons among sampled responses) and anchor-guided ranking (enabling scalable construction with few reference responses). Experiments on open-ended chat and reasoning benchmarks show that RRC consistently outperforms existing reward construction methods, unlocking the potential of generative reward models in RL. The code is publicly available.

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
papers.abstract: On-policy (Self-)Distillation (OPD / OPSD) has shown strong potential for post-training large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods still rely heavily on external supervision, including ground-truth signals, environmental feedback, or guidance from larger models, and therefore fall short of genuine "self"-distillation. In this study, we show that on-policy self-distillation can be achieved using only a model's own generations via internal consistency. We propose unsupervised on-policy self-distillation (U-OPSD). U-OPSD first samples multiple rollouts and constructs a pseudo solution by majority vote under a self-consistency threshold. It then conditions the model's distribution on the pseudo-solution and distills itself on the disagreeing completions, allowing the model to correct itself precisely where it is confidently wrong. Across diverse benchmarks, base models, and training settings, U-OPSD consistently improves over the base models and matches or surpasses supervised methods with ground truth (GT) such as OPSD and GRPO. On five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, i.e., AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25, MATH500, and AMC23, U-OPSD improves over the base model by 8.5% and 10.7% on Qwen3 non-thinking mode at 4B and 8B scales, and outperforms OPSD by 3.2% and 2.3% on average, respectively. In thinking mode, U-OPSD stays on par with OPSD, ahead by 0.9% at 4B and level at 8B and surpassing GRPO by 0.7% and 1.1%, respectively. Code is available at [https://github.com/williamium3000/u-opsd](https://github.com/williamium3000/u-opsd).
papers.summary_zh:
**背景与问题**：现有的大语言模型（LLM）后训练方法，如在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD），虽展现出强大潜力，但高度依赖外部监督信号（如真实标签、环境反馈或更强模型的指导），因此并非真正的“自”蒸馏。这限制了其在无监督场景下的应用。  

**方法创新**：本文提出**无监督在线策略自蒸馏（U-OPSD）**，仅利用模型自身生成的数据实现自蒸馏。核心思想是：  
1. **自一致性采样**：对同一提示多次采样生成多条回答，通过多数投票构建“伪答案”，并设置自一致性阈值筛选高置信度样本；  
2. **针对性自我修正**：仅对与伪答案不一致的回答进行蒸馏，使模型能精确纠正自身“自信但错误”的输出，而无需任何外部信号。  

**主要结果**：在五个数学推理基准（AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25、MATH500、AMC23）上，U-OPSD显著优于基础模型，并匹配或超越使用真实标签的监督方法（如OPSD、GRPO）。  
- **非思考模式（Qwen3，4B/8B）**：相比基础模型平均提升**8.5%/10.7%**，相比OPSD提升**3.2%/2.3%**；  
- **思考模式**：与OPSD持平（4B提升0.9%，8B持平），并超越GRPO（提升0.7%/1.1%）。  

**意义**：U-OPSD首次证明，无需任何外部监督，仅靠模型内部一致性即可实现高效自蒸馏，为LLM的无监督后训练开辟了新路径，且代码已开源。
papers.summary_en: **Unsupervised On-Policy Self-Distillation (U-OPSD)** eliminates the need for external supervision (e.g., ground truth, rewards, or teacher models) in LLM post-training. It samples multiple rollouts, constructs a pseudo-solution via majority voting under a self-consistency threshold, then distills the model only on disagreeing completions, enabling precise self-correction where the model is confidently wrong. Across five math reasoning benchmarks (AIME24/25, HMMT25, MATH500, AMC23), U-OPSD improves over base models by **8.5%/10.7%** (Qwen3 non-thinking, 4B/8B) and **outperforms supervised OPSD by 3.2%/2.3%**, while matching OPSD in thinking mode and surpassing GRPO by **0.7%/1.1%**. This work demonstrates that genuine self-distillation is achievable without any supervision, offering a scalable paradigm for unsupervised LLM alignment. Code: [github.com/williamium3000/u-opsd](https://github.com/williamium3000/u-opsd).
