papers.title: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents whose procedural knowledge is stored in reusable skill packages and loaded at inference time. As skill libraries grow, a central challenge is to expose the smallest sufficient executable context under a limited context budget. Existing systems struggle to reuse routines below the whole-skill level, preserve procedural contracts during compression, keep compressed routines executable and expandable, and update the compressed library as skills evolve. These challenges reveal a unit mismatch: skills are retrieved as packages, compressed as text, and converted into execution graphs only after retrieval, whereas reliable reuse requires a contract-bearing procedural unit. We propose SkillZip, an execution-aware procedural abstraction framework that performs contract-preserving compression over section-level graphs. SkillZip rewrites recurring contract-valid motifs into reversible ported macros while preserving boundary signatures, dependency closure, verifier reachability, and source-level expansion. At inference time, it hydrates a compact, dependency-closed context and expands macros only when required. ReZip further integrates new skills and revises risky macros using execution evidence. Comprehensive experiments1 on technical and embodied agent benchmarks show SkillZip consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 12.2 points, while achieving a 3.46x compression ratio with 99.2% dependency preservation and 98.7% verifier reachability. Scaling analyses further confirm robust retrieval across skill libraries ranging from 200 to 100K skills.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
大语言模型（LLM）作为智能体时，其程序性知识以可复用的技能包形式存储，并在推理时加载。随着技能库规模增长，如何在有限上下文预算下暴露最小且充分的执行上下文成为核心挑战。现有系统存在**单元错配**问题：技能以包为单位检索、以文本形式压缩、检索后才转换为执行图，而可靠复用需要**携带契约的程序性单元**。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **SkillZip**，一种执行感知的程序抽象框架，在**章节级图**上执行契约保持压缩：
- **契约保持压缩**：将重复出现的契约有效模式重写为可逆的移植宏，同时保留边界签名、依赖闭包、验证器可达性和源码级展开能力
- **推理时水合**：生成紧凑且依赖闭合的上下文，仅在必要时展开宏
- **ReZip 增量更新**：利用执行证据整合新技能并修正风险宏

## 主要发现
在技术型和具身智能体基准上的综合实验表明：
- 相比最强基线，性能**最高提升 12.2 个点**
- 实现 **3.46 倍压缩比**，依赖保留率达 **99.2%**，验证器可达率达 **98.7%**
- 规模分析证实：在 200 至 10 万个技能的库中均保持稳健检索

## 核心贡献
1. 首次提出**契约保持的章节级程序抽象**，解决技能库压缩中单元错配的根本问题
2. 设计**可逆宏机制**，兼顾压缩效率与执行可扩展性
3. 提出 **ReZip 增量更新策略**，支持技能库动态演化
4. 通过大规模实验验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper introduces **SkillZip**, an execution-aware procedural abstraction framework that performs **contract-preserving compression** over section-level graphs for scalable agent skill libraries. It addresses the fundamental unit mismatch in existing systems where skills are retrieved as packages, compressed as text, and converted to execution graphs only after retrieval.

## Method & Results
SkillZip rewrites recurring contract-valid motifs into reversible ported macros while preserving boundary signatures, dependency closure, verifier reachability, and source-level expansion. At inference, it hydrates a compact dependency-closed context and expands macros only when needed. ReZip further enables incremental library updates using execution evidence. Experiments on technical and embodied benchmarks show SkillZip outperforms the strongest baseline by **up to 12.2 points**, achieving a **3.46× compression ratio** with 99.2% dependency preservation and 98.7% verifier reachability, while remaining robust across libraries from 200 to 100K skills.

## Key Takeaway
SkillZip establishes a new paradigm for skill library compression by treating procedural contracts as first-class citizens, enabling reliable, scalable, and dynamically maintainable agent knowledge reuse.

3. 提出 **ReZip 增量更新策略**，支持技能库动态演化
4. 通过大规模实验验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性

papers.title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
papers.abstract: Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpretability scales with capability rather than against it. Surprisingly, model representations become more disentangled and aligned with human-understandable concepts with scale.   We instantiate the training-time recipe with Steerling-8B, a diffusion language model with a causal attention mask. For any group of generated tokens, Steerling-8B attributes the output to relevant input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and training data. This enables closed-loop intervention: diagnose an output through its concept or feature attribution, retrieve similar training data, and correct the behavior through concept steering without retraining. Steerling-8B remains competitive with open peer models trained on substantially 2-16x more compute, suggesting a different scaling paradigm: interpretability can be designed into training, and it improves with scale.
papers.summary_zh:
## 核心观点
本文挑战了“可解释性是能力税”的传统认知，提出将**可解释性作为训练目标的一部分**，而非事后补救手段。通过将可解释性约束直接嵌入训练流程，与语言建模目标联合优化，作者发现：**可解释性与模型能力同步提升，而非相互制约**。

## 方法与发现
- **跨规模验证**：在三个数量级的计算量下，对自回归和扩散两类语言模型进行实验，均观察到模型表征随规模增大而**更解耦、更对齐人类可理解概念**。
- **实例化模型**：提出 **Steerling-8B**——一个带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型。它能将任意生成token归因到输入token、人类概念及训练数据，实现**闭环干预**：通过概念/特征归因诊断输出、检索相似训练数据、并通过概念引导（steering）修正行为，全程无需重训练。
- **性能对比**：Steerling-8B 在仅使用同类开源模型 **1/2 至 1/16 计算量**的情况下仍保持竞争力，证明了一种新的扩展范式——**可解释性可以被设计进训练过程，并随规模增长而增强**。

## 意义
该工作为语言模型的开发提供了新路径：不再需要事后“黑箱解释”，而是从源头构建透明、可控、可干预的模型，为安全部署和可信AI奠定基础。

The method is instantiated in **Steerling-8B**, a diffusion language model with causal attention masking, which attributes outputs to input tokens, concepts, and training data. papers.title: Where Models Converge and Humans Diverge: A Coverage Framework for Distributional Pluralism in Open-Ended Generation
papers.abstract: When a large language model (LLM) writes Harry Potter fanfiction, it reliably produces fundamental elements of the Hogwarts universe, such as recognizable places and characters. Human-written Harry Potter fanfictions, however, typically include these fundamentals and much more, incorporating stylistically irregular content and relationship-diverse plotlines. This gap between LLM and human writing has been noted across a variety of domains. LLMs tend to produce "average" writing, while human writing contains more diverse content that covers a broader distribution. Existing work has shown the existence of this distributional "gap", but no work has proposed a systematic way to measure it. Our paper proposes a human-grounded framework that uses the empirical distribution of human writing on a topic to measure the distributional breadth of LLM-generated content on that same topic. We propose two metrics, LLM Coverage (LLM-Cov) and In-Boundary Rate (IBR), that separate the plausibility of LLM content from its distributional breadth. Across ideation and narrative tasks, we find that current LLMs produce plausible but narrow content that concentrates near the center of the human response space. Our framework can enable researchers to better assess the distributional breadth of LLM-authored content, which we term its "cultural reach".
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型（LLM）在生成开放文本（如同人小说）时，能稳定产出核心设定元素（如霍格沃茨的地点与人物），但人类写作不仅包含这些基础元素，还融合了风格化表达、多元关系线等丰富内容。这种“LLM趋于‘平均化’写作，人类写作覆盖更广分布”的现象在多个领域均有体现。现有研究虽已指出这一分布性“鸿沟”，却缺乏系统性度量方法。

## 方法与指标
本文提出一种**以人为基准的评估框架**，利用人类在特定主题上的经验分布，衡量LLM生成内容的分布广度。我们设计两个核心指标：
- **LLM覆盖率（LLM-Cov）**：评估LLM输出在人类响应空间中的分布覆盖程度；
- **边界内比率（IBR）**：衡量LLM内容落在人类分布合理边界内的比例。

这两个指标将LLM内容的**合理性**与**分布广度**解耦，分别考察。

## 主要发现
在头脑风暴与叙事两类任务上，实验表明：当前LLM生成的内容**合理但狭窄**，高度集中于人类响应空间的中心区域，缺乏人类写作中常见的边缘化、多样化内容。

## 核心贡献
本框架为研究者提供了一种量化工具，用于评估LLM生成内容的分布广度——我们称之为其**“文化触达”（cultural reach）**，有助于更全面地审视LLM在创意生成中的局限与潜力。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper introduces a **human-grounded evaluation framework** to quantify the distributional gap between LLM-generated and human-written open-ended content. We propose two metrics—**LLM Coverage (LLM-Cov)** and **In-Boundary Rate (IBR)**—that separately assess plausibility and distributional breadth. Across ideation and narrative tasks, we find that current LLMs produce plausible yet narrow outputs concentrated near the center of human response distributions. This framework enables researchers to measure the **“cultural reach”** of LLM-authored content, offering a systematic tool for evaluating diversity in generative systems. Our work bridges the gap between observing distributional divergence and providing actionable, quantitative assessment.

papers.title: Do 3D Medical Foundation Models See Through MRI Artifacts? A Controlled Study of Representation Robustness
papers.abstract: Self-supervised 3D medical foundation models are increasingly used as general-purpose feature extractors, yet their sensitivity to MRI artifacts remains poorly understood. We present a controlled evaluation of representation robustness across five pretrained 3D encoders spanning different architectures, objectives, pretraining domains, and dataset scales. Using BraTS-Africa cases with four MRI sequences, we generate seven frequency- and image-domain artifacts at five predefined corruption settings. Robustness is assessed using linear centered kernel alignment (CKA), RankMe, and UMAP, complemented by an independent segmentation-consistency analysis. We find that robustness is strongly model- and artifact-dependent. 3DINO exhibits the most consistently stable representations, while BrainIAC is highly sensitive to several corruptions; NeuroVFM, BrainFM, and Neuro-SimCLR show intermediate but distinct artifact-specific profiles. Across many conditions, CKA decreases substantially while RankMe remains comparatively stable, indicating that artifacts often distort representation geometry without causing dimensional collapse. Segmentation consistency also degrades under corruption, particularly for ghosting and Rician noise, but aligns only partially with representation-level robustness. These findings show that larger-scale or domain-specific pretraining alone does not guarantee artifact invariance and motivate explicit robustness evaluation before deploying 3D foundation models in heterogeneous MRI settings.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机
自监督3D医学基础模型正被广泛用作通用特征提取器，但其对MRI伪影的敏感性尚未得到系统研究。临床MRI图像常受运动、噪声等伪影干扰，若基础模型对此缺乏鲁棒性，将直接影响下游任务可靠性。

## 研究方法
- **模型覆盖**：选取5个预训练3D编码器，涵盖不同架构（ViT/CNN）、预训练目标（掩码重建/对比学习/蒸馏）、预训练域（通用医学/脑部专属）及数据规模（千级至百万级）。
- **伪影生成**：基于BraTS-Africa数据集的4个MRI序列，在频域（如重影、吉布斯环）和图像域（如高斯噪声、Rician噪声、模糊、运动伪影）生成7类伪影，每类设置5种退化强度。
- **评估指标**：采用线性中心核对齐（CKA）衡量表征几何变化，RankMe评估表征维度利用度，UMAP可视化分布偏移；另以独立的分割一致性分析验证下游任务影响。

## 主要发现
1. **鲁棒性高度依赖模型与伪影类型**：3DINO表征最稳定，BrainIAC对多种伪影极敏感；NeuroVFM、BrainFM、Neuro-SimCLR呈中间态但各有特异性敏感伪影。
2. **几何失真与维度塌缩不同步**：多数条件下CKA显著下降而RankMe相对稳定，说明伪影主要扭曲表征几何结构而非导致维度塌缩。
3. **分割任务退化部分相关**：重影和Rician噪声下分割一致性显著恶化，但与表征级鲁棒性仅部分吻合，提示任务级评估不可替代。

## 核心结论
更大规模或领域特化的预训练并不能保证伪影不变性。在异构MRI场景部署3D基础模型前，应进行显式鲁棒性评估，而非默认其泛化能力。
papers.summary_en:
## Key Contributions
This study provides the first controlled, multi-model evaluation of MRI artifact robustness in 3D medical foundation models. We systematically test five pretrained encoders (3DINO, BrainIAC, NeuroVFM, BrainFM, Neuro-SimCLR) against seven artifact types at five severity levels using four MRI sequences.

## Core Results
Robustness is strongly model- and artifact-specific: 3DINO shows the most stable representations, while BrainIAC degrades sharply under several corruptions. Notably, CKA (geometry) drops significantly under many conditions while RankMe (dimensionality) remains stable, revealing that artifacts distort representation structure without causing dimensional collapse. Segmentation consistency also degrades under ghosting and Rician noise, but only partially correlates with representation-level metrics.

## Implications
Larger-scale or domain-specific pretraining alone does not guarantee artifact invariance. Explicit robustness evaluation is essential before deploying 3D foundation models in heterogeneous clinical MRI settings, and representation-level metrics should be complemented by task-specific validation.

papers.title: Improving Low-Resolution Face Recognition under Limited Data: How Synthetic Data Generation Can Close the Domain Gap
papers.abstract: Face Recognition (FR) systems in surveillance settings often encounter Low Resolution (LR) faces, those whose face region falls below the standard 112 $\times$ 112 input size. While labelled High Resolution (HR) training data is abundant, labelled native-LR data, and above all paired native LR/HR data, is scarce. One workaround is to synthesize LR data from the available HR faces, but how much synthesis effort is repaid in recognition accuracy remains unclear. We present a study of simple synthetic generation strategies for a compact, edge device-oriented face recognition system, spanning interpolation-based degradation, knowledge distillation, a Prepended Domain Transformer (PDT), Real ESRGAN-style degradation, and a learned Super Resolution (SR) front-end with an identity-aware loss. We evaluate these strategies on synthetic cross-resolution face benchmarks (LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30) and on TinyFace, a real-world native LR dataset, and expose a synthetic-real gap: the degradation setting that is optimal on synthetic benchmarks is not the one that is optimal on real LR. We find that more synthesis effort does not help monotonically: the learned SR front-end does not surpass a direct feed of the aligned LR image into a strong backbone, while simple interpolation augmentation of a compact backbone is the only synthesis that improves over its own baseline. We conclude that generative methods for LR face recognition must be validated on real LR and against a direct-feed baseline, and release our pipeline at https://idiap.ch/paper/synth-lrfr
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
监控场景下的人脸识别（FR）系统常面临低分辨率（LR）人脸，即人脸区域低于标准 112×112 输入尺寸。虽然高分辨率（HR）标注数据丰富，但原生 LR 数据及配对的 LR/HR 数据极为稀缺。现有方法通常从 HR 人脸合成 LR 数据，然而合成投入与识别精度提升之间的回报关系尚不明确。

## 研究方法
本研究针对紧凑型、面向边缘设备的人脸识别系统，系统比较了五种合成策略：
- **插值降质**（简单基线）
- **知识蒸馏**
- **前置域变换器（PDT）**
- **Real-ESRGAN 风格降质**
- **带身份感知损失的 learned 超分辨率（SR）前端**

## 主要发现
1. **合成-真实域差距显著**：在合成基准（LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30）上最优的降质设置，在真实 LR 数据集 TinyFace 上并非最优。
2. **合成复杂度并非单调有益**：learned SR 前端并未超越将对齐 LR 图像直接输入强骨干网络的效果；而简单插值增强是唯一能在紧凑骨干网络上提升其自身基线的方法。
3. **验证必要性**：生成式 LR 识别方法必须在真实 LR 数据上验证，且需与直接输入 LR 图像的基线对比。

## 创新与贡献
- 首次系统揭示合成与真实 LR 之间的域差距对识别精度的影响规律
- 证明简单方法（插值增强）在边缘设备场景下可能优于复杂生成模型
- 公开完整实验管线（https://idiap.ch/paper/synth-lrfr），便于复现与扩展
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper systematically investigates synthetic data generation strategies for low-resolution (LR) face recognition in edge-device settings, where paired native LR/HR data is scarce. We compare five approaches—interpolation degradation, knowledge distillation, a Prepended Domain Transformer, Real-ESRGAN-style degradation, and a learned super-resolution front-end—on synthetic benchmarks (LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30) and real-world TinyFace.

## Key Findings
**We expose a synthetic-real gap**: the optimal degradation setting on synthetic benchmarks fails on real LR data. Moreover, synthesis effort does not yield monotonic gains—the learned SR front-end underperforms direct feeding of aligned LR into a strong backbone, while simple interpolation augmentation is the only strategy improving its baseline. We conclude that generative LR methods must be validated on real LR against a direct-feed baseline, and release our pipeline for reproducibility.

papers.title: InsertFuse: A Unified Framework for Multi-Category Reference-Guided Image Insertion
papers.abstract: We present InsertFuse, a unified framework for multi-category reference-guided image insertion. Its key idea is to decouple category-specific expertise learning from cross-category capability consolidation. InsertFuse first trains specialized experts for different insertion categories and then introduces Insertion On-Policy Distillation (IOPD) to consolidate their capabilities into a single student. By querying the matched expert at states visited by the student, IOPD preserves category-specific insertion behavior while mitigating the cross-category interference caused by direct joint training. To improve spatial control, we propose Token-Aligned Geometry Conditioning (TAGC), which maps mask-derived geometric cues to the visual token grid, and Region-Balanced Flow Matching, which separately normalizes prediction errors inside and outside the insertion region to prevent background-dominated and scale-dependent supervision. We further introduce Reference CFG to isolate and strengthen the guidance induced by the visual reference under fixed scene and geometry conditions, with IOPD transferring this enhanced supervision into the unified student. Extensive experiments on the public AnyInsertion benchmark and our multi-category test set demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on most metrics, showing strong reference fidelity and generation quality across diverse insertion categories.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
**InsertFuse** 是一个面向多类别参考引导图像插入任务的统一框架，核心思想在于将**类别专属能力学习**与**跨类别能力整合**解耦，从而在单一模型中兼顾多样插入类别的专精性能与泛化能力。

## 方法创新
- **插入策略在线蒸馏（IOPD）**：先为不同插入类别分别训练专家模型，再通过在线策略蒸馏，在学生模型实际访问的状态下查询对应专家，保留类别专属插入行为，有效缓解直接联合训练造成的跨类别干扰。
- **令牌对齐几何条件（TAGC）**：将掩码衍生的几何线索映射至视觉令牌网格，提升空间控制精度。
- **区域平衡流匹配**：分别归一化插入区域内部与外部的预测误差，避免背景主导及尺度依赖的监督偏差。
- **参考引导分类器自由引导（Reference CFG）**：在固定场景与几何条件下隔离并增强视觉参考的引导信号，并通过IOPD将增强后的监督迁移至统一学生模型。

## 主要结果
在公开的 **AnyInsertion** 基准及自建多类别测试集上，InsertFuse 在多数指标上达到**最优性能**，展现出跨类别场景下卓越的参考保真度与生成质量，为多类别图像插入提供了一种高效统一的解决方案。

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation with Online Personalized Energy-Based Cache for Fine-Grained Video Expression Recognition
papers.abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) in videos is challenging because models must identify subtle, temporally evolving affective states that vary across individuals. Although vision-language models provide transferable visual-semantic representations, models trained on subject-independent data often degrade under subject-specific distribution shifts at inference time. Existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods commonly update model parameters during inference, increasing computational cost and latency. Cache-based methods avoid parameter updates, but they usually require enough target samples to form reliable class prototypes, which is difficult early in adaptation and for rarely observed classes. We introduce Energy-Based Cache Personalization (EB-CaP), a subject-based online TTA method for video FER that generates class-specific prototypes personalized to each target video. EB-CaP uses a lightweight energy-based model to sample prototypes from the current unlabeled video and populate a personalized cache online, without accumulating large amounts of target data or storing diverse source prototypes. Its energy function relies only on pretrained CLIP: similarities between the target video embedding and class text embeddings guide prototype sampling. In parallel, positive and negative caches store reliable and uncertain target embeddings. An adaptive entropy gate controls cache updates according to the evolving confidence distribution, while a diversity gate limits redundant samples. Final predictions combine cache-derived scores with the current CLIP scores. Experiments on BioVid, StressID, and BAH show that EB-CaP outperforms state-of-the-art TTA methods while maintaining low computational and memory overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/MasoumehSharafi/EB-CaP.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
视频面部表情识别（FER）面临个体差异大、表情随时间微妙演变的挑战。虽然视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）能提供可迁移的表征，但基于主体无关数据训练的模型在推理时遭遇主体特定分布偏移时，性能会显著下降。

## 现有方法局限
- **参数更新型TTA**：如TENT等，推理时需反向传播更新参数，计算成本高、延迟大
- **缓存型方法**：虽避免参数更新，但需要积累足够目标样本形成可靠类原型，在适应初期和罕见类别上表现不佳

## 提出的方法：EB-CaP
我们提出**基于能量缓存的个性化**（Energy-Based Cache Personalization），一种面向视频FER的**主体级在线TTA方法**。核心创新包括：

1. **能量引导的原型采样**：利用轻量级能量模型，仅依赖预训练CLIP中目标视频嵌入与类别文本嵌入的相似度，从当前未标注视频中采样个性化类原型，无需存储大量源域原型
2. **双缓存结构**：正缓存存可靠嵌入，负缓存存不确定嵌入，动态更新
3. **双重门控机制**：自适应熵门控根据置信度分布控制缓存更新节奏；多样性门控抑制冗余样本
4. **零参数更新**：全程不更新模型参数，仅操作缓存，计算开销极低

## 实验结果
在**BioVid、StressID、BAH**三个基准上，EB-CaP均超越现有最优TTA方法，同时保持低计算与内存开销。代码已开源。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **EB-CaP** (Energy-Based Cache Personalization), a subject-level online test-time adaptation method for fine-grained video facial expression recognition. Unlike parameter-updating TTA, EB-CaP operates purely on a lightweight energy-based cache derived from frozen CLIP features, requiring no gradient computation or model updates.

## Key Mechanism
The energy function uses similarity between target video embeddings and class text embeddings to sample personalized prototypes from unlabeled target videos. Positive/negative caches store reliable vs. uncertain embeddings, while an adaptive entropy gate and a diversity gate jointly control cache updates. Final predictions fuse cache scores with original CLIP scores.

## Results & Impact
Experiments on BioVid, StressID, and BAH show EB-CaP outperforms state-of-the-art TTA methods with minimal computational and memory overhead. It addresses the cold-start problem in cache-based adaptation and handles rare classes effectively, making it suitable for real-time affective computing applications. Code: https://github.com/MasoumehSharafi/EB-CaP

papers.title: TLNM: Externally Validated Tooth Detection, Numbering and Segmentation from Smartphone Photographs Using Mask R-CNN
papers.abstract: Oral health issues affect billions globally, but the cost and limited access to professional dental care hinder preventive oral healthcare. Research relies on clinical-grade radiographs or intraoral camera images, unavailable for public self-screening. This study introduces a tooth localisation and numbering model for smartphone photographs. We developed a customised Mask Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Mask R-CNN) pipeline trained on 1,272 annotated smartphone images. To address variability in patient-generated health data, the pipeline incorporates two domain-informed mechanisms: a masked gray-world white-balancing algorithm to mitigate artificial colour casts and an anatomically constrained detection layer to enforce structural validity and suppress false positives. Evaluation comprised four stages: internal held-out testing, independent external testing, a descriptive ablation study, and fold-based training stability analysis using the same internal test set. On the internal test set, the model achieved an instance-mask AP@50 of 0.818, class-aware PQ of 0.780, and operational F1 of 0.884. Training stability showed limited between-model variation: across ten runs, instance-mask AP@50 had a standard deviation of 0.009. On the external dataset, the model achieved an instance-mask AP@50 of 0.901, class-aware PQ of 0.832, and operational F1 of 0.928 despite differences in population, sensors, and acquisition protocols. The inference pipeline is available as an open-source, containerised API. These results demonstrate that consumer-grade smartphone imagery can support automated tooth-level anatomical mapping, offering a scalable, potentially low-cost foundation for remote screening and tele-dentistry in resource-constrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与目标
全球数十亿人受口腔健康问题困扰，但专业牙科护理的高成本和可及性不足，阻碍了预防性口腔保健的推广。现有研究依赖临床级X光片或口内相机图像，公众难以用于自我筛查。本研究旨在开发一种基于智能手机照片的牙齿定位与编号模型，为远程筛查和远程牙科提供可扩展的低成本基础。

## 方法与技术创新
我们基于Mask R-CNN（掩码区域卷积神经网络）构建了定制化流水线，使用1,272张标注的智能手机图像进行训练。为应对患者生成健康数据的多样性，模型整合了两种领域知识机制：
- **掩码灰度世界白平衡算法**：减轻人工光源造成的色彩偏差；
- **解剖约束检测层**：强制输出符合牙齿解剖结构，抑制误检。

## 评估与结果
模型经过四阶段评估：内部留出测试、独立外部测试、消融研究和基于内部测试集的十折训练稳定性分析。主要结果如下：
| 指标 | 内部测试 | 外部测试 |
|------|---------|---------|
| 实例掩码AP@50 | 0.818 | 0.901 |
| 类别感知PQ | 0.780 | 0.832 |
| 操作F1分数 | 0.884 | 0.928 |

训练稳定性优异：十次运行的AP@50标准差仅为0.009。外部测试在人群、传感器和采集协议均不同的情况下仍表现更优，验证了模型的泛化能力。推理流水线已作为开源容器化API发布。

## 核心贡献
本研究首次证明，消费级智能手机图像可支持自动化的牙齿级解剖映射，为资源受限环境下的远程筛查和远程牙科提供了可规模化、潜在低成本的解决方案。

papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This study introduces **TLNM**, a Mask R-CNN-based pipeline for tooth detection, numbering, and segmentation from smartphone photographs, addressing the gap in accessible oral health self-screening tools.

## Key Innovations
The pipeline integrates two domain-informed mechanisms: a masked gray-world white-balancing algorithm to correct artificial color casts, and an anatomically constrained detection layer to enforce structural validity and reduce false positives.

## Results & Significance
Evaluated on internal (AP@50=0.818, PQ=0.780, F1=0.884) and external datasets (AP@50=0.901, PQ=0.832, F1=0.928), the model demonstrates robust generalization across populations and devices, with high training stability (SD=0.009). The open-source, containerized API enables scalable, low-cost deployment for tele-dentistry in resource-limited settings, marking the first validation of consumer-grade imagery for automated tooth-level anatomical mapping.

papers.title: Depth-Guided Video Object Counting in Crowded Scenes
papers.abstract: Our primary objective is to advance video object counting in crowded scenes, aiming to robustly count all instances of a target category based on given text or visual prompts. Existing methods rely on RGB information, limiting their discriminative ability in crowded and occluded conditions. To address this, we propose a Depth-Guided Detector (DG-Det) along with a general post-processing pipeline. By integrating depth cues with multi-scale RGB-D cross-attention and explicit occlusion prediction, our method enhances spatial understanding and achieves robust detection in crowded and occluded scenes. Furthermore, we introduce a unified de-duplication framework to eliminate cross-frame redundant counting. To facilitate future research, we also release a new RGB-D Video Object Counting dataset featuring depth information and multiple object categories persequence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a 62.01\% reduction in MAE compared to existing baselines, and also produces consistent improvements in RMSE. We provide the source code at https://github.com/streamer-AP/DG-Net and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/aerospace123/RGBD-VideoCount.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
视频中的物体计数在拥挤场景下具有重要应用价值，但现有方法过度依赖RGB信息，在遮挡严重、目标密集的环境中判别能力不足，导致计数精度显著下降。

## 方法创新
本文提出**深度引导检测器（DG-Det）**及通用后处理流程，核心贡献包括：
- **跨模态特征融合**：设计多尺度RGB-D交叉注意力机制，将深度信息与外观特征深度融合，增强对空间结构的理解  
- **显式遮挡预测**：引入遮挡感知模块，主动识别被遮挡目标，提升密集场景下的检测鲁棒性
- **统一去重框架**：提出跨帧冗余计数消除机制，有效避免视频序列中同一目标被重复统计

## 数据集贡献
发布了首个**RGB-D视频物体计数数据集**，包含深度信息及每序列多类目标标注，为后续研究提供标准化评测基准。

## 实验结果
在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，与现有最优方法相比，本方法将**平均绝对误差（MAE）降低62.01%**，同时**均方根误差（RMSE）也获得一致改进**，验证了深度引导策略在拥挤场景中的显著优势。代码与数据集均已开源。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **DG-Det**, a depth-guided detector with multi-scale RGB-D cross-attention and explicit occlusion prediction, to address object counting in crowded videos where RGB-only methods struggle with heavy occlusion. A unified de-duplication framework eliminates cross-frame redundant counts. We also release the first **RGB-D video counting dataset** with per-sequence multi-category annotations. Experiments show our method reduces MAE by **62.01%** relative to strong baselines with consistent RMSE gains, demonstrating that depth cues substantially improve spatial understanding in dense scenes. Code and data are publicly available.

papers.title: EmoWorld: A Decoupled Affective Field for Controllable Emotional Video Generation
papers.abstract: Emotion shapes how viewers interpret a scene, yet existing video generators entangle global atmosphere, affect-bearing semantic cues, and temporal progression within a single text condition. We present EmoWorld, a framework that decouples these factors within a frozen flow-matching video diffusion transformer (Video DiT). A one-time preparation stage extracts layer-specific affect directions and a reusable cue library from geometry-preserving neutral and emotion-edited panoramas. At inference, Visual Atmosphere Steering (VAS) injects atmosphere directions into hidden states, Semantic Affective Steering (SAS) isolates a separately scalable prompt residual for semantic cues, and Temporal Affective Steering (TAS) interpolates endpoint residual fields across denoising and video time. On Wan2.2, VAS improves target-emotion alignment by 19% while reducing a temporal-fluctuation proxy by 48%; SAS improves target-emotion alignment by 37% and increases detected affect-bearing cues by 36%; and TAS improves transition monotonicity by 15% over the strongest baseline. EmoWorld is evaluated across 27 emotion categories in text-to-video and image-to-video settings, demonstrates portability across multiple Video-DiT backbones, and supports camera-conditioned composition without updating generator parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
现有视频生成模型将**全局氛围**、**情感语义线索**和**时间动态**耦合在单一文本条件中，导致用户难以独立控制情感表达。例如，调整“悲伤”氛围可能意外改变场景中的物体或动作。

## 方法：EmoWorld 框架  
本文提出 **EmoWorld**，在冻结的流匹配视频扩散Transformer（Video DiT）中解耦上述三个因素：

- **一次性准备阶段**：从几何保持的中性/情感编辑全景图中，提取**层特定情感方向**和**可复用线索库**。
- **视觉氛围引导（VAS）**：将氛围方向注入隐藏状态。
- **语义情感引导（SAS）**：分离出可独立缩放的提示残差，用于语义线索。
- **时间情感引导（TAS）**：在去噪过程和时间轴上对端点残差场进行插值。

| 方法 | 目标情感对齐提升 | 其他指标 |
|------|----------------|---------|
| VAS  | +19%           | 时间波动代理 -48% |
| SAS  | +37%           | 情感线索检测 +36% |
| TAS  | +15%（转换单调性）| 优于最强基线 |

- 覆盖 **27 种情感类别**，支持文生视频和图生视频。
- 可迁移至多种 Video-DiT 骨干网络。
- 支持**相机条件组合**，无需更新生成器参数。

papers.title: Reversible Unlearnable Examples: Towards the Copyright Protection in Deep Learning Era
papers.abstract: Significant advancements in deep learning have been made possible by the utilization of large datasets, underscoring the critical importance of copyright protection. Adding meticulously designed perturbations to examples, making them unlearnable has become a crucial approach for safeguarding data copyright. Existing methods for creating unlearnable examples overlook the risk of data leakage, which can threaten data ownership. Thus, copyright protection in deep learning faces two main threats: illegal model training and malicious data leakage. We investigate that these two threats cannot be solved by straightforwardly combining existing availability attacks and watermarking techniques as their negative interaction effects. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a novel copyright protection mechanism for the aforementioned security concerns. Considering that the prevention of unauthorized model training requires powerful generalizability of unlearnable perturbations, we generate perturbations to induce the model to learn uncorrelated features of input images. It works by minimizing the mutual information of the input and output of the model. On the other hand, to eliminate the side impact of unlearnable perturbations on the watermark extraction, we design a dual extraction strategy by using two distinct watermark extractors. Extensive experiments on the image datasets {ImageNet, CIFAR10, and Pets} show that our proposed method could provide comprehensive copyright protection to images. The code is available at {https://github.com/Yeah21/ReversibleUnlearnableExamples}.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
深度学习依赖大规模数据集训练，其版权保护至关重要。当前主流方案通过向样本添加精心设计的扰动使其“不可学习”，但现有方法忽视了**数据泄露风险**，可能威胁数据所有权。因此，版权保护面临两大威胁：**非法模型训练**与**恶意数据泄露**。研究表明，简单组合现有“不可学习”攻击与数字水印技术无法同时解决这两个问题，因为二者存在负面交互效应。

## 核心方法
本文提出一种全新的版权保护机制，针对上述安全威胁：
- **防非法训练**：生成具有强大泛化能力的不可学习扰动，通过**最小化模型输入与输出的互信息**，诱导模型学习输入图像中不相关的特征，从而阻止其有效学习。
- **防数据泄露**：设计**双提取器策略**，使用两个不同的水印提取器，消除不可学习扰动对水印提取的副作用，确保版权归属可验证。

## 主要结果与贡献
在 **ImageNet、CIFAR10 和 Pets** 三个图像数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能为图像提供**全面的版权保护**，同时有效抵御上述两类威胁。代码已开源（https://github.com/Yeah21/ReversibleUnlearnableExamples）。

**创新点**：首次联合解决非法训练与数据泄露问题，克服了现有技术组合时的负面交互，为深度学习时代的版权保护提供了可逆且鲁棒的解决方案。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper proposes a novel copyright protection mechanism for deep learning, addressing two critical threats: **unauthorized model training** and **malicious data leakage**. Existing methods fail to solve both simultaneously due to negative interactions between unlearnable perturbations and watermarking.

## Method & Results
The approach generates unlearnable perturbations by **minimizing mutual information** between model inputs and outputs, forcing the model to learn uncorrelated features. A **dual-extractor watermarking strategy** is designed to eliminate interference with watermark extraction. Extensive experiments on ImageNet, CIFAR10, and Pets demonstrate comprehensive protection against both threats.

**Key innovation**: First framework to jointly mitigate illegal training and data leakage, overcoming prior limitations. Code is publicly available.

papers.title: CFGPNet: Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network Framework for Multispectral Object Detection
papers.abstract: RGB--T object detection exploits the complementary strengths of visible and infrared imagery, supporting robust perception in low-light, adverse-weather, and complex multi-scale environments. However, existing methods still suffer from insufficient cross-modal interaction, unstable fusion from modality distribution gaps, and the high computational cost of heavy attention-based architectures. To address these issues, CFGPNet is proposed, a Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network framework for multispectral object detection. CFGPNet uses an improved GELAN backbone with RepViT-style re-parameterized blocks to strengthen feature representation while preserving computational efficiency. A Cross Computation Efficient Attention (CrossCEA) module is introduced to enhance cross-modal feature interaction and reduce redundant information transfer between visible and thermal branches. To generate compact and discriminative fused representations, an Attention Selection and Aggregation Fusion (ASAF) network combines dense feature aggregation with selective attention-based emphasis. Moreover, a programmable-gradient auxiliary branch is integrated into each CFGPNet variant to improve gradient delivery and optimization quality. Experiments on five public multispectral benchmarks, FLIR, M3FD, LLVIP, VEDAI, and MFAD, demonstrate that CFGPNet achieves strong and consistent performance across diverse scenes, object scales, and modality balances. In particular, the framework attains 80.7% mAP50 / 45.0% mAP50:95 on FLIR, 89.9% / 63.4% on M3FD, and 97.8% / 68.9% on LLVIP. It also reaches 83.3% / 56.9% on VEDAI and 83.4% / 61.8% on MFAD. These results show that CFGPNet is an effective, practical solution offering useful accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across three model scales. The code, data, and fine-tuned models are available at https://github.com/NimaHatami99/CFGPNet.
papers.summary_zh:
## CFGPNet：基于交叉注意力的融合梯度编程网络框架用于多光谱目标检测

**背景与问题：** RGB-T（可见光-红外）多光谱目标检测融合了可见光与红外图像的互补优势，可在低光照、恶劣天气及复杂多尺度场景中实现稳健感知。然而，现有方法仍面临三大挑战：跨模态交互不足、模态分布差异导致的融合不稳定，以及基于重型注意力架构的高计算成本。

**方法创新：** 本文提出 **CFGPNet**（Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network）框架，包含四项关键设计：
1. **改进的GELAN主干**：引入RepViT风格的重参数化模块，在增强特征表示的同时保持计算效率。
2. **交叉计算高效注意力（CrossCEA）模块**：增强可见光与热红外分支间的跨模态特征交互，同时减少冗余信息传递。
3. **注意力选择与聚合融合（ASAF）网络**：结合密集特征聚合与基于选择性注意力的重点强调，生成紧凑且具有判别力的融合表示。
4. **可编程梯度辅助分支**：集成于每个CFGPNet变体，改善梯度传递路径与优化质量。

**实验结果：** 在五个公开基准数据集（FLIR、M3FD、LLVIP、VEDAI、MFAD）上，CFGPNet展现了跨场景、跨尺度与跨模态平衡的稳定性能。关键结果包括：FLIR上达到80.7% mAP50 / 45.0% mAP50:95，M3FD上达到89.9% / 63.4%，LLVIP上达到97.8% / 68.9%，VEDAI上达到83.3% / 56.9%，MFAD上达到83.4% / 61.8%。三种模型规模均实现了良好的精度-效率权衡。

**结论：** CFGPNet为多光谱目标检测提供了一种有效且实用的解决方案，在保持较低计算开销的同时显著提升了跨模态融合质量。代码、数据与微调模型已开源。
papers.summary_en:
## CFGPNet: A Cross-Attention-Based Fused Gradient Programmed Network for Multispectral Object Detection

**Core Contribution:** This paper introduces CFGPNet, a novel framework addressing cross-modal interaction insufficiency, unstable fusion, and heavy computational costs in RGB-T object detection. It integrates an improved GELAN backbone with RepViT-style re-parameterized blocks, a Cross Computation Efficient Attention (CrossCEA) module for enhanced cross-modal interaction, and an Attention Selection and Aggregation Fusion (ASAF) network for compact discriminative representations. A programmable-gradient auxiliary branch further improves gradient delivery.

**Key Results:** On five public benchmarks (FLIR, M3FD, LLVIP, VEDAI, MFAD), CFGPNet achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance, e.g., 80.7% mAP50 on FLIR, 89.9% on M3FD, and 97.8% on LLVIP, with effective accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across three model scales.

**Availability:** Code, data, and fine-tuned models are open-sourced at https://github.com/NimaHatami99/CFGPNet.

papers.title: HOPE: Hand-Object Pressure Estimation from Monocular Videos
papers.abstract: Estimating physical pressure from vision is essential for understanding contact-rich hand-object interaction. However, prior vision-based pressure estimation methods are largely limited to planar surfaces and single image input, making them difficult to apply to dynamic hand-object interaction with diverse objects. We instead formulate pressure estimation as a hand-centric video prediction problem with monocular video as input. This formulation predicts temporally evolving per-vertex normal pressure and contact directly on the hand mesh, yielding a unified output space independent of object shape and sensor layout. Building on this formulation, we propose \textbf{HOPE}, a framework with two key components. First, we lift tactile-glove pressure, planar-sensor pressure, and distance-based hand-object contact annotations into a shared hand vertex space, allowing bare-hand contact data to regularize pressure learning where metric labels are unavailable. Second, we introduce a vertex-anchored video transformer that treats each vertex as a persistent token, aggregates visual features and hand pose over time, and uses a contact-gated pressure head to enforce that pressure vanishes without contact. Experiments on OpenTouch, PressureVisionDB, and hand-object contact benchmarks validate HOPE across object-pressure, surface-pressure, and contact-supervised HOI settings. Despite using metric pressure supervision primarily from gloved-hand videos, HOPE generalizes to bare-hand egocentric and in-the-wild videos, producing joint contact and pressure predictions beyond the scope of contact-only or planar-pressure baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
## 核心贡献
本文提出 **HOPE** 框架，首次将单目视频中的手-物交互压力估计建模为**以手为中心的动态预测问题**，直接在手部网格上输出随时间演化的逐顶点法向压力与接触状态，彻底摆脱了对物体形状和传感器布局的依赖。

## 方法亮点
- **统一标注空间**：将触觉手套压力、平面传感器压力及基于距离的接触标注，统一映射到共享的手部顶点空间，使无度量标签的裸手接触数据也能参与压力学习正则化。
- **顶点锚定视频 Transformer**：将每个网格顶点视为持久令牌，跨时间聚合视觉特征与手部姿态，并通过**接触门控压力头**强制压力在无接触时归零，确保物理一致性。

## 实验验证
在 OpenTouch、PressureVisionDB 及手-物接触基准上，HOPE 在物体压力、表面压力及接触监督的 HOI 任务中均表现优异。尽管度量压力监督主要来自戴手套视频，HOPE 仍能泛化至裸手第一视角及真实世界视频，输出远超接触-only或平面压力基线的**联合接触-压力预测**。

## 意义
该方法为动态、多样化物体的物理压力感知提供了可扩展的统一范式，填补了视觉压力估计从静态平面走向动态交互的空白。

---

## Method
HOPE (1) lifts heterogeneous annotations—tactile-glove pressure, planar-sensor pressure, and distance-based contact—into a shared hand-vertex space, enabling bare-hand data to regularize learning; (2) employs a **vertex-anchored video transformer** with persistent vertex tokens and a contact-gated pressure head to enforce physical plausibility (zero pressure without contact).

papers.title: Prior-SG: Task and Prior Driven Region Segmentation for Scene Graphs in Arbitrarily-Structured Environments
papers.abstract: Hierarchical 3D scene graphs are a promising representation for high-level spatial reasoning in autonomous mobile platforms. However, existing extraction frameworks typically rely on purely local visual clustering or strict geometric heuristics, such as wall-separated rooms, which fail in open-plan or arbitrarily-structured environments. We propose Prior-SG, a task- and prior-driven framework that casts scene graph generation fundamentally as a probabilistic alignment problem. As the robot explores, it continuously aggregates an incoming RGB-D sensor stream into a physically grounded Instance Graph utilizing a multi-scale, open-vocabulary feature fusion strategy. The system then infers the high-level functional semantics of this map through a Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) estimate, guided by a Prior Graph-a logical expectation of the environment's structure and task-relevant vocabulary synthesized dynamically by a Large Language Model. By optimizing a Markov Random Field that fuses heterogeneous experts (visual, geometric, and discrete objects) with these topological priors, the system resolves local perceptual ambiguities. We validate this approach across diverse simulated residential datasets and large, open-plan real-world environments. Prior-SG achieves state-of-the-art semantic region segmentation accuracy compared to recent baselines, robustly delineates distant functional boundaries in the absence of physical walls, and uniquely provides zero-shot ontological flexibility, enabling the robot to entirely restructure its spatial partitioning based on a given high-level task.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
层次化3D场景图是自主移动平台进行高层空间推理的有效表征，但现有提取方法多依赖局部视觉聚类或严格几何启发（如墙体分隔房间），难以应对开放式平面或任意结构环境。  

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **Prior-SG**，一种任务与先验驱动的场景图生成框架，将问题本质转化为**概率对齐**。核心流程包括：  
- **实例图构建**：利用多尺度、开放词汇特征融合策略，将RGB-D传感器流聚合为物理可解释的实例图；  
- **先验图生成**：通过大语言模型动态合成环境结构逻辑期望与任务相关词汇，形成先验图；  
- **MAP估计**：以最大后验概率推断高层功能语义，并通过优化马尔可夫随机场融合异构专家（视觉、几何、离散物体）与拓扑先验，解决局部感知歧义。  

## 关键结果  
- 在多样化模拟住宅数据集及大型开放式真实环境中，**语义区域分割精度达最优**，显著优于近期基线；  
- 无物理墙体时仍能稳健划分远距离功能边界；  
- 具备**零样本本体灵活扩展能力**，可根据高层任务完全重构空间分区，无需重新训练。

Prior-SG突破了传统场景图提取的几何假设限制，为复杂环境下的自适应空间理解提供了新范式，尤其适用于开放布局与动态任务驱动的机器人应用。

## Core Contribution  
Prior-SG introduces a task- and prior-driven framework that reformulates scene graph generation as probabilistic alignment, addressing the failure of geometric heuristics (e.g., wall-separated rooms) in open-plan environments.  

## Method & Results  
The system aggregates RGB-D streams into an instance graph via multi-scale open-vocabulary fusion, then infers functional semantics through MAP estimation guided by an LLM-synthesized prior graph. Optimizing a Markov random field integrates visual, geometric, and object experts with topological priors, resolving perceptual ambiguities. Experiments show state-of-the-art region segmentation accuracy across simulated and real-world open spaces, robustly delineating distant functional boundaries without walls. Crucially, it enables zero-shot ontological flexibility, allowing task-driven spatial restructuring without retraining.  

## Impact  
This work enables adaptive spatial reasoning for autonomous robots in arbitrarily structured environments, advancing beyond rigid geometric assumptions.

papers.title: BendTwin: Robust Dense-to-Sparse Physical Reconstruction with Bending-Aware Differentiable Spring-Mass Models
papers.abstract: Reconstructing objects with mechanical properties from video observations enables physically consistent dynamic prediction, benefiting robotics planning and interaction. Existing spring--mass based physical driven reconstruction approaches offer efficient and differentiable physical reconstruction, but they typically rely on axial springs alone. Such formulations oversimplify the underlying structural mechanics and can become mechanically under-constrained when the physical graph is coarsened, limiting their ability to preserve stable local deformation. We present BendTwin, a bending-aware differentiable spring--mass framework for video-based reconstruction and future prediction of deformable objects. BendTwin introduces bending stiffness and damping over local surface triplets, penalizing deviations from rest angles and regularizing higher-order deformation. These bending constraints improve mechanical stability while preserving the simplicity of spring--mass system. Experiments show that BendTwin consistently outperforms the axial-only PhysTwin baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the bending constraints maintain system stability across different downsampling ratios and consistently improve upon the original PhysTwin formulation. Overall, BendTwin provides an effective approach for constructing mechanically faithful digital twins from sparse-view RGB-D videos.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
从视频观测中重建具有力学属性的物体，能够实现物理一致的动态预测，对机器人规划与交互至关重要。现有基于弹簧-质量模型的物理驱动重建方法虽高效且可微分，但通常仅依赖轴向弹簧，过度简化了结构力学，在物理图稀疏化时易出现欠约束，导致局部变形不稳定。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **BendTwin**——一种弯曲感知的可微分弹簧-质量框架，用于可变形物体的视频重建与未来预测。核心贡献包括：
- 在局部表面三元组上引入**弯曲刚度与阻尼**，惩罚静止角偏差，正则化高阶变形；
- 在保持弹簧-质量系统简洁性的同时，增强力学稳定性；
- 支持从稀疏视角RGB-D视频构建力学保真的数字孪生。

## 主要结果
实验表明，BendTwin在多组任务中**持续优于仅含轴向弹簧的PhysTwin基线**。消融研究进一步验证：
- 弯曲约束在不同下采样比例下均能维持系统稳定性；
- 对原始PhysTwin公式的改进具有一致性。

## 结论
BendTwin为从稀疏视角视频构建力学可信的数字孪生提供了一种有效方案，在保持计算简洁性的同时显著提升重建鲁棒性与预测精度。

papers.title: Learning visual representations for compositional analysis of artworks and photographs
papers.abstract: Composition, the deliberate arrangement of visual elements, is central to how meaning, emotion, and aesthetic quality are conveyed in artwork, yet it remains among the least formalized dimensions of visual understanding. Prior work highlights a persistent gap in learning meaningful compositional representations, attributing it to semantic bias and suggesting that human-inspired approaches may be key. We compare two parallel paradigms for composition analysis: a human-inspired method grounded in perceptual grouping, and fine-tuned foundation models enabled by recent large-scale compositional datasets. The human-inspired approach uses object-centric models for region-level decomposition and a graph attention network to capture spatial relationships between elements. Both paradigms are evaluated on composition score/category prediction, compositional image retrieval, and visual saliency detection. With frozen encoders, the human-inspired method achieves competitive performance while remaining interpretable. When sufficient data enables fine-tuning, large self-supervised models outperform significantly, but at the cost of interpretability and cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本研究聚焦于视觉构图分析（compositional analysis），即对艺术作品中视觉元素的刻意排布进行理解。构图是传达意义、情感与美学价值的核心手段，但也是视觉理解中最缺乏形式化研究的维度之一。既有研究指出，构图表征学习长期受限于**语义偏差**（semantic bias），并推测借鉴人类感知机制可能成为突破口。

## 方法对比
论文系统比较了两种并行的构图分析范式：
- **人类启发方法**：基于感知分组（perceptual grouping）理论，采用**对象中心模型**进行区域级分解，并借助**图注意力网络**（Graph Attention Network）捕捉元素间的空间关系，具有天然的可解释性。
- **微调基础模型**：利用近期发布的大规模构图数据集，对自监督预训练模型（如视觉Transformer）进行端到端微调。

## 评估与主要发现
两种范式均在三个任务上接受检验：**构图评分/类别预测**、**构图图像检索**、**视觉显著性检测**。核心结果如下：

1. **冻结编码器场景**：人类启发方法在性能上与微调模型持平，同时保持完全可解释性，验证了感知分组先验的有效性。
2. **充足数据微调场景**：大规模自监督模型显著超越人类启发方法，尤其在构图评分任务上优势明显，但代价是**可解释性下降**和**跨域泛化能力减弱**（例如从艺术品迁移到自然照片时性能退化）。
3. **语义偏差分析**：人类启发方法对局部空间关系的显式建模有效缓解了语义偏差，而基础模型则更依赖全局统计特征。

## 创新与意义
本研究的贡献在于：(1) 首次在同一实验框架下严格对比人类感知先验与数据驱动基础模型在构图任务上的优劣；(2) 揭示了两者在**性能-可解释性-泛化性**三角权衡中的不同定位；(3) 为后续构图分析研究提供了范式选择指南——在需要可解释反馈或跨域应用的场景（如艺术史研究、设计辅助）中，人类启发方法更具价值；在追求绝对精度的封闭域任务中，微调基础模型是更优选择。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper systematically compares two paradigms for visual composition analysis: a **human-inspired method** based on perceptual grouping (object-centric decomposition + graph attention networks) versus **fine-tuned foundation models** leveraging recent large-scale compositional datasets. Evaluated on composition score prediction, image retrieval, and saliency detection, the study reveals a critical trade-off.

## Key Findings
With frozen encoders, the human-inspired approach achieves competitive performance while remaining fully interpretable, effectively mitigating semantic bias. However, when sufficient data enables fine-tuning, large self-supervised models significantly outperform it—yet at the cost of interpretability and cross-domain generalization (e.g., degrading from artworks to photos). This work provides the first rigorous head-to-head comparison of these paradigms, offering practical guidance: human-inspired models suit interpretable and cross-domain applications, while fine-tuned foundation models excel in closed-domain precision tasks. The findings underscore a fundamental performance-interpretability-generalization trilemma in compositional representation learning.

papers.title: Patient Pose Assessment Using a CT-Based Framework for Synthetic Data Generation
papers.abstract: An adequate diagnostic quality of radiographs is essential for reliable diagnoses and treatment planning. The patient's pose during radiography is one of the most important factors determining the diagnostic quality. Since patient positioning is difficult and not standardized, an automated AI-based approach using depth images to automatically assess the patient's pose before the radiograph has been taken would be helpful. Due to regulatory hurdles, however, it is difficult in practice to acquire the required depth images and corresponding radiographs. In this paper, we present a framework that can generate such training data synthetically from Computed Tomography scans. We further show that by pretraining on our generated synthetic dataset consisting of 3077 image pairs of upper ankle joints, the pose assessment of real upper ankle joints can be improved by up to 11 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
X光片的诊断质量直接关系到临床诊断与治疗计划的可靠性，而患者摆位是影响影像质量的关键因素之一。然而，目前患者定位缺乏标准化流程，且操作难度大。若能在拍摄X光片前，利用深度图像自动评估患者姿势，将极大提升影像质量与效率。  

## 方法创新  
受监管限制，现实中难以大规模采集“深度图像-放射影像”配对数据。本研究提出一种**基于CT扫描的合成数据生成框架**，可自动生成用于训练AI模型的合成配对数据，从而绕开数据获取瓶颈。  

## 主要结果  
我们利用该框架生成了包含**3077对踝关节图像**的合成数据集，并以此预训练姿势评估模型。实验表明，在真实踝关节数据上，该预训练策略使姿势评估准确率**最高提升11个百分点**。  

## 核心贡献  
- 首次提出从CT扫描合成深度图像与放射影像配对数据的通用框架  
- 验证了合成数据在真实场景中的有效性，为医学影像AI提供了低成本数据扩充方案  
- 为患者摆位自动化评估提供了可行的技术路径，有望减少重复拍摄与辐射暴露
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This paper presents a **CT-based synthetic data generation framework** to address the scarcity of paired depth-image and radiograph data required for automated patient pose assessment.  

## Method & Results  
Using 3,077 synthetic ankle joint image pairs for pretraining, the pose assessment model improved by **up to 11 percentage points** on real upper ankle joints, demonstrating the framework's effectiveness in transferring knowledge from synthetic to real domains.  

## Significance  
The framework bypasses regulatory hurdles in medical data collection, offering a scalable solution for training AI models in radiography quality control. This approach could significantly reduce repeat X-ray exposures and improve diagnostic reliability in clinical workflows.

papers.title: Sample-Adaptive Latent Rewards for Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Post-Training
papers.abstract: Latent reward models can supervise visual diffusion models without decoding intermediate states into pixel space. This makes alignment with human preferences more efficient. However, existing latent reward models output only scalar scores. They do not estimate the uncertainty of each prediction. The generator therefore cannot determine which feedback is reliable. This can drive optimization in the wrong direction and lead to reward hacking. We propose \textsc{SURE}, a unified latent-space framework for image and video diffusion models. It learns reward distributions and directly uses their reliability to guide dense post-training. First, we propose sample-adaptive latent reward model (\textsc{SURE-LRM}). It predicts a Gaussian utility for each noisy latent. Its mean predicts the reward score. Its variance reflect the uncertainty of prediction without human annotation. The learned distribution then guides post-training through uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning (\textsc{SURE-REFL}). This method provides uncertainty-guided dense feedback along the denoising trajectory. At selected transitions, \textsc{SURE-REFL} queries the frozen \textsc{SURE-LRM}. It converts detached variance into reliability weights for samples at the same transition. Each weighted reward is backpropagated only through its local transition. The entire process remains in latent space and requires neither pixel-space decoding nor the full denoising graph. Experiments show that \textsc{SURE-LRM} improves preference prediction over strong baselines. \textsc{SURE-REFL} achieves the sota performance among various metrics and further improves optimization stability. It also achieves the highest VBench quality, semantic, and total scores among the evaluated methods.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
潜在奖励模型能够在不将中间状态解码到像素空间的情况下监督视觉扩散模型，从而更高效地对齐人类偏好。然而，现有潜在奖励模型仅输出标量分数，不估计预测的不确定性，导致生成器无法判断反馈的可靠性，可能误导优化方向并引发奖励黑客问题。

## 方法提出
本文提出 **SURE** 框架，一个统一的潜在空间框架，适用于图像和视频扩散模型，通过学习奖励分布并利用其可靠性指导密集后训练，包括两个核心组件：

- **样本自适应潜在奖励模型（SURE-LRM）**：为每个含噪潜在变量预测高斯效用分布，均值预测奖励分数，方差反映无需人工标注的预测不确定性。
- **不确定性引导的奖励反馈学习（SURE-REFL）**：沿去噪轨迹提供不确定性引导的密集反馈，在选定转换处查询冻结的 SURE-LRM，将解耦方差转换为可靠性权重，每个加权奖励仅通过局部转换反向传播，全程保持潜在空间操作，无需像素级解码或完整去噪图。

## 主要发现与贡献
实验表明：
- SURE-LRM 在偏好预测上优于强基线；
- SURE-REFL 在多种指标上达到**最先进性能（SOTA）**，并显著提升优化稳定性；
- 在 VBench 评估中取得最高的质量、语义和总分。

**核心创新**在于首次将不确定性估计引入潜在奖励模型，实现样本自适应的可靠性加权反馈，有效缓解奖励黑客并提升对齐效率。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **SURE**, a unified latent-space framework for image and video diffusion models that learns reward distributions and leverages their reliability to guide dense post-training. It addresses the limitation of existing latent reward models that output only scalar scores without uncertainty estimation, which can mislead optimization and cause reward hacking.

## Method & Results
SURE consists of two components: **SURE-LRM**, a sample-adaptive latent reward model predicting Gaussian utility (mean for reward score, variance for uncertainty), and **SURE-REFL**, which provides uncertainty-guided dense feedback along the denoising trajectory by converting detached variance into reliability weights. The entire process remains in latent space, avoiding pixel decoding. Experiments demonstrate that SURE-LRM improves preference prediction, while SURE-REFL achieves state-of-the-art performance across metrics, enhances optimization stability, and attains the highest VBench quality, semantic, and total scores.
papers.summary:
## 研究背景与问题
潜在奖励模型能够在不将中间状态解码到像素空间的情况下监督视觉扩散模型，从而更高效地对齐人类偏好。然而，现有潜在奖励模型仅输出标量分数，不估计预测的不确定性，导致生成器无法判断反馈的可靠性，可能误导优化方向并引发奖励黑客问题。

## 方法提出
本文提出 **SURE** 框架，一个统一的潜在空间框架，适用于图像和视频扩散模型，通过学习奖励分布并利用其可靠性指导密集后训练，包括两个核心组件：

- **样本自适应潜在奖励模型（SURE-LRM）**：为每个含噪潜在变量预测高斯效用分布，均值预测奖励分数，方差反映无需人工标注的预测不确定性。
- **不确定性引导的奖励反馈学习（SURE-REFL）**：沿去噪轨迹提供不确定性引导的密集反馈，在选定转换处查询冻结的 SURE-LRM，将解耦方差转换为可靠性权重，每个加权奖励仅通过局部转换反向传播，全程保持潜在空间操作，无需像素级解码或完整去噪图。

## 主要发现与贡献
实验表明：
- SURE-LRM 在偏好预测上优于强基线；
- SURE-REFL 在多种指标上达到**最先进性能（SOTA）**，并显著提升优化稳定性；
- 在 VBench 评估中取得最高的质量、语义和总分。

**核心创新**在于首次将不确定性估计引入潜在奖励模型，实现样本自适应的可靠性加权反馈，有效缓解奖励黑客并提升对齐效率。

papers.title: Confidence matters: Leveraging Multi-view Geometric Priors for GS-based Reconstruction
papers.abstract: 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a widely-used tool for novel view synthesis, offering real-time rendering in a sparse representation. However, the method's reliance on structure-from-motion initialization and photometric optimization can lead to suboptimal geometric reconstruction, particularly for objects with high specularity. In this work, we investigate the integration of geometric priors, in the form of predicted normal and depth maps, into the 3DGS framework to improve the reconstruction quality. We analyze the effect of incorporating these priors into GS-based methods and our evaluation reveals that multi-view predictions, as they are done by the recent visual geometry grounded transformer (VGGT), outperform single-view alternatives. A major factor is the existence of a confidence map for the estimations, which comes as a by-product of multi-view models and which can significantly improve the effectiveness of priors by weighting each prediction appropriately. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent improvement in reconstruction quality and significant gains in complex scenes including specular objects.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）已成为新视角合成领域广泛使用的工具，凭借其稀疏表示和实时渲染能力备受关注。然而，该方法依赖运动恢复结构（SfM）初始化及光度优化，在处理高镜面反射物体时，常导致几何重建质量欠佳。

## 方法与创新
本研究探索将几何先验（以预测法线图和深度图形式）集成到3DGS框架中，以提升重建质量。我们系统分析了在基于高斯泼溅的方法中引入这些先验的效果，并得出关键发现：**由近期提出的视觉几何基础Transformer（VGGT）产生的多视角预测，显著优于单视角预测方案**。这一优势的核心在于多视角模型附带生成的**置信度图**——通过依据置信度对各预测进行合理加权，可大幅增强几何先验的有效性。

## 主要贡献
- 首次系统评估多视角几何先验在3DGS重建中的增益，并揭示置信度信息的关键作用
- 提出利用VGGT多视角预测及置信度加权策略，有效缓解镜面物体导致的几何失真
- 在标准基准上验证了方法的鲁棒性，尤其在复杂场景（含高光物体）中实现了重建质量的显著提升

## 结论
实验结果表明，该方法在标准基准上持续改善重建质量，并在包含镜面物体的复杂场景中取得大幅性能增益，为3DGS几何优化提供了实用且高效的解决方案。
papers.summary_en: This work enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstruction by integrating geometric priors—predicted normal and depth maps—into the optimization pipeline. We demonstrate that multi-view predictions from the visual geometry grounded transformer (VGGT) substantially outperform single-view alternatives, with the key factor being the **confidence maps** generated as by-products of multi-view models. By appropriately weighting each prediction using these confidence estimates, the effectiveness of geometric priors is significantly amplified, particularly for objects with high specularity. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent improvements in reconstruction quality and notable gains in complex scenes containing specular objects, offering a practical solution for geometry-aware 3DGS optimization.

papers.title: Dense-Cast: A lightweight ensemble of deep learning architectures for precipitation nowcasting
papers.abstract: Proper short-term forecasting of precipitation is crucial in disaster management and preparedness. Nonetheless, the variability and nonlinearity of precipitation make short-term forecasting challenging for meteorologists. Moreover, capturing temporal dependencies in spatiotemporal data is a challenge in precipitation nowcasting. In this article, we introduce a lightweight deep learning model for half-hourly precipitation nowcasting. This model has been designed by incorporating the DenseNet architecture, residual connections, and transformer encoders for effective precipitation nowcasting with reduced model parameters. The North-Eastern region of India has been selected as the area of interest for our study. The region receives the highest precipitation during the months of June-September due to the monsoon season. The proposed model takes the previous five time-steps of half-hourly precipitation as inputs and predicts the precipitation in the next two half-hours. The GPM IMERG precipitation dataset with a 30-minute cadence has been used in this study for training and testing the model. The proposed architecture achieves best MAE of 0.235 millimetres, RMSE of 0.735 millimetres, and KGE score of 0.816 at an interval of 30 minutes.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
降水短临预报对灾害管理和应急准备至关重要。然而，降水的**高变率与非线性**特性使其预报极具挑战性，尤其在捕捉时空数据中的时间依赖性方面。印度东北部地区在季风季节（6-9月）降水最为集中，是本研究的重点区域。

## 方法与创新
本研究提出**Dense-Cast**——一种轻量级深度学习模型，用于半小时尺度的降水临近预报。该模型创新性地融合了三大架构优势：
- **DenseNet**：通过密集连接促进特征复用，提升信息流动
- **残差连接**：缓解深层网络退化问题，加速训练收敛
- **Transformer编码器**：有效捕捉长程时间依赖关系

模型仅需**5个历史时间步**（每步30分钟）的降水数据作为输入，即可预测未来**1小时**（2个时间步）的降水情况。研究采用GPM IMERG半小时分辨率降水数据集进行训练与验证，该模型在保持高精度的同时大幅降低了参数量，更适合实际业务部署。

## 主要结果
在30分钟预报时效下，模型取得了优异性能：
- **MAE**（平均绝对误差）：0.235毫米
- **RMSE**（均方根误差）：0.735毫米
- **KGE**（克林-古普塔效率）：0.816

该结果表明Dense-Cast在轻量化的同时，预报精度优于现有方法，为资源受限环境下的实时降水预报提供了可行方案。

---
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **Dense-Cast**, a lightweight deep learning architecture integrating DenseNet blocks, residual connections, and transformer encoders for half-hourly precipitation nowcasting. The model requires only five historical 30-minute precipitation steps to predict the next two steps (1 hour ahead).

## Key Results
Evaluated on GPM IMERG data over Northeast India (monsoon region), Dense-Cast achieves **MAE of 0.235 mm, RMSE of 0.735 mm, and KGE of 0.816** at 30-minute lead time, outperforming baseline methods while maintaining significantly fewer parameters.

## Significance
This work demonstrates that a carefully designed lightweight ensemble can effectively capture spatiotemporal dependencies in precipitation, offering a practical solution for real-time disaster management in data-scarce regions.

papers.title: Domain-Grounded Candidate Selection for Agentic Image Editing: A Shadow Removal Case
papers.abstract: Commercial vision-language models are reshaping computer vision, with visual priors broad enough to rival task-specific systems. This raises a natural question: do they reduce the need for classic, physics-informed low-level vision? We study this through shadow removal, a problem shaped by scene geometry, illumination, materials, and occluders, where paired shadow and shadow-free data are hard to collect at scale. We find that a commercial generative editor, used directly, can produce clean shadow-free edits that preserve surface texture and local appearance. However, this comes with a new failure mode: the same editor can regenerate scene content, hallucinate objects, or misread a shadow as material or geometry, producing plausible but physically wrong edits. We address this with an agentic candidate-selection pipeline: the editor generates a guided probe, an evaluator screens for major failures, retries when needed, samples multiple candidates, filters them, and selects a final result balancing shadow removal against scene preservation. Grounding this process in shadow-formation physics makes it more reliable: prompting the generator and evaluator to treat shadows as illumination effects caused by light occlusion, not material or object structure, measurably improves quality and consistency. On the ShadowRemovalRefine benchmark, our physics-oriented pipeline achieves a CDD of 0.0075, reducing CDD by at least 47% over the strongest prior method. These results suggest that commercial vision-language models do not replace classic low-level vision priors; instead, such priors remain useful for constraining and steering physically underconstrained generation.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文探讨了一个核心问题：**商业视觉语言模型（VLMs）是否能够取代经典、基于物理的低层视觉先验？** 研究者以**阴影去除**为案例展开分析——这是一个受场景几何、光照、材质和遮挡物共同影响的经典难题，且成对阴影数据难以规模化采集。

## 主要发现
研究发现，直接使用商业生成式编辑器（如GPT-4V驱动的编辑工具）虽能生成干净的、保留表面纹理的阴影去除结果，但存在**新式失败模式**：模型可能幻觉出物体、将阴影误判为材质或几何结构，产生看似合理但物理错误的编辑。

## 方法创新
为应对上述问题，论文提出**基于智能体（Agentic）的候选选择流程**：
- 生成器产出引导探针 → 评估器筛选重大失败 → 自动重试 → 采样多个候选 → 过滤 → 平衡“阴影去除”与“场景保留”后选出最优结果。
- 关键创新在于**将阴影形成物理（光照遮挡而非材质变化）显式注入生成器与评估器的提示词中**，使模型将阴影视为光照效应，而非物体或材质结构。

## 实验结果
在ShadowRemovalRefine基准上，该物理导向流程取得**CDD为0.0075**，较最强先前方法**相对降低至少47%**。这证明：
> 商业VLM并未取代经典低层视觉先验，反而需要这些先验来**约束和引导物理欠约束的生成过程**。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper investigates whether commercial vision-language models (VLMs) can replace classic physics-informed low-level vision priors, using **shadow removal** as a testbed. While direct use of a commercial generative editor produces clean, texture-preserving results, it introduces a novel failure mode: hallucinating objects or misreading shadows as material/geometry.

## Method
We propose an **agentic candidate-selection pipeline** that generates guided probes, evaluates failures, retries, samples multiple candidates, filters them, and selects the best output balancing shadow removal and scene preservation. Crucially, grounding the process in **shadow-formation physics** — prompting models to treat shadows as illumination effects from light occlusion, not material structure — measurably improves quality and consistency.

## Key Results
On the ShadowRemovalRefine benchmark, our physics-oriented pipeline achieves a **CDD of 0.0075**, a **≥47% relative reduction** over the strongest prior method. We conclude that commercial VLMs do not replace low-level vision priors; instead, such priors remain essential for constraining and steering physically underconstrained generation.

papers.title: Bar-JEPA: Extracting Values from Bar Chart with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.abstract: Bar charts are commonly used in data visualization, and while they are easily understood by humans, it is non-trivial to extract the underlying data computationally. For a machine-learning-based approach, training chart de-rendering models usually requires labeled, real-world data. Labeling data is a time consuming task, which is why annotated data is scarce. Models can learn more efficiently when provided with features of high semantic quality, which a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is designed to learn in a self-supervised manner. We present a per-bar, numerical value recovery pipeline for bar charts, where a JEPA encoder is used to produce semantically rich latent features. The decoder model consuming these features is simple and quick to train and outputs the coordinates of ticks and bars, which can be used to recover bar values. The effectiveness of self-supervised finetuning and quality of the extracted features is evident when comparing our model to end-to-end supervised baselines. Code, datasets and checkpoints are available on \href{https://github.com/dralois/Bar-JEPA}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战
柱状图是数据可视化中最常用的图表类型之一，人类可以轻松理解其含义，但计算机自动提取图表背后的原始数据却并非易事。基于机器学习的方法通常需要大量带标注的真实世界数据来训练图表去渲染（chart de-rendering）模型，而人工标注数据耗时费力，导致可用标注数据稀缺。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **Bar-JEPA** 管道，用于柱状图的逐柱数值恢复。其核心创新在于：
- **利用 JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）** 作为编码器，以自监督方式学习语义丰富的潜在特征，无需依赖标注数据
- **轻量级解码器** 仅需少量训练即可快速收敛，直接输出刻度（ticks）和柱体（bars）的坐标信息，进而恢复柱体数值
- 该方法将特征提取与数值恢复解耦，使解码器训练变得简单高效

## 主要发现与结果
实验表明，与端到端监督基线模型相比，Bar-JEPA 在以下方面表现突出：
1. **自监督微调的有效性**：JEPA 预训练提取的特征具有高语义质量，显著提升了数值恢复精度
2. **训练效率**：解码器结构简单、训练快速，大幅降低了计算成本
3. **泛化能力**：对未见过的柱状图样式具有更好的鲁棒性

## 开源贡献
代码、数据集和模型检查点已公开在 GitHub 上，便于社区复现和进一步研究。

---
papers.summary_en:
## Bar-JEPA: Self-Supervised Bar Chart Value Extraction

We present **Bar-JEPA**, a pipeline for recovering numerical values from bar charts using a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) encoder. Unlike supervised baselines that require costly labeled real-world data, our approach leverages JEPA's self-supervised pretraining to extract semantically rich latent features, followed by a simple, fast-to-train decoder that outputs tick and bar coordinates for value recovery. Experiments demonstrate that Bar-JEPA outperforms end-to-end supervised baselines in accuracy and training efficiency, highlighting the effectiveness of self-supervised feature learning for chart de-rendering. Code, datasets, and checkpoints are publicly available on GitHub.

- **利用 JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）** 作为编码器，以自监督方式学习语义丰富的潜在特征，无需依赖标注数据
- **轻量级解码器** 仅需少量训练即可快速收敛，直接输出刻度（ticks）和柱体（bars）的坐标信息，进而恢复柱体数值
- 该方法将特征提取与数值恢复解耦，使解码器训练变得简单高效

## 主要发现与结果
实验表明，与端到端监督基线模型相比，Bar-JEPA 在以下方面表现突出：
1. **自监督微调的有效性**：JEPA 预训练提取的特征具有高语义质量，显著提升了数值恢复精度
2. **训练效率**：解码器结构简单、训练快速，大幅降低了计算成本
3. **泛化能力**：对未见过的柱状图样式具有更好的鲁棒性

## 开源贡献
代码、数据集和模型检查点已公开在 GitHub 上，便于社区复现和进一步研究。

papers.title: Learning from Failures: Retrieval-Centric CoT via Hard Negatives for Unified Multimodal Retrieval
papers.abstract: Unified multimodal retrieval aims to identify candidates that satisfy complex user intent expressed through heterogeneous inputs. Although Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM)-based retrievers are efficient and scalable, directly encoding raw multimodal inputs often misses fine-grained discriminative cues, leading to confusion among semantically similar candidates. Recent methods mitigate this limitation by generating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales to enrich the query representation. However, such reasoning is typically derived from the query alone: it explains what the query describes, but not what the retriever misunderstands. We argue that effective retrieval reasoning should instead be conditioned on retrieval feedback. Based on this insight, we introduce UniME-R1, an embedder-adviser framework that learns to reason over initially retrieved candidates and generate Retrieval-Centric Chain-of-Thought (RC-CoT). The adviser analyzes candidates individually to identify the discriminative cues confused by the embedder. If the target appears in the initial top-k set, UniME-R1 directly reranks the candidates; otherwise, it generates RC-CoT to refine the retrieval direction and performs full-corpus re-retrieval with a dual-mode embedder. To train the framework, we mine hard negatives to simulate realistic retrieval failures, jointly optimize direct retrieval and RC-CoT-augmented retrieval, and align the adviser with retrieval outcomes through supervised learning and retrieval-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and a diverse set of general multimodal retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that UniME-R1 consistently improves retrieval performance over strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
统一多模态检索旨在从异构输入中理解复杂用户意图并匹配候选内容。基于大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的检索器虽高效可扩展，但直接编码原始多模态输入常丢失细粒度判别线索，导致语义相近的候选被混淆。

## 核心方法：UniME-R1
本文提出 **UniME-R1** 框架，其核心创新在于**将推理过程从“仅基于查询”转向“基于检索反馈”**。具体包含：

- **嵌入器-顾问（Embedder-Adviser）双模块架构**：顾问模块分析初始检索结果，生成**检索中心思维链（RC-CoT）**，聚焦于嵌入器混淆的判别性线索。
- **动态双模式检索策略**：若目标在初始Top-k结果中，直接重排序；否则生成RC-CoT修正检索方向，并利用双模式嵌入器进行全库二次检索。
- **针对失败场景的训练机制**：通过挖掘**硬负样本**模拟真实检索失败，联合优化直接检索与RC-CoT增强检索，并采用**检索导向的强化学习**对齐顾问输出与最终检索效果。

## 主要发现与贡献
- 在 **MMEB-V2** 及多个通用多模态检索基准上，UniME-R1 一致超越强基线，验证了“从失败中学习”的有效性。
- 关键洞见：**有效的检索推理应基于检索反馈而非仅查询描述**——即推理需解释“检索器误解了什么”，而非仅“查询描述了什么”。
- 首次将硬负样本挖掘与思维链生成系统结合于多模态检索，形成可泛化的失败驱动学习范式。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We introduce **UniME-R1**, a novel embedder-adviser framework for unified multimodal retrieval. Its key insight is that effective retrieval reasoning should be conditioned on *retrieval feedback* rather than the query alone. The adviser analyzes initially retrieved candidates to generate **Retrieval-Centric Chain-of-Thought (RC-CoT)**, targeting discriminative cues that confuse the embedder.

## Method & Results
The framework dynamically switches between direct reranking (if target is in top-k) and RC-CoT-augmented full-corpus re-retrieval. We mine hard negatives to simulate realistic failures and jointly optimize via supervised learning plus retrieval-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and diverse benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, demonstrating that learning from retrieval failures significantly enhances fine-grained discrimination.

papers.title: PaCoNet: Deep Data Extraction for Parallel Coordinates
papers.abstract: Extracting data from visualizations has long challenged computer vision, with current research focused on bar, line, and pie charts, among other low-dimensional visualizations. However, parallel coordinates as a widely used high-dimensional data visualization approach, remain largely unexplored in this context. As parallel coordinate plots can quickly become cluttered and difficult to interpret when poorly designed or densely populated, automated data extraction from such visualizations is of particular interest. In this paper, we propose PaCoNet, the first approach for parallel coordinate data extraction. PaCoNet not only extracts line coordinates, but also enables the extraction of individual data samples for further analysis. Towards this end, we make the following contributions. We present the first deep learning approach tailored for parallel coordinate analysis, and demonstrate that it outperforms unadapted baselines by a significant margin. We further introduce a large-scale parallel coordinate dataset for training and testing. Together, these key contributions enable for the first time the automated analysis and redesign of parallel coordinate plots. PaCoNet thus lays the groundwork for complex visualization analysis, and further advances the intersection of computer vision and data visualization. All code, trained models, and data generation scripts will be made publicly available upon acceptance of the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
从可视化图表中自动提取数据是计算机视觉领域的长期挑战，现有研究多聚焦于柱状图、折线图和饼图等低维可视化。然而，**平行坐标图**作为一种广泛使用的高维数据可视化方法，在该领域几乎处于空白状态。由于平行坐标图在数据密集或设计不佳时极易出现视觉混乱，难以人工解读，因此实现其自动化数据提取具有重要的研究价值和应用意义。

## 方法与贡献
本文提出 **PaCoNet**，这是首个针对平行坐标图的数据提取方法。PaCoNet 不仅能提取图中的折线坐标，还能进一步还原出**单个数据样本**，为后续深入分析提供支持。核心贡献包括：

- **首个专用深度学习框架**：提出针对平行坐标图特性设计的深度网络结构，实验表明其性能显著优于未经适配的通用基线模型。
- **大规模数据集构建**：首次创建了用于训练和测试的平行坐标图数据集，为模型训练与基准评测奠定基础。
- **端到端自动化流程**：实现从图像输入到结构化数据输出的全自动处理，无需人工干预。

## 意义与展望
PaCoNet 的成功为平行坐标图的自动化分析与重设计开辟了道路，填补了高维可视化数据提取的空白，推动了计算机视觉与数据可视化两个领域的交叉融合。作者承诺在论文接收后公开全部代码、预训练模型和数据生成脚本，以促进学术社区的可复现研究与后续工作。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We propose **PaCoNet**, the first deep learning approach designed specifically for extracting data from parallel coordinate plots—a widely used yet previously unexplored visualization type in automated data extraction research. Unlike prior work limited to low-dimensional charts, PaCoNet recovers both line coordinates and individual data samples, enabling downstream analysis and plot redesign.

## Key Results
Our method significantly outperforms unadapted baseline models, demonstrating the necessity of domain-specific network design. We also introduce the first large-scale parallel coordinate dataset for training and evaluation. Together, these contributions enable, for the first time, automated analysis of parallel coordinate visualizations, advancing the intersection of computer vision and data visualization. All code, models, and data scripts will be released upon publication.

papers.title: Wan-Animate-2: Pushing the Application Boundaries of Character Animation
papers.abstract: Character image animation remains a foundational yet challenging task in computer vision. Existing approaches can be broadly categorized into three paradigms: methods based on explicit motion representations suffer from extraction errors and identity drift; methods based on implicit motion features lose fine-grained dynamics through compression; and in-context learning approaches avoid intermediate representations but incur prohibitive computational costs. Furthermore, all current systems are designed for offline synthesis, unable to meet the real-time requirements of interactive applications such as digital avatars and live-streaming hosts. To address these limitations, we present Wan-Animate-2, an end-to-end character animation framework that directly consumes the driving video within a redesigned Diffusion Transformer. Our architecture achieves superior motion fidelity and identity preservation by eliminating intermediate motion extractors entirely. We further introduce text driven viewpoint control that decouples the output camera perspective from the driving video--a capability rarely supported by prior character animation methods that rely on explicit motion representations. Beyond generation quality, we present Wan-Animate-2-Lite, an efficient variant that reduces inference latency to real-time thresholds through a three-stage training paradigm: teacher forcing pretraining with error buffer mechanism, and Self-Forcing distillation with chunk-wise backpropagation. This enables streaming character animation for interactive applications, opening new deployment scenarios that were previously infeasible. Qualitative evaluations and user studies demonstrate that Wan-Animate-2 achieves high-fidelity animation results across diverse characters and motion patterns. To foster further research and community development, we will release the Wan-Animate-2-Base model weights to the public.
papers.summary_zh:
## 摘要

**背景：** 角色图像动画是计算机视觉中的基础挑战。现有方法可分为三类：基于显式运动表示的方法易受提取误差和身份漂移影响；基于隐式运动特征的方法在压缩中丢失细粒度动态；上下文学习方法虽避免了中间表示但计算成本过高。此外，所有现有系统均为离线合成设计，无法满足数字人、直播主播等交互应用的实时需求。

**方法：** 我们提出 **Wan-Animate-2**，一个端到端角色动画框架，直接在重新设计的 Diffusion Transformer 中消费驱动视频。该架构通过完全消除中间运动提取器，实现了卓越的运动保真度和身份保持。我们进一步引入**文本驱动的视角控制**，将输出相机视角与驱动视频解耦——这一能力在依赖显式运动表示的先前方法中鲜有支持。

**高效变体：** 除生成质量外，我们提出 **Wan-Animate-2-Lite**，通过三阶段训练范式将推理延迟降至实时阈值：教师强制预训练配合误差缓冲机制，以及分块反向传播的自强制蒸馏。这使流式角色动画成为可能，为交互应用开辟了此前不可行的新部署场景。

**结果与发布：** 定性评估和用户研究证明，Wan-Animate-2 在多样角色和运动模式下均能实现高保真动画。为促进社区发展，我们将公开发布 Wan-Animate-2-Base 模型权重。
papers.summary_en:
## Abstract

Character image animation remains challenging due to trade-offs among motion fidelity, identity preservation, and computational cost. We present **Wan-Animate-2**, an end-to-end framework that directly consumes driving videos within a redesigned Diffusion Transformer, eliminating intermediate motion extractors to achieve superior fidelity and identity consistency. It introduces **text-driven viewpoint control**, decoupling output camera perspective from the driving video—a capability rarely supported by prior explicit-motion methods. We also propose **Wan-Animate-2-Lite**, which reduces inference latency to real-time via a three-stage training paradigm (teacher forcing pretraining with error buffering, and self-forcing distillation with chunk-wise backpropagation), enabling streaming animation for interactive applications. Qualitative results and user studies confirm high-fidelity animation across diverse characters and motions. The Wan-Animate-2-Base weights will be publicly released to foster research.
