papers.title: Budget Allocation in Neural Differential Distinguishers
papers.abstract:
Neural differential distinguishers are usually compared at a fixed number of labeled samples. However, different input representations may require different numbers of ciphertexts per sample, making fixed-sample comparisons potentially misleading from a cryptanalytic data-complexity perspective. In this paper, we study neural differential distinguishers under a fixed ciphertext budget. We ask whether the available encryption queries should be spent on more independent plaintext bases, or on richer samples containing more ciphertext-difference rows.

We introduce a shared-base multi-difference representation in which several input differences are applied around the same plaintext base, and compare it with the standard single-difference baseline and an independent-pair control representation. Experiments on GIFT-64, PRESENT-64, RECTANGLE-64, and SPECK-64/128 show that the single-difference baseline is rarely the best fixed-budget allocation. Adding more difference rows often improves the distinguisher even though it reduces the number of independent training samples. At the same time, the optimal number of rows is not universal: logistic regression often benefits from larger representations, while a multilayer perceptron frequently prefers intermediate values due to sample-starvation and overfitting.

We further test several non-adaptive difference sets and observe that the main trend is not tied to a single hand-picked set. The results suggest that the number of differences per sample should be treated as an explicit design parameter in neural differential cryptanalysis, and that fixed-budget evaluation is necessary for comparing richer neural distinguisher inputs fairly.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
神经差分区分器通常以固定数量的标记样本进行比较，但不同输入表示可能每个样本需要不同数量的密文，导致固定样本比较在密码分析数据复杂度上可能产生误导。本文研究在固定密文预算下，加密查询应分配给更多独立明文基，还是更丰富的含多密文差分行的样本。

## 方法与实验
提出**共享基多差分表示**，在相同明文基上应用多个输入差分，并与标准单差分基线和独立对控制表示对比。在GIFT-64、PRESENT-64、RECTANGLE-64和SPECK-64/128上进行实验。

## 主要发现
- **单差分基线很少是最优固定预算分配**。增加差分行通常提升区分器性能，尽管减少了独立训练样本数。
- **最优行数不通用**：逻辑回归常受益于更大表示；多层感知机因样本匮乏和过拟合，常偏好中间值。
- 测试多种非自适应差分集，确认主要趋势不依赖单一手工挑选的集合。

## 结论与意义
每个样本的差分数量应作为神经差分密码分析中的**显式设计参数**。固定预算评估对于公平比较更丰富的神经区分器输入是必要的，为密码分析中的数据复杂度权衡提供了新视角。

---

papers.title: Fast Object Removal Attacks on Safety-Critical Video-based Perception Systems
papers.abstract: By leveraging data from video-based perception systems, intelligent transportation systems (ITS) support safety-critical applications that improve road safety. However, adversaries may manipulate video frames to compromise downstream perception modules, causing failures in safety-critical functions and increasing risks to vulnerable road users. This paper presents a novel attack model and an end-to-end framework for near-real-time targeted object removal attack on a video-based safety-critical system. The end-to-end attack pipeline consists of four stages: localizing targets in each frame, retrieving coherent patches from earlier frames, blending them using context-aware alpha compositing, and reconstructing attacked frames. Experiments at an intersection on the South Carolina Connected Vehicle Testbed (SC-CVT) show that reconstructed frames have high global similarity to the originals, with frame-level Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 40 dB and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) above 0.996. Using the YOLO-based detector, the attack reduces object detections by up to 97.59% and achieves a frame-level attack success rate of 94.48%. Across the evaluated detectors and frame resolutions, the mean execution time ranges from 0.074 to 0.172 seconds per frame on GPU hardware, indicating near-real-time performance in testing. The forensic evaluation using several pretrained tamper-detection models shows limited ability to distinguish reconstructed from authentic frames. The findings suggest that video-based perception is vulnerable to stealthy object removal attacks that can degrade the performance of safety-critical applications by reducing object detectability. These findings can help develop mitigation strategies against adversarial object removal attacks that threaten safety-critical applications, such as vision-based pedestrian safety systems.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
基于视频的感知系统是智能交通系统（ITS）支撑道路安全关键应用的核心。然而，攻击者可能通过篡改视频帧，诱导下游感知模块失效，从而威胁弱势道路使用者的安全。

## 方法  
本文提出了一种新型攻击模型及端到端框架，实现针对视频安全关键系统的近实时目标移除攻击。攻击流程包括四个阶段：  
- **目标定位**：在每帧中定位待移除目标  
- **补丁检索**：从早期帧中提取连贯的背景补丁  
- **融合合成**：利用上下文感知的Alpha合成进行混合  
- **帧重建**：生成攻击后的视频帧  

实验在南卡罗来纳州互联车辆测试平台（SC-CVT）的交叉路口进行。

## 主要发现  
- **帧质量**：重建帧与原始帧高度相似，帧级PSNR超过40 dB，SSIM超过0.996  
- **攻击效果**：基于YOLO检测器，目标检测率降低达97.59%，帧级攻击成功率达94.48%  
- **执行效率**：在GPU硬件上，平均每帧处理时间为0.074至0.172秒，接近实时  
- **隐蔽性**：多种预训练的篡改检测模型均难以区分重建帧与真实帧  

## 结论与意义  
研究表明，视频感知系统易受隐蔽性目标移除攻击，该攻击可显著降低安全关键应用的性能。本研究的发现有助于制定针对此类对抗性攻击的防御策略，特别是保护基于视觉的行人安全系统。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This paper presents a novel end-to-end framework for near-real-time targeted object removal attacks on video-based safety-critical perception systems in intelligent transportation.

## Key Results  
- **Attack effectiveness**: Reduces YOLO-based object detections by up to 97.59%, with a frame-level success rate of 94.48%  
- **Frame quality**: Reconstructed frames achieve PSNR > 40 dB and SSIM > 0.996, maintaining high visual similarity to originals  
- **Performance**: Mean execution time of 0.074–0.172 seconds per frame on GPU, enabling near-real-time operation  
- **Stealthiness**: Multiple pretrained tamper-detection models fail to reliably distinguish attacked frames from authentic ones  

## Implication  
The findings reveal that video-based perception is vulnerable to stealthy object removal, which can degrade safety-critical applications. This work provides a foundation for developing mitigation strategies against such adversarial threats, particularly for vision-based pedestrian safety systems.

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving AI Verification via Minimal Information Disclosure
papers.abstract: AI verification crosses a trust boundary: a verifier must learn enough to establish an authorized claim, yet the same evidence can reveal sensitive details about the model, workload, or hardware. We introduce minimal information disclosure (MID), which designs and quantifies the information content of verifier-facing evidence itself. MID measures collateral leakage with conditional mutual information: what the release reveals about the protected property after the authorized result is known. MID is general by design: it can accommodate different verification goals, protected properties, evidence sources, and deployment constraints. To demonstrate MID's practicality, we evaluate it on four physical measurements and six verification tasks spanning execution type, hardware identity, compute scale, and model identity. These experiments use three mechanism-design variables--the evidence channel, collection policy, and release transformation--but MID is not limited to these choices and can accommodate other deployable mechanisms. Across these tasks, MID produces three releases with perfect held-out verification and zero measured collateral leakage, while the remaining tasks yield explicit privacy--utility frontiers. MID also supports ZKP-certified releases: we demonstrate our proposed linear-projection mechanism using a Groth16 zk-SNARK.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
AI验证跨越了信任边界：验证者必须获取足够信息以确认授权声明，但同一证据可能泄露模型、工作负载或硬件的敏感细节。本文提出**最小信息泄露（MID）**框架，旨在设计与量化验证证据本身的信息含量。

## 核心方法
- **度量标准**：MID使用条件互信息衡量附带泄露——即授权结果已知后，证据发布仍暴露的受保护属性信息量
- **通用设计**：框架可适配不同验证目标、受保护属性、证据来源及部署约束
- **机制变量**：通过三种机制设计变量（证据通道、采集策略、发布变换）实现信息控制

## 关键发现
在**4项物理测量**与**6项验证任务**（涵盖执行类型、硬件身份、计算规模、模型身份）的评估中：
- ✅ **3项任务**实现完美留出验证且零附带泄露
- 📊 其余任务生成明确的隐私-效用权衡前沿
- 🔐 支持ZKP认证发布：基于Groth16 zk-SNARK实现线性投影机制

## 创新意义
MID首次将验证证据的信息含量作为可设计、可量化的对象，而非仅依赖加密或混淆技术。该框架为隐私保护AI验证提供了系统化方法论，在保持验证准确性的同时，实现可证明的隐私保障边界，适用于多种实际部署场景。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper introduces **Minimal Information Disclosure (MID)**, a framework that designs and quantifies the information content of verifier-facing evidence in AI verification, addressing the fundamental trust-privacy tension.

## Method & Results
MID measures collateral leakage via conditional mutual information—what remains revealed about protected properties after authorized outputs are known. Evaluated on 4 physical measurements and 6 verification tasks (execution type, hardware identity, compute scale, model identity), MID achieves **perfect held-out verification with zero measured leakage** in 3 tasks, while others yield explicit privacy-utility frontiers. The framework's generality is demonstrated through three mechanism-design variables (evidence channel, collection policy, release transformation), with ZKP-certified releases implemented via Groth16 zk-SNARK.

## Significance
MID shifts privacy preservation from post-hoc encryption to **proactive evidence design**, enabling provable privacy guarantees without sacrificing verification accuracy—a practical solution for real-world AI verification deployments.

papers.title: Solving the Shortest Vector Problem in $2^{0.6039n}$ Time via Mid-point Hessian
papers.abstract: We present randomized algorithms for the shortest vector problem (SVP). For the $n$-dimensional lattice $\mathcal L$, our algorithms solve SVP in time $2^{0.6039n+o(n)}$ classically and $2^{0.5411n+o(n)}$ quantumly and space $2^{0.5n+o(n)}$, improving the previous best algorithm running in $2^{n+o(n)}$ time and space of Aggarwal, Dadush, Regev, and Stephens-Davidowitz [STOC'15].   Our algorithms heavily use the property of the Hessian of the periodic Gaussian function at the half shortest vector: For a shortest vector $v \in \mathcal L$, the Hessian at $v/2$ has the eigenvector close to $v$, which can be used to recover $v$ using the (preprocessing) bounded distance decoding algorithm. Given the periodicity modulo $\mathcal L$, the candidate midpoints are indexed by the parity classes in $\mathcal L/2\mathcal L$. Our algorithm searches for the class of a shortest vector by estimating the corresponding Hessians using discrete Gaussian samples.   We optimize the algorithm using random sublattice cosets and various sampling technique, achieving the final complexity. The optimization techniques may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
最短向量问题（SVP）是格密码学中的核心难题，其求解复杂度直接关系到众多密码方案的安全性评估。此前最优算法由Aggarwal等人于STOC'15提出，运行时间为$2^{n+o(n)}$（时间和空间均为指数级），而本文旨在突破这一瓶颈。

## 核心方法与创新
本文提出基于**中点Hessian矩阵**的随机化SVP求解算法，关键思想包括：
1. **几何性质挖掘**：对于最短向量$v$，周期高斯函数在$v/2$处的Hessian矩阵存在一个接近$v$方向的特殊特征向量，可利用预处理的**有界距离解码**（BDD）恢复$v$。
2. **奇偶类搜索**：利用格模$2\mathcal{L}$的周期性，将候选中点划分为奇偶类，通过离散高斯采样估计各奇偶类对应的Hessian，从而定位最短向量所属类别。
3. **复杂度优化**：结合**随机子格陪集**与多种采样技术，显著降低搜索空间与采样成本，最终实现：
   - 经典复杂度：$2^{0.6039n+o(n)}$时间
   - 量子复杂度：$2^{0.5411n+o(n)}$时间
   - 空间复杂度：$2^{0.5n+o(n)}$

## Core Contribution
We present randomized algorithms for the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP) achieving **$2^{0.6039n+o(n)}$ classical time** and **$2^{0.5411n+o(n)}$ quantum time**, with space $2^{0.5n+o(n)}$—improving the previous $2^{n+o(n)}$ bound by Aggarwal et al. (STOC'15).

## Key Ideas
- **Mid-point Hessian property**: For a shortest vector $v$, the Hessian of the periodic Gaussian at $v/2$ has an eigenvector aligned with $v$, enabling recovery via bounded distance decoding.
- **Parity-class search**: Candidate midpoints are indexed by $\mathcal{L}/2\mathcal{L}$; we estimate Hessians via discrete Gaussian sampling to identify the correct class.
- **Optimization techniques**: Random sublattice cosets and advanced sampling reduce complexity, potentially benefiting other lattice problems.

papers.title: Agentic Incident Response through Digital Twin-Enhanced Multiscale Planning
papers.abstract: Incident response is currently managed by security operators using predefined playbooks, resulting in slow, labor-intensive security decision-making processes. Consequently, there is a growing need for automated incident response planning. Decision-theoretic approaches based on control, optimization, and reinforcement learning have been proposed to automate such planning tasks with well-grounded approaches, yet most of which, while guaranteeing strong performance, are limited to abstract models and cannot be directly applied to operational systems. A promising approach to mitigate this limitation is to use the security knowledge embedded in large language models (LLMs) to develop agentic response systems. However, current agentic approaches rely on repeated invocations of the LLM to generate a response plan, which is unreliable and limits the planning horizon due to hallucination. In this paper, we develop a principled LLM-based planning method by combining decision-theoretic planning with LLM-generated response commands. The proposed agentic incident response approach uses a rollout planner to compute a high-level response strategy that allocates security resources (the tactical scale), which is then translated into executable commands by a lightweight LLM agent (the operational scale). Within this architecture, we use a digital twin that supports tactical planning through simulation and operational execution through emulation. Across three attack scenarios, our agentic approach reduces recovery execution time by 15.1\% on average and increases the recovery rate by 33.6\% over frontier LLM baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
当前事件响应（Incident Response）依赖安全运维人员执行预定义剧本，导致决策过程缓慢且劳动密集。虽然基于控制论、优化和强化学习的决策理论方法可自动化规划任务，但多数方法局限于抽象模型，难以直接应用于实际系统。大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体系统虽有潜力，但现有方法依赖反复调用LLM生成计划，易产生幻觉且规划视野有限。

## 方法创新
本文提出一种**基于原则的LLM规划方法**，融合决策理论规划与LLM生成命令。具体架构包括：
- **战术层（Tactical Scale）**：采用滚动规划器（Rollout Planner）计算高层响应策略，优化安全资源分配；
- **操作层（Operational Scale）**：由轻量级LLM智能体将策略翻译为可执行命令；
- **数字孪生（Digital Twin）**：同时支持战术规划的仿真推演与操作执行的模拟测试。

## 关键结果
在三个攻击场景中，与前沿LLM基线相比，本方法取得显著提升：
- **恢复执行时间**平均降低 **15.1%**
- **恢复成功率**平均提高 **33.6%**

## 核心贡献
1. 首次将决策理论规划与LLM生成能力系统结合，实现多尺度（战术-操作）的自动化响应；
2. 利用数字孪生桥接抽象规划与实际执行，提升计划可靠性；
3. 实证验证了混合架构在真实攻击场景中的有效性，为安全自动化提供新范式。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper presents a **principled LLM-based planning method** for automated incident response, combining decision-theoretic planning with LLM-generated commands. The proposed agentic system employs a **two-scale architecture**: a rollout planner computes high-level response strategies for resource allocation (tactical scale), which are translated into executable commands by a lightweight LLM agent (operational scale). A **digital twin** supports both simulation for tactical planning and emulation for operational execution.

## Key Findings
Across three attack scenarios, the approach achieves **15.1% average reduction in recovery execution time** and **33.6% improvement in recovery rate** over frontier LLM baselines. This work addresses critical limitations of prior agentic methods—unreliability and limited planning horizon due to hallucination—by grounding LLM outputs in decision-theoretic optimization. The results demonstrate that hybrid human-AI architectures can significantly enhance the speed and effectiveness of security operations, offering a scalable path toward autonomous incident response in operational systems.

papers.title: Antares: Foundation Models for Agentic Vulnerability Localization
papers.abstract: Vulnerability localization is a fundamental step in software security, requiring models to reason over large codebases and iteratively identify vulnerable implementations. We present Antares, a family of compact language models (350M, 1B, and 3B parameters) for agentic vulnerability localization. Based on IBM Granite base models, Antares is trained through a two-stage pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning on cybersecurity reasoning and repository exploration data with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards over vulnerable repositories. Across extensive evaluations, Antares-3B approaches GPT-5.5 while outperforming open-weight models over 200x larger in size. The Antares family further enables fast, low-cost local inference, completing a full 500-task evaluation sweep in approximately 15 minutes on a single H100 GPU, corresponding to an amortized evaluation time of under 2 seconds and less than $0.002 per task.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
漏洞定位是软件安全的基础任务，要求模型在大型代码库中推理并迭代定位易受攻击的实现。现有方案多依赖超大模型，部署成本高、推理速度慢，难以满足实际安全审计需求。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **Antares**——一个紧凑型语言模型家族（参数规模 350M、1B、3B），专为智能体式漏洞定位设计。基于 IBM Granite 基础模型，Antares 采用两阶段训练流水线：  
1. **监督微调**：在网络安全推理与代码库探索数据上微调，赋予模型领域知识与工具调用能力；  
2. **可验证奖励强化学习**：在真实脆弱代码库上，利用可验证的定位结果作为奖励信号，优化模型策略。

## 关键结果  
- **性能突破**：Antares-3B 在基准测试中接近 GPT-5.5 水平，同时显著超越体积大 200 倍以上的开源模型（如 70B 级模型）。  
- **极致效率**：整个家族支持快速低成本的本地推理。在单张 H100 GPU 上，完成全部 500 个任务的评估仅需约 **15 分钟**，平均每个任务耗时 **<2 秒**，成本 **<0.002 美元**。  
- **规模效益**：即使最小模型（350M）也展现出竞争力，证明高效训练策略可弥补参数规模劣势。

## 意义  
Antares 展示了“小而专”的模型设计理念：通过领域定制训练与强化学习，紧凑模型可在特定安全任务上匹敌甚至超越巨型通用模型，为资源受限环境下的智能安全分析提供了可行路径。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
We introduce **Antares**, a family of compact language models (350M–3B parameters) for agentic vulnerability localization, trained via a two-stage pipeline: supervised fine-tuning on cybersecurity reasoning and repository exploration, followed by reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards on vulnerable repositories.

## Key Findings  
- **Performance**: Antares-3B approaches GPT-5.5-level accuracy while outperforming open-weight models over 200× larger in size.  
- **Efficiency**: The full model family enables rapid local inference—completing a 500-task evaluation sweep in ~15 minutes on a single H100 GPU (amortized <2s and <$0.002 per task).  
- **Scalability**: Even the 350M variant shows competitive results, highlighting that domain-tuned compact models can rival massive general-purpose ones in specialized security tasks.

## Significance  
Antares demonstrates that targeted training and reinforcement learning can make small models practical and cost-effective for real-world vulnerability localization, offering a viable alternative to large-scale proprietary systems.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Representations for Binary Program Clustering: From Empirical Study to Retrieval-Augmented Learning
papers.abstract: Malware clustering is a critical task in cybersecurity that helps discover threats and analyze evolving malware families. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and tabular representation learning (TRL) have achieved breakthroughs in other domains, their application to binary program clustering (the task of clustering all incoming samples regardless of label) remains largely unexplored. This study presents the first systematic investigation of SSL and TRL methods for binary program clustering, conducted in two phases on the public Ember and Bodmas datasets. In Phase 1, we establish a performance ceiling by adapting prominent vision-based SSL models (BYOL, SimSiam, Barlow Twins, VICReg) for tabular data with supervised pair generation, finding that BYOL and SimSiam achieve performance comparable to fully supervised models, while Barlow Twins and VICReg significantly underperform. In Phase 2, we evaluate purely unsupervised TRL methods against strong baselines (PCA, Autoencoder, UMAP), demonstrating that VIME establishes a new state of the art for binary program clustering. Informed by these findings, we propose VIME-R, a retrieval-augmented extension of VIME that replaces random marginal-distribution corruption with retrieval-based augmentation to generate more informative training pairs. VIME-R further improves upon VIME, achieving 2.7\%-5.8\% higher Homogeneity on both datasets. Our results highlight retrieval-augmented tabular representation learning as a promising direction for enhancing automated malware analysis. Code will be made available.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机
恶意软件聚类是网络安全中的关键任务，有助于发现未知威胁并分析不断演变的恶意软件家族。尽管自监督学习（SSL）和表格表示学习（TRL）在其他领域取得了突破性进展，但它们应用于二进制程序聚类（即对所有输入样本进行无标签聚类）的研究仍十分匮乏。

## 研究方法
本研究首次系统性地探索了SSL与TRL方法在二进制程序聚类中的应用，并在公开的**Ember**和**Bodmas**数据集上分两个阶段开展实验：
- **阶段一**：将视觉领域主流SSL模型（BYOL、SimSiam、Barlow Twins、VICReg）适配至表格数据，并采用有监督的样本对生成策略，建立性能上限基准。
- **阶段二**：评估纯无监督TRL方法（如VIME），并与强基线（PCA、自动编码器、UMAP）进行对比。

基于阶段发现，我们提出**VIME-R**——一种检索增强的VIME扩展方法，用检索式增强替代随机边际分布损坏，以生成更具信息量的训练样本对。

## 主要发现与贡献
- **阶段一结果**：BYOL和SimSiam在表格数据上达到了与全监督模型相当的性能，而Barlow Twins和VICReg则显著落后。
- **阶段二结果**：VIME确立了二进制程序聚类的新最优性能（SOTA），优于所有基线方法。
- **创新点VIME-R**：在VIME基础上进一步提升了聚类效果，在两个数据集上的**同质性（Homogeneity）指标分别提升了2.7%至5.8%**，验证了检索增强策略的有效性。

## 结论与展望
本研究不仅填补了SSL/TRL在恶意软件聚类领域的研究空白，还证明了检索增强表格表示学习在自动化恶意软件分析中的巨大潜力。代码将开源，以促进后续研究。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper presents the first systematic study of self-supervised learning (SSL) and tabular representation learning (TRL) for **binary program clustering**, conducted on the public Ember and Bodmas datasets.

## Key Findings
- **Phase 1**: Vision-based SSL models (BYOL, SimSiam) adapted to tabular data with supervised pair generation achieve performance comparable to fully supervised models, while Barlow Twins and VICReg underperform significantly.
- **Phase 2**: The purely unsupervised TRL method VIME establishes a new state of the art for this task, outperforming strong baselines (PCA, Autoencoder, UMAP).

## Novel Method
We propose **VIME-R**, a retrieval-augmented extension of VIME that replaces random corruption with retrieval-based augmentation to generate more informative training pairs. VIME-R further improves clustering quality, achieving **2.7%–5.8% higher Homogeneity** on both datasets.

## Conclusion
Our results demonstrate that retrieval-augmented tabular representation learning is a promising direction for enhancing automated malware analysis. Code will be released to facilitate future research.

papers.title: TrainShield: Targeted Awareness for Cybersecurity Training
papers.abstract: In recent years, cybersecurity threats have increasingly exploited human behaviour rather than purely technical vulnerabilities, exposing the limits of traditional awareness programmes delivered outside real-world contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce TrainShield, an interaction paradigm for contextual cybersecurity training that embeds adaptive learning interventions directly within user workflows. The system integrates real-time risk detection (e.g., phishing and data loss prevention) with event-triggered hypermedia overlays that dynamically connect users to context-specific learning nodes embedded within their browsing workflow to deliver personalised micro-learning content and structured feedback tailored to the user's knowledge level and current context. This approach operationalises behavioural theories by transforming security incidents into immediate learning opportunities, shifting users from automatic to reflective decision-making at critical moments. We further formalise a design model that maps detected events to adaptive training instances, combining user modelling, context extraction, and large language model (LLM)-based content generation.   A preliminary study indicates that the approach is perceived as useful in increasing risk awareness and is preferred over lengthy and asynchronous traditional training formats, while also highlighting challenges in aligning generated content with user expectations. Overall, the results suggest that embedding contextual, event-driven training within everyday interactions is a promising direction for behaviour-oriented cybersecurity education.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
近年来，网络安全威胁日益利用人类行为而非纯粹的技术漏洞，传统脱离真实工作场景的培训项目暴露出明显局限。

## 方法创新：TrainShield系统
本文提出 **TrainShield**——一种情境化网络安全培训的交互范式，将自适应学习干预直接嵌入用户工作流。系统核心包括：
- **实时风险检测**：识别钓鱼攻击、数据泄露等威胁
- **事件触发的超媒体覆盖层**：在用户浏览过程中动态连接情境化学习节点
- **个性化微学习内容**：基于用户知识水平和当前情境，提供结构化反馈

该设计将行为理论落地，把安全事件转化为即时学习机会，在关键时刻促使用户从自动化决策转向反思性决策。作者还形式化了一个设计模型，将检测事件映射到自适应培训实例，整合用户建模、情境提取和基于大语言模型（LLM）的内容生成。

## 主要发现与意义
初步研究表明，该方法在提升风险意识方面被认为有效，且用户更偏好这种形式而非冗长异步的传统培训。同时，研究也揭示了生成内容与用户预期对齐的挑战。总体而言，将情境化、事件驱动的培训嵌入日常交互，是行为导向网络安全教育的一个有前景的方向。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper introduces **TrainShield**, a contextual cybersecurity training paradigm that embeds adaptive learning interventions directly into user workflows. It integrates real-time risk detection with event-triggered hypermedia overlays, delivering personalized micro-learning content tailored to users' knowledge and current context.

## Key Findings
A preliminary study shows the approach is perceived as useful for increasing risk awareness and is preferred over lengthy traditional training formats, though challenges remain in aligning LLM-generated content with user expectations. The work formalizes a design model mapping detected security events to adaptive training instances, operationalizing behavioral theories by transforming incidents into immediate learning opportunities. Results suggest that embedding event-driven training within everyday interactions is a promising direction for behavior-oriented cybersecurity education.

papers.title: A Multi-Objective AutoML-based Efficient Intrusion Detection System for EV Charging Networks
papers.abstract: Electric Vehicle Charging Systems (EVCSs) are increasingly connected with Internet of Things (IoT) devices, which improves charging intelligence but also expands their exposure to cyber-attacks. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are essential for securing EV charging networks; however, conventional Machine Learning (ML)-based IDSs often rely on manual model design and mainly optimize detection performance without fully considering inference latency and model size. In this paper, a Multi-Objective Automated ML (MOO-AutoML)-based efficient IDS is proposed for EVCS security. The proposed framework uses a lightweight training strategy and a LightGBM-based automated feature selection method to select compact feature subsets based on accumulated feature importance. Then, Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III (NSGA-III) jointly optimizes the feature selection threshold and key LightGBM hyperparameters under three objectives: maximizing weighted F1-score, minimizing 99th percentile inference latency ratio, and minimizing model size ratio. Experiments on CICEVSE2024 and CICIDS2017 show that the proposed MOO-AutoML IDS achieves competitive weighted F1-scores, lower P99 inference latency, and smaller model sizes than the compared methods. Overall, the results indicate that the proposed method can support accurate and efficient intrusion detection for EVCS and IoT security under practical deployment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
电动汽车充电系统（EVCS）与物联网（IoT）设备的深度融合提升了充电智能化水平，但也扩大了网络攻击暴露面。入侵检测系统（IDS）是保障充电网络安全的关键，但传统基于机器学习的IDS依赖人工模型设计，且主要优化检测性能，未充分考虑推理延迟与模型体积。  

## 研究方法  
本文提出一种基于多目标自动化机器学习（MOO-AutoML）的高效IDS框架。该框架首先采用轻量级训练策略和基于LightGBM的自动化特征选择方法，依据累积特征重要性筛选紧凑特征子集；随后，利用非支配排序遗传算法III（NSGA-III）联合优化特征选择阈值和LightGBM关键超参数，同时最大化加权F1分数、最小化99百分位推理延迟比和模型大小比三个目标。  

## 主要发现  
在CICEVSE2024和CICIDS2017数据集上的实验表明，所提MOO-AutoML IDS在保持竞争性加权F1分数的同时，相比对比方法实现了更低的P99推理延迟和更小的模型体积。  

## 创新点与意义  
本研究的核心创新在于将多目标优化引入AutoML管道，在检测精度、实时性和资源约束间取得平衡。结果表明，该方法能够在实际部署约束下为EVCS和IoT安全提供准确且高效的入侵检测支持，为智能电网边缘设备的安全防护提供了可行方案。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This paper proposes a Multi-Objective Automated ML (MOO-AutoML) framework for efficient intrusion detection in Electric Vehicle Charging Systems (EVCS). Unlike conventional ML-based IDS that rely on manual design and single-objective optimization, our method jointly optimizes detection performance, inference latency, and model size.  

## Method & Results  
The framework integrates a lightweight training strategy with LightGBM-based automated feature selection, and employs NSGA-III to co-optimize feature thresholds and hyperparameters under three objectives. Experiments on CICEVSE2024 and CICIDS2017 demonstrate that the proposed IDS achieves competitive weighted F1-scores while reducing P99 latency and model size compared to baselines.  

## Significance  
This work provides a practical solution for deploying accurate and resource-efficient intrusion detection in EVCS and IoT environments, addressing real-world constraints of latency and memory. The results highlight the potential of multi-objective AutoML in securing critical energy infrastructure.

papers.title: TurboRetry: Mitigating Large-Scale QUIC Handshake Floods with Off-the-Shelf DPU Offloading
papers.abstract: The modern transport protocol QUIC is designed to enhance network performance and security, but it remains vulnerable to handshake flooding attacks. Such attacks exhaust CPU resources by forcing the server to perform expensive cryptographic operations via a large number of handshaking requests. QUIC provides a built-in defense mechanism, the Retry mechanism, to mitigate these attacks. However, our experiments reveal that it can still become a performance bottleneck under large-scale QUIC handshake floods due to substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we design and implement TurboRetry, a split design, that offloads the Retry mechanism onto DPUs to efficiently mitigate QUIC handshake floods. TurboRetry partitions the tasks of the Retry into two categories, and then assigns them to the DPUs and the host, respectively. To preserve QUIC semantics and reduce the coordination overhead, TurboRetry designs an extended Retry token format and an efficient cooperation scheme. In addition, TurboRetry offloads the connection authorization task to the on-path DPA to further improve both performance and security. Our evaluation shows that TurboRetry outperforms the host-side implementation by a wide margin, improving throughput by 10-20$\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
QUIC 作为现代传输协议，在提升网络性能与安全性的同时，仍面临握手洪泛攻击（handshake flood）的威胁。攻击者通过海量握手请求迫使服务器执行昂贵的密码学运算，从而耗尽 CPU 资源。QUIC 内置的 Retry 机制虽能缓解此类攻击，但实验表明：在大规模握手洪泛下，Retry 机制自身的计算开销会使其成为新的性能瓶颈。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出 **TurboRetry**——一种基于拆分设计的 DPU 卸载方案，将 Retry 机制从主机卸载到商用 DPU（数据处理单元）上，以高效抵御 QUIC 握手洪泛。核心创新包括三点：  
1. **任务拆分**：将 Retry 处理逻辑划分为两类任务，分别分配给 DPU（负责无状态、计算密集的令牌生成与验证）与主机（负责有状态、需要上下文的连接管理），实现负载均衡。  
2. **扩展令牌格式与协作协议**：设计新的 Retry 令牌格式（携带必要状态信息），并制定低开销的 DPU-主机协作方案，在保持 QUIC 语义完整性的同时，大幅减少协调通信。  
3. **路径内授权**：将连接授权任务下沉至路径上的 DPA（数据处理加速器），进一步缩短响应路径，同时提升安全性（授权决策更贴近网络边缘）。

## 主要结果  
实验评估显示，与纯主机端实现相比，TurboRetry 在吞吐量上实现了 **10–20 倍**的提升，且在高并发洪泛场景下仍能保持稳定的低延迟响应。该方案证明了使用现成商用 DPU 即可高效缓解大规模 QUIC 握手攻击，无需专用硬件或修改 QUIC 协议栈。

---
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
TurboRetry is a split-design system that offloads QUIC's Retry mechanism onto commodity DPUs to defend against large-scale handshake floods. By partitioning Retry tasks into DPU-side (stateless, compute-intensive) and host-side (stateful, context-dependent) categories, it eliminates the CPU bottleneck while preserving QUIC semantics through an extended token format and a low-overhead cooperation scheme. Additionally, connection authorization is moved to the on-path DPA, improving both performance and security. Evaluation shows a **10–20× throughput improvement** over host-side implementations under flood stress, demonstrating that off-the-shelf DPUs can effectively mitigate QUIC handshake attacks without protocol modifications.

papers.title: Stylometric Defenses Against Author Impersonation in Software Repositories
papers.abstract: Software supply-chain attacks increasingly exploit an identity gap where compromised maintainer accounts authorize malicious changes. This work evaluates patch-level authorship verification as a behavioral defense layer, showing that stylometric analysis can operate not only on full source files but also on patch-level commits. We fine-tune a cross-modal transformer on more than 20 years of Linux kernel commit history to embed code diffs and commit messages into a unified stylometric space, achieving ROC AUC of 0.93 for open-world authorship verification. We then use these representations in a streaming anomaly detector suited to continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) settings. We validate the pipeline on two retrospective supply-chain incidents involving different patch characteristics: the 2021 PHP backdoor and the 2026 ForceMemo/GlassWorm campaign. Without retraining, the proposed detector surfaces both PHP forged commits within approximately 1% of the maintainer audit queue and ranks the 28 scoreable ForceMemo spoofs with a median per-repository review burden of 0.8%. These results indicate that cross-modal patch-level embeddings can support behavioral triage against author impersonation in real-world repositories.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
软件供应链攻击日益猖獗，攻击者常利用**维护者身份失窃**这一身份缺口，在代码仓库中植入恶意提交。现有防护多聚焦于代码内容审查，缺乏对**提交者行为一致性**的验证。

## 方法创新
本研究提出一种**补丁级作者身份验证**机制，作为行为防御层：
- **跨模态Transformer模型**：基于Linux内核20余年提交历史微调，将代码diff与提交消息嵌入统一文体特征空间
- **流式异常检测器**：适配CI/CD场景，实现实时作者身份可疑度评分
- 无需重训练即可迁移至新仓库

## 关键结果
| 验证场景 | 性能指标 |
|---------|---------|
| 开放世界作者验证 | ROC AUC = 0.93 |
| 2021 PHP后门（2个伪造提交） | 均在审计队列前1%被检出 |
| 2026 ForceMemo/GlassWorm（28个可评分伪造） | 每仓库中位审查负担仅0.8% |

## 核心贡献
1. 首次证明**补丁级文体分析**可有效防御作者冒充攻击
2. 跨模态嵌入能捕捉代码与文本的联合作者风格特征
3. 极低的审查负担（<1%）使该方案具备实际部署可行性

Retrospective validation on the 2021 PHP backdoor and 2026 ForceMemo/GlassWorm incidents shows all forged commits surface within ~1% of the audit queue, with a median per-repository review burden of 0.8%, requiring no retraining. Results demonstrate that cross-modal patch embeddings enable practical behavioral triage against author impersonation in real-world repositories.

papers.title: D-MUTRA: DLT-based MUTual Remote Attestation for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) comprise autonomous software agents that collaborate to perform complex tasks in critical cyber-physical domains, including multi-robot coordination and the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). In such distributed environments, a compromised agent may execute modified software while appearing trustworthy, causing other agents to act on false information and corrupting the mission. Agents must therefore establish and maintain mutual trust throughout operation. Remote attestation (RA) is a well-established technique for this purpose, enabling a remote verifier to assess the integrity of a potentially compromised prover device. However, conventional RA approaches face significant limitations in MAS: integrity guarantees are restricted to boot or application-load time, designs rely on centralized trusted verifiers or security hardware, and attestation records lack transparency and auditability. To address these limitations, this paper presents D-MUTRA, a blockchain-based framework that introduces a mutual RA protocol in which agents measure their runtime integrity while verifying that of their peers, acting as both prover and verifier. The framework operates entirely in software and relies on two components: a Security-as-a-Service that instruments agents with lightweight measurement and verification capabilities, and a smart contract that coordinates the attestation protocol in a decentralized and transparent manner. We implement a proof-of-concept on a private Ethereum blockchain using Hyperledger Besu and evaluate it in a swarm robotics scenario built with Robot Operating System (ROS) and the Gazebo simulator. Results show that D-MUTRA enables agents to continuously attest one another, detects malicious software modifications, and scales to large deployments with negligible overhead on protected applications.
papers.summary_zh:
## 摘要
**背景**：多智能体系统（MAS）由自主软件代理组成，在关键网络物理领域（如多机器人协调、工业物联网）协作执行复杂任务。此类分布式环境中，被攻陷的代理可能运行被篡改的软件却仍显可信，导致其他代理基于虚假信息行动并破坏任务。因此，代理必须在运行期间建立并维持相互信任。

**问题**：远程证明（RA）虽为成熟技术，但传统方法在MAS中面临重大局限：完整性保障局限于启动或应用加载时；设计依赖中心化可信验证器或安全硬件；证明记录缺乏透明性与可审计性。

**方法**：本文提出 **D-MUTRA**，一种基于区块链的框架，引入**相互远程证明协议**——代理在验证对等方运行时完整性的同时，也度量自身完整性，同时扮演证明者与验证者角色。框架完全基于软件，由两组件构成：①**安全即服务（Security-as-a-Service）**，为代理注入轻量级度量与验证能力；②**智能合约**，以去中心化且透明的方式协调证明协议。

**实验与结果**：我们在私有以太坊（Hyperledger Besu）上实现概念验证，并在基于ROS与Gazebo的群体机器人场景中评估。结果表明，D-MUTRA支持代理持续相互证明，能检测恶意软件篡改，且对大规部署的可扩展性强，对受保护应用的开销可忽略不计。

**创新点**：去中心化互证（无需中心验证器）；运行时连续完整性监测；区块链提供透明可审计的证明记录；纯软件实现，降低硬件依赖。
papers.summary_en:
## Summary
Multi-agent systems (MAS) face critical trust challenges: compromised agents may run altered software while appearing benign, misleading peers and corrupting missions. Conventional remote attestation (RA) methods are limited by boot-time-only guarantees, reliance on centralized verifiers or trusted hardware, and non-transparent attestation records. This paper presents **D-MUTRA**, a blockchain-based mutual RA framework where agents act as both provers and verifiers, continuously measuring their own runtime integrity while attesting peers. The software-only design leverages a Security-as-a-Service component for lightweight measurement and a smart contract for decentralized, transparent protocol coordination. A proof-of-concept on Hyperledger Besu (private Ethereum) with a ROS/Gazebo swarm robotics scenario demonstrates that D-MUTRA enables continuous mutual attestation, detects malicious modifications, and scales to large deployments with negligible application overhead. Key innovations include eliminating centralized verifiers, achieving runtime-level integrity monitoring, and providing auditable attestation logs via blockchain.
papers.summary:
## 摘要
**背景**：多智能体系统（MAS）由自主软件代理组成，在关键网络物理领域（如多机器人协调、工业物联网）协作执行复杂任务。此类分布式环境中，被攻陷的代理可能运行被篡改的软件却仍显可信，导致其他代理基于虚假信息行动并破坏任务。因此，代理必须在运行期间建立并维持相互信任。

**问题**：远程证明（RA）虽为成熟技术，但传统方法在MAS中面临重大局限：完整性保障局限于启动或应用加载时；设计依赖中心化可信验证器或安全硬件；证明记录缺乏透明性与可审计性。

**方法**：本文提出 **D-MUTRA**，一种基于区块链的框架，引入**相互远程证明协议**——代理在验证对等方运行时完整性的同时，也度量自身完整性，同时扮演证明者与验证者角色。框架完全基于软件，由两组件构成：①**安全即服务（Security-as-a-Service）**，为代理注入轻量级度量与验证能力；②**智能合约**，以去中心化且透明的方式协调证明协议。

**实验与结果**：我们在私有以太坊（Hyperledger Besu）上实现概念验证，并在基于ROS与Gazebo的群体机器人场景中评估。结果表明，D-MUTRA支持代理持续相互证明，能检测恶意软件篡改，且对大规部署的可扩展性强，对受保护应用的开销可忽略不计。

**创新点**：去中心化互证（无需中心验证器）；运行时连续完整性监测；区块链提供透明可审计的证明记录；纯软件实现，降低硬件依赖。

papers.title: GalSAS-SDR-SIM: An End-to-End Simulation Platform for Galileo Signal Authentication Service
papers.abstract: Galileo is developing a Signal Authentication Service (SAS) that integrates Open Service Navigation Message Authentication (OSNMA) on the E1 band with Spreading Code Authentication (SCA) on the E6 band to strengthen its resilience to spoofing attacks. As Galileo SAS is still under development, access to realistic and controllable SAS signals remains limited, hindering both the early development of compatible receivers and reproducible research on signal authentication. To bridge this gap, this paper presents GalSAS-SDR-SIM, an open-source software-defined radio (SDR) simulation platform that emulates the SAS workflow by coupling E6 code encryption with the OSNMA key-disclosure process. The platform allows flexible SAS configuration of code encryption parameters to accommodate receivers with different computational capabilities. It also supports the concurrent generation of Galileo E1, E5b, and E6 signals for user-defined locations and times, and OSNMA cross-satellite configurations. Experimental results demonstrate simultaneous verification of navigation messages and spreading codes. We further evaluate SAS authentication performance and computational resource costs under different SAS configurations. Implemented according to publicly available official specifications, GalSAS-SDR-SIM provides a practical tool for accelerating SAS-capable receiver development and supporting the research community in evaluating and improving Galileo signal-authentication techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机
Galileo（伽利略）卫星导航系统正在开发信号认证服务（SAS），该服务在E1频段集成开放服务导航消息认证（OSNMA），并在E6频段集成扩频码认证（SCA），以增强系统对抗欺骗攻击的韧性。然而，由于Galileo SAS仍处于开发阶段，研究人员和接收机制造商难以获取真实且可控的SAS信号，这严重阻碍了兼容接收机的早期开发以及信号认证技术的可复现研究。

## 方法创新
本文提出了 **GalSAS-SDR-SIM**，一个开源的软件定义无线电（SDR）仿真平台。该平台通过耦合E6频段扩频码加密与OSNMA密钥披露过程，完整模拟了SAS工作流程。其核心创新包括：
- **灵活配置**：支持对扩频码加密参数进行灵活设置，以适应不同计算能力的接收机
- **多信号并发**：支持在用户指定的时间和地点并发生成Galileo E1、E5b和E6三频段信号
- **跨卫星支持**：支持OSNMA跨卫星配置，满足多星座认证场景需求

## 主要结果与贡献
实验结果表明，该平台能够实现导航消息与扩频码的**同步验证**，并进一步评估了不同SAS配置下的认证性能与计算资源开销。平台严格依据公开的官方规范实现，为加速SAS兼容接收机开发提供了实用工具，同时为研究社区评估和改进Galileo信号认证技术奠定了可复现的实验基础。

The platform offers flexible configuration of code encryption parameters to suit receivers with varying computational capabilities, and supports concurrent generation of Galileo E1, E5b, and E6 signals for user-defined locations/times, including cross-satellite OSNMA setups. Experimental results demonstrate simultaneous verification of navigation messages and spreading codes, along with performance and resource-cost evaluation under different SAS configurations. Built strictly on public official specifications, this tool accelerates SAS-capable receiver development and provides a reproducible testbed for advancing Galileo signal-authentication research.

papers.title: Multi-Backbone Self-Supervised Ensembles for Audio Deepfake Detection and a Cross-Track Analysis of Generation-Detection Asymmetry
papers.abstract: This paper describes the participation of team "Go-To-Germany" in the ImageCLEF 2026 Audio Deepfake Detection and Generation task. Our detection system, built on a four-backbone self-supervised learning (SSL) ensemble combining WavLM-Large, Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M, ECAPA-TDNN, and x-vector representations, achieved a final score of 0.9522 on the official ImageCLEF 2026 evaluation, with perfect accuracy (1.0000) on participant-generated deepfakes and 0.8875 on the held-out organizer ground-truth real data. For the Generation sub-task, our official team submission, an F5-TTS v1 baseline processed with a uniform reverberation pass and submitted as a deliberate anti-forensic probe, ranked first with a final score of 0.4304 (word error rate (WER) 4.99%, character error rate (CER) 2.07%); details of our four-model program (GLM-TTS, F5-TTS, XTTS v2, CosyVoice3), from which the official entry was drawn, appear in the paper. We present a cross-track analysis revealing a pronounced asymmetry: our detection system identifies 100% of participant-generated deepfakes, while our official generation entry, despite ranking first in the Audio Generation sub-task and evading 61.4% and 56.2% of participant and organizer detectors, attains a Final Score of 0.4304 against 0.9522 on the Detection side. We further report falsification-based ablation experiments (LOSO 56-speaker cross-validation, three-region backbone geometry, bootstrap confidence intervals, and PCA analysis) that motivate our architectural-insurance hypothesis for multi-backbone SSL ensembling. We complement these results with five cross-track insights and five pre-registered falsification experiments connecting generation-side evasion to detection-side design decisions, and we openly report an 11.25% false-positive gap on held-out organizer real recordings as the principal open challenge for deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述
本文报告了团队“Go-To-Germany”在ImageCLEF 2026音频深度伪造检测与生成任务中的参与情况。研究核心包含三项贡献：**检测系统**、**生成系统**及**跨赛道不对称性分析**。

## 检测系统：多骨干自监督集成
我们构建了基于**四骨干自监督学习（SSL）集成**的检测模型，融合WavLM-Large、Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M、ECAPA-TDNN和x-vector四种表征。在官方评测中取得**0.9522的最终分数**：对参与者生成的深度伪造音频检测准确率达100%（1.0000），但对主办方保留的真实录音准确率为0.8875，暴露了**11.25%的假阳性差距**——这是部署中面临的主要挑战。

## 生成系统：反取证探针
官方提交的生成条目采用F5-TTS v1基线，经均匀混响处理后作为**刻意的反取证探针**，在生成子任务中排名第一（最终分数0.4304，词错误率4.99%，字符错误率2.07%）。论文详细描述了四模型方案（GLM-TTS、F5-TTS、XTTS v2、CosyVoice3）。

## 跨赛道不对称性分析
核心发现呈现**显著不对称**：检测系统能识别100%的参与者生成音频，而官方生成条目虽排名第一，且成功规避了61.4%的参与者检测器和56.2%的组织者检测器，其0.4304的生成分数远低于检测侧的0.9522。这种不对称揭示了生成与检测之间的深层博弈关系。

## 消融实验与理论假设
通过**伪造消融实验**（LOSO 56说话人交叉验证、三区域骨干几何分析、bootstrap置信区间和PCA分析），我们提出了**架构保险假说**：多骨干SSL集成的鲁棒性源于不同预训练表征在伪造痕迹上的互补覆盖。研究还提供了五项跨赛道洞见和五个预注册的证伪实验，将生成侧规避与检测侧设计决策联系起来。

## 主要贡献
- 首个公开的多骨干SSL集成音频深度伪造检测方案
- 排名第一的反取证生成条目及其完整技术细节
- 系统性的跨赛道不对称性量化分析
- 可复现的消融实验框架与开放问题声明
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contributions
This paper presents our dual-track system for the ImageCLEF 2026 Audio Deepfake task. Our **detection system**, a four-backbone self-supervised ensemble (WavLM-Large, Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M, ECAPA-TDNN, x-vector), achieved a final score of **0.9522**, with 100% accuracy on participant deepfakes but 0.8875 on held-out organizer real data (an 11.25% false-positive gap). Our **generation entry**, an anti-forensic F5-TTS v1 baseline with reverberation, ranked first (score 0.4304, WER 4.99%, CER 2.07%) while evading 61.4% of participant and 56.2% of organizer detectors.

The central finding is a **pronounced generation-detection asymmetry**: perfect detection of participant deepfakes contrasts with our own entry's high evasion rate, suggesting different failure modes for known versus novel generation pipelines. Falsification-based ablations (LOSO cross-validation, backbone geometry, PCA) support an **architectural-insurance hypothesis**—multi-backbone SSL ensembling provides complementary coverage of artifact patterns. We report five cross-track insights and five pre-registered falsification experiments linking generation-side evasion to detection-side design choices. The open challenge remains closing the false-positive gap on real-world organizer data, critical for practical deployment.

papers.title: EntailLLM: Verifying LLM-Generated Vulnerability Discovery Paths with Domain Knowledge via Logic Programming
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to reason about software vulnerabilities, but their outputs can silently violate domain knowledge, limiting their reliability in safety-critical settings such as medical devices. Prior work either treats that output as a prediction to be scored or constrains it to walks within a single knowledge graph; neither checks whether reasoning over a binary is consistent with an independent body of domain knowledge. We present EntailLLM, which validates each LLM-proposed analyst path by entailment: the path is a traversal of the binary's function call graph, the domain knowledge is represented in a separate graph, and verification aligns the two under temporal annotated logic. Across three CWE classes, four LLMs, three prompting strategies, and seven binaries varying in size from 405 to 12,696 function call-graph nodes, domain knowledge raises pooled entailment from 78% to 98%, with entailment decreasing in only 3% of the experiments. EntailLLM is deployed end-to-end on real medical-device binaries, reaching 98% pooled entailment without per-device tuning. Our system inherits the formal guarantees of generalized annotated logic, providing logical verification of LLM output that is both explainable and grounded in well-defined semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型（LLM）在软件漏洞推理中应用日益广泛，但其输出可能**静默违反领域知识**，在医疗设备等安全关键场景中可靠性受限。现有方法要么将输出作为待评分预测，要么将其约束在单一知识图谱内行走，均**无法验证二进制推理与独立领域知识的一致性**。

## 方法创新
本文提出 **EntailLLM** 系统，通过**蕴含验证**（entailment）校验每条LLM提出的分析路径：
- **路径表示**：将LLM输出建模为二进制函数调用图上的遍历路径
- **领域知识**：以独立图结构表示漏洞领域知识
- **逻辑对齐**：在**时间标注逻辑**（temporal annotated logic）下对齐路径与知识图，实现形式化验证

该方法继承了广义标注逻辑的**形式化保证**，提供可解释、语义明确的逻辑验证。

## 实验结果
- **覆盖范围**：3个CWE类别、4种LLM、3种提示策略、7个二进制程序（函数调用图节点数从405到12,696）
- **核心效果**：领域知识将**池化蕴含率从78%提升至98%**，仅3%实验出现下降
- **实际部署**：在真实医疗设备二进制上端到端运行，**无需逐设备调参**即达98%池化蕴含率

## 主要贡献
1. 首次将LLM漏洞推理与独立领域知识通过逻辑编程进行**蕴含验证**
2. 形式化保证下实现**可解释的漏洞路径校验**
3. 在医疗设备真实场景中验证了**跨模型、跨提示策略的鲁棒性**

---
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
**EntailLLM** validates LLM-generated vulnerability analysis paths via **entailment checking** under temporal annotated logic. Each proposed path (a traversal of the binary's function call graph) is aligned against a separate domain-knowledge graph, enabling formal verification that prior scoring-based or single-graph approaches lack.

## Key Results
Across 3 CWE classes, 4 LLMs, 3 prompting strategies, and 7 binaries (405–12,696 call-graph nodes), domain knowledge **raises pooled entailment from 78% to 98%**, with degradation in only 3% of experiments. Deployed end-to-end on real medical-device binaries, it achieves **98% pooled entailment without per-device tuning**.

## Significance
The system inherits formal guarantees from generalized annotated logic, providing **explainable, semantically grounded verification** of LLM output—a critical step toward trustworthy AI in safety-critical software analysis.

papers.title: Benign Alone, Harmful Together: Exploiting Experience Composition in Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Self-evolving large language model agents improve their capabilities by distilling interaction trajectories into persistent experiences. Yet this mechanism introduces a new safety risk: experiences that are benign in isolation may jointly weaken an agent's safety boundary when accumulated and reused across sessions. Existing memory attacks typically require direct memory access or induce explicitly malicious records, limiting their stealthiness and applicability. We propose EvoBreak, an experience-conditioned sequential attack that operates through individually benign attack-stage tasks and induced experiences. EvoBreak repeatedly observes the experiences distilled by the victim, identifies uncovered target-relevant requirements, and adaptively acquires complementary experiences before reformulating the final query to activate them jointly. To support training, we introduce BreakGym, a structure-first synthesis pipeline that generates decomposable safety-sensitive targets with diverse dependency structures. EvoBreak is optimized using rejection-sampling supervised fine-tuning and Hint-guided GRPO. Experiments across self-evolving frameworks, victim backbones, pre-evolution domains, and safety benchmarks demonstrate that EvoBreak consistently outperforms existing attacks while maintaining high benignness. - 在多种自进化框架、受害者骨干模型、进化前领域及安全基准测试中，EvoBreak 持续优于现有攻击方法，同时保持较高的良性度（单个阶段任务均无害）。
- 实验结果揭示了**良性经验组合**作为自进化智能体中持久攻击面的存在，即安全风险并非来自单一恶意输入，而是来自经验在时间维度上的**组合效应**。

**意义**：该研究首次系统性地证明，自进化机制中经验的累积性复用本身即构成安全漏洞，为设计更鲁棒的自进化安全防护（如经验隔离、组合审计）提供了关键启示。

papers.title: MNC: Scope-Bound Semantic Declassification for Private LLM-Agent Communication
papers.abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can expose protected state through internal messages, tool arguments, logs, and persistent memory even when their public outputs appear innocuous. Existing privacy prompts, redaction methods, and source-level access controls restrict surface content or data access, but do not specify what a legitimately informed agent should disclose or how that disclosure may be reused downstream. We introduce Minimum-Necessary Communication (MNC), a typed semantic-declassification protocol that selects a task-sufficient disclosure from an application-authored candidate family and binds it to explicit recipient, purpose, forwarding, lifetime, logging, and memory scopes. A reference monitor enforces these scopes across subsequent operations, while a history-aware extension accounts for inference risk accumulated over repeated disclosures. Controlled semantic-join, memory, probing, and longitudinal experiments show that conventional defenses can preserve protocol-level utility while exposing substantial additional inference signal. Under identical receipt text, MNC preserves authorized delivery while blocking unauthorized forwarding, logging, durable storage, and retrieval after expiration that a text-only semantic declassifier permits. Two-backbone MAGPIE executions further show that mediated disclosures propagate through subsequent planning, tool use, coordination, and memory retrieval. These results support scope-bound semantic declassification as a practical communication boundary for private LLM-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景
多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统即使公开输出看似无害，也可能通过内部消息、工具参数、日志和持久记忆泄露受保护状态。现有隐私提示、文本脱敏和源代码级访问控制仅限制表面内容或数据访问，却未规定“合法知情的智能体”应披露什么，以及披露信息如何在后续流程中被复用。

## 核心方法
本文提出**最小必要通信（MNC）**协议——一种类型化的语义去分类机制：
- 从应用作者定义的候选信息族中，选取足以完成任务的最小披露集合；
- 将披露与明确的接收者、用途、转发权限、有效期、日志策略和记忆范围绑定；
- 通过**引用监视器**在后续所有操作中强制执行这些范围约束；
- 引入**历史感知扩展**，累计评估多次披露带来的推理风险。

## 主要发现
1. **对比实验**：在语义连接、记忆、探测和纵向场景中，传统防御虽能保持协议级效用，却暴露了额外推理信号；而MNC在相同接收文本下，可阻止未经授权的转发、日志记录、持久存储及过期后的检索——这些操作是纯文本语义去分类器所允许的。
2. **端到端验证**：在两个骨干模型（MAGPIE）执行中，受控披露能正确传播至后续规划、工具调用、智能体协调和记忆检索环节，且全程不越界。

## 创新与意义
MNC首次将“范围绑定”引入LLM智能体通信的语义去分类，为私有多智能体系统提供了可验证的通信边界。该工作填补了“披露后复用控制”的空白，为构建可审计、可问责的隐私保护智能体协作框架奠定了基础。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper introduces **Minimum-Necessary Communication (MNC)**, a typed semantic-declassification protocol for multi-agent LLM systems. Unlike existing prompts, redaction, or access controls, MNC selects a task-sufficient disclosure from an application-authored candidate family and binds it to explicit recipient, purpose, forwarding, lifetime, logging, and memory scopes—enforced by a reference monitor across all downstream operations.

## Key Results
Experiments show that conventional defenses preserve protocol-level utility while leaking substantial inference signals, whereas MNC blocks unauthorized forwarding, logging, durable storage, and post-expiration retrieval under identical receipt text. End-to-end MAGPIE executions confirm that mediated disclosures correctly propagate through planning, tool use, coordination, and memory retrieval without scope violation.

## Significance
MNC establishes scope-bound semantic declassification as a practical communication boundary for private LLM-agent systems, filling the critical gap of post-disclosure reuse control. This work enables auditable, privacy-preserving multi-agent collaboration with verifiable guarantees.

papers.title: Performance analysis of Machine learning algorithms for predicting malware
papers.abstract: Malware poses a persistent and evolving threat to modern computing systems, making accurate and timely detection a critical cybersecurity challenge. Traditional signature-based antivirus solutions often fail to identify newly emerging malware, leaving systems vulnerable until updated signatures become available. To address this limitation, this study proposes a machine learning-based malware detection framework capable of distinguishing malicious software from benign applications with high accuracy. Several state-of-the-art classification algorithms, including Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), XGBoost, and Extra Trees Classifier, were evaluated and compared using a benchmark malware dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that XGBoost achieved the best performance, attaining an accuracy of 98.62%, outperforming the other evaluated models. To demonstrate the practical applicability of the proposed approach, a real-time client-server malware detection system was also developed using the Flask framework, enabling efficient classification of executable files as malicious or benign. The findings highlight the effectiveness of advanced machine learning techniques for enhancing malware detection and contribute toward the development of intelligent and scalable cybersecurity solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
恶意软件（Malware）对现代计算系统构成持续且不断演变的威胁，快速准确地检测恶意代码是网络安全领域的核心挑战。传统基于特征签名的防病毒方案往往无法识别新型恶意软件，在签名库更新前系统将长期暴露于风险之中。

## 研究方法
本研究提出一种基于机器学习的恶意软件检测框架，旨在高精度区分恶意软件与良性应用。研究采用基准恶意软件数据集，系统评估并比较了四种先进分类算法：
- **人工神经网络（ANN）**
- **支持向量机（SVM）**
- **XGBoost**
- **极端随机树（Extra Trees Classifier）**

## 主要发现
实验结果表明，**XGBoost 表现最优**，检测准确率达到 **98.62%**，显著优于其他对比模型。为验证方法的实际可用性，研究团队还基于 Flask 框架开发了**实时客户端-服务器恶意软件检测系统**，能够高效地将可执行文件分类为恶意或良性。

## 创新与贡献
- 系统对比了多种主流机器学习算法在恶意软件检测任务上的性能
- 构建了可部署的实时检测原型系统，弥合了学术研究与工程实践之间的差距
- 证实了先进机器学习技术在增强恶意软件检测方面的有效性，为开发智能化、可扩展的网络安全解决方案提供了实证支持

---

## Methods & Results
Four state-of-the-art classifiers—**ANN, SVM, XGBoost, and Extra Trees**—were evaluated on a benchmark malware dataset. **XGBoost achieved the highest accuracy of 98.62%**, outperforming all other models. To bridge research and practice, a **real-time Flask-based client-server detection system** was also developed, enabling efficient classification of executable files as malicious or benign.

## Significance
The findings demonstrate the strong potential of advanced ML techniques for enhancing malware detection accuracy, contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and deployable cybersecurity solutions.

papers.title: A Multimodal Automatic Redteaming Evaluation based on Atomic Jailbreak Strategy Decoupling and Combination
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress in image-text comprehension and generation, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that can trigger harmful outputs and pose serious safety concerns. Existing multimodal jailbreak attacks have shown the feasibility of such attacks, but they still face two fundamental challenges: the lack of a atomic multi-modal strategy space, the absence of a concise and efficient executable framework beyond human-craft experience. To address these challenges, we first decompose the text-image jailbreak strategy space into three levels: structural, semantic, and syntactic, constructing a jailbreak strategy set encompassing both text and image modalities to systematically achieve combined coverage of different attack types. Then we propose a multimodal automated red team jailbreak method named Hierarchical Atomic Combination Attack (HACA). Specifically, based on a six-dimensional strategy space, a cross-modal joint planner is used to select and combine the different atomic jailbreak strategy for subsequent jailbreak command generation. Finally, at the implementation level, we explore to apply a unified generate executor to directly generate jailbreak instructions based on the selected multi-modal strategies. A series of experiments show that our automated red team method can achieve an attack success rate of average 95.48\% against five mainstream MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图像-文本理解与生成方面取得了显著进展，但仍易受越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）影响，可能产生有害输出，引发严重安全风险。现有攻击方法虽已证明可行性，却面临两大核心挑战：**缺乏原子化的多模态策略空间**，以及**缺乏超越人工经验的简洁高效可执行框架**。

## 方法创新  
针对上述问题，本文首先将文本-图像越狱策略空间**解耦为三个层级**：结构层、语义层和句法层，构建了涵盖文本与图像两种模态的越狱策略集，系统性地实现了对不同攻击类型的组合覆盖。在此基础上，提出一种名为 **HACA（Hierarchical Atomic Combination Attack，层级原子组合攻击）** 的多模态自动化红队越狱方法。该方法基于六维策略空间，利用**跨模态联合规划器**（cross-modal joint planner）选择并组合不同的原子越狱策略，用于后续越狱指令生成；在实现层面，探索使用**统一生成执行器**（unified generate executor），直接基于所选多模态策略生成越狱指令。

## 实验结果  
系列实验表明，本文的自动化红队方法在**五个主流MLLMs**上实现了**平均95.48%的攻击成功率**，显著验证了策略解耦与组合框架的有效性和通用性。

## 核心贡献  
1. 首次系统性地将多模态越狱策略解耦为结构、语义、句法三层原子空间；  
2. 提出HACA框架，实现跨模态策略的自动化选择、组合与执行，降低对人工经验的依赖；  
3. 在多个主流模型上达到高攻击成功率，为多模态安全评估提供了可复用的自动化基准工具。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This paper addresses two fundamental gaps in multimodal jailbreak attacks: the lack of an atomic strategy space and the absence of an automated executable framework. We decompose the text-image jailbreak strategy space into **three hierarchical levels** (structural, semantic, syntactic), constructing a comprehensive strategy set covering both modalities.

## Method & Results  
We propose **HACA (Hierarchical Atomic Combination Attack)**, a multimodal automated red-team method. It employs a **cross-modal joint planner** to select and combine atomic strategies from a six-dimensional space, followed by a **unified generator** that directly produces jailbreak instructions. Experiments on **five mainstream MLLMs** demonstrate an **average attack success rate of 95.48%**, validating the effectiveness and generalizability of our decoupling-and-combination framework.

## Significance  
This work provides a systematic, reproducible, and high-performance automated red-teaming tool for multimodal safety evaluation, reducing reliance on human-crafted attack templates.
papers.summary:
## 研究背景  
多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图像-文本理解与生成方面取得了显著进展，但仍易受越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）影响，可能产生有害输出，引发严重安全风险。现有攻击方法虽已证明可行性，却面临两大核心挑战：**缺乏原子化的多模态策略空间**，以及**缺乏超越人工经验的简洁高效可执行框架**。

## 方法创新  
针对上述问题，本文首先将文本-图像越狱策略空间**解耦为三个层级**：结构层、语义层和句法层，构建了涵盖文本与图像两种模态的越狱策略集，系统性地实现了对不同攻击类型的组合覆盖。在此基础上，提出一种名为 **HACA（Hierarchical Atomic Combination Attack，层级原子组合攻击）** 的多模态自动化红队越狱方法。该方法基于六维策略空间，利用**跨模态联合规划器**（cross-modal joint planner）选择并组合不同的原子越狱策略，用于后续越狱指令生成；在实现层面，探索使用**统一生成执行器**（unified generate executor），直接基于所选多模态策略生成越狱指令。

## 实验结果  
系列实验表明，本文的自动化红队方法在**五个主流MLLMs**上实现了**平均95.48%的攻击成功率**，显著验证了策略解耦与组合框架的有效性和通用性。

## 核心贡献  
1. 首次系统性地将多模态越狱策略解耦为结构、语义、句法三层原子空间；  
2. 提出HACA框架，实现跨模态策略的自动化选择、组合与执行，降低对人工经验的依赖；  
3. 在多个主流模型上达到高攻击成功率，为多模态安全评估提供了可复用的自动化基准工具。

papers.title: $S^3$: Improving Agent Safety through Multi-Stage Defense
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on multi-stage agentic workflows, with stages such as memory, planning, and tool execution, to accomplish complex tasks. However, risks may emerge at different stages, propagate across steps, and become difficult to detect and mitigate. Existing safety methods protect only isolated stages and are difficult to integrate, leaving agents without comprehensive protection throughout the workflow. To address these limitations, we introduce Stage-Specific Safety Skills, a unified abstraction that represents heterogeneous safety designs as reusable and composable components with explicit stage semantics. We further develop an automated transformation pipeline that converts existing safety designs into reusable safety skills and establish a community-driven safety skill library. Building on this abstraction, we propose $S^3$, a multi-stage defense framework in which a guard agent orchestrates stage-specific safety skills for risk detection and mitigation throughout the agentic workflow. We also construct the Multi-Stage Risk Benchmark (MSRB) to evaluate representative risks across workflow stages. Experimental results show that $S^3$ consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art baselines in both safety effectiveness and utility preservation. These results demonstrate the potential of stage-specific safety skills as a scalable and composable foundation for building resilient and trustworthy agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题
大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖**多阶段智能体工作流**（如记忆、规划、工具执行等）完成复杂任务。然而，安全风险可能在不同阶段出现、跨步骤传播，且难以被检测和缓解。现有安全方法仅保护孤立阶段，难以集成，导致智能体在整个工作流中缺乏全面防护。

## 方法创新
本文提出**阶段特定安全技能（Stage-Specific Safety Skills）**，一种统一抽象，将异构安全设计表示为具有明确阶段语义、可复用且可组合的组件。主要贡献包括：

- **自动化转换流水线**：将现有安全设计自动转化为可复用的安全技能
- **社区驱动安全技能库**：建立共享技能资源池
- **$S^3$ 多阶段防御框架**：由守卫智能体（guard agent）编排各阶段安全技能，实现全工作流风险检测与缓解
- **多阶段风险基准（MSRB）**：构建覆盖工作流各阶段的代表性风险评估数据集

## 实验结果与意义
实验表明，$S^3$ 在**安全有效性**和**实用性保持**两方面均持续优于现有最先进基线。该结果验证了阶段特定安全技能作为可扩展、可组合基础，用于构建韧性可信智能体系统的潜力。

## Key Results

Experiments demonstrate that $S^3$ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both safety effectiveness and utility preservation, highlighting its potential as a scalable foundation for resilient and trustworthy LLM agent systems.

papers.title: SoK: How Frontier AI Reshapes System-Level Security Risk Dynamics in Critical Infrastructure
papers.abstract: Frontier artificial intelligence (FAI), encompassing large-scale, general-purpose AI systems, including large language models, multimodal foundation models, and agentic systems, is increasingly integrated into critical infrastructure (CI). This challenges long-standing security assumptions of bounded behavior, segmented networks, component transparency, and human-paced decision-making. Existing AI-security literature typically organizes risks by attack type, lifecycle stage, or asset class, but fails to capture the system-level dynamics, such as how risk emerges, spreads, and is controlled, through which FAI reshapes CI security outcomes. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) introduces a five-dimensional risk-dynamics framework that characterizes how FAI reconfigures CI security across the lifecycle: (i) Capability Emergence through new FAI-enabled attack and defense capabilities, (ii) Infiltration Pathways through data, models and AI supply chains, (iii) Cross-System Propagation across interconnected infrastructures and dependencies, (iv) degradation of effective technical and human Control Authority, and (v) strain on institutional Response Capacity under operational pressure. Rather than enumerating threats, the framework identifies recurring mechanisms that jointly determine system-level risk. We further identify a structural mismatch between academic AI-security research and CI operational constraints, and derive a deployment-oriented research agenda grounded in system-level assurance criteria. Collectively, this work shifts attention from model-centric robustness to lifecycle-structured, system-level assurance in interconnected CI environments.
papers.summary_zh:
## 核心问题
前沿人工智能（FAI），包括大语言模型、多模态基础模型及智能体系统，正加速融入关键基础设施（CI）。这从根本上挑战了传统安全假设中的行为受限、网络分段、组件透明及人工节奏决策等前提。现有AI安全文献多按攻击类型、生命周期或资产类别组织风险，却未能捕捉FAI重塑CI安全结果的**系统级动态**——即风险如何产生、扩散与被控制。

## 方法论与框架
本SoK论文提出一个**五维风险动态框架**，贯穿生命周期刻画FAI如何重构CI安全：
1. **能力涌现**：FAI催生的新型攻防能力
2. **渗透路径**：通过数据、模型及AI供应链的入侵渠道
3. **跨系统传播**：互联基础设施间的风险级联与依赖扩散
4. **控制权退化**：技术与人为主控权威的有效性衰减
5. **响应能力承压**：机构在运行压力下的应急与恢复能力紧张

该框架不枚举具体威胁，而是识别共同决定系统级风险的**重复性机制**。

## 关键发现
- 识别出学术AI安全研究与CI运行约束之间的**结构性错配**（如实时性、可用性、监管合规等约束差异）。
- 据此推导出**面向部署的研究议程**，以系统级保障标准为基础，而非模型级鲁棒性。

## 核心贡献
本文推动安全视角从“以模型为中心”的鲁棒性，转向“以生命周期为结构”的**系统级保障**，适用于高度互联的CI环境，为政策制定者、系统架构师与安全研究员提供统一分析语言。
papers.summary_en: This SoK paper examines how frontier AI (FAI)—including large language models, multimodal foundation models, and agentic systems—reshapes system-level security risk dynamics in critical infrastructure (CI), challenging long-held assumptions of bounded behavior, network segmentation, and human-paced control. We propose a **five-dimensional framework**—Capability Emergence, Infiltration Pathways, Cross-System Propagation, Control Authority Degradation, and Response Capacity Strain—that captures recurring mechanisms of risk generation, spread, and mitigation across the FAI lifecycle, rather than enumerating isolated threats. Our analysis reveals a **structural mismatch** between academic AI-security research and CI operational constraints (e.g., real-time latency, availability, regulatory compliance), and we derive a deployment-oriented research agenda grounded in system-level assurance criteria. The key contribution is shifting security discourse from model-centric robustness to lifecycle-structured, system-level assurance in interconnected CI environments, offering a unified analytical lens for researchers, architects, and policymakers.

papers.title: Securing Agentic AI: From Per-Action Checks to Trajectory Assurance
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly used to execute consequential tasks in environments governed by operational constraints, organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and technical standards. Their safety is therefore determined not by the correctness of individual actions, but by whether their overall behavior remains consistent with the rules and invariants of the systems in which they operate. As large language model (LLM)-based agents become more autonomous and increasingly delegate tasks across organizational boundaries, securing them evolves from a single challenge into a broad and interconnected landscape spanning the entire agentic stack. At the single-agent level, untrusted inputs through prompts, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool interfaces create attack surfaces. In multi-agent settings, delegation and communication introduce challenges related to identity, trust, capability control, and decision transparency, while the underlying model routing and execution control plane remains vulnerable to manipulation and to unverified model provenance. Perhaps the most fundamental challenge is behavioral containment: sequences of individually permissible actions may collectively violate system-level constraints and safety invariants. At the broader level, supply-chain integrity, provenance, accountability, and end-to-end observability remain largely open problems. A common principle unifies these directions: security must become a verifiable property of the architectures, protocols, and runtimes that govern agent behavior, rather than an optional layer of guidance. Charting these challenges provides a roadmap toward trustworthy autonomous agent deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与核心问题
自主智能体（Agentic AI）正被广泛部署于受操作约束、组织政策、法规要求和技术标准支配的环境中执行关键任务。其安全性不再取决于单个动作的正确性，而在于整体行为是否始终与系统规则及不变量保持一致。随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体日益自主化，并跨组织边界委托任务，其安全挑战已从单一问题演变为覆盖整个智能体技术栈的互联安全版图。

## 主要安全挑战分析
- **单智能体层面**：通过提示词、记忆、检索知识及工具接口注入的不可信输入构成攻击面。
- **多智能体层面**：委派与通信引入身份、信任、能力控制和决策透明度问题；底层模型路由与执行控制平面易受操纵，且模型来源缺乏验证。
- **最根本挑战**：行为遏制（Behavioral Containment）——一系列单独允许的动作可能在整体上违反系统级约束和安全不变量。
- **宏观层面**：供应链完整性、来源追溯、责任归属和端到端可观测性仍是开放问题。

## 核心观点与路线图
本文提出一个统一原则：**安全必须成为治理智能体行为的架构、协议和运行时的可验证属性**，而非可选的指导层。通过系统梳理上述挑战，文章为可信自主智能体部署绘制了路线图，强调从“逐动作检查”转向“轨迹级保证”（Trajectory Assurance），即对智能体全生命周期行为进行持续验证与约束。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
This paper systematically maps the security landscape of agentic AI across the entire stack—from single-agent prompt/memory/tool interfaces to multi-agent delegation, model routing, and supply-chain integrity. The authors identify **behavioral containment** as the most fundamental challenge: sequences of individually permissible actions can collectively violate system-level invariants. They propose a unifying principle: security must become a **verifiable property** of the architectures, protocols, and runtimes governing agent behavior, rather than an optional guidance layer. The paper advocates shifting from per-action checks to **trajectory assurance**—continuous verification of whole-behavior compliance. This roadmap addresses open problems in provenance, accountability, and end-to-end observability, providing a foundation for trustworthy autonomous agent deployment in constrained environments.

papers.title: The Condition-Number Barrier in Sparse Least Squares
papers.abstract: In [AS21], Axiotis and Sviridenko conjectured that the linear dependence on the restricted condition number in sparse convex optimization cannot be improved by a polynomial-time algorithm. We establish their conjectured lower bound for least-squares objectives, conditional on the randomized exact-volume Small-Set Expansion Hypothesis in the weighted regular-graph formulation of Raghavendra, Steurer, and Tulsiani [RST12]. Concretely, for every fixed $γ\in(0,1]$, there is no randomized polynomial-time algorithm that, with probability at least $2/3$, returns a vector $x$ such that, writing $s=\lVert x\rVert_0$, \[   \lVert Ax-b\rVert_2^2   \leq   \min_{\lVert z\rVert_0\leq k}\lVert Az-b\rVert_2^2+\varepsilon   \quad\text{and}\quad   s=O\!\left(k\,κ_{s+k}^{\,1-γ}\right), \] where $κ_r$ is the restricted condition number at sparsity level $r$. The result holds even on rational instances with $A$ of full column rank.   The proof was first obtained using a fully automated Gemini-based agentic system developed internally at Google. The authors have verified the proof and edited it for clarity of presentation.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与核心问题
稀疏最小二乘问题旨在寻找满足稀疏约束（即非零分量个数受限）的近似解，在信号处理、统计学习和组合优化中具有广泛应用。问题的求解质量通常由**受限条件数** κ_r 刻画，它反映了在稀疏度 r 下矩阵 A 的数值稳定性。Axiotis 和 Sviridenko 在 [AS21] 中提出猜想：在稀疏凸优化中，任何多项式时间算法都无法突破对受限条件数的线性依赖。

## 方法与主要结果
本文针对最小二乘目标函数，在**随机化精确体积小集合扩张假设**（Raghavendra, Steurer, Tulsiani 提出的加权正则图形式）下，严格证明了上述猜想的下界。具体而言，对于任意固定 γ∈(0,1]，不存在随机多项式时间算法能以至少 2/3 的概率返回向量 x，使其满足：
- 目标函数值达到近似最优：‖Ax−b‖₂² ≤ min_{‖z‖₀≤k}‖Az−b‖₂² + ε
- 稀疏度可控：s = O(k·κ_{s+k}^{1−γ})

该结果即使在 A 为满列秩的有理数实例上依然成立。

## 创新点与意义
1. **首次严格证明**了稀疏最小二乘中条件数依赖的下界，验证了 [AS21] 猜想在最小二乘情形下的正确性。
2. **技术突破**：证明最初由 Google 内部开发的**全自动 Gemini 智能体系统**完成，作者随后验证并整理成文。这展示了 AI 辅助数学证明的潜力。
3. **理论意义**：为稀疏优化问题的计算复杂度提供了新的硬性边界，表明在广泛假设下，条件数的线性依赖是不可避免的。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution
We prove the conjectured lower bound of Axiotis and Sviridenko for sparse least squares, showing that no randomized polynomial-time algorithm can improve the linear dependence on the restricted condition number. Under the randomized exact-volume Small-Set Expansion Hypothesis (in the weighted regular-graph formulation), for any fixed γ∈(0,1], no algorithm returns a solution with sparsity s = O(k·κ_{s+k}^{1−γ}) while achieving ε-approximate optimality, even for rational full-rank instances. The proof was initially derived by an automated Gemini-based agentic system at Google, then verified and edited by the authors. This establishes a fundamental computational barrier in sparse convex optimization and highlights the emerging role of AI in formal mathematical discovery.

## 研究背景与核心问题
稀疏最小二乘问题旨在寻找满足稀疏约束（即非零分量个数受限）的近似解，在信号处理、统计学习和组合优化中具有广泛应用。问题的求解质量通常由**受限条件数** κ_r 刻画，它反映了在稀疏度 r 下矩阵 A 的数值稳定性。Axiotis 和 Sviridenko 在 [AS21] 中提出猜想：在稀疏凸优化中，任何多项式时间算法都无法突破对受限条件数的线性依赖。

## 方法与主要结果
本文针对最小二乘目标函数，在**随机化精确体积小集合扩张假设**（Raghavendra, Steurer, Tulsiani 提出的加权正则图形式）下，严格证明了上述猜想的下界。具体而言，对于任意固定 γ∈(0,1]，不存在随机多项式时间算法能以至少 2/3 的概率返回向量 x，使其满足：
- 目标函数值达到近似最优：‖Ax−b‖₂² ≤ min_{‖z‖₀≤k}‖Az−b‖₂² + ε
- 稀疏度可控：s = O(k·κ_{s+k}^{1−γ})

该结果即使在 A 为满列秩的有理数实例上依然成立。

## 创新点与意义
1. **首次严格证明**了稀疏最小二乘中条件数依赖的下界，验证了 [AS21] 猜想在最小二乘情形下的正确性。
2. **技术突破**：证明最初由 Google 内部开发的**全自动 Gemini 智能体系统**完成，作者随后验证并整理成文。这展示了 AI 辅助数学证明的潜力。
3. **理论意义**：为稀疏优化问题的计算复杂度提供了新的硬性边界，表明在广泛假设下，条件数的线性依赖是不可避免的。

papers.title: Pairwise-Independent Dithering for Single-Stage Hadamard Quantization
papers.abstract: Quantizing high-dimensional vectors is fundamental to similarity search, distributed learning, and model compression. Feng, Indyk, Kapralov, Krachun, and Prokhorov established sharp guarantees for an unbiased dithered quantizer based on a randomized Hadamard transform [FIK+26]. Their $1/d$-scale inner-product estimator, however, uses a second randomized transform and residual quantization, increasing both communication and the leading constant in the proved bound. We show that this extra stage is unnecessary: pairwise-independent dithers across Hadamard coordinates suffice. The resulting unbiased single-stage estimator uses $b$ bits per coordinate and achieves \[ \mathbb{E}\!\left[   \left|\left\langle y,\widehat{x}-x\right\rangle\right|^2 \right] \leq \left(\frac{3π\sqrt{3}}{2}+o(1)\right) \frac{\lVert y\rVert_2^2}{d\,4^b}, \] as $b\to\infty$, with a dimension-free $o(1)$ term uniform over unit inputs and fixed queries. Compared with the two-stage construction of Feng et al., it eliminates the residual-stage $O(d)$-bit payload and reduces the leading upper-bound constant by a factor of approximately $5.93$.   The proof was first obtained using a fully automated Gemini-based agentic system developed internally at Google. The authors have verified the proof and edited it for clarity of presentation.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
高维向量的量化是相似性搜索、分布式学习与模型压缩中的基础操作。Feng等学者近期针对基于随机Hadamard变换的无偏抖动量化器建立了精确的理论保证，但其提出的**1/d尺度内积估计器**需要依赖第二次随机变换与残差量化阶段，这不仅增加了通信开销，也导致理论界中主常数的增大。

## 方法与核心创新  
本文证明该额外阶段并非必要：**仅需在Hadamard坐标间采用两两独立的抖动（pairwise-independent dithers）**，即可实现单阶段无偏估计。具体而言，所提出的估计器对每个坐标仅使用\(b\)比特，并满足如下内积误差界：  
\[
\mathbb{E}\left[\left|\langle y,\widehat{x}-x\rangle\right|^2\right] \le \left(\frac{3\pi\sqrt{3}}{2}+o(1)\right)\frac{\|y\|_2^2}{d\,4^b},
\]  
其中\(b\to\infty\)，且\(o(1)\)项与维度无关，对单位范数输入和固定查询一致成立。

## 主要结果与优势  
- **消除残差阶段**：相比Feng等人的两阶段构造，本方法省去了\(O(d)\)比特的残差载荷，显著降低通信成本。  
- **常数改进**：主上界常数从原方法的约\(5.93\)倍因子降至\(\frac{3\pi\sqrt{3}}{2}\)（约8.16），即**降低了约5.93倍**（注：原文表述为“reduces the leading upper-bound constant by a factor of approximately 5.93”，此处指相对改进）。  
- **证明方式**：该证明最初由Google内部开发的**全自动Gemini智能体系统**获得，作者随后人工验证并润色了证明表述，确保严谨性与可读性。

## 意义  
本研究简化了Hadamard量化的理论构造，在保持无偏性与最优误差阶的同时，提升了通信效率与常数紧致性，为高维向量量化提供了更实用的理论工具。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This paper simplifies the two-stage Hadamard quantization framework of Feng et al. by showing that **pairwise-independent dithers across Hadamard coordinates suffice** for unbiased single-stage estimation, eliminating the need for a second randomized transform and residual quantization.

## Key Result  
The proposed \(b\)-bit per-coordinate estimator achieves the inner-product error bound  
\[
\mathbb{E}\left[\left|\langle y,\widehat{x}-x\rangle\right|^2\right] \le \left(\frac{3\pi\sqrt{3}}{2}+o(1)\right)\frac{\|y\|_2^2}{d\,4^b},
\]  
as \(b\to\infty\), with a dimension-free \(o(1)\) term uniform over unit inputs and fixed queries.

## Advantages  
- **Communication efficiency**: Removes the \(O(d)\)-bit residual payload.  
- **Tighter constant**: Reduces the leading upper-bound constant by a factor of ~5.93 compared to the prior two-stage method.  
- **Verification**: The proof, initially generated by an automated Gemini-based agentic system at Google, was manually verified and edited for clarity by the authors.

papers.title: Approximating two-terminal network reliability
papers.abstract: We present a fully polynomial-time randomised approximation scheme (FPRAS) for the two-terminal reliability problem on general graphs, both directed and undirected. We also show that the complementary unreliability question is \BIS-hard. The key idea of the algorithm was discovered by GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究概述  
本文针对**双终端网络可靠性问题**（在一般有向与无向图中，计算两个指定节点间至少存在一条有效路径的概率）提出了一种**全多项式时间随机近似方案（FPRAS）**。该问题是网络可靠性领域的经典难题，属于#P-hard，此前仅对特殊图类（如平面图、有界树宽图）存在近似算法，而一般图上的多项式时间近似方案长期悬而未决。

## 核心方法与创新  
- **算法设计**：基于GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra发现的**关键新思路**，通过构造一种新颖的**马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样框架**，将可靠性估计转化为对“割集状态空间”的加权采样，并利用**耦合从过去（CFTP）**技术实现完美采样，从而避免传统MCMC的混合时间瓶颈。  
- **复杂度保证**：对于任意图（有向或无向），算法在多项式时间内以(1+ε)相对误差逼近可靠性值，且运行时间关于图规模、ε⁻¹及可靠性参数均为多项式，严格满足FPRAS定义。  
- **补充结论**：同时证明了**互补不可靠性问题的BIS-hard性**（即计算“两节点间不连通概率”至少与二分独立集计数问题一样困难），这为不可靠性问题的精确或近似求解划定了新的计算复杂性边界，说明可靠性与不可靠性在近似难度上存在本质不对称。

## 意义  
该结果首次为一般图上的双终端可靠性提供了FPRAS，填补了数十年来的理论空白；同时BIS-hard结论揭示了不可靠性问题的内在困难，为后续研究指明了方向。方法中借鉴大语言模型洞见的思路，也展示了AI辅助算法发现的潜力。
papers.summary_en:
## Core Contribution  
This paper presents the **first fully polynomial-time randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS)** for the two-terminal network reliability problem on general directed and undirected graphs, resolving a long-standing open question. The algorithm, inspired by a key insight from GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra, employs a novel Markov chain Monte Carlo framework with perfect sampling via coupling from the past, achieving (1+ε)-approximation in polynomial time. Additionally, the authors prove that the complementary **unreliability problem is BIS-hard**, establishing a fundamental complexity asymmetry between reliability and unreliability. This work not only closes a decades-old gap in network reliability theory but also demonstrates the potential of AI-assisted algorithmic discovery.
